20224 - Network Engineer II

Location: Savannah, GA

Company Overview:

Hyundai AutoEver America (HAEA) is the dynamic IT powerhouse behind Hyundai Motor Corporation, a Fortune 500 global leader in the automotive industry. As a key affiliate, we provide cutting-edge IT services and support to top brands including Kia, Genesis, Hyundai Translead, Hyundai Mobis, Hyundai Capital, and Glovis.

HAEA offers a truly global and collaborative environment. Here, you’ll drive innovation, boost operational efficiency, and help shape the future of mobility for the Hyundai Motor Group.

At HAEA, we understand that IT is the cornerstone of today’s fast-evolving digital world. By uniting all IT resources under one roof, we deliver consistent, top-quality solutions while serving as the crucial information link between Hyundai’s Global Headquarters and North American operations.

If you’re passionate about technology and eager to make a real impact at a world-class company, Hyundai AutoEver America is the place to grow your career. Join us and be part of the transformation that’s driving the future of automotive innovation.

Website: http://www.haeaus.com

Role Overview:

The Network Engineer III plays a key role in ensuring the reliability, performance, and security of the organization’s network infrastructure. This position is responsible for supporting the design, implementation, and ongoing maintenance of LAN, WAN, and wireless environments. Working closely with cross-functional IT teams, the Network Engineer II troubleshoots network issues, optimizes performance, and helps implement scalable solutions that align with business needs. The role requires balancing technical requirements with operational priorities while maintaining a secure and resilient network environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Network Design & Implementation: Assist in designing, configuring, and deploying LAN, WAN, and wireless networks, including routers, switches, firewalls, VPNs, and VLANs.
  • Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Monitor network performance, identify and resolve connectivity, latency, and security issues, and ensure minimal downtime and optimal user experience.
  • Security & Compliance: Implement and maintain network security controls (e.g., firewalls, IDS, access controls) and ensure adherence to change management and security policies.
  • Infrastructure Management & Support: Maintain network hardware, communication circuits, and asset inventory, while supporting disaster recovery, backup, and restoration processes.
  • Collaboration & Continuous Improvement: Partner with IT teams to evaluate new technologies, support capacity planning, document configurations, and provide guidance to junior team members.

Scope:

  • Network Operations & Maintenance: Configure, install, and maintain network infrastructure (routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers) to ensure reliable performance.
  • Troubleshooting & Incident Response: Diagnose and resolve connectivity, latency, and outage issues, minimizing downtime and preventing recurrence.
  • Performance Monitoring & Optimization: Monitor network health and traffic to identify bottlenecks and optimize performance proactively.
  • Security & Compliance: Implement and support network security controls, participate in audits, and ensure adherence to security and change management processes.
  • Documentation & Collaboration: Maintain accurate network documentation and work cross-functionally to support integration, projects, and issue resolution.
  • Continuous Improvement & Planning: Support capacity planning, evaluate new technologies, and share knowledge to enhance team capabilities and network efficiency.

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience: Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience as a Network Engineer in enterprise or mid-sized environments.
  • Networking Fundamentals: Strong understanding of core networking concepts and protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, switching).
  • Hardware & Configuration Expertise: Proven ability to configure, manage, and troubleshoot network equipment (e.g., Cisco or similar vendors).
  • Tools & Monitoring: Experience with network monitoring and management tools (e.g., Cisco IOS, WLC, ACS, or similar platforms).
  • Certifications: CCNA (Routing & Switching) required.
  • Problem Solving & Communication: Strong analytical skills with the ability to troubleshoot issues quickly and collaborate effectively across teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, or related field.
  • Additional Certifications: CCNA Wireless, CCNA Voice, Network+, or equivalent certifications.
  • Advanced Technologies: Experience with WiFi-6, 5G networking, or modern wireless solutions.
  • Security Knowledge: Familiarity with network security principles and best practices (firewalls, access control, segmentation).

In addition to a competitive salary, this position offers a fantastic benefits package that includes comprehensive medical/dental coverage, generous PTO, education assistance, and annual merit increase eligibility in a growth-focused work environment.

Team Culture: 

The Network Engineering team operates in a collaborative, fast-paced, and solutions-oriented environment focused on delivering reliable and secure network services. Team members are encouraged to take ownership, work cross-functionally, and continuously improve systems and processes. The culture values technical excellence, accountability, and adaptability, ensuring the team can effectively support evolving business and technology needs.

  • Collaborative & Team-Focused: Strong partnership across IT teams, fostering open communication and shared problem-solving.
  • Reliability & Accountability: Emphasis on ownership, responsiveness, and delivering stable, high-performing network services.
  • Continuous Learning & Innovation: Encourages staying current with emerging technologies and improving processes to enhance efficiency.
  • Proactive Problem Solving: Focus on anticipating issues, optimizing performance, and minimizing disruptions through forward-thinking approaches.

Our Company adheres to the equal employment opportunity guidelines set forth by federal, state and local laws. The information requested on this form is sought in good faith and will not be used to discriminate against the applicant based on race, religion or creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic characteristics, marital status, sex or gender (which includes pregnancy, childbirth, or related circumstances), gender identity, gender expression, age, citizenship, sexual orientation, family care or medical leave status, military and veteran status, political affiliation, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state and local laws.

descriptionHtml:
Category/Area of Expertise: IT & Technology

Job Requisition: 494450

Address: USA-NC-Salisbury-2110 Executive Drive

Store Code: Infrastructure-Network (5118718)

Ahold Delhaize USA, a division of global food retailer Ahold Delhaize, is part of the U.S. family of brands, which includes five leading omnichannel grocery brands - Food Lion, Giant Food, The GIANT Company, Hannaford and Stop & Shop. Our associates support the brands with a wide range of services, including Finance, Legal, Sustainability, Commercial, Digital and E-commerce, Technology and more.

Primary Purpose

The Data Center Network Engineer III is responsible for the design, implementation, administration, optimization, and support of enterprise data center network infrastructure. This senior-level engineer ensures high availability, scalability, performance, and security across mission-critical environments.

Our flexible/hybrid work schedule includes 3 in-person days at one of our core locations and 2 remote days. Our core office location is Salisbury, NC.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain enterprise data center networks.
  • Support spine-leaf architectures and routing/switching technologies.
  • Administer Arista and Cisco network platforms.
  • Deploy and support F5 load balancing solutions.
  • Manage Infoblox DNS, DHCP and IPAM services.
  • Provide Tier III troubleshooting and incident resolution.
  • Implement changes through ServiceNow and participate in CAB processes.
  • Track project deliverables and milestones using Jira.
  • Maintain documentation, diagrams, and operational procedures.
  • Support automation and continuous improvement initiatives.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of network engineering experience.
  • Strong knowledge of BGP, VXLAN, EVPN, VLANs, and QoS.
  • Experience with Arista, Cisco, F5 and Infoblox platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

  • CCNP Enterprise or Data Center
  • CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure or Data Center
  • Arista ACE
  • F5 Certified Administrator
  • Infoblox Certification
  • Hands-on experience with Arista AOS Switches, ZTS, Cloud vision.
  • Experience with F5 BIG-IP-Load Balancers, Infoblox DDI and Threat Prevetion, ServiceNow and Jira.

Salary Range: $125,040 - $187,560

All ADUSA job offers take multiple factors into consideration including, but not limited to salary range, internal equity, a candidate's qualifications, geographic region, job-related knowledge and skills.

This position is eligible for an incentive bonus based on company performance as provided by the plan terms and governing documents.

At Ahold Delhaize USA, we provide services to one of the largest portfolios of grocery companies in the nation, and we're actively seeking top talent.

Our team shares a common motivation to drive change, take ownership and enable our brands to better care for their customers. We thrive on supporting great local grocery brands and their strategies.

Our associates are the heartbeat of our organization. We are committed to offering a welcoming work environment where all associates can succeed and thrive. Guided by our values of courage, care, teamwork, integrity (and even a little humor), we are dedicated to being a great place to work.

We believe in collaboration, curiosity, and continuous learning in all that we think, create and do. While building a culture where personal and professional growth are just as important as business growth, we invest in our people, empowering them to learn, grow and deliver at all levels of the business.

descriptionHtml:
MANTECH seeks a motivated, career and customer-oriented Network Engineer, Centrix to join our team in Doral, FL.

Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To

  • Designing, deploying, configuring, and maintaining enterprise network infrastructure supporting CENTRIXS Combined Federated Server/Combined (CFS/C) capabilities.
  • Managing enterprise routers, switches, firewalls, network crypto devices, and cross-domain coalition network architectures.
  • Troubleshooting complex network routing, switching protocols, coalition data flows, and hardware connectivity issues.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional technical teams, coalition partners, and leadership to ensure secure multinational network interoperability.
  • Conducting routine network maintenance, firmware upgrades, vulnerability patching, and configuration management controls.
  • Maintaining system baselines, configuration management records, and engineering documentation across CENTRIXS network nodes.
  • Recommending and implementing continuous engineering process improvements to enhance coalition network performance and security compliance.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Network Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field with 5+ years of experience in enterprise network engineering.
    • OR a master’s degree and 3+ or more years of relevant experience
    • OR an associate’s degree and 7+ or more years of relevant experience
    • OR a high school diploma and 9+ or more years of relevant experience
  • Proven experience configuring, administering, and troubleshooting CENTRIXS network systems, coalition WAN/LAN environments, or cross-domain networks.
  • Strong background in enterprise routing/switching protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP), VPNs, firewalls, and network access control.
  • Experience maintaining network baselines, baseline documentation controls, and security patch deployment schedules.
  • Experience creating, maintaining, and communicating complex technical engineering documentation and coalition network topology diagrams.
Preferred Qualifications

  • Relevant professional certifications such as Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP Enterprise/Security), or CompTIA Security+.
  • Prior experience supporting U.S. Military Command operations, Combatant Command environments, or multinational coalition networks.
  • Familiarity with DoD STIG compliance, automated vulnerability scanning tools (ACAS), and crypto key management (HAIPE/TACLANE).
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across multi-disciplinary engineering teams in fast-paced operational environments.

Clearance Requirements

  • Must hold a current/active top secret security clearance.

Physical Requirements

  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50%.
  • Needs to occasionally move about inside the office to access file cabinets, office machinery, etc.
  • Frequently communicates with co-workers, management, and customers, which may involve delivering presentations. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations.

This is a hybrid position requiring an on-site presence 3 to 4 days per week. Please note that the number of days on-site can increase based on business needs.

Job Summary

The Senior Network Engineer is responsible for implementing, configuring, and maintaining network infrastructure across the enterprise. This role focuses on hands-on technical work including performance monitoring, issue resolution, and configuration management. The Senior Network Engineer works closely with architecture and security teams to ensure operational excellence and supports the stability, scalability, and security of all network services.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deploy, configure, and maintain enterprise-grade network infrastructure across global data centers and remote sites. (routers, switches, firewalls, wireless, etc.)
  • Monitor and optimize network performance using industry-standard tools to ensure high availability and reliability across diverse time zones.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of network topology, configurations, and operational procedures.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues involving routing, switching, firewalls, wireless systems, and connectivity between international locations.
  • Execute network changes and updates following change management processes.
  • Support the administration of Cisco network gear along with Palo Alto, Checkpoint, and F5 solutions.
  • Perform firmware upgrades, patches, and configuration changes in line with change management protocols.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams—including architecture, security, and cloud operations—to support integrated infrastructure projects.
  • Work with vendors and service providers to maintain uptime and support.
  • Document configuration standards and network diagrams to support scalability and incident response.
  • Provide input on network designs and participate in the evaluation of new technologies.
  • Ensure compliance with security standards and assist in audits or remediation tasks.
  • Serve as a technical escalation point for network-related incidents and problems.
  • Participate in on-call rotation and global incident escalations to ensure 24x7 uptime coverage.

Education Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in information systems, Engineering, Computer Science or a related field of study. Related experience may be considered in lieu of required formal education

Experience

5–7 years of experience in network engineering, including configuration, troubleshooting, and support of enterprise networks.

Licenses/Certifications Required

  • Professional Industry Certifications in the area of Network infrastructure, such as CCNP, CCIE

Licenses/Certifications Preferred

  • Industry Certifications in Networking, Cyber, wireless, telecom, or other infrastructure areas

Technical Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with Cisco routing and switching platforms (Catalyst, Nexus)
  • Configuration and support of Cisco and/or Juniper routers and switches
  • Network monitoring tools (e.g., SolarWinds, NetFlow, Wireshark)
  • Firewall administration (e.g., Palo Alto, Checkpoint, Cisco ASA)
  • Load balancer configuration and troubleshooting (F5 LTM/GTM)
  • Wireless networking (e.g., Cisco, HP/Aruba)
  • IP addressing and protocols: IPv4/IPv6, TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, DNS, DHCP
  • VLANs, STP, HSRP/VRRP, port-channeling
  • TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, BGP, EIGRP, OSPF
  • Network change and incident management processes
  • Familiarity with SD-WAN and basic cloud networking concepts (AWS/GCP/Azure)
  • Network monitoring and packet analysis tools (SolarWinds, Wireshark, NetFlow)
  • Solid understanding of global WAN technologies, VPN, and remote access infrastructure

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field experience.

  • Experience and success in designing, implementing and managing secure networks that employs all modern defenses and capabilities
  • Experience in Software Defined WAN solutions, Hierarchical Enterprise LAN, Low Latency Data Center networks, 802.11 Enterprise Wireless, Cloud Networking, Voice-Over-IP, Network security concepts including Network Access Control, IPsec Tunnels, Client VPN solutions, and Next Generation Firewalls.

  • Has established modern monitoring frameworks and toolsets with dashboards, metrics, and reports across all infrastructure and security areas.

  • Outstanding verbal communication skills; proven ability to communicate effectively at all levels.

Altamira Technologies has a long and successful history providing innovative solutions throughout the U.S. National Security community. Headquartered in McLean, Virginia, Altamira serves the defense, intelligence and homeland security communities worldwide by focusing on creating innovative solutions leveraging common standards in architecture, data and security. Altamira believes that our people and the culture of our company differentiate us from other companies.

Position Location: McLean, VA/Chantilly, VA

Position: Senior Network Engineer

Position Description

We are seeking a Senior Network Engineer responsible for configuration, implementation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of a critical operational network. Provides an engineering resource to support data communications and related applications requirements. Provides administrative support of installed systems/networks. Responsible for planning and implementing the necessary hardware, software and telecommunications equipment to maintain and/or enhance the organization’s networks. Evaluates vendor products and recommends purchases. Recommends and implements network policies and procedures and ensures adherence to security procedures.

Responsibilities

  • Assist in installations, configurations, upgrades, and maintenance of network equipment (switches, firewalls, and load balancers)
  • Monitor network performance and troubleshooting
  • Document network configurations and diagrams
  • Provide technical support to system operators
  • Assist in implementing STIG compliance

Desired Knowledge And Skills

  • TCP/IP Model
  • Routing
  • Switching
  • Multi-chassis groups - Multi-Link Aggregation Domain or Switch Aggregation Groups
  • Link Aggregation Control Protocol 802.3ad
  • VLANs and VLAN Trunking, (802.1q & 802.3ac)
  • Network Time Protocol
  • Troubleshooting
  • Access Control Lists
  • Firewalls
  • Security Zone
  • Security Policies
  • Network Address Translation
  • Troubleshooting
  • Load Balancing
  • Virtual Servers
  • Server Pool
  • Health Checks

Education And Experience

  • Must currently possess a TS/SCI w/CI polygraph.
  • Minimum of Bachelors Degree + 4 years of related experience (Additional experience can be substituted in lieu of degree)

The Company

NorthMark Compute & Cloud (NMC²) is backed by dedicated leadership and investment, with a clear mission as it operates at the bleeding edge of technology. Its goal is to scale and enhance the high-performance computing (HPC) and cloud infrastructure that supports its clients' research, production, and delivery, enabling breakthroughs that shape the industries of tomorrow. Its engineers build critical infrastructure to eliminate friction in scientific research, simulations, analysis, and decision-making, accelerating discovery and driving faster innovation.

The Position

We are seeking a Network Engineer to join our Network and Security Platform Management team, which is responsible for a global network footprint across office, data center and co-location environments. In this position, you will leverage your deep technical expertise in large-scale data center network operations to ensure performance, resilience and scalability. You will play a key role in implementing and supporting cutting-edge networking solutions that support complex compute and research workflows, and work collaboratively across multiple engineering and operations teams.

Responsibilities

  • Implementing and maintaining scalable and resilient data center network infrastructure, built on Cisco and Arista technologies
  • Leading troubleshooting and break/fix efforts for complex enterprise network issues involving routing, switching, firewalls and WAN infrastructure
  • Automating operational tasks, using tools such as Git, Ansible, Python and Jinja2
  • Implementing and managing WAN networks using IOS-XR, segment routing and multitenant design principles
  • Monitoring and proactively managing the health and performance of a global network infrastructure, using modern telemetry and observability tools
  • Supporting and operating Infrastructure-as-Code and CI/CD practices for network provisioning
  • Collaborating with the Network Engineering team to deliver high-quality designs and ensuring the successful roll-out of strategic initiatives
  • Working closely with Data Center, Security and DevOps teams to ensure alignment on infrastructure goals and configurations
  • Mentoring and coaching junior team members; promoting knowledge sharing and documentation across the team
  • Conducting regular network audits and ensuring compliance with internal standards and best practices

Requirements

  • Proven experience operating and engineering large-scale enterprise or data center networks
  • Strong expertise in Cisco and Arista hardware and software platforms, including IOS, IOS-XR, NX-OS and EOS
  • In-depth understanding and hands-on experience with BGP, OSPF, EVPN, VXLAN and MPLS technologies
  • Practical experience in WAN technologies, including SD-WAN, segment routing and multitenancy environments.
  • Basic knowledge in scripting and automation and familiarity with tools like Python, Ansible, Jinja2 and Git
  • Strong diagnostic skills, including packet analysis and performance tuning
  • Experience with network monitoring tools and predictive analysis systems
  • Demonstrated ability to work in Agile and DevOps-oriented environments
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills; comfortable managing priorities in high-pressure scenarios
  • CCNP or equivalent level of certification preferred; CCIE or relevant vendor certifications a strong plus
  • Experience with InfiniBand technology and managing large-scale High Performance Computing (HPC) clusters

The Company also retains the right to require all employees to undertake additional or different job responsibilities when necessary to meet business needs.

Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

  • Company-Paid Lunch Stipend: Lunch is provided via GrubHub
  • Company-Paid Benefits: 100% Employer-Paid Medical in our High Deductible Health Plan, Dental and Vision benefits for employees and their families, 16 weeks of Paid Parental Leave, Employee Assistance Program, Life insurance, Short-Term Disability and Long-Term Disability
  • 401(k): Company will match 100% of your contributions up to 6%
  • Optional Employee-Paid Benefits: Medical insurance in our PPO plan and a variety of other benefits such as Health Savings Accounts (with Company Contribution!), Flexible Spending Accounts, Supplemental Life Insurance, Wellhub and more.

descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about the chance to bring your IT experience to a world-class organization that is leading the way in both content and technology to serve and protect our citizens home and abroad? Do you have the Network Engineering skills necessary to build and maintain virtualized and containerized environments? If you’re a team player with attention to detail and excellent customer service, then Thomson Reuters Special Services (TRSS) is looking for you!

About The Role

As a Network Engineer, you will work as part of a small, agile team to maintain, secure, and optimize our complex network infrastructure. You will collaborate with IT, DevOps, and security teams to ensure our systems remain reliable, performant, and compliant with industry standards. As a Network Engineer, you will also contribute to a variety of areas including:

  • Maintaining, upgrading, configuring, and securing network equipment and software.
  • Ensuring compliance with security guidelines (SOC2, STIG, NIST, etc.).
  • Troubleshooting connectivity and bandwidth issues.
  • Documenting network configurations, processes, and changes and participate in cross‑training.
  • Coordinating with the IT team on infrastructure initiatives.
  • Participating in establishing and enforcing security compliance policies.
  • Performing after-hours maintenance and support when required.

About You

You’re a good fit for the role of Network Engineer if you have/are:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. Equivalent experience will be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Minimum 5 years of network engineering experience.
  • Industry certifications preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of TCP/IP and the OSI model.
  • Experience with AWS networking (Transit Gateway, VPCs, Route53).
  • Familiarity with automation tools (Terraform, Ansible).
  • GitHub experience.
  • Cisco networking platforms (Nexus NX‑OS, Catalyst IOS).
  • Cisco and Palo Alto firewall platforms (Firepower FTD/FMC, PAN‑OS).
  • VMware vSphere networking (distributed switches).
  • Networking for containerized environments.
  • Wireless networking (Wi‑Fi design, security, troubleshooting).
  • High availability networking (LACP).
  • IPsec site‑to‑site VPNs with IKEv2 across different vendors.
  • Remote VPN and SDP solutions (ZTNA).
  • Network and performance monitoring.
  • Network OS patching, updates, hardening.
  • Linux, Apache, Tomcat administration.
  • Scripting (PowerShell, Linux shell).
  • Understanding of programming concepts to support DevOps teams.
  • System monitoring tools (Nagios, Splunk).
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. National Security Clearance
  • U.S. Citizenship essential to comply with government contract/agency or department of Federal Government requirements

What’s in it For You?

  • Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.

companyDescription: Vibrint helps national security customers make the right call – sustaining mission advantage at the forefront of intelligence gathering and analysis. Our teams of technologists, analysts and mission specialists pursue innovation in high-performance computing, SIGINT research and analysis, software and systems development, and mission resilience. descriptionHtml:
Vibrint transforms national security missions through advanced technology, data, and responsible intelligence solutions. Our teams design, secure, deploy, and sustain critical capabilities that enable faster, more informed mission decisions across some of the nation's most complex operational environments. By joining this prime contract, you'll help modernize and support secure systems, networks, laboratories, and fielded infrastructure serving mission users at customer and remote locations.

As a Network Engineer, you will configure, deploy, and sustain network infrastructure supporting two operational customers. Working alongside government and contractor teammates, you will support Cisco and Arista devices, firewalls, and cryptographic equipment across local and remote environments. You'll combine hands-on lab work with operational troubleshooting and help design modern network environments as the team transitions from legacy systems toward containerized and cloud technologies where appropriate. Your primary work location will be our contractor facility in Columbia, Maryland, with frequent work at the customer facility in NBP320. You'll also end your day knowing that you're doing work that truly matters.

Position requires an active TS/SCI clearance with a Full Scope Polygraph (FSP).

Responsibilities

  • Configure, administer, troubleshoot, and sustain Cisco and Arista network infrastructure.
  • Provide ongoing operational support for network devices, firewalls, and cryptographic equipment.
  • Configure and test new equipment in the contractor lab before deployment.
  • Support on-site and remote fielding of equipment at customer and partner locations.
  • Develop and validate configurations for new systems and infrastructure upgrades.
  • Help design network architectures and support modernization of legacy environments.
  • Support the adoption of containerized and cloud environments where appropriate for customer requirements.
  • Review operational updates, coordinate priorities with teammates, and resolve Jira tickets.
  • Travel occasionally, as needed, to locations outside the continental United States (OCONUS).
  • Participate in on-call support for operational systems once trained and familiar with the environment.

Qualifications

  • Experience configuring and sustaining Cisco and Arista network devices.
  • Experience troubleshooting network infrastructure and supporting equipment deployment and operations.
  • Ability to collaborate with government and contractor teammates supporting local and remote systems.
  • Availability to work primarily in Columbia, Maryland, with frequent work at NBP320.
  • Willingness and ability to travel occasionally to OCONUS locations and participate in on-call support.
  • A current IAT Level I certification.
  • Active TS/SCI with polygraph level clearance.
  • Candidates must meet one of the following education and experience combinations:
    • Sixteen (16) years of network engineering experience without a degree; or
    • A bachelor's degree, plus twelve (12) years of network engineering experience; or
    • A master's degree, plus ten (10) years of network engineering experience.
Desired Skills

  • Experience with Cisco Call Manager.
  • Experience configuring and supporting Cisco ASA firewalls.
  • Experience with network design and architecture.
  • Experience automating repetitive tasks, inventory collection, and compliance activities.
  • Experience with cloud technologies, hyperconverged infrastructure, or containerized environments.
  • Familiarity with Latte 'Art and supporting STE/STN devices and associated SSP compliance requirements.

___________________________________________________________________

The pay range for this position is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Our approach to crafting offers considers various factors to provide an equitable and competitive comprehensive compensation package. These considerations include, but are not limited to, contracted rates, education, certification(s), experience, specific competencies required for this position, and geographic location.

Vibrint's comprehensive compensation package includes but is not limited to: competitive salary; annual merit-based salary increase and discretionary bonus program; 401(k) plan with a company maximum 9% contribution; 11 paid federal holidays; 160 hours of paid time off; medical, dental, vision, life and short- & long-term disability insurance; employee assistance program; and a generous professional development allowance.

Equal Opportunity Employer

All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, family structure, marital status, disability, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by law in all phases of the employment process and in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations.

An equal opportunity employer/disability/vet. Policy-Statement_EEO-EmployeesAndCandidates.pdf (vibrint.com).

Please apply for immediate consideration.

descriptionHtml:
SUMMARY

The Senior Network & Infrastructure Engineer owns the network that connects Kids2's US offices, the Suwanee data center, Azure, Hong Kong, mainland China and Mexico. This is a senior, hands-on role on a small Global IT team, owning network architecture and the roadmap as well as firewalls, WAN and site-to-site tunnels, remote access VPN, and Meraki wired and wireless networks.


PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES AND ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Own the network architecture, design standards and roadmap across all sites.
  • Lead network projects such as China connectivity and WAN and firewall refreshes, from design through cutover.
  • Manage carriers and network vendors, and give input on the network budget.
  • Administer FortiGate and Cisco ASA/FTD (FMC) firewalls, including rules, policies, upgrades and change requests.
  • Review firewall rules and logs, and keep configurations backed up and documented.
  • Operate the IPsec tunnels and carrier-managed WAN (DTNaaS) between the US, Azure, Hong Kong and China.
  • Troubleshoot tunnel, routing and circuit issues, and work with carriers on outages and changes.
  • Own Cisco Secure Client and Meraki client VPN, including configuration, client deployment, upgrades and user issues.
  • Administer Cisco Meraki MX, MS and MR across all sites, including SSIDs, VLANs, switching, alerts and inventory.
  • Operate certificate-based Wi-Fi (SCEPman, RADIUS/NPS) and work with the endpoint team on the device profiles that deliver certificates.
  • Plan and lead office network buildouts and moves with the manager and regional IT staff.
  • Renew public and internal certificates, including SAP system certificates.
  • Manage internal and external DNS.
  • Submit changes through Jira Service Management, review other network changes before they go through, and write runbooks for every system owned.
  • Serve as the final technical escalation point for network issues.
  • Mentor the help desk and regional IT staff on network work.
  • Take part in after-hours maintenance windows across US and Asia business hours.


QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

  • 7 or more years of network engineering experience in a multi-site company.
  • Production experience administering FortiGate or Cisco firewalls, site-to-site IPsec VPN and WAN routing.
  • Experience with Cisco Meraki (MX, MS and MR) and remote access VPN such as Cisco Secure Client.
  • Experience with network connectivity into mainland China and Azure networking.
  • Experience leading network projects and managing carriers and vendors is preferred.


EDUCATION & SKILLS

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Certificate lifecycle and DNS administration; 802.1X wireless with RADIUS and certificate-based authentication.
  • Clear written documentation and the ability to work with regional IT staff across time zones.


CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

  • CCNP, Fortinet NSE 6 or NSE 7 preferred.


COMPUTER/TECHNICAL SKILLS

  • Must be proficient with FortiGate, Cisco ASA/FTD and FMC, Cisco Meraki, Cisco Secure Client and IPsec VPN. Working knowledge of RADIUS/NPS, SCEPman, DNS, Azure networking, Jira Service Management, and PowerShell or Python for network tasks.


PHYSICAL DEMANDS

  • While performing the duties of this job, the team member is regularly required to talk or hear.
  • The team member frequently is required to sit; have flexible use of hands; reach with hands and arms; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.
  • The team member is occasionally required to stand and walk.
  • The team member must regularly lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds, including racking network hardware.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.


WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • General office environment in Atlanta, GA (hybrid)
  • Regular on-site work at the Suwanee data center
  • After-hours maintenance windows across US and Asia business hours

CarShield is seeking an experienced Network Engineer to join its growing Infrastructure team. descriptionHtml:
About Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analysis that provide clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns.

Position Overview

The Information Technology (ITS) team at CRA is currently a Global team of 40 professionals dedicated to enhancing, maintaining, and developing the firm's technology infrastructure and security. The team is comprised of four functions: Service Delivery & Telecom, Enterprise Application Solutions, Infrastructure, Networking and Cloud Services and Security. Information Technology staff are based in the Boston, Chicago, London, Munich, New York, Oakland, and Washington, DC offices.

Responsibilities

We are seeking an experienced Network Engineer to join our small global networking team. The successful candidate will bring in-depth, hands-on expertise in planning, designing, implementing, documenting, securing, and troubleshooting enterprise network systems across campus, data center, wireless, WAN, and cloud environments. This position supports day-to-day operations and maintenance, advances security initiatives, and collaborates with IT colleagues and business stakeholders on a global scale. Typical responsibilities include:

  • Design, install, configure, test, document, and maintain secure network infrastructure across on-premises and cloud environments;
  • Identify, diagnose, and resolve complex network, wireless, firewall, DNS, and connectivity issues;
  • Produce and maintain Microsoft Visio network diagrams, implementation plans, configuration standards, and as-built documentation;
  • Administer and use Nexus Dashboard, Catalyst Center, Infoblox, and other management platforms for visibility, configuration, assurance, and lifecycle activities;
  • Maintain accurate configuration records, inventories, circuit information, support documentation, and vendor contacts;
  • Plan and execute upgrades while minimizing service disruption and maintaining tested rollback procedures;
  • Develop, implement, and maintain policies, procedures, and training plans for network resource administration, appropriate use, and disaster recovery;
  • Ensure network hardware, software, firmware, and configurations are current, supportable, and secure;
  • Monitor and test network performance and provide meaningful performance statistics, reports, and recommendations;
  • Coordinate with internal teams and external vendors to deliver projects and resolve incidents;
  • Coordinate across other teams within the IT department and across the firm; some travel to other CRA offices will be expected;
  • Some out-of-hours and weekend work will be required for scheduled upgrades and in response to unexpected outages.

Desired Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree (Master's desirable) in Computer Science, Information Systems or related discipline;
  • 4-6 years relevant work experience, preferably in a professional services environment;
  • Current Cisco certification at the CCNA level or a demonstrated track record of maintaining Cisco certifications at or above the CCNA level is required; CCNP preferred, relevant Microsoft Azure and AWS certifications highly desired;
  • Demonstrated knowledge of secure LAN/WAN, campus, data center, wireless, and cloud networking operations;
  • Hands-on experience designing, implementing, and supporting networking in both Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS);
  • Hands-on experience with Cisco Nexus data center switching, Cisco Catalyst switching, Cisco Catalyst wireless, and Cisco Firepower firewalls;
  • Experience with network management and automation platforms, including Cisco Nexus Dashboard, Cisco Catalyst Center, and Infoblox;
  • Demonstrated skill designing and documenting logical and physical networks using Microsoft Visio;
  • Strong practical knowledge of Cisco enterprise networking platforms across LAN/WAN, data center, wireless, firewall, and most importantly, cloud-connected environments;
  • Proficiency with network protocols and technologies, including Spanning Tree, DNS, DHCP, BGP, OSPF, HSRP, LACP, SNMP, NTP, IPsec VPN, and QoS;
  • Experience creating, reviewing, implementing, and troubleshooting firewall policies, preferably using Cisco Firepower;
  • Ability to create and maintain accurate network topology, rack, connectivity, and as-built documentation using Microsoft Visio;
  • Ability to propose and clearly communicate changes to existing network topology that improve availability, security, performance, and operational supportability;
  • Familiarity with ITIL change management practices, implementation planning, rollback planning, and pre-change risk assessment;
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across Layers 1 through 7, including packet capture and network performance analysis;
  • Must be comfortable in customer-facing scenarios and effectively collaborating in cross-functional technical teams;
  • Self-motivated, with a strong ability to prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment;
  • Ability to travel to other offices and execute project plans with minimal oversight.

Additional Preferred Skills

  • Demonstrated strong knowledge with Microsoft Azure networking, including virtual networks, routing, network security controls, and hybrid connectivity;
  • Demonstrated strong knowledge with Amazon Web Services networking, including VPCs, routing, security controls, and hybrid connectivity;
  • Cisco Nexus data center switches and Nexus Dashboard;
  • Cisco Catalyst switches, Catalyst wireless infrastructure, and Catalyst Center;
  • Cisco Firepower firewalls; Palo Alto firewall experience is also valued;
  • Infoblox DNS, DHCP, and IP address management (IPAM);
  • Cisco ISE and 802.1X network access control;
  • Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN;
  • Kemp LoadMaster load balancers;
  • Cisco Umbrella;
  • PKI, certificate lifecycle management, domain registration, DNS, and 802.1X fundamentals.

To Apply

To Be Considered For This Position, We Require

  • Resume – please include current address, personal email and telephone number;
  • Work Product (optional, submitted in cover letter field) – submit a sample set of diagrams generated with Visio.

Career Growth And Benefits

  • CRA’s robust skills development programs, encompassing both formal and informal programs, encourage you to thrive as an individual and team member. Training includes technical training, presentation skills, internal seminars, and career mentoring and performance coaching from an assigned senior colleague. Additional leadership and collaboration opportunities exist through internal firm development activities.
  • We offer a comprehensive total rewards program including a superior benefits package, wellness programming to support physical, mental, emotional and financial well-being, and in-house immigration support for foreign nationals and international business travelers.

Work Location Flexibility

CRA creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognize that individuals realize a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently expect that individuals spend at least 3 to 4 days a week working in the office (which may include traveling to another CRA office or to client meetings), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.

Responsible AI Use in Recruiting

We believe that recruiting is fundamentally a human process, and we are committed to a hiring process that is fair, transparent, and people-focused. While AI and other technology-enabled tools help our team operate more efficiently, we strive to provide every candidate with a personalized, thoughtful, and high-touch experience. As CRA invests significant human effort to find qualified members for our teams, we expect candidates to invest corresponding human effort to learn about CRA, prepare thoughtful application materials, and engage with our interviewers. Read more about appropriate hiring manager, recruiting team, and candidate AI at CRA on our website.

Our Commitment to Equal Employment Opportunity

Charles River Associates is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

Salary And Other Compensation

A good-faith estimate of the annual base salary range for this position is $130,000-$152,500. Starting pay within this range may vary based on factors such as education level, experience, skills, geographic location, market conditions, and other qualifications of the successful candidate. This position is eligible for additional bonus incentive compensation. CRA offers a comprehensive benefits package, subject to eligibility requirements, which includes: medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) retirement plan with employer match; life and disability insurance; paid time off (vacation, sick leave, holidays); paid parental leave; wellness programs and employee assistance resources; and commuter benefits.

The Corporate Enterprise Network (WAN): Network Engineer – Senior provides senior-level network engineering, implementation, modernization, and sustainment support for a DoD customer's global classified and unclassified WAN infrastructure. Responsible for ensuring secure, reliable connectivity between DoD facilities, networks, cloud environments, and mission-critical enterprise services.

Responsibilities Include

  • Design, configure, install, test, and maintain enterprise WAN routers, switches, firewalls, and associated infrastructure.
  • Support WAN connectivity across classified and unclassified networks as well as connectivity with DISN, NIPRNet, SIPRNet, and other DoD networks.
  • Configure and troubleshoot advanced routing and switching technologies, including BGP, OSPF, MPLS, multicast, QoS, and IPv4/IPv6.
  • Engineer and maintain Cisco networking platforms and Check Point firewall technologies.
  • Implement network technology refreshes, equipment replacements, and infrastructure modernization.
  • Perform Tier III/IV troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and restoration of network services.
  • Provide 24x7x365 on-call engineering support as required.
  • Conduct site surveys, infrastructure assessments, installation planning, and implementation activities.
  • Support DISA circuit provisioning, testing, activation, and troubleshooting.
  • Develop Engineering Change Requests, implementation plans, test plans, rollback procedures, and network diagrams.
  • Apply DISA STIGs, agency configuration standards, and cybersecurity requirements to network devices.
  • Evaluate network capacity, utilization, performance, and potential reliability improvements.
  • Support enterprise cloud connectivity, application delivery, and secure network integration.
  • Conduct laboratory testing, technology evaluations, and interoperability validation.
  • Provide technical support to Government and contractor WAN Management, NOC personnel, and other engineering teams.
  • Travel to CONUS or OCONUS locations for network installation or troubleshooting as required.

Required Skills, Qualifications And Experience

  • Experience:
    • Five years of progressive IT experience, including at least two projects involving Network and Telecommunications Services and Network Management. At least one qualifying project must have occurred within the previous three years.
  • Education:
    • High School Diploma.
  • Citizenship and Clearance:
    • US Citizenship is required.
    • DoD Top Secret clearance or Secret clearance with favorably adjudicated Tier 5/SSBI investigation.
  • Certification:
    • DoD 8570/8140: IAT Level III baseline certification.
    • Cisco Certified Network Professional – Enterprise (CCNP-E).
  • Location and Travel:
    • Candidates must be able to work onsite daily in Pearl Harbor, HI.
    • Travel of up to approximately 40% may be required, both CONUS and OCONUS for network installation or troubleshooting as required.
Preferred Qualifications

  • Check Point Certified Security Administrator (CCSA) or higher certification.
    • If not attained prior to hire, must be attained after hire.
  • AWS Cloud Practitioner
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals
  • CompTIA Cloud+.
Work Environment And Physical Demand

  • Must be able to work from a computer for extended periods.
  • Must be able to work from office, comm closet, warehouse, and other environments associated with network deployment and sustainment.

The projected salary range for this position is $140,000+ annually. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including years of relevant experience, active security clearance level, certifications, technical skillset, contract requirements, and overall qualifications.

At AGE Solutions, we reward performance, invest in growth, and share success. Our benefits support the whole person, professionally, financially, and personally.

  • 26 Days Paid Leave: Includes vacation, sick, personal time, and holidays. You choose how to use it.
  • Performance Bonuses: Performance bonuses are awarded based on individual contributions and company-wide results, aligning recognition with impact.
  • 401(k) with Match: We match 3% of your contributions with immediate vesting.
  • Financial Protection: Company-paid life insurance up to $300K and options for additional coverage for you and your dependents.
  • Health Benefits: Multiple medical plans, dental, vision, FSA and HSA options to fit your needs.
  • Parental Leave: 15 days of fully paid leave for new parents, because family matters.
  • Military Differential Pay: We bridge the gap for employees on active duty, so they don’t take a financial hit while serving.
  • Professional Growth: Paid training and certifications, tuition reimbursement, and the tools and tech to get the job done right.
  • Shared Success: In the event of a company sale, our CEO has committed to returning 80% of net proceeds to employees. This ensures our team shares in the long term value they help create.

At AGE, you’ll do work that matters, supported by a company that delivers for its people.

SUMMARY:

The Senior Network Engineer designs, implements, supports, and improves enterprise network infrastructure across voice, data, LAN, WAN, and Wi-Fi environments. This role is responsible for evaluating new technologies and providing hands-on engineering, operational support, and troubleshooting for Cisco, Extreme, and HP networks across the Gillette Stadium campus in Foxborough, MA, and all TKG companies and locations, including TKG, NEP, KSE, IFP, KAGR, and residential sites.

Duties And Responsibilities

  • Evaluate and recommend new technologies to enhance current capabilities. Design and deploy wired and wireless network infrastructure solutions for both public and private environments, including fiber-based backhaul solutions.
  • Track network roadmaps, manage RFQs and benchmarks, and support strategic planning for future infrastructure improvements.
  • Resolve issues related to traffic flow, security, backhaul, and mobile data offloading. Provide engineering support across a broad range of programs by analyzing, planning, implementing, maintaining, troubleshooting, and enhancing complex network systems.
  • Develop security policies for trusted and untrusted Wi-Fi access and continuously improve network security in alignment with industry best practices. Maintain and protect personally identifiable information and other confidential data in accordance with applicable privacy regulations, including HIPAA and Massachusetts privacy requirements.
  • Receive assignments in the form of objectives and establish plans to meet defined goals, timelines, and schedules. Work on complex problems requiring in-depth analysis of technical and operational factors.
  • Manage structured cabling infrastructure, telecommunications systems, and third-party support vendors.
  • Maintain and monitor network and security management systems, respond to incidents, events, and alerts, manage asset inventories, and keep system and network diagrams and documentation current.
  • Special projects and assignments as business dictates
  • Responsible for the creation, maintenance and control of all personal identifiable information or any other information protected by Confidentiality and Privacy Standards see Mass Regulations on Personal Identity Regulations and HIPAA

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

Skills And Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field preferred.
  • 10+ years of experience as a Network Engineer.
  • 5+ years of experience architecting large-scale wireless infrastructure, including outdoor or carrier-grade Wi-Fi environments. Strong knowledge of wireless standards such as 802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax and wireless LAN design, including site surveys.
  • 5+ years of experience with Layer 2 protocols, including STP, 802.1d/s/w, 802.1q, LACP, and 802.1x, as well as Layer 3 protocols such as IPv4/IPv6, TCP, UDP, ARP, HSRP/VRRP, SNMP, and NAT.
  • 5+ years of experience with routing protocols such as OSPF, BGP, ECMP, and VRFs, along with experience in stateful firewalls, non-stateful filtering, and packet inspection.
  • Experience with network monitoring and management platforms, including SolarWinds. Proficiency with Cisco routers, switches, Cisco FTD next-generation firewalls (NGFW), Cisco Firepower Management Center (FMC), Microsoft Azure networking and cloud infrastructure, Catalyst Center, Cisco ISE, HP switches, Aruba ClearPass, Extreme Networks, and network automation tools.
  • Strong understanding of the OSI model, IT standards, procedures, and policies. Ability to work independently, make sound technical decisions, communicate effectively, document work clearly, and manage multiple priorities with strong attention to detail.
  • Must be able to learn new tasks quickly, complete assignments independently, and make timely decisions within the context of operational workflows.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.
  • This role is based on site at the corporate office in Foxboro, MA.
  • The position operates in a fast-paced office environment.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

  • CCNP or equivalent preferred
  • CCIE or equivalent preferred

Other Duties

This job description is not intended to be a comprehensive list of all duties, responsibilities, or activities required for the role. Duties and responsibilities may change at any time, with or without notice.

This company is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.

descriptionHtml:
Hyve Company Overview

Hyve Solutions transforms complex engineering challenges into production reality for technology innovators building AI, cloud, and connected infrastructure. As a US-based manufacturing partner, the company rapidly delivers fast, agile execution through dep technical partnerships and co-innovation, and supply chain clarity. Hyve’s integrated ODM, CM, and SI capabilities eliminate vendor complexity while accelerating time-to-market with single-partner accountability from design through scale. The company co-innovates with deep engineering expertise, treating customer success as its own while building tomorrow's digital infrastructure.

Position Summary

The Senior Network Engineer is responsible for the design, implementation, security, and support of enterprise network infrastructure across corporate offices, manufacturing facilities, warehouses, and data centers globally. This role will lead network architecture, operational excellence, infrastructure modernization, cybersecurity initiatives, and major infrastructure projects while ensuring high availability and business continuity.

This role is ideal for a hands-on engineer who can architect and support enterprise-scale networks while driving infrastructure modernization, security, and operational excellence across a global organization.

This position will be onsite 5 days a week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, and support enterprise network infrastructure solutions across global locations.
  • Manage and maintain LAN, WAN, WLAN, SD-WAN, VPN, and data center network environments.
  • Configure, support, and troubleshoot Cisco, Arista, and Fortinet networking platforms.
  • Administer and optimize routing, switching, wireless, firewall, DNS, DHCP, and network security services.
  • Lead network lifecycle management, hardware refreshes, capacity planning, and infrastructure upgrades.
  • Manage and maintain network infrastructure systems, including switching, Wi-Fi, firewalls, VMware, SAN, and storage platforms.
  • Strengthen cybersecurity posture through implementation of security controls, segmentation, vulnerability remediation, and compliance requirements.
  • Monitor network performance, availability, and reliability while driving continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Lead infrastructure projects, site expansions, migrations, and major incident response efforts.
  • Perform root cause analysis for critical outages and develop long-term corrective actions.
  • Collaborate with cloud, systems, cybersecurity, and manufacturing teams to deliver secure and scalable solutions.
  • Manage vendor relationships, service providers, support contracts, and technical escalations.
  • Develop and maintain network documentation, standards, diagrams, and operating procedures.
  • Participate in on-call support and after-hours maintenance activities as required.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 8+ years of experience in enterprise network engineering and infrastructure support.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Cisco, Arista, Fortinet, and enterprise wireless technologies.
  • Deep knowledge of TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, VLANs, VPNs, DNS, DHCP, QoS, and network security principles.
  • Experience supporting multi-site manufacturing, warehouse, enterprise, or data center environments.
  • Strong troubleshooting, project management, and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration abilities.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with SD-WAN technologies and cloud networking in Azure and AWS.
  • Experience with VMware, SAN, storage, virtualization, and enterprise infrastructure platforms.
  • Certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, Fortinet NSE/FCP, Aruba, or Arista ACE.
  • Experience supporting ISO 27001 compliance, security audits, information security governance, and risk management programs.
  • Experience with infrastructure automation and network monitoring tools.


Compensation

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $120,000-180,000 annually. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, qualifications, and business needs.

What’s in it for you

Benefit Insurance

  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • Health Savings Account (HSA)
  • Mental Health Care
  • 401K with match
  • Paid Holidays, Vacation & Sick Days
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Perks at Work
  • LEAP Program
  • MyFlexPay


We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

(on-site 5 days per week, Chantilly, VA: TS/SCI Clearance required)

Job summary

If you enjoy working with new technologies, enterprise-leading equipment, and seek to optimize systems to achieve maximum performance, we would like to speak to you. This position will play a key role in driving the performance, stability, and scalability of next-generation networks to support Information Technology (IT) workloads.

You will join a diverse team of software and platform engineers to design, deploy, and maintain network infrastructure. You will collaborate with people inside and outside the organization to deliver the highest standards for building, deploying, and scaling networks.

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Network Engineer to join our team. As a key member of the Networking team, you will play a critical role in implementing and supporting robust network infrastructure solutions.

Key Job Responsibilities

  • Deploy, configure, troubleshoot, and maintain Layer 2/3 data center architectures using BGP, VLANs, MLAG, LAG, Spine/Leaf topologies, Trunk/Access ports, and other related technologies.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into effective network solutions.
  • Stay updated on the latest networking trends and best practices; proactively seek out new learning opportunities to enhance technical expertise.
  • Contribute to the documentation of network infrastructure designs and configurations for future reference and knowledge sharing among team members.
  • Travel up to 25% of the time, as required, to perform on-site installations, maintenance, and troubleshooting activities at customer sites or data centers.

Required Qualifications

  • Proven experience in deploying, configuring, and managing Layer 2/3 Data Center architectures.
  • Expertise in VLAN, MLAG (Multi-Chassis Link Aggregation Group), LAG (Link Aggregation Group) configuration, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience with Spine and Leaf architecture design and implementation.
  • Strong understanding of Trunk/Access ports, their functions, and how to configure them for optimal performance in various network environments.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills; ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to travel up to 25% of the time, as required.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and commitment to quality work.
  • Ability to stay updated on industry trends and technology advancements; willingness to continue learning new things.
  • Active TS/SCI and the ability to maintain access as required by the program
  • Candidates must be able to lift to 25lbs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience deploying, managing, and monitoring a diverse ecosystem of networking technologies to guarantee maximum availability, performance, and security of the network.
  • Proficiency with network telemetry and analysis tools (Wireshark, SNMP, NetFlow, and Solarwinds) for deep packet inspection and network optimization.
  • Extensive hands-on experience configuring enterprise-grade core/edge routers, firewalls, and switches (Cisco, Juniper, and Arista).
  • Experience implementing secure WAN transport mechanisms such as IPSEC site-to-site VPNs, GRE/DMVPN tunnels, QoS traffic shaping, and ACL policies.
  • In depth experience deploying and troubleshooting core dynamic routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP), MPLS, and modern SD-WAN platforms (Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN\VIPTELA, Fortinet, or Silver Peak) to manage multisite enterprise traffic and WAN edge connectivity.

We offer

  • A dynamic and collaborative working environment that fosters professional growth and development.
  • Opportunities for personal and technical skill enhancement through ongoing training and professional development opportunities.
  • A supportive and inclusive team culture that values diversity and encourages individual contributions.

If you are passionate about networking, have a strong technical background, and thrive in a collaborative environment, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

Pay Range: There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at ELEVI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At ELEVI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits. Learn more here.

The proposed salary range for this position is:

$185,000-240,000

Why Work at ELEVI?

To become an ELEVI employee is to become an integral part of the team. From Federal to Commercial, ELEVI offers our employees the ability to expand skills and fully engage their minds and passions. Each member of the team enjoys the opportunity to expand their career to meet their individual goals and objectives. We celebrate the ideas that bring about positive change, and the diverse talents and backgrounds that come together to create those ideas.

Our benefit packages encompass competitive compensation, financial and counseling services, retirement options, and health insurance programs. Coupled with work/life benefits to address significant life problems as well as everyday problems involved in juggling work, family, and life. We trust you to take the time you need when you feel it's appropriate. No need to keep track or save up. We trust our employees and empower them to shape their work themselves so that we can achieve the best possible results.

It is the policy of ELEVI to provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and employment applicants—without regard to unlawful considerations of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, sensory, physical or mental disability, marital status, veteran or military status, genetic information, or any other classification protected by applicable local, state, or federal laws. Senior Network Engineer, Trading Infrastructure

Location: Chicago

Type: Full time, Permanent

Team: Network Engineering / Network Automation


A leading global trading firm is seeking a Senior Network Engineer to design, build, operate and evolve the network infrastructure behind its trading business. This is a hands-on role for an engineer who enjoys solving hard problems across low latency networking, automation, WAN connectivity and global data centre environments.


The successful candidate will work on critical projects that help the firm scale, improve performance and stay ahead in a highly competitive trading environment. descriptionHtml:

We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Senior Network Engineer to join our IT team and lead the design, deployment, and management of mission-critical network infrastructure. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in enterprise networking and hands-on experience with leading solutions/technologies provided by Cisco, Palo Alto, and Aruba. This position requires a proactive professional who can ensure high availability, performance, and security across our global network infrastructure

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and support enterprise-grade network solutions, with a focus on scalability, security, and performance.
  • Administer and maintain Cisco Catalyst switches and Aruba wireless infrastructure to support wired and wireless connectivity across multiple locations.
  • Manage and secure network perimeters using Palo Alto firewalls and configure site-to-site and client-based VPN connections.
  • Monitor network health and performance using SolarWinds or other monitoring tools; respond to alerts and resolve issues proactively.
  • Lead infrastructure upgrade projects, network segmentation, and expansion efforts, ensuring minimal disruption to operations.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate network services with cloud and hybrid environments.
  • Conduct in-depth troubleshooting and root cause analysis for complex network issues, including hardware, software, and configuration anomalies.
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive network documentation, including topology diagrams, IP schemas, and operational procedures.
  • Ensure compliance with security standards and assist with internal/external audits as required.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
  • 7+ years of experience in enterprise network engineering roles.
  • Strong expertise with Cisco Catalyst switches and Aruba wireless technologies.
  • Proven experience configuring and managing Palo Alto Networks firewalls and VPN solutions.
  • Proficient in network monitoring and alerting using SolarWinds or similar platforms.
  • Solid understanding of Layer 2/3 protocols, including VLANs, STP, BGP, OSPF, and EIGRP.
  • Familiarity with security frameworks, access control policies, and segmentation strategies.
  • Experience supporting networks in hybrid or cloud environments (AWS/AWS GovCloud, Azure, or GCP) is a plus.
  • Excellent communication, organizational, and documentation skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a dynamic environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced degrees or certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, or PCNSE
  • Experience with Zero Trust Network Architecture (ZTNA) design and SASE/SSE implementation.
  • Working knowledge of network automation using scripting tools (e.g., Python, Ansible).
  • Familiarity with NAC (Network Access Control) solutions and 802.1X implementations.
  • Prior experience supporting IT operations in regulated industries (e.g., defense, healthcare, finance).
  • Exposure to SD-WAN, IPAM, and advanced QoS configurations.
  • Experience with disaster recovery and business continuity planning for network services.

  • Competitive Salary: Industry-standard salaries with opportunities for performance-based bonuses
  • Retirement Plan: 401(k) plan with company match
  • Stock Options: Equity options to give employees a stake in the company’s success
  • Life and Disability Insurance: Basic life insurance and short- and long-term disability coverage

Altamira believes that our people and the culture of our company differentiate us from other companies.

Position Location: McLean, VA/Chantilly, VA

Position: Senior Network Engineer

Position Description

We are seeking a Senior Network Engineer responsible for configuration, implementation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of a critical operational network. Provides an engineering resource to support data communications and related applications requirements. Provides administrative support of installed systems/networks. Responsible for planning and implementing the necessary hardware, software and telecommunications equipment to maintain and/or enhance the organization’s networks. Evaluates vendor products and recommends purchases. Recommends and implements network policies and procedures and ensures adherence to security procedures.

Responsibilities

  • Assist in installations, configurations, upgrades, and maintenance of network equipment (switches, firewalls, and load balancers)
  • Monitor network performance and troubleshooting
  • Document network configurations and diagrams
  • Provide technical support to system operators
  • Assist in implementing STIG compliance

Desired Knowledge And Skills

  • TCP/IP Model
  • Routing
  • Switching
  • Multi-chassis groups - Multi-Link Aggregation Domain or Switch Aggregation Groups
  • Link Aggregation Control Protocol 802.3ad
  • VLANs and VLAN Trunking, (802.1q & 802.3ac)
  • Network Time Protocol
  • Troubleshooting
  • Access Control Lists
  • Firewalls
  • Security Zone
  • Security Policies
  • Network Address Translation
  • Troubleshooting
  • Load Balancing
  • Virtual Servers
  • Server Pool
  • Health Checks

Education And Experience

  • Must currently possess a TS/SCI w/CI polygraph.
  • Minimum of Bachelors Degree + 4 years of related experience (Additional experience can be substituted in lieu of degree)

Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including, but not limited to, the scope of the position, relevant experience, education, certifications, internal equity, customer contractual requirements, security clearance requirements, and other legitimate business considerations.

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or relevant academic discipline is preferred.
  • 5+ years of professional IT experience.
  • 3 years of participation on project teams.
  • Global project experience.

Licenses and Certifications

  • Cisco CCNP (Cisco Certified Network Professional) Certification preferred.
  • Amazon Web Services (AWS) Certification preferred.
  • Fortinet Certification preferred.

Skills And Abilities

  • Advanced knowledge of Ethernet, wide area networking, routing, TCP/IP, voice and wireless communications.
  • Network experience in global enterprise environments
  • Understanding of DNS & Domain Registration.
  • Understanding of current core business practices and how IT solutions support them.
  • Advanced knowledge of IT functional area strategies and how they are integrated.
  • Must be able to perform all essential functions of the position with limited assistance.

Additional Skills And Abilities

  • Experience with network switches, routers & wireless; Cisco/Meraki preferred.
