Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

Position Summary:

In support of our ongoing growth, we are looking for a Network Engineer to add to our Plex Cloud Operations department and our continuous improvement culture. As a member of the Network & Firewall team, you will be responsible for supporting and maintaining the networks of Plex's private and public cloud. We are looking for an engineer with the desire to leverage automation and infrastructure as code to help secure and scale our product while building resiliency and redundancy into all solutions.

Your Responsibilities

  • Support, implement, and operate networking infrastructure across both private datacenters and public cloud environments, primarily Azure, including routing, firewalling, WAN connectivity, and overlay networking.
  • Provide network and remote connectivity hardware/software support for internal and external customers.
  • Support, manage, and troubleshoot highly available ISP circuits, multi-homed BGP architectures, datacenter interconnect, DCI, and SD-WAN connectivity across multiple regions.
  • Perform root cause investigations and contribute to process/procedure documentation.
  • Maintain and expand NGFW rule base to ensure least access principles across public and private firewall zones.
  • Project work including:
    • Structured cabling.
    • Physical infrastructure lifecycle replacements.
    • Network and application security.
    • Monitoring, alerting, and auto remediation.
    • Deploy public cloud, primarily Azure, and private cloud networks utilizing infrastructure as code and GitOps tooling.
    • Support certificate lifecycle management and PKI operations using Keyfactor.
    • Support privileged access management and credential hygiene using Keeper Security.
    • Support, improve, and maintain network and system monitoring solutions.
    • Participate in an on-call rotation.
    • Participate in scheduled monthly maintenance windows (second Sunday of each month) as part of a team rotation, typically supporting 3–4 maintenance windows per year.

    The Essentials - You Will Have

    • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent years of relevant work experience.
    • Legal authorization to work in the US is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.
    • Ability to travel up to 10% of time.

    The Preferred - You Might Also Have

    • Typically requires 2+ years enterprise infrastructure experience.
    • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform and/or Ansible.
    • Experience working with Git-based workflows such as GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, or similar.
    • Experience with BGP and MP-BGP, EVPN, in production datacenter environments, including overlay/underlay architectures. Vendor-neutral experience acceptable; Arista.
    • Experience with certificate management, PKI concepts, and tools such as Keyfactor.
    • Experience with privileged access management or enterprise password vaulting tools such as Keeper Security.
    • Familiarity with identity and access management platforms such as Okta.
    • Foundational understanding of prompt engineering.
    • Must be able to lift 40 lbs., stand on a ladder for a long period of time, and crawl into tight spaces.
    • Solutions experience: Azure, Terraform, Ansible, Elastic, Cisco NX-OS, Arista EOS, BGP, EVPN/VXLAN, Arista DMF or similar packet capture technology, NetFlow/IPFIX, Wireshark, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Keyfactor PKI, Keeper Security, Okta, Jira, Confluence, Windows Server, Ubuntu, VMware, SNMP, LibreNMS.
    • This position requires access to technical data controlled under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Applicants must be U.S. persons as defined under 22 C.F.R.
    • 120.62, which includes U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, protected individuals (asylees and refugees), and individuals granted asylum or refugee status.

    What We Offer

    • Health Insurance including Medical, Dental and Vision
    • 401k
    • Paid Time off
    • Parental and Caregiver Leave
    • Flexible Work Schedule where you will work with your manager to enjoy a work schedule that can be flexible with your personal life.
    • To learn more about our benefits package, please visit at www.raquickfind.com.

    This position is part of a job family. Experience will be the determining factor for position level and compensation.

    For this role, the Base Salary Compensation is from $96,720 - 145,080 USD with an annual target bonus of 5% of base salary. Our company benefits for the US can be found here. Actual pay will be based on factors such as skills, knowledge, education, and experience.

    At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.



    We are an Equal Opportunity Employer including disability and veterans.

    If you are an individual with a disability and you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application process, please contact our services team at +1 (844) 404-7247.

    Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

descriptionHtml:
Job Number: R0250800

Network Engineer, Lead

The Opportunity:

A well-designed network is critical to move data and enable the organization to achieve their missions, but how can an organization make sure their network will fit their current and evolving needs? Crafting the right network, with the right equipment and software, requires a combination of technical skill and careful planning. That’s why we need you, a seasoned network engineer who knows how to develop the exact network Booz Allen needs.

As a Network Engineer on our team, focusing on data center and enterprise networking, you will upgrade or develop enterprise-wide infrastructure, troubleshoot and resolve complex network issues, analyze current working infrastructures and increase security, reliability, and availability for mission-critical network systems. Support connectivity to and from private cloud and co-located hosted infrastructure with public cloud integration. Support branch office and WAN site network capabilities. Design and configure connectivity to devices in a colocation data center. Assist with merger and acquisition activity related to network infrastructure consolidation and integrations. Due to the nature of work performed within this facility, U.S. citizenship is required.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 8+ years of experience in data center networking environments for a medium to large enterprise
  • 8+ years of experience with Cisco switches, routers, and Nexus platforms
  • 8+ years of experience with configuration and support of routing protocols, including BGP, EIGRP, or OSPF
  • Experience deploying and managing Cisco ACI
  • Experience implementing cloud edge designs linking on-premises networks to different cloud environments
  • Experience with Aruba SilverPeak Edge Connect devices
  • Experience in multi-vendor network environments, network monitoring and logging systems, and automation technologies, including Ansible and Python
  • Ability to respond to on call and emergency incidents and support network event escalations
  • Ability to use ServiceNow for daily IT tasks
  • HS diploma or GED


Nice If You Have:

  • Knowledge of datacenter technologies, including virtualization, cloud IaaS, such as Azure or AWS, F5 load balancing, firewall, and security technologies
  • Knowledge of Cisco wireless and Cisco ISE
  • Cisco CCIE or CCNP Data Center Certification


Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $99,000.00 to $225,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

  • Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
  • Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen or customer facility, in alignment with your leadership's expectations and the needs of the role.
  • Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed full-time at a customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.


Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

- 8+ years of experience with Cisco switches, routers, and Nexus platforms
- 8+ years of experience with configuration and support of routing protocols, including BGP, EIGRP, or OSPF
- Experience deploying and managing Cisco ACI
- Experience implementing cloud edge designs linking on-premises networks to different cloud environments
- Experience with Aruba SilverPeak Edge Connect devices
- Experience in multi-vendor network environments, network monitoring and logging systems, and automation technologies, including Ansible and Python
- Ability to respond to on call and emergency incidents and support network event escalations
- Ability to use ServiceNow for daily IT tasks
- HS diploma or GED


Nice If You Have:

Peraton is seeking a Senior Network Engineer to support our Department of Defense (DoD) / Intelligence Community (IC) customers as part of a highly talented, highly motivated, and high-performing team.   • Participate in Agile meetings (sprint planning, daily standups, sprint retrospectives, sprint reviews, etc.) and work in an Agile process to plan your work for future sprints and increments
  • Work with teams across Group and customers to understand cloud networking requirements for upcoming projects; develop and document Wide Area Networks (WANs) / Local Area Networks (LANs)

Qualifications

Required qualifications:

  • This position requires the candidate to possess and maintain a minimum of Top-Secret clearance with the ability to obtain TS/SCI
  • Associates degree in Engineering or Computer Technology and 10+ years of experience; OR Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Computer Technology and 8+ years of network engineering experience; OR Master's Degree and 6+ years of network engineering experience. An additional four (4) years of relevant experience will be considered in lieu of a Bachelor's degree.
  • Candidate must meet DoD 8140 foundational requirements for a Network Operations Specialist work role at an advanced or above proficiency.

  • Secures network and maintains device software up to date in accordance with DOD policies.
  • Strong understanding of IP addressing and subnetting.
  • You have 3-5 years of experience operating/maintaining/troubleshooting DoD encryption/COMSEC equipment.
  • Background in supporting software and/or network operations with a clear understanding of networking fundamentals

Desired qualifications:

  • You are able to effectively communicate both with customers and technical staff.
  • You have experience working with UNIX and/or LINUX systems in a network environment.
  • Strong problem solving and decision-making ability.
  • You are detail/process oriented, can multi-task, and the ability to work with minimal supervision
  • You have excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with management, the customer and user organizations across DoD.

Peraton offers enhanced benefits to employees working on this critical National Security program, which include heavily subsidized employee benefits coverage for you and your dependents, 25 days of PTO accrued annually up to a generous PTO cap and eligible to participate in an attractive bonus plan

descriptionHtml:
The Company

Ingles Markets began in 1963 as a single supermarket and has since grown into a regional grocery store chain with just under 200 retail locations operating in 6 southeastern states, a 1.6-million-square foot distribution center, two truck fleets, and a milk processing plant. Ingles Markets’ headquarters and distribution center are located just 15 minutes outside of Asheville, NC in the town of Black Mountain.

The Team

We are a lean team that services 27,000 employees across 6 states. We work hard as a collective to ensure everything is accomplished, even if it is not in our job description. While we do take things seriously, we like to have fun while we are doing it, so we can create the most impact and difference in our community.

The Position

The Network Engineer designs, implements, and manages enterprise network infrastructure across corporate, data center, cloud, and retail environments to ensure reliability, security, and scalability. This hands-on role involves executing network designs, troubleshooting LAN/WAN, VPN, and wireless technologies, maintaining documentation, and supporting lifecycle management. Additionally, the engineer collaborates with vendors, leads project deployments, and stays current with best practices to provide expertise on infrastructure and interoperability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and support end-to-end network infrastructure across multiple environments following best practices.
  • Participate in network life-cycle projects, including hardware refreshes, technology upgrades, and design improvements.
  • Configure and manage Palo Alto NGFW firewalls, including security policies, threat prevention, NAT, and IPsec VPNs.
  • Support Cisco ACI environments (APIC, Nexus), including leaf/switch design, tenant/fabric interconnectivity, and SDN concepts.
  • Configure and maintain enterprise wireless networks (Cisco, Aruba), including SSID design, authentication (WPA2/WPA3, 802.1X), and RF troubleshooting.
  • Implement and support secure VPN solutions for employees and partners.
  • Perform routine monitoring, capacity assessments, and respond to alerts using network management tools.
  • Troubleshoot Layer 1–4 network issues using diagnostic tools (ping, traceroute, packet captures).
  • Apply deep knowledge of TCP/IP, the OSI model, IPv4 addressing, subnetting, and routing protocols (OSPF, BGP).
  • Configure and troubleshoot enterprise routing and switching platforms, including VLANs, trunking, EtherChannel, and Spanning Tree.
  • Maintain accurate network documentation (diagrams, port maps, inventory, standards).
  • Collaborate with ISPs and carriers to resolve circuit issues promptly.
  • Ensure compliance with security standards (PCI-DSS, SOX) and implement best practices for segmentation and secure configurations.
  • Provide Tier-2/3 support for network-related tickets and collaborate with help desk and application teams.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and perform after-hours maintenance during approved change windows.
  • Observe all company rules and policies.
  • Adhere to all local, state, and federal health and civil code regulations.
  • Perform all other duties and assignments as directed.

The Ideal Candidate

  • A High School Diploma or equivalent is required.
  • A Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field is preferred.
  • 4+ years of experience in various networking areas is required.
  • Strong understanding of TCP/IP networking, the OSI model, IPv4 addressing, subnetting, and route summarization.
  • Hands-on experience with Cisco routing and switching platforms and protocols (OSPF, BGP).
  • Experience with Palo Alto firewalls and VPN configuration.
  • Familiarity with Cisco ACI or similar SDN solutions.
  • Knowledge of enterprise wireless technologies and RF fundamentals.
  • Proficiency with network monitoring tools and diagnostic utilities (Wireshark, CLI analysis).
  • Understanding of network security best practices and compliance requirements.
  • Basic scripting or automation exposure (Python, Ansible) preferred.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills are required.
  • Detail-oriented.
  • Able to prioritize and multitask effectively.
  • Able to work well as a team.
  • Flexible and able to adapt quickly in a dynamic work environment.
  • Must live in AL, GA, NC, SC, TN or VA.

descriptionHtml:
What is Landstar?

Landstar stands for safe, secure and reliable transportation services delivered by our unique network of small business owners. Independent agents and capacity providers operating under the Landstar umbrella enjoy the strength and support of one of the industry’s most stable and successful companies. Our network of independent entrepreneurs provide customers with personalized service at the local level with the global reach and resources of a multi-billion dollar company.

Location: Hybrid Jacksonville, FL

Schedule: Monday – Friday 8-5 with on-call rotation

What work will you perform?

The Senior Network Engineer designs, implements, operates, maintains, and troubleshoots enterprise network infrastructure across campus, data center, cloud, and remote-access environments. The role supports highly available infrastructure spanning Cisco enterprise and data center networking, dynamic routing, network security, application delivery, hybrid-cloud connectivity, SD-WAN, and Zero Trust technologies. The successful candidate brings strong hands-on troubleshooting skills and can analyze complex connectivity issues across network, security, cloud, and application layers.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Manage, maintain, troubleshoot, and optimize enterprise network infrastructure, including hardware, software, configurations, documentation, and operational standards.
  • Design, configure, and troubleshoot Cisco enterprise and data center networking, including routing, switching, Cisco Nexus, BGP, OSPF, and EVPN/VXLAN technologies.
  • Design, support, and troubleshoot resilient network connectivity across corporate locations, data centers, Microsoft Azure, Internet services, third-party networks, and SD-WAN environments, including routing, security, DNS, application access, and performance issues.
  • Support Zero Trust and secure remote-access solutions, including Zscaler technologies, and the transition from traditional VPN architectures to Zero Trust Network Access and cloud-delivered security models.
  • Work with identity, endpoint, and security teams to integrate network access controls with identity providers, device posture, certificates, endpoint security, and authentication technologies.
  • Support network security infrastructure, including Cisco firewall technologies, segmentation, access controls, and secure network connectivity.
  • Support F5 BIG-IP load-balancing and application-delivery infrastructure.
  • Perform advanced troubleshooting and root-cause analysis using packet captures, protocol analysis, telemetry, logs, and monitoring tools to identify complex connectivity issues across network, security, cloud, and application environments.
  • Participate in hardware and software lifecycle management, upgrades, migrations, network transformations, and technology refresh initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain automation using Python, APIs, shell scripting, or similar technologies to improve network operations and reduce repetitive administrative work.
  • Participate in incident response, change management, problem management, and remediation of network-related events.
  • Collaborate across infrastructure, security, cloud, identity, endpoint, application, and operations teams, and communicate technical issues, risks, recommendations, and project status to technical teams and management.

Required Minimum Experience And Education

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited four-year college or university; or 3 years of related network engineering experience and/or technical training; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 3 years of enterprise network engineering experience, including routing, switching, and troubleshooting.
  • 2 years of experience supporting enterprise data center networking.
  • 1 year of hands-on experience with Cisco enterprise routing and switching, or security technologies.

Preferred Experience And Education

  • Two years of experience with Cisco Nexus or data center switching technologies.
  • One year of experience with one or more of the following: EVPN/VXLAN, Zscaler or Zero Trust Network Access, SD-WAN, F5 BIG-IP, Cisco firewalls, or Cloud Environment networking (Azure, AWS, Oracle, etc.).
  • Experience with network automation using Python, APIs, shell scripting, or similar technologies.
  • Relevant certification such as CCNP Enterprise, CCNP Data Center, Microsoft Azure, cloud, or cybersecurity certification.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Advanced knowledge of enterprise network architecture, routing, switching, and troubleshooting.
  • Strong knowledge of BGP, OSPF, TCP/IP, Ethernet, VLANs, trunking, spanning tree, port channels, IP addressing, subnetting, route policy, and redistribution.
  • Knowledge of Cisco IOS, IOS-XE, Nexus, and NX-OS platforms and modern data center concepts, including spine-and-leaf networking, VXLAN, EVPN, VNIs, and VTEPs.
  • Knowledge of network security concepts and technologies, including segmentation, firewalls, ACLs, VPNs, encryption, NAT, DNS security, least-privilege access, identity-based access, device posture, and continuous verification.
  • Understanding of Zscaler and cloud-delivered security models, including secure Internet access, private application access, traffic forwarding, application segmentation, and endpoint connectivity.
  • Understanding of hybrid-cloud networking and methods for securely connecting data centers, branches, cloud environments, SaaS platforms, and remote users.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure networking, including virtual networks, routing, network security, VPNs, private connectivity, and hybrid-cloud integration.
  • Working knowledge of load balancing, high availability, SSL/TLS, traffic management, and application-delivery concepts.
  • Skill in analyzing packet flows and captures using Wireshark, tcpdump, or equivalent protocol-analysis tools.
  • Skill in using monitoring, telemetry, logging, and analysis platforms to investigate availability, capacity, latency, packet loss, routing behavior, and application performance.
  • Ability to isolate whether connectivity or performance issues originate from the client, LAN/WAN, routing, DNS, firewall, secure-access platform, load balancer, cloud infrastructure, or application.
  • Ability to develop or modify Python and shell scripts and work with REST APIs, JSON, and related automation methods.
  • Ability to perform structured root-cause analysis and evaluate how new networking and security technologies fit within an existing enterprise architecture.
  • Ability to manage multiple technical priorities in an enterprise production environment.
  • Ability to produce clear network diagrams, configurations, engineering standards, procedures, and technical documentation.
  • Ability to explain complex infrastructure and security issues to technical and nontechnical audiences and collaborate across infrastructure, security, cloud, identity, endpoint, application, and operations teams.
  • This job posting is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of all activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice.

What is Landstar?

Landstar stands for safe, secure and reliable transportation services delivered by our unique network of small business owners. Independent agents and capacity providers operating under the Landstar umbrella enjoy the strength and support of one of the industry’s most stable and successful companies. Our network of independent entrepreneurs provide customers with personalized service at the local level with the global reach and resources of a multi-billion dollar company.

Location: Hybrid Jacksonville, FL 

Schedule: Monday – Friday 8-5 with on-call rotation 

What work will you perform?

The Senior Network Engineer designs, implements, operates, maintains, and troubleshoots enterprise network infrastructure across campus, data center, cloud, and remote-access environments. The role supports highly available infrastructure spanning Cisco enterprise and data center networking, dynamic routing, network security, application delivery, hybrid-cloud connectivity, SD-WAN, and Zero Trust technologies. The successful candidate brings strong hands-on troubleshooting skills and can analyze complex connectivity issues across network, security, cloud, and application layers.

Essential Responsibilities



-  Manage, maintain, troubleshoot, and optimize enterprise network infrastructure, including hardware, software, configurations, documentation, and operational standards.
- Design, configure, and troubleshoot Cisco enterprise and data center networking, including routing, switching, Cisco Nexus, BGP, OSPF, and EVPN/VXLAN technologies.
- Design, support, and troubleshoot resilient network connectivity across corporate locations, data centers, Microsoft Azure, Internet services, third-party networks, and SD-WAN environments, including routing, security, DNS, application access, and performance issues.
- Support Zero Trust and secure remote-access solutions, including Zscaler technologies, and the transition from traditional VPN architectures to Zero Trust Network Access and cloud-delivered security models.
- Work with identity, endpoint, and security teams to integrate network access controls with identity providers, device posture, certificates, endpoint security, and authentication technologies.
- Support network security infrastructure, including Cisco firewall technologies, segmentation, access controls, and secure network connectivity.
- Support F5 BIG-IP load-balancing and application-delivery infrastructure.
- Perform advanced troubleshooting and root-cause analysis using packet captures, protocol analysis, telemetry, logs, and monitoring tools to identify complex connectivity issues across network, security, cloud, and application environments.
- Participate in hardware and software lifecycle management, upgrades, migrations, network transformations, and technology refresh initiatives.
- Develop and maintain automation using Python, APIs, shell scripting, or similar technologies to improve network operations and reduce repetitive administrative work.
- Participate in incident response, change management, problem management, and remediation of network-related events.
- Collaborate across infrastructure, security, cloud, identity, endpoint, application, and operations teams, and communicate technical issues, risks, recommendations, and project status to technical teams and management.

Required Minimum Experience And Education



- Bachelor’s degree from an accredited four-year college or university; or 3 years of related network engineering experience and/or technical training; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
- 3 years of enterprise network engineering experience, including routing, switching, and troubleshooting.
- 2 years of experience supporting enterprise data center networking.
- 1 year of hands-on experience with Cisco enterprise routing and switching, or security technologies.

Preferred Experience And Education



-  Two years of experience with Cisco Nexus or data center switching technologies.
- One year of experience with one or more of the following: EVPN/VXLAN, Zscaler or Zero Trust Network Access, SD-WAN, F5 BIG-IP, Cisco firewalls, or Cloud Environment networking (Azure, AWS, Oracle, etc.).
- Experience with network automation using Python, APIs, shell scripting, or similar technologies.
- Relevant certification such as CCNP Enterprise, CCNP Data Center, Microsoft Azure, cloud, or cybersecurity certification.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities



- Advanced knowledge of enterprise network architecture, routing, switching, and troubleshooting.
- Strong knowledge of BGP, OSPF, TCP/IP, Ethernet, VLANs, trunking, spanning tree, port channels, IP addressing, subnetting, route policy, and redistribution.
- Knowledge of Cisco IOS, IOS-XE, Nexus, and NX-OS platforms and modern data center concepts, including spine-and-leaf networking, VXLAN, EVPN, VNIs, and VTEPs.
- Knowledge of network security concepts and technologies, including segmentation, firewalls, ACLs, VPNs, encryption, NAT, DNS security, least-privilege access, identity-based access, device posture, and continuous verification.
- Understanding of Zscaler and cloud-delivered security models, including secure Internet access, private application access, traffic forwarding, application segmentation, and endpoint connectivity.
- Understanding of hybrid-cloud networking and methods for securely connecting data centers, branches, cloud environments, SaaS platforms, and remote users.
- Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure networking, including virtual networks, routing, network security, VPNs, private connectivity, and hybrid-cloud integration.
- Working knowledge of load balancing, high availability, SSL/TLS, traffic management, and application-delivery concepts.
- Skill in analyzing packet flows and captures using Wireshark, tcpdump, or equivalent protocol-analysis tools.
- Skill in using monitoring, telemetry, logging, and analysis platforms to investigate availability, capacity, latency, packet loss, routing behavior, and application performance.
- Ability to isolate whether connectivity or performance issues originate from the client, LAN/WAN, routing, DNS, firewall, secure-access platform, load balancer, cloud infrastructure, or application.
- Ability to develop or modify Python and shell scripts and work with REST APIs, JSON, and related automation methods.
- Ability to perform structured root-cause analysis and evaluate how new networking and security technologies fit within an existing enterprise architecture.
- Ability to manage multiple technical priorities in an enterprise production environment.
- Ability to produce clear network diagrams, configurations, engineering standards, procedures, and technical documentation.
- Ability to explain complex infrastructure and security issues to technical and nontechnical audiences and collaborate across infrastructure, security, cloud, identity, endpoint, application, and operations teams.

Position Description:

This senior-level network engineering position with the University of Louisville provides advanced technical expertise for the design, implementation, operation, administration and management of highly complex university networks and services used by faculty, staff and students. This position independently resolves complex network issues, leads network projects and improvements, and requires broad knowledge and experience with enterprise network equipment, protocols, applications and services used across the university.

Work is performed in both an office setting and in a variety of campus locations including campus buildings, network wiring closets and the campus data center. Some work may be performed remotely, but staff may need to be present on campus for some work activities. Maintenance work may require presence on campus on nights and weekends.

Please include an example of a network project that you have led.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

  • Independently monitor and manage equipment comprising the university’s campus, data center and remote-site networks, including routers, switches, wireless access points, Internet and Internet2 connectivity, and related services such as network security, IP addressing, DNS and DHCP. Be an active participant in the design, implementation, and configuration of those services.
  • Support administration of network-related applications and services, including VoIP, cloud connectivity, guest access, wireless onboarding, network monitoring, authentication and security controls.
  • Diagnose and resolve outages, connectivity issues and performance problems; provide escalation support for trouble tickets and service requests and coordinate resolution with internal teams, vendors and service providers.
  • Capable of leading technical activities for network projects, upgrades and scheduled maintenance windows, including development of implementation plans, risk mitigation, testing, change documentation and post-implementation validation. We are a 24/7 operation and thus some work may occur outside normal business hours.
  • Analyze network performance, capacity, availability and security metrics; recommend and implement improvements that increase reliability, resiliency, scalability and user experience.
  • Develop and maintain network standards, diagrams, configurations, procedures and operational documentation; contribute to disaster recovery and business continuity planning for network services.
  • Maintain current knowledge of networking technologies, security and industry practices through training, self-study, certifications and professional development activities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced knowledge of enterprise network architecture, routing, security, switching and related network services.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical work, communicate recommendations and coordinate complex changes across teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize work to meet multiple, competing deadlines.
  • Demonstrated problem-solving abilities with keen attention to detail.
  • Proven self-starter with the ability to work independently with limited direction and oversight.
  • Effective oral, written and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI to troubleshoot, design, and analyze.

Who We Are

As a global leader in digital infrastructure, QTS designs, builds and operates advanced data centers that support strategic AI, cloud and digital transformation initiatives. We are driven by a mission to connect the world for good and our people make it possible. Every single day, the creativity, dedication and genuine care for our communities are what push us forward and make this a truly special place to be.

The Network Engineer III is primarily responsible for the provisioning, deployment, and ongoing operations and maintenance of all QTS managed network services for customers and internal QTS customers. This individual will need a fundamental understanding of physical/virtual networking and firewall management, including any associated automation. The Network Engineer III will also work escalated networking tickets to help support the Operations Service Center (OSC). The candidate must be well versed in Network technologies and display a desire to continuously grow and improve both technical and soft skills.

RESPONSIBILITIES, Other Duties May Be Assigned

  • Troubleshoot & support networking concepts and protocols such as: BGP, OSPF, VLAN/PVLAN, STP, HSRP/VRRP, IP sub-netting, and routing while increasing your understanding of a wider set of protocols and advanced technologies
  • Configure, test and troubleshoot on platforms like ASR 9000, Nexus 7000 –Nexus 9000s
  • Engineer and test DDOS and traffic mitigation techniques and solutions
  • Troubleshoot DWDM optical network solutions
  • Demonstrate current industry knowledge as it pertains to the following; Management of peering/IX/NAP issues, a proficient level of understanding in contemporary network architectures, networking security protocols/procedures, and network scaling/capacity issues
  • Work with Cisco routing and switching platforms like Catalyst 6500/7600, ASR 9000, Nexus
  • Manage assigned tickets to ensure SLA compliance and customer satisfaction
  • Troubleshoot network port configuration issues
  • Understand prefix and access lists, read and comprehend traceroutes
  • Create A, C, and MX records using basic knowledge of DNS
  • Configure site-to-site and client- to- site VPNs
  • Maintain/troubleshoot VPN’s and ability to check Phase 1 and Phase 2
  • Triage and escalate tickets according to QTS policy
  • Conduct firewall rule changes
  • Work with the24x7x365 Operations Service Center and be flexible in availability as needed

Basic Qualifications

  • BS degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Engineering or other related field or equivalent professional experience
  • Seven or more years of progressive IT engineering experience
  • Five or more years of professional network engineering experience
  • Advanced proficiency with at least two of the following protocols: BGP, OSPF, HSRP, EIGRP, MPLS
  • Solid understanding of anti-DDoS and IPS/IDS solutions
  • CCNA certification (or equivalent)
  • US Citizenship for this position is required by law due to federal customer contracts

descriptionHtml:
The Sr Network Engineer is a senior-level technical role responsible for leading advanced network operations, engineering, and infrastructure improvements across corporate, retail, and cloud environments. This position owns the resolution of high-impact and complex network incidents, provides technical leadership across multi-site connectivity and security initiatives, and ensures the network environment remains stable, secure, and scalable. The role works within established standards and change control processes while contributing to architecture, modernization planning, operational maturity, and mentoring Level 1 and Level 2 engineers.

Duties And Responsibilities

  • Lead resolution of Tier 3 network incidents and outages involving complex LAN/WAN, SD-WAN, firewall, and wireless issues across multiple locations.
  • Perform deep technical troubleshooting including advanced routing/switching analysis, packet capture review, and root cause analysis.
  • Own deployment standards for network technologies including configuration templates, security baselines, and operational best practices.
  • Architect, implement, and support enterprise network solutions across retail and corporate environments, ensuring scalability and performance.
  • Serve as the technical escalation point for Fortinet platforms including FortiGate, FortiSwitch, FortiAP, FortiNAC, and centralized management through FortiManager.
  • Lead FortiNAC administration and policy enforcement across wired and wireless environments, including endpoint profiling, automated onboarding workflows, quarantine/remediation actions, and integration with FortiGate/FortiSwitch/FortiAP to strengthen visibility and network access control.
  • Lead and improve network monitoring strategy (e.g., PRTG and enterprise alerting) including KPI-driven tuning, noise reduction, and proactive detection.
  • Support and optimize SD-WAN design, circuit failover strategy, WAN performance validation, and application pathing improvements.
  • Partner with internal teams, vendors, and service providers to drive resolution for complex carrier issues, circuit migrations, and store-level connectivity escalations.
  • Lead network project execution including store openings, refresh initiatives, platform standardization, security improvements, and circuit modernization.
  • Develop and maintain network documentation including diagrams, implementation standards, site templates, troubleshooting guides, and network lifecycle processes.
  • Provide technical mentorship to Level 1 and Level 2 engineers, including training support, troubleshooting coaching, and review of technical work.
  • Participate in change planning, maintenance windows, and risk assessments to ensure minimal business disruption and controlled execution.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives to increase network stability, reduce downtime, and improve service delivery across the organization.

Position Qualifications

  • Expert-level understanding of enterprise networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, routing protocols, VLAN design, subnetting, WAN technologies, and wireless architecture.
  • Strong experience troubleshooting and supporting multi-site retail networks at scale, including high availability and business-critical connectivity requirements.
  • Strong firewall and security knowledge including policy design, NAT, segmentation, and VPN technologies.
  • Strong experience administering FortiNAC to enforce enterprise network access control, including endpoint profiling, policy design, agentless/agent-based onboarding, guest/BYOD workflows, remediation/quarantine rules, and integration with Fortinet infrastructure (FortiGate/FortiSwitch/FortiAP) to improve visibility, compliance, and security across wired and wireless environments.
  • Experience leading technical projects and producing clear documentation, standards, and operational procedures.
  • Proven ability to communicate effectively with technical teams, vendors, and business stakeholders during incident response and project execution.
  • Ability to prioritize, manage, and execute in a fast-paced environment supporting multiple locations and simultaneous initiatives.
  • Ability to travel to retail locations as needed (occasional based on business needs).
  • Ability to participate in after-hours/on-call support as scheduled.

Education And/Or Experience

  • Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or related field preferred (or equivalent experience).
  • 5+ years of experience in network operations and engineering roles supporting enterprise infrastructure.
  • Strong experience with Fortinet technologies preferred (FortiGate, FortiSwitch, FortiAP, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, FortiNAC).
  • Experience supporting SD-WAN, carrier troubleshooting, and large-scale multi-site environments preferred.
  • Professional certifications preferred (two or more): CCNP, Fortinet NSE certifications, Network+.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to sit and work at a computer for extended periods.
  • Ability to lift and carry up to 40 lbs (network equipment, boxes, peripherals).
  • Ability to bend, crouch, and work in small network closets or under counters when required.
  • Atlanta, GA Based position - hybrid

Responsibilities
ByteDance infrastructure networking brings together innovative ideas and technologies from network architecture, software-defined networking (SDN), network virtualization, switch software and hardware co-design, and high-speed networking, to create hyperscale data-center networking solutions that power several of the most popular apps of the world such as TikTok which serve hundreds of millions of users around the globe.

ByteDance infrastructure networking is responsible for planning, building and operating the global, intelligent network infrastructure to meet the requirements of high availability, scalability, and high-performance. By joining this team, you will gain marketable network experience in multiple technological domains on a global scale.

Responsibilities
- Plan, design, implement, operate and optimize ByteDance's global backbone network across all major continents.
- Collaborate with network architecture, SDN, tools platform teams to improve network scalability, resource utilization, buildout efficiency and operational excellence.
- Collaborate with team members across multiple time zones to ensure continuous global network operations.
- Partner with the NOC team to support the day-to-day operations of the global backbone network infrastructure, including responding to network incident alerts, mitigation, and service restoration during network failures.
- Travel may be required up to 15% - 30% of the time.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualification(s)
- Bachelor's in Computer Science, Information Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
- Good understanding of network protocols including TCP/IP, OSPF/IS-IS, BGP and MPLS related technologies.
- Hands-on experience with designing, building and operating wide area network (WAN) using devices from mainstream vendors, such as Cisco, Arista, Juniper, H3C, Nokia, etc.
- Self-motivated, good communication and written skills.

Preferred Qualification(s)
- In-depth knowledge and skill of backbone traffic engineering technologies, such as RSVP-TE, SRTE-MPLS and SRv6 etc.
- In-depth knowledge of quality-of-service (QoS) technologies and implementations on wide area network.
- Good understanding of controller-based software-defined networking.
- Programming/scripting in Python or other languages.

About Us
Founded in 2012, ByteDance's mission is to inspire creativity and enrich life. With a suite of more than a dozen products, including TikTok, Lemon8, CapCut and Pico as well as platforms specific to the China market, including Toutiao, Douyin, and Xigua, ByteDance has made it easier and more fun for people to connect with, consume, and create content.​


Why Join ByteDance
Inspiring creativity is at the core of ByteDance's mission. Our innovative products are built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and enrich life - a mission we work towards every day.​
As ByteDancers, we strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our Company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
Diversity & Inclusion​
ByteDance is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At ByteDance, our mission is to inspire creativity and enrich life. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

ByteDance is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request​

descriptionHtml:
About Intuitive Machines:

Intuitive Machines is an innovative and cutting-edge space company making cislunar space accessible to both public and private customers. Our mission is to further science and exploration, communications, and economic progress from the Earth to the Moon and beyond. With multiple NASA lunar missions in development and additional private missions on our manifest, we pride ourselves in supporting NASA, our customers, and the nation in paving the way to return humans to the surface of the Moon. Our world-class team includes experts in all aspects of spacecraft subsystems design, development, and test, on-orbit operations, and safety.

About The Position:

Intuitive Machines is seeking Network Engineer (JPSS) program at NASA Goddard Space Flight Center. The position is located in Greenbelt, MD.

The Network Engineer to design, implement, secure, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure supporting mission‑critical systems in a FISMA High environment. The ideal candidate has hands‑on expertise with both Cisco and Extreme Networks Layer 3/4 switching platforms, high‑speed backbone connectivity, and security‑driven network operations.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, configure, and maintain Cisco and Extreme Layer 3/4 switches in a high‑availability environment.
  • Deploy and manage 10 Gb (and higher) uplinks, redundant paths, and resilient architectures.
  • Ensure all network systems comply with FISMA High controls, documentation standards, and auditing requirements.
  • Implement secure VLAN architectures, routing protocols (OSPF, BGP), and access-control mechanisms.
  • Monitor network performance, troubleshoot issues, and optimize throughput and reliability.
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to ensure continuous compliance with federal security standards (NIST 800‑53, RMF).
  • Maintain configuration baselines, diagrams, and change‑control documentation.
  • Participate in incident response, root‑cause analysis, and after‑action reviews.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 9+ years of professional experience as a Network Engineer in enterprise or federal environments.
  • Expertise with Cisco IOS/XE and ExtremeXOS or Extreme Fabric solutions.
  • Proven experience deploying and supporting 10 Gb (or faster) backbone links.
  • Strong understanding of Layer 3/4 routing and switching, VLANs, ACLs, QoS, and network segmentation.
  • Experience working in FISMA High or comparable regulated environments (DoD, NASA, DHS, etc.).
  • Familiarity with NIST 800‑53, RMF, and security compliance frameworks.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain required clearances.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Cisco certifications (CCNA, CCNP, or equivalent).
  • Extreme Networks certifications (ENSA, ENSD, etc.).
  • Experience with network automation (Python, Ansible, REST APIs).
  • Knowledge of firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPN technologies, and Zero Trust architecture.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

descriptionHtml:
Redstone Arsenal/Huntsville, AL

IPTA's Technology Solutions Team is passionate about providing our customers with technical solutions that satisfy their business needs. Through collaborative interactions with customers, team members, subject matter experts (SMEs), technical leaders, and partners we design practical solutions that solve real problems for major government and business organizations. As a member of our Technology Solutions group, you will work with a team of technologists focused on delivering innovative business solutions using emerging technologies through proven successful methods.

Our Team

We are looking for talented people who are enthusiastic about applying technology to deliver innovative outcomes with "fierce determination, fearless integrity, and passionate service." Our belief is that our people are the key to success. By encouraging and enabling continued learning, our team members grow to achieve their personal career goals. We are looking for:

  • Smart people with a passion for technology
  • Ability to solve challenging business problems
  • Self-directed professionals
  • Hunger to continually learn and grow

IPTA is looking for great talented people to support the work at the Army Aviation and Missile Center (AvMC). AvMC is the Army's focal point for providing research, development and engineering technology and services for aviation and missile platforms across the life cycle. AvMC's mission is to "deliver collaborative and innovative aviation and missile capabilities for responsive and cost-effective research, development, and life cycle engineering solutions" to equip the Warfighter with the best technology today and tomorrow.

IPTA is seeking a Networking Engineer for network and system administration, integration enhancements, and the operational and preventative maintenance of the AvMC classified and unclassified infrastructure. The ideal candidate will ensure the network environment remains secure, reliable, scalable, and compliant with AvMC and Army requirements. This role requires a hands-on engineer who can design, implement, troubleshoot, and sustain complex network environments while supporting dynamic research and test operations.

Responsibilities

  • Design, configure, implement, upgrade, and maintain classified and unclassified network infrastructure including switches, routers, firewalls, and virtual networking components
  • Upgrade network configurations to support evolving modeling, simulation, and test requirements
  • Configure and maintain VLANs, routing, VPNs, DNS, DHCP, NTP, and network segmentation
  • Monitor network performance and troubleshoot connectivity, latency, and configuration issues
  • Maintain network documentation including diagrams, configurations, and baselines
  • Assist with IT modernization and technology refresh initiatives
  • Perform configuration, preventative maintenance, fault isolation of local/remote LAN equipment, and telecommunications circuitry.
  • Duties may include providing specifications and detailed schematics for network architecture; providing information for hardware and software selection; and tools for the most efficient solution to meet business needs, including present and future capacity requirements
  • Plan implementation of enhancements and upgrades to the classified and unclassified networks
  • Conduct testing of network systems and associated devices
  • Evaluate and report on new network technologies to enhance capabilities of the network
  • Conduct audit of equipment and production systems and create appropriate reports

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field
  • Great communication and organizational skills
  • Ten (10) years of prior experience in a similar role
  • DoD 8570 Level II/III certification desired
  • Active Security Clearance Required

IPTA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All employment decisions are based on individual merit, including qualifications, experience, performance, and business needs, consistent with applicable federal laws and federal contracting requirements. IPTA provides equal opportunity and utilizes merit-based principles to make employment related decisions.

descriptionHtml:
Viridien (www.viridiengroup.com) is an advanced technology, digital and Earth data company that pushes the boundaries of science for a more prosperous and sustainable future. With our ingenuity, drive and deep curiosity we discover new insights, innovations, and solutions that efficiently and responsibly resolve complex natural resource, digital, energy transition and infrastructure challenges.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Network Engineer to support the operation, reliability, and evolution of Viridien's global network infrastructure. Based within the Network Operations team at the Houston HPC Hub, this role supports enterprise, data center, cloud-connected, security, and SD-WAN environments. You will contribute to operational activities, infrastructure projects, and technology lifecycle initiatives while helping enhance the resilience, performance, and security of our global network services.

About The Team

You will join our global Network Operations team, responsible for delivering secure, reliable, and high-performing connectivity services that support Viridien's business, operational, and research activities worldwide. Working closely with infrastructure teams, vendors, and business stakeholders, you will contribute to the development and maintenance of our data center, cloud, enterprise, WAN, wireless, and network security platforms.

The team combines deep technical expertise with a collaborative, practical, and service-focused culture. We value ownership, clear communication, continuous learning, and teamwork across regions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support, maintain and troubleshoot enterprise network infrastructure across WAN, LAN, wireless, data center, cloud-connected and security environments.
  • Monitor daily Data center operations.
  • Deploy, configure and monitor routing, switching, firewall and network security platforms.
  • Investigate network incidents, contribute to root cause analysis and support preventative improvement actions.
  • Monitor network availability, performance, health and capacity across critical services.
  • Participate in infrastructure projects, hardware refreshes, migrations and service improvement initiatives.
  • Work with senior engineers to implement network enhancements and introduce new technologies.
  • Maintain accurate technical documentation, diagrams, standards and operational procedures.
  • Support network security, resilience, compliance and lifecycle management activities.
  • Collaborate with vendors, service providers and internal stakeholders to support operational and project requirements.
  • Participate in an on-call support rotation and occasional out-of-hours maintenance activities.

Qualifications

 Required

  • Approximately 3–5 years' experience supporting enterprise, datacentre, cloud-connected or service provider network environments.
  • Hands-on experience configuring, supporting and troubleshooting production network infrastructure.
  • Good understanding of routing, switching, WAN, firewall and network security fundamentals.
  • Practical knowledge of technologies such as BGP, OSPF, VLANs, QoS, VPNs and TCP/IP.
  • Experience using monitoring, alerting or operational management platforms.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem-solving skills, with a practical and service-focused approach.
  • Ability to work effectively within a collaborative technical team and build strong working relationships.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrates ownership, accountability and reliability in delivering work.
  • Comfortable working in a global, multicultural and highly technical environment.

Preferred

  • Experience with Arista, Aruba/HPE, Cisco, Dell, Palo Alto or Juniper technologies.
  • Exposure to SD-WAN and hybrid networking environments.
  • Familiarity with Azure networking or cloud connectivity solutions.
  • Knowledge of datacentre networking technologies such as VXLAN, EVPN or MLAG.
  • Experience with telemetry, observability or performance monitoring platforms.
  • Experience with scripting or automation.
  • Industry certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, ACSP, ACMP, or PCNSA.
  • Degree in Computer Science or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Curious and motivated to continuously develop technical knowledge and skills.
  • Proactive in identifying opportunities for improvement and resolving issues.
  • Able to balance operational responsibilities with project-based work.
  • Committed to continuous learning and professional development.

Why work with us?

  • Yearly Performance Bonus
  • Hybrid & Flexible Work: One remote day per week
  • Generous Time Off: Three weeks of vacation to recharge, plus three personal days and eight sick days to use when you need them most
  • Retirement Benefits: Excellent 401k match program – contribute up to 5%, and we’ll match up to 7%!
  • Comprehensive Healthcare: Medical, dental, vision, and supplemental benefits to support you and your family’s wellbeing
  • Parental Support: Paid parental leave for all parents, plus fertility care coverage to support every unique journey
  • Wellness & Wellbeing: EAP and Wellness Program to support mental and emotional wellbeing, with a free, onsite fitness center to help you stay active
  • Free Lunches: Take a break from meal prep – we provide lunch three days a week (Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays)!

Learning and Development

Job Description

Position Summary:

In support of our ongoing growth, we are looking for a Network Engineer to add to our Plex Cloud Operations department and our continuous improvement culture. As a member of the Network & Firewall team, you will be responsible for supporting and maintaining the networks of Plex's private and public cloud. We are looking for an engineer with the desire to leverage automation and infrastructure as code to help secure and scale our product while building resiliency and redundancy into all solutions.

Your Responsibilities

  • Support, implement, and operate networking infrastructure across both private datacenters and public cloud environments, primarily Azure, including routing, firewalling, WAN connectivity, and overlay networking.
  • Provide network and remote connectivity hardware/software support for internal and external customers.
  • Support, manage, and troubleshoot highly available ISP circuits, multi-homed BGP architectures, datacenter interconnect, DCI, and SD-WAN connectivity across multiple regions.
  • Perform root cause investigations and contribute to process/procedure documentation.
  • Maintain and expand NGFW rule base to ensure least access principles across public and private firewall zones.
  • Project work including:
    • Structured cabling.
    • Physical infrastructure lifecycle replacements.
    • Network and application security.
    • Monitoring, alerting, and auto remediation.
    • Deploy public cloud, primarily Azure, and private cloud networks utilizing infrastructure as code and GitOps tooling.
    • Support certificate lifecycle management and PKI operations using Keyfactor.
    • Support privileged access management and credential hygiene using Keeper Security.
    • Support, improve, and maintain network and system monitoring solutions.
    • Participate in an on-call rotation.
    • Participate in scheduled monthly maintenance windows (second Sunday of each month) as part of a team rotation, typically supporting 3–4 maintenance windows per year.

    The Essentials - You Will Have

    • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent years of relevant work experience.
    • Legal authorization to work in the US is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.
    • Ability to travel up to 10% of time.

    The Preferred - You Might Also Have

    • Typically requires 2+ years enterprise infrastructure experience.
    • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform and/or Ansible.
    • Experience working with Git-based workflows such as GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, or similar.
    • Experience with BGP and MP-BGP, EVPN, in production datacenter environments, including overlay/underlay architectures. Vendor-neutral experience acceptable; Arista.
    • Experience with certificate management, PKI concepts, and tools such as Keyfactor.
    • Experience with privileged access management or enterprise password vaulting tools such as Keeper Security.
    • Familiarity with identity and access management platforms such as Okta.
    • Foundational understanding of prompt engineering.
    • Must be able to lift 40 lbs., stand on a ladder for a long period of time, and crawl into tight spaces.
    • Solutions experience: Azure, Terraform, Ansible, Elastic, Cisco NX-OS, Arista EOS, BGP, EVPN/VXLAN, Arista DMF or similar packet capture technology, NetFlow/IPFIX, Wireshark, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Keyfactor PKI, Keeper Security, Okta, Jira, Confluence, Windows Server, Ubuntu, VMware, SNMP, LibreNMS.
    • This position requires access to technical data controlled under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Applicants must be U.S. persons as defined under 22 C.F.R.
    • 120.62, which includes U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, protected individuals (asylees and refugees), and individuals granted asylum or refugee status.

    What We Offer

    • Health Insurance including Medical, Dental and Vision
    • 401k
    • Paid Time off
    • Parental and Caregiver Leave
    • Flexible Work Schedule where you will work with your manager to enjoy a work schedule that can be flexible with your personal life.
    • To learn more about our benefits package, please visit at www.raquickfind.com.

    This position is part of a job family. Experience will be the determining factor for position level and compensation.

    For this role, the Base Salary Compensation is from $96,720 - 145,080 USD with an annual target bonus of 5% of base salary. Our company benefits for the US can be found here. Actual pay will be based on factors such as skills, knowledge, education, and experience.

    At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.



    We are an Equal Opportunity Employer including disability and veterans.

    If you are an individual with a disability and you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application process, please contact our services team at +1 (844) 404-7247.

    Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

Senior Network Engineer


Setting/Hours: 100% Remote | Full-time


Join trak group in partnering with a growing client in Hamilton, Ohio that’s expanding its Shared Services team.


Position Summary


We are seeking a Senior Network Engineer to design, implement, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise network environments within a 24x7x365 managed services operation. This role owns the reliability, performance, security, and connectivity of client LAN, WLAN, and WAN environments while serving as a senior technical escalation point for complex networking issues.


The ideal candidate has broad networking expertise, strong customer-facing skills, and experience supporting multi-vendor enterprise environments.


Key Responsibilities


Network Engineering & Operations:

  • Design, configure, deploy, document, and support secure enterprise LAN, WLAN, and WAN solutions.
  • Troubleshoot complex network connectivity, performance, and availability issues.
  • Support routers, switches, wireless networks, firewalls, VPNs, and other network infrastructure.
  • Manage environments utilizing technologies from Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto, Arista, Brocade, Ubiquiti, and other manufacturers.
  • Support MPLS, VPN, SD-WAN, wireless, firewall, and network security technologies.
  • Conduct regular environment reviews and client health checks to identify performance, capacity, and resiliency improvements.
  • Monitor network growth and recommend infrastructure enhancements.


Incident, Problem & Change Management:

  • Respond to and resolve customer incidents and service requests within established SLAs.
  • Follow ITIL-based incident, problem, change, configuration, performance, and capacity management processes.
  • Participate in major incident response and complex troubleshooting efforts.
  • Perform vulnerability remediation and support security incident response activities.
  • Maintain accurate network documentation, asset inventories, and CMDB information.
  • Participate in a rotating 24x7 after-hours on-call schedule.


Technical Leadership:

  • Serve as a senior escalation point for Tier I and Tier II technical teams.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and training to junior engineers and support staff.
  • Develop repeatable technical procedures and identify opportunities to automate recurring tasks.
  • Collaborate across technical teams to resolve complex customer issues.
  • Document solutions, configurations, troubleshooting procedures, and operational standards.


Customer Support:

  • Work directly with customers to troubleshoot technical issues and communicate resolution plans.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of client environments, service offerings, and SLAs.
  • Provide professional technical guidance and recommendations to customers.
  • Deliver a high level of responsiveness and customer service throughout the support process.


Required Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 5 years of Network Engineering or Network Administration experience within enterprise or managed services environments.
  • Strong knowledge of network architecture, design, implementation, administration, and support.
  • Strong understanding of TCP/IP, ARP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, and related networking protocols.
  • Experience with MPLS and VPN technologies, including remote-access and site-to-site VPNs.
  • Experience supporting multi-vendor network environments, including platforms such as Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto, Arista, Brocade, and Ubiquiti.
  • Knowledge of wireless networking technologies.
  • Experience with traditional and next-generation firewalls, including IDS, IPS, DPI, access controls, and network security.
  • Experience with ticketing and IT service management systems.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent customer service, communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to independently prioritize and resolve multiple technical issues.
  • Availability to participate in rotating 24x7 on-call support.
  • Ability to travel locally and overnight as needed, typically less than 10%.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with VMware NSX.
  • Experience with SD-WAN technologies.
  • Knowledge of VoIP technologies.
  • Experience with SIEM platforms and security operations.
  • ITIL v3 Foundation certification.
  • Major Incident Management experience.
  • Server+, Network+, and/or A+ certifications.
  • Experience with automation or configuration management technologies such as Python, Ansible, Puppet, Chef, or SaltStack.
  • Associate or bachelor's degree, technical school training, or relevant military technical experience.


Ideal Candidate Profile:

  • Senior-level network professional capable of troubleshooting complex enterprise environments with minimal supervision.
  • Strong technical mentor who enjoys helping junior engineers develop their skills.
  • Customer-focused engineer who can translate complex technical issues into clear, professional communication.
  • Security-conscious professional with experience supporting highly available, multi-client network environments.
  • Proactive problem solver who looks beyond immediate incidents to identify root causes, automate recurring tasks, and improve overall network reliability.


If you're ready to take the next step in your career and want to make an impact, partner with trak group to explore this opportunity.

 woodfederalsolutions.com

  • Assist system engineers and cross organizational teams to formulate solutions in response to mission requirements.
  • Design and verify network solutions to support requirements for routing protocols, policy based routing, traffic shaping, border gateway protocols, tunneling IP Security, network address translations, network security, firewall contexts, load-balancing, latency, data throughput, WAN acceleration, and monitoring.

  • Experience with Wireless Technology, Enterprise 802.11 wireless

descriptionHtml:
Snapshot of the Role

As a Network Engineer with Husco, you will play a key role in maintaining and enhancing the global network infrastructure that supports our operations around the world. Serving as a primary networking resource across our international facilities, you’ll ensure reliable, secure connectivity, proactively monitor network performance, troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues, and drive network improvement initiatives that keep our business running efficiently.

This is an opportunity for a hands-on networking professional who enjoys solving technical challenges, driving continuous improvement, and making a direct impact on a global IT environment.

What You’ll be Doing:

  • Support and maintain Husco’s global network infrastructure.
  • Monitor network performance, security, and reliability across multiple locations.
  • Lead network improvement projects and deploy new technologies.
  • Troubleshoot complex connectivity and infrastructure issues.
  • Partner with IT and business teams to deliver scalable networking solutions.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and help shape future network strategy.
  • Develop and maintain network standards, documentation, and best practices.

What You’ll Need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in IT or equivalent combination of education and experience required.
  • 4 years of experience supporting enterprise network environments required.
  • Strong knowledge of routing, switching, wireless networking, and security principles required.
  • Experience with Cisco and Fortinet networking technologies and network monitoring tools required.
  • Azure Networking Experience is preferred.
  • CCNA certification and Fortinet training or certifications preferred.
  • Authorized to work in the United States.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive pay and benefits
  • 100% tuition reimbursement and support for continued learning
  • 401(k) program with company match
  • 3 weeks of paid time off + 12 paid holidays
  • Ample volunteer opportunities
  • Employee-led clubs and sports teams

Who We Are:

Imagine a place where your career can soar, where innovation meets excellence, and where your contributions truly matter. Welcome to Husco.

Here, you’ll find the freedom to shape your work and leave a lasting impact. We believe in empowering you to grow personally and professionally, continuously enhancing your skills and knowledge.

Your role at Husco goes beyond the ordinary – you’ll be at the forefront of supporting teams that develop innovative hydraulic and electro-mechanical systems that enhance efficiency and performance. These products make a real difference globally, building the communities we live in, growing the food that feeds us, and enhancing transportation around the world.

Join our vibrant, industry-leading team and experience a culture that values your creativity, dedication, and drive. Together, we’re not just achieving goals; we’re setting new standards and making a positive impact every day.

(HUSCO IS PROUD TO BE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER.)
