descriptionHtml:
KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is a leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We're also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

In this role, you'll join KAYAK's Infrastructure Operations team in our Cambridge or Concord, MA office and take ownership of the network infrastructure that keeps our datacenters, cloud connectivity, and office environments running reliably. You'll work closely with infrastructure, security, and platform teams — contributing to real modernization programs and day-to-day network operations that directly support the platform millions of travelers depend on.

If you bring curiosity to technical problems and care about doing reliable, well-documented work — we'd love to hear from you.

In This Role You Will

  • Own and operate datacenter network infrastructure, including spine-leaf fabric, edge routers, firewalls, and inter-datacenter links across our US and European sites
  • Plan and execute network changes — routing updates, VLAN modifications, firewall access control list changes, and peering route moves — with clear change management and minimal service disruption
  • Monitor all managed network equipment for faults, performance degradation, and capacity risks; respond to alerts and coordinate remediation with relevant teams
  • Support cloud network connectivity, including BGP peering, inter-datacenter links, and cloud network changes that affect production platform availability
  • Manage network authentication and access control infrastructure (centralized AAA policies, integration with identity providers) to ensure secure and auditable access to network devices
  • Contribute to active network modernization programs, including fabric upgrades and hardware lifecycle work
  • Document network procedures, runbooks, and change records to build shared knowledge and support safe, repeatable operations
  • Participate in on-call rotations to support 24/7 network availability, responding to critical alerts and escalations as needed
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive network tasks using scripting, reducing manual effort and improving team velocity
  • Collaborate with infrastructure, security, and platform teams on changes that affect network connectivity, replication paths, or storage access

Please Apply If You Have

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in network engineering, infrastructure operations, or a related technical role in a production environment (equivalent experience, training, or transferable skills considered)
  • Solid working knowledge of networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, VLANs, DNS, load balancing, and firewall policy management
  • Experience designing, operating, or troubleshooting spine-leaf or similar datacenter fabric architectures (Juniper, Arista, Cisco, or equivalent)
  • Hands-on experience with firewall platforms and network security controls in a production environment
  • Familiarity with cloud networking in AWS, GCP, or Azure — including virtual private networks, transit gateways, BGP peering, and security groups
  • Experience with network monitoring and observability tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, LogicMonitor, or equivalent)
  • Working knowledge of at least one scripting language (Python, Bash, or similar) for automation and operational tooling
  • Solid working knowledge of Linux systems in a networked infrastructure context
  • Experience with ticketing and change management workflows (Jira, ServiceNow, or similar)
  • A degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience

Nice To Have (not Required)

  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code or configuration management tools (Terraform, Ansible, or similar)
  • Experience with container platform networking or platform-adjacent network work (network plugins, ingress, service mesh)
  • Exposure to network authentication platforms such as Aruba ClearPass or similar centralized access control systems

Benefits and Perks

  • Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year
  • Focus on mental health and well-being:
    • Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth
    • Company-paid subscription to HeadSpace
    • Company-wide week off a year – the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)
    • No meeting Fridays
    • Paid parental leave
    • Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday
    • Paid volunteer time
  • Focus on your career growth:
    • Development Dollars
    • Leadership development
    • Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings
    • Travel Discounts
    • Employee Resource Groups
  • Competitive retirement and health plans
  • Free lunch 2 days per week
  • Fun quarterly events such as boat trips, arcades, ski trips, Thursday happy hours, and more
Compensation

There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. The range for this Massachusetts based role is $115,000 - $150,000 not inclusive of annual bonus and recurring RSU grants.

We offer a competitive base salary and benefits including: health benefits; flexible spending account; retirement benefits; life insurance; paid time off (including PTO, paid sick leave, medical leave, bereavement leave, floating holidays and paid holidays); and parental leave benefits.

Inclusion

At KAYAK, we want everyone to have the space to grow, share ideas and do great work. That's why we're focused on hiring the best talent from all walks of life and experiences, supporting them well and making sure no one feels like they have to fit a mold to belong here.

Need any adjustments for the interview, application or on the job? No problem – just give us a heads-up. We've got you.

descriptionHtml:
About The Role

It's a great time to join us at Airlines Reporting Corporation (ARC)! ARC accelerates the growth of global air travel by delivering forward-looking travel data, flexible distribution services and other innovative industry solutions. We are a leading travel intelligence company with the world’s largest, most comprehensive global airline ticket dataset, including more than 15 billion passenger flights. By working here, you can contribute to solutions and expertise that strengthen economies and enrich lives. We think big, embrace challenges and explore new ideas to lead the way for the travel industry.

ARC is looking for a Network Engineer IV to join our team! In this role, you will provide day-to-day service and support of the network operational infrastructure and maintain the core and edge data network for 24/7/365 datacenter, remote offices, and a remote disaster recovery site. You will create architecture and design, install, configure, and maintain the following types of equipment: next- generation firewalls, load balancers, VPN appliances, wireless technologies, and all switching and routing equipment and cabling. The Network Engineer IV will diagnose and resolve complex issues with technology and new products as needed. Identify potential future issues and suggest ways to avoid them. You'll work independently managing projects, technical issues, and problems without management oversight or direction. And, collaborate with peers and provide assistance with problem solving.

Applicants should be located within commuting distance of our Louisville, KY office.

What You'll Get To Do

  • Design, document, install, configure, upgrade, and maintain all equipment that supports network infrastructure environment plus: firewalls, web application load balancers, security appliances, and cloud technologies within established architectural guidelines and change management procedures.
  • Maximize network operation and performance by monitoring and troubleshooting network problems and collaborating with the leadership to address and mitigate future problems.
  • Perform all system backup and restore processes for disaster planning and recovery. Mentor others to meet deadlines.
  • Lead complex network infrastructure projects for installation of systems or for network design changes, work independently on assigned tasks and complete them in an appropriate time frame.
  • Keep up to date in advancements in the network technologies field by updating job knowledge, participating in education opportunities, reading professional publications, and participating in professional organizations which is critical in supporting business needs and users.
  • Strong understanding of cloud networking technologies (Amazon Web Services(AWS), Microsoft Azure).
  • Working knowledge of automation tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, and Github.

You'll Bring These Qualifications

  • Associate’s degree preferred; equivalent experience considered
  • 7+ years networking experience
  • Ability to manage complex projects and implementations with little manager oversight or teammate assistance.
  • Complex administration and troubleshooting skills of routers, switches, firewalls, VPN appliances.
  • Design and support complex WAN and connectivity using point-to-point circuits, MPLS, and IPSEC.
  • Advanced understanding of switching technologies like multilayer switching, VLAN trunking, VTP, spanning-tree
  • Advanced Knowledge of OSI and TCP/IP networking models, network flow, traffic patterns and optimization of network paths for best performance
  • Knowledge of secure socket layer (SSL) VPN administration
  • Advanced experience in managing enterprise wireless network infrastructure including wireless access points, 802.1x, RADIUS
  • Ability to configure custom monitoring of equipment with technologies like SNMP
  • Working knowledge of cloud technologies, and connectivity to cloud infrastructure
  • Advanced experience with cloud automation tools like CloudFormation and Terraform

What We Can Offer You

  • Joining ARC means joining a team that is motivated, diverse, creative, collaborative and solutions-oriented. We think big, embrace challenges, and explore new ideas to lead the way for the travel industry.
  • Our employees value the hands-on learning and professional development opportunities that allow them to expand their skills and grow their career in new, dynamic ways.
  • ARC offers WorkFlex. WorkFlex is ARC’s hybrid work program which offers eligible employees the flexibility to work from home while also requiring in office workdays throughout the year to foster collaboration and connection throughout the organization. We’ve designed WorkFlex to enable employees to succeed and thrive while maintaining strong connections to one another and ARC - both of which are critical to our shared success.
  • We offer a highly competitive, comprehensive benefits package so you can worry less and focus on what truly matters. Please click here to review our benefits on our company website.
  • By joining ARC, you will partner with top minds in the industry as we use data and technology to innovate how the world travels.

EOE M/F/D/V Females and Minorities Encouraged to Apply

descriptionHtml:
Behind every claim paid and every agent helped is a network that has to work. As a Network Engineer on our IT Infrastructure team, you'll help keep MOE connected and secure, working hands-on with Palo Alto firewalls, Aruba switching and wireless, SASE, and cloud connectivity across Azure and AWS. You'll learn alongside senior engineers, contribute to real modernization projects, and build deep expertise in network security and cloud networking along the way.


Location: The successful candidate will work on-site at our Home Offices in the Greater Seattle area. The candidate must live within driving distance of our offices.


What You'll Do-

  • Implement, maintain, and support our enterprise network, including firewalls, switching, wireless, and WAN/SD-WAN/SASE.
  • Manage the Palo Alto firewall environment, including policies, threat prevention, URL filtering, and tuning.
  • Administer Aruba CX switching and wireless (Aruba Central) across corporate and branch locations, while supporting our remaining Cisco gear during the transition.
  • Support and optimize Palo Alto Strata Cloud SASE for secure remote access and branch connectivity.
  • Support cloud connectivity across Azure (VNets, ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway) and AWS (VPCs, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect).
  • Strengthen security through segmentation, lateral movement controls, and access policy, partnering with the security team on reviews and compliance.
  • Contribute to network projects from design through implementation, and keep diagrams, runbooks, and SOPs up to date.
  • Share on-call duties and help respond to network incidents.
  • Stay on top of emerging tech and bring ideas to the team.


What You Bring-

  • Hands-on experience with Palo Alto firewalls (PAN-OS, Panorama) and Strata Cloud (Prisma Access, GlobalProtect).
  • Strong experience with Aruba switching (AOS-CX preferred) and wireless, plus familiarity with Aruba Central.
  • Working knowledge of routing and switching, including BGP, OSPF, VLANs, STP, and QoS.
  • A solid grasp of network security principles like zero trust and micro-segmentation.
  • Comfort in the CLI and with change management processes.
  • Systematic troubleshooting skills and a calm head under pressure.
  • Clear communication with both technical peers and non-technical leaders, and strong documentation habits.
  • Familiarity with Cisco IOS/NX-OS.
  • Bonus points for scripting or automation experience (PowerShell, Python, Bash, Ansible).


Education & Experience-

  • 3–5 years of enterprise networking experience in a production environment
  • Proven production experience with Palo Alto firewalls and Aruba switching and wireless (required).
  • Experience with Strata Cloud, Prisma Access, or SASE platforms preferred.
  • 1–2 years of Azure and/or AWS networking experience a plus.
  • Familiarity with DR/BCP network design, network monitoring tools, and SIEM integration (such as Splunk) a plus.
  • BS in a STEM field preferred, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Certifications preferred: PCNSA (PCNSE a plus), ACCA/ACCP, CCNA, AZ-700 or AWS networking equivalent.


Hiring Range: $116,300 - $130,900*

Salary Range: $116,300 - $145,200


Candidates with more experience may be considered for a Sr. Network Engineer position. Compensation and position will be commensurate with experience.

Sr. Network Engineer

Hiring Range: $161,700 - $182,300*

Salary Range: $161,700 - $196,300


*The Hiring Range represents Mutual of Enumclaw’s current hiring pay scale for this role. Mutual of Enumclaw reserves the right to modify or update this range any time. Exact compensation may vary based on skills and experience. Compensation is only one part of our entire total rewards package. To see some of the benefits and perks we offer, please click here.


Physical Requirements-

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer, including video conferencing.
  • Occasional DataCenter or Network Closet work.
  • Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds.

descriptionHtml:
About The Role

Together AI is looking for a Senior Network Engineer to design, deploy, and operate the global network infrastructure supporting our production services and high-performance AI compute environments.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone with deep networking expertise who can also troubleshoot across Linux, Kubernetes, automation, and application boundaries. You will work on large-scale, multi-vendor data center networks and help ensure they remain highly available, reliable, scalable, and performant.

The ideal candidate has strong networking fundamentals, experience operating complex networks at scale, and a structured, evidence-based approach to troubleshooting. You should be comfortable owning problems from initial investigation through root cause and resolution, including situations where the issue may extend beyond the network itself.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of professional experience designing, building, and supporting large-scale production data center, cloud, service-provider, or high-performance computing networks (excluding enterprise networks).
  • Deep understanding of TCP/IP and strong experience with technologies such as BGP, OSPF, VXLAN, EVPN, ECMP, and QoS.
  • Experience designing and supporting multi-tenant network environments using technologies such as VRFs, VLANs, overlays, and policy-based segmentation.
  • Hands-on experience deploying and troubleshooting network platforms from vendors such as Arista, Cisco, Juniper, and NVIDIA.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills using tools such as Wireshark, tcpdump, MTR, curl, nmap, and standard Linux networking utilities.
  • Ability to diagnose connectivity, latency, packet-loss, routing, and performance issues across the network, host, and application layers.
  • Experience developing or maintaining network automation using Python, Ansible, or similar tools.
  • Experience working through a Git-based software development lifecycle, including branching, code review, validation, linting, testing, CI/CD, deployment, and rollback.
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes networking, including pods, services, CNIs, and basic connectivity troubleshooting.
  • Foundational knowledge of RDMA networking and technologies such as RoCE or InfiniBand.
  • Experience with cloud networking in AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills.

Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, operate, and maintain global, multi-vendor, multi-protocol networks supporting high-performance AI compute infrastructure.
  • Troubleshoot complex network and application-connectivity issues, identify root causes, and drive problems through resolution.
  • Analyze telemetry, packet captures, logs, and performance data to identify network degradation, congestion, packet loss, and capacity constraints.
  • Participate in architecture and design reviews to ensure solutions meet requirements for performance, availability, scalability, security, and operational supportability.
  • Develop and maintain automation, validation, and operational tooling that improves network reliability and reduces manual effort.
  • Evaluate network hardware, software, optics, and emerging technologies for use in production environments.
  • Establish standards and operational best practices for network design, deployment, monitoring, change management, and incident response.
  • Lead projects addressing complex technical challenges and contribute directly to the network engineering roadmap.
  • Partner with infrastructure, systems, security, and application teams to troubleshoot issues that cross traditional ownership boundaries.

Preferred

  • Hands-on experience deploying or operating RoCE and/or InfiniBand fabrics.
  • Experience supporting GPU clusters, HPC environments, distributed storage, or other high-bandwidth and latency-sensitive workloads.
  • Understanding of AI training and inference traffic patterns and the demands they place on network infrastructure.
  • Experience operating networks spanning thousands of devices, multiple data centers, and multiple geographic regions.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted engineering tools and the ability to validate, test, and safely deploy AI-generated automation or code.

About Together AI

Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high-performance inference that scales reliably, fine-tuning and reinforcement learning for creating frontier-level specialized models, and pre-training at massive scale for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves 400+ trillion tokens a month.

Compensation

We offer competitive compensation, startup equity, health insurance and other competitive benefits. The US base salary range for this full-time position is: $190,000 - $280,000 + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by location, level and role. Individual compensation will be determined by experience, skills, and job-related knowledge.

Application Policy

Please read each role carefully and apply to the position best suited to you. Candidates are limited to 6 applications within a 90-day period, and applications beyond that limit will be automatically rejected. You may apply to additional roles 90 days after your last application.

Equal Opportunity

Together AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more.

Please see our privacy policy at https://www.together.ai/privacy

descriptionHtml:
At Bloom Energy, our vision for a world powered by clean, reliable, and affordable energy is more than just a dream—we’re making it reality. 

  

For over two decades, we’ve been at the forefront of the global energy transition, pioneering solutions that empower critical industries to thrive in a rapidly digitizing, energy-intensive world. From revolutionizing power for AI-driven data centers to ensuring resilience for hospitals, electric grids, manufacturing facilities, and utilities, our solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC) and solid oxide electrolyzer (SOEC) technologies are redefining what’s possible by delivering energy abundance for all. With more than 30,000 fuel cell modules deployed worldwide, we are the trusted partner for Fortune 100 companies and innovators alike. Our cutting-edge solutions enable unparalleled “time-to-power” capabilities, reliability, and sustainability, ensuring our customers remain ahead in a world where soaring energy demand and intensifying energy scarcity are rapidly becoming the new norm. 

  

At Bloom, we thrive on collaboration, bold thinking, and relentless innovation. We believe that, together, we can create a brighter, more sustainable future while tackling the most pressing challenges of the 21st century. 

  

We are looking for a  Senior Network Engineer to join our team in one of today’s most exciting technologies.  This role will report to our Senior Network Manager and based in San Jose, CA.  This is a fully on-site, in office role 5 days a week. 

Key Responsibilities:


  • Design, implement, and support wired and wireless LAN, SD‑WAN, IPAM, and WAN solutions from major vendors across corporate, manufacturing, and field environments.
  • Operate and maintain network infrastructure from major vendors, ensuring high availability and performance.
  • Implement and support secure network solutions using Palo Alto firewalls, VPNs, IDS/IPS, NAC, policy management, and network segmentation.
  • Support data center networking and connectivity to cloud and customer environments.
  • Troubleshoot complex network issues, participate in incident response, and support root cause analysis.
  • Contribute to network standards, documentation, configurations, and operational procedures.
  • Collaborate with security, IT, manufacturing, and operations teams to deliver business initiatives.
  • Assist with hardware and software lifecycle management, upgrades, and refresh projects.
  • Maintain accurate records of network assets, configurations, and system downtime


Skills and Experience Requirements:


  • Minimum 6-8 years of experience implementing and supporting large enterprise networks.
  • Strong hands-on experience and knowledge of wired and wireless LAN, SD‑WAN, WAN optimization, firewalls, VPNs, and data center networking
  • Experience defining operational standards, documentation, and network processes.
  • Solid knowledge of routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, ISIS), LAN Switching (STP, REP), Security (IPSec, MACSec)
  • Experience with Palo Alto firewalls, IDS/IPS and VPN design, implementation and administration
  • Experience with Zscaler implementations.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks effectively, and support multiple initiatives.
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Experience working on OT network environment is a plus.


Bloom Energy is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. We are committed to compliance with all applicable laws providing equal employment opportunities. All qualified applicants, will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability. Bloom Energy makes reasonable accommodations, consistent with applicable laws, for the known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified applicant or employee with a disability, who can perform the essential job functions, unless undue hardship would result.

At Bloom Energy, we are committed to supporting the well-being of our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits package for eligible employees includes competitive Medical, Dental, and Vision plans with a large employer contribution, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with company match, generous Mental Health Support services, Legal services, virtual Physical Therapy access, and Fertility & Family Forming benefits.

Bloom Energy is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices.

FULL TIME ROLE ONLY: The total compensation for this position includes standard company benefits and is based on various factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills and experience.

Salary Ranges:

$134,500.00 - $193,500.00

Description & Requirements

Maximus is seeking a Senior Network Engineer to provide expertise to a federal client in support of their mission critical systems in defense of our Homeland.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Network Engineer to join our team. As a Senior Network Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining our organization's network infrastructure. Your role will involve overseeing network administration, troubleshooting complex issues, and ensuring the performance, availability, and security of our network systems.



We offer flexible work arrangements to support employees while meeting client and program requirements. Relocation assistance is available to eligible candidates who currently live more than 50 miles from the applicable work location in Colorado Springs, CO.

Active Secret Security clearance required.

Maximus TCS (Technology and Consulting Services) Internal Job Profile Code: TCS167, T5, Band 8

Job-Specific Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Configure and maintain network devices such as routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, and VPN concentrators.
  • Monitor network performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement optimization strategies to ensure optimal throughput and reliability.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve network issues using firewall logs, switch packet capture tools, and Wireshark; engaging with cross-functional teams to leverage support and collaboration when necessary
  • Conduct network capacity planning and bandwidth management to accommodate future growth and changing business needs.
  • Collaborate with other teams to integrate network infrastructure with cloud services, storage systems, and other IT components.
  • Stay updated on emerging technologies, industry trends, and best practices in networking and recommend their adoption as appropriate.
  • Create and maintain documentation related to network configurations, diagrams, standard operating procedures, and troubleshooting guides.
  • Provide technical leadership, guidance, and mentorship to junior network engineers.
  • Managing, monitoring, maintaining, and securing networks and tenant network segments that integrate the transport of networks and data.
  • Organizing, documenting, and managing the delivery of Network load balancing services.
  • Document and Manage Internet Protocol Addresses

Job-Specific Minimum Requirements:

  • 12+ years of experience in a Senior Network Engineer role or in a related field.
  • Must possess ONE of the following certifications: Certified as a Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) OR Cisco Certified Design Expert (CCDE) OR Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert (CCIE).
  • An active Security clearance is required.
  • Due to federal requirements, only US Citizens can be considered. Candidates with dual citizenship cannot be considered.
  • A High School diploma or GED is required.
  • Candidates must reside within a commutable distance to Colorado Springs
  • Participation in a rotational on-call schedule for emergency page-outs is required
  • Additional tasks to be assigned as needed.

About The Job

We are seeking a Network Engineer to design, engineer, implement, and support network connectivity for our corporate offices and enterprise environment. This role applies network engineering principles to develop and maintain Cisco-based network solutions, assess connectivity and application requirements, and translate business needs into reliable, scalable network designs. Key technologies include Meraki Wireless, routing protocols (BGP, EIGRP, and static routing), switching, WAN connectivity, SD-WAN, QoS, AAA, and Azure Cloud. The role also evaluates new networking technologies, develops and tests technical changes, and supports implementation and ongoing optimization of network solutions.

What Does Success Look Like?


  • Engineer and implement reliable network solutions that meet business and technical requirements.
  • Develop and test network configurations and technical changes before implementation.
  • Improve network performance, resiliency, and scalability through analysis and continuous optimization.
  • Evaluate networking technologies and recommend solutions based on technical requirements and network engineering best practices.
  • Provide advanced troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for complex network issues.


What Does A Day in the Life of this Job Look Like?

Daily Operations


  • Design and engineer network configurations and solutions across routing, switching, wireless, WAN, SD-WAN, QoS, AAA, and related technologies.
  • Assess business, application, and connectivity requirements and translate them into network designs and implementation plans.
  • Develop, test, document, and implement network changes, including configurations, upgrades, and new capabilities.
  • Evaluate new and emerging networking technologies and recommend solutions that improve performance, reliability, security, or efficiency.
  • Perform network performance analysis, capacity assessment, and optimization to support a reliable and scalable environment.
  • Perform advanced troubleshooting, fault analysis, and root-cause analysis for complex network issues; develop sustainable corrective solutions.
  • Support network engineering for office deployments, infrastructure refreshes, and other projects and initiatives.
  • Partner with business stakeholders and technical teams to provide engineering guidance and communicate design decisions.
  • Provide on-call support for high-priority issues and use ServiceNow to document incidents, changes, and resolution activities.


Education

Background and Education Required


  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience


EXPERIENCE (and Other Qualifications)


  • 3-5 years of experience in network engineering, preferably in Cisco-based enterprise environments
  • Hands-on experience designing, configuring, testing, and implementing routing, switching, wireless, WAN, and/or SD-WAN solutions
  • Experience assessing network requirements and translating them into technical designs and implementation plans
  • Experience with network performance analysis, advanced troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis
  • Working knowledge of routing protocols such as BGP and EIGRP, QoS, AAA, and cloud networking concepts; Azure experience is valued
  • Intermediate understanding of ITIL industry standards, best practices, and audit requirements
  • Demonstrated proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Visio, PowerPoint, Word, and Excel


Other Skills/Characteristics


  • Ability to work independently as a remote extension of a larger team and collaborate effectively across technical teams
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate options and develop practical engineering solutions
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical recommendations to business and technical stakeholders
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Positive, flexible, self-motivated, and detail-oriented approach with strong follow-through
  • Ability to learn new technologies quickly and apply new concepts and procedures effectively
  • Ability to manage high-stress, demanding situations and handle confidential information appropriately


Salary Range: $98,400 to $115,800 annually + bonus eligibility. This is the expected salary range for this position. Ultimately, in determining pay, we'll consider the successful candidate’s location, experience, and other job-related factors.

General Summary:

The Senior Network Engineer is accountable for delivering reliable, secure, resilient, and continuously improving enterprise networking services that enable the University's academic, research, administrative, and student success mission.

As a senior technical member of Information Technology Services, this position designs, implements, operates, secures, and modernizes the University's enterprise networking environment. The role combines strategic engineering with hands-on technical expertise to ensure the University's physical and logical network infrastructure remains secure, scalable, highly available, and prepared to support future institutional needs.

The successful candidate is expected to maintain expertise in current and emerging networking technologies while continuously evaluating opportunities to improve reliability, security, automation, operational efficiency, and the overall customer experience.

Examples of Duties:

Primary Responsibilities

Enterprise Network Engineering

Design, implement, operate, and continuously improve the University's enterprise networking infrastructure supporting academic, research, residential, BMS and administrative environments.

Responsibilities include enterprise networking across the full communications stack, including physical communications infrastructure (Layer 1), campus LAN and WAN services, enterprise routing and switching, wireless networking, data center networking, Internet connectivity, and hybrid cloud networking. The position supports technologies such as OSPF, BGP, EVPN/VXLAN, IPv4/IPv6, network segmentation, resiliency, and high availability while maintaining flexibility to adopt emerging enterprise networking technologies as the University's needs evolve.

Enterprise Connectivity & Security

Engineer secure, resilient connectivity across campus, cloud, IoT and research environments by partnering with cybersecurity, enterprise applications, research computing, and external providers.

This includes Zero Trust networking, Network Access Control (NAC), secure remote access, firewall integration, hybrid cloud connectivity, identity-aware networking, Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, UMassNet, Internet2, and other strategic technology partners.

Engineering Excellence

Improve the University's networking environment through sound engineering practices, automation, lifecycle management, documentation, and continuous improvement.

Leverage scripting, APIs, Infrastructure as Code, monitoring, observability, AI-assisted operations, and engineering standards to reduce technical debt, improve operational efficiency, and strengthen service reliability.

Technical Leadership

Provide technical leadership for enterprise networking initiatives by leading complex implementations, mentoring colleagues, evaluating emerging technologies, developing engineering standards, and collaborating across Information Technology Services and the broader University community.

Decision-Making Authority

The Senior Network Engineer exercises independent technical judgment in the planning, design, implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of enterprise networking services.

Within established ITS governance, this position is expected to:

  • Make technical decisions regarding enterprise networking infrastructure. Recommend engineering standards, lifecycle investments, and modernization initiatives.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend adoption where appropriate.
  • Lead technical decision-making during major projects and critical incidents.
  • Balance innovation, operational stability, security, maintainability, and customer experience when making engineering decisions.

Work Environment, Schedule & Physical Requirements

This is primarily an on-site engineering position requiring regular engagement throughout the University's campuses. While limited remote work may be available in accordance with University policy and operational needs, the essential functions of this position require frequent hands-on work within the University's physical technology environment.

The successful candidate will regularly:

  • Work in telecommunications rooms (MDFs/IDFs), data centers, classrooms, laboratories, lecture halls, residence halls, and other campus facilities.
  • Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise networking infrastructure.
  • Participate in construction, renovation, infrastructure modernization, and lifecycle replacement projects.
  • Coordinate with Facilities, contractors, telecommunications providers, vendors, and campus partners.
  • Support planned maintenance windows, emergency response activities, and critical infrastructure deployments.
  • Collaborate with other IT partners on a variety of projects, planning and troubleshooting of campus critical technology infrastructure.

The position also requires:

  • Ability to lift, carry, and install equipment weighing up to 50 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Ability to climb ladders, work in confined spaces, and safely perform physical infrastructure work.
  • Valid driver's license (or the ability to lawfully operate a University vehicle) and the ability to travel between University locations as operational needs require.
  • Participation in evening, overnight, weekend, emergency, and on-call activities as operational needs require.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Seven years of progressively responsible experience designing, implementing, operating, or supporting complex enterprise networking environments.
  • Demonstrated experience with enterprise networking technologies, including routing, switching, wireless networking, physical communications infrastructure, and network security.
  • Hands-on experience designing, implementing, operating, and troubleshooting Aruba enterprise networking environments, including Aruba wired and wireless platforms, Aruba Central and/or AirWave, and ClearPass for network access control and policy enforcement.
  • Experience with modern enterprise routing technologies such as OSPF, BGP, EVPN/VXLAN, or comparable networking architectures.
  • Experience supporting enterprise LAN, WAN, cloud, or hybrid networking environments.
  • Experience with automation through scripting, APIs, Infrastructure as Code, or comparable technologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives, communicate effectively, and collaborate across technical and nontechnical teams.
  • Ability to perform the essential work environment, schedule, travel, and physical requirements of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting higher education, research computing, healthcare, or another complex enterprise environment.
  • Experience with Cisco, Juniper, or comparable enterprise platforms is also valued.
  • Experience with research and education networks such as UMassNet or Internet2.
  • Professional certifications or equivalent demonstrated experience in enterprise networking.
  • Experience leading infrastructure modernization initiatives.
  • Experience mentoring junior staff members in various technology capacities.

Supervision Received:

The Senior Network Engineer reports to the Director of Network Services and exercises substantial independent judgment in carrying out assigned technical, operational, and project responsibilities.

Supervision Exercised:

The Senior Network Engineer does not normally exercise direct supervision but may provide technical leadership, functional direction, mentoring, or project coordination to other employees, consultants, contractors, and student staff.

Application Instructions:

Please apply online with your resume, cover letter and list of three professional references.

Review of candidates will begin following the application closing date.

Only Internal candidates in the Professional Staff Bargaining Unit will be considered during the first 10 business days of the posting. All other candidates will be considered after that period.

Salary Ranges for the appropriate Pay Grade can be found at the following link:

Grade: 34

This is an exempt union position.

All official salary offers must be approved by Human Resources.

UMass Boston is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, we will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations for the hiring process. If reasonable accommodation is needed, please contact HR@umb.edu or 617-287-5150.

descriptionHtml:
Department: Technology

Location: Chicago, IL

Description

The network team designs, implements, and supports the network infrastructure for Wolverine's proprietary real-time trading systems, including proprietary hardware platforms, with a focus on low latency. Network performance and redundancy are critical to the global trading operation. The Network Engineer will be part of a team that works with Wolverine's software engineers and traders to support the high availability of the electronic trading infrastructure.

This is a hybrid position, with a mixture of working from home and working in our Chicago office. The candidate is expected to be local to the Metropolitan Chicago area and will periodically travel to Chicago and New Jersey area data centers.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, engineer, and implement low-latency network solutions based on requirements from business stakeholders
  • Own and manage strategic projects to implement and optimize low-latency, high-performance network solutions at and between data center locations
  • Work with financial exchanges, brokers, and banks to implement network connectivity in shared colocation facilities
  • Carry out high-level analysis and troubleshooting of the network infrastructure
  • Respond to network requests and troubleshoot network failures to diagnose, isolate, and resolve complex problems, ensuring timely results and minimal disruption to operations
  • Perform network maintenance and system upgrades, including patches and hotfixes to address vendor bugs and vulnerabilities
  • Monitor system resource utilization and historical trends, and perform capacity planning
  • Provide the technical knowledge needed to ensure safe, effective, and efficient changes to the network infrastructure
  • Produce and maintain detailed technical documentation
  • Participate in the team's on-call rotation

What We’re Looking For

  • Minimum of 6 years in a technical networking environment as a network engineer
  • Deep, hands-on experience with complex network designs and principles, including L2 switching and dynamic routing (OSPF, BGP, EIGRP) in complex environments, with advanced traffic steering, filtering, and route redistribution
  • Strong network security fundamentals: firewalling (ASA, Palo Alto), security zones and DMZ design, network ACLs, NAT, and site-to-site IPSec VPN
  • Solid knowledge of multicast (PIM, IGMP) and best practices for deploying it, including the delivery of real-time market data feeds
  • Extensive knowledge of network operating systems (IOS / NX-OS / EOS / PANOS based network devices)
  • Ability to troubleshoot network latency and packet-drop issues using monitoring, diagnostic, and packet analysis tools (e.g., tcpdump, Wireshark)
  • Meticulous attention to detail, with a proven ability to prioritize competing workloads and manage implementation schedules
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and the ability to work independently within a team structure
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to distill complex technical issues into clear, concise terms
  • Strategic thinking balanced with sharp day-to-day execution, and a commitment to continuous improvement

Preferred

  • CCIE certification
  • Knowledge of exchange connectivity in financial trading environments
  • Experience working with financial exchanges, brokers, and banks
  • Experience with network automation; understanding of Python and Ansible
  • Experience with physical planning, implementing, and supporting space, power, and structured cabling within a data center environment
  • Experience troubleshooting fiber optic connectivity within and between data center locations

Bonus Points

  • Hands-on experience with cloud services (AWS, GCP)
  • Understanding of network time synchronization protocols
  • Experience with databases and big data tools (e.g., MySQL, Splunk, InfluxDB, Grafana)
  • Experience with Linux shell utilities

We strive to be the experts of our own network, and this role is expected to operate with that mindset - including the willingness to invest the time needed to learn our environment in depth, and the humility to own and learn from mistakes.

We are currently only considering candidates who are presently authorized to work in the US for this position and who do not require visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Why Join Us

Our flat organizational structure promotes teamwork across the Firm and offers easy access to senior staff. While we work exceptionally well as a team in the office, our bonds are further strengthened through company events, activities and giving back. Volleyball, soccer, hockey, 5K runs, picnic, parties, and trivia nights provide friendly competition and build better relationships. By getting out of our usual environment and doing out-of-the-ordinary things together, we foster creativity and broaden our imaginations to accomplish new challenges.

Benefits

  • Highly competitive salary & bonus opportunity
  • Generous paid time off and flexible scheduling
  • 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, life, and disability benefits for single coverage
  • Generous Paid Parental Leave
  • Retirement Plans: 401K and Roth 401K
  • Profit sharing plan
  • Long- and short-term disability

Additional Perks:

  • Free breakfast and lunch from our in-house kitchen with rotating menus (including snacks!)
  • On-site gym with a subsidized membership
  • Frequent company outings
  • Opportunity to give back to organizations that help individuals in need in the Chicagoland area

Professional Development:

Department: Technology

Location: Chicago, IL

Description

The network team designs, implements, and supports the network infrastructure for Wolverine's proprietary real-time trading systems, including proprietary hardware platforms, with a focus on low latency. Network performance and redundancy are critical to the global trading operation. The Network Engineer will be part of a team that works with Wolverine's software engineers and traders to support the high availability of the electronic trading infrastructure.

This is a hybrid position, with a mixture of working from home and working in our Chicago office. The candidate is expected to be local to the Metropolitan Chicago area and will periodically travel to Chicago and New Jersey area data centers.

What You’ll Do



- Design, engineer, and implement low-latency network solutions based on requirements from business stakeholders
- Own and manage strategic projects to implement and optimize low-latency, high-performance network solutions at and between data center locations
- Work with financial exchanges, brokers, and banks to implement network connectivity in shared colocation facilities
- Carry out high-level analysis and troubleshooting of the network infrastructure
- Respond to network requests and troubleshoot network failures to diagnose, isolate, and resolve complex problems, ensuring timely results and minimal disruption to operations
- Perform network maintenance and system upgrades, including patches and hotfixes to address vendor bugs and vulnerabilities
- Monitor system resource utilization and historical trends, and perform capacity planning
- Provide the technical knowledge needed to ensure safe, effective, and efficient changes to the network infrastructure
- Produce and maintain detailed technical documentation
- Participate in the team's on-call rotation

What We’re Looking For



- Minimum of 6 years in a technical networking environment as a network engineer
- Deep, hands-on experience with complex network designs and principles, including L2 switching and dynamic routing (OSPF, BGP, EIGRP) in complex environments, with advanced traffic steering, filtering, and route redistribution
- Strong network security fundamentals: firewalling (ASA, Palo Alto), security zones and DMZ design, network ACLs, NAT, and site-to-site IPSec VPN
- Solid knowledge of multicast (PIM, IGMP) and best practices for deploying it, including the delivery of real-time market data feeds
- Extensive knowledge of network operating systems (IOS / NX-OS / EOS / PANOS based network devices)
- Ability to troubleshoot network latency and packet-drop issues using monitoring, diagnostic, and packet analysis tools (e.g., tcpdump, Wireshark)
- Meticulous attention to detail, with a proven ability to prioritize competing workloads and manage implementation schedules
- Strong cross-functional collaboration and the ability to work independently within a team structure
- Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to distill complex technical issues into clear, concise terms
- Strategic thinking balanced with sharp day-to-day execution, and a commitment to continuous improvement

Preferred



- CCIE certification
- Knowledge of exchange connectivity in financial trading environments
- Experience working with financial exchanges, brokers, and banks
- Experience with network automation; understanding of Python and Ansible
- Experience with physical planning, implementing, and supporting space, power, and structured cabling within a data center environment
- Experience troubleshooting fiber optic connectivity within and between data center locations

Bonus Points



- Hands-on experience with cloud services (AWS, GCP)
- Understanding of network time synchronization protocols
- Experience with databases and big data tools (e.g., MySQL, Splunk, InfluxDB, Grafana)
- Experience with Linux shell utilities

We strive to be the experts of our own network, and this role is expected to operate with that mindset - including the willingness to invest the time needed to learn our environment in depth, and the humility to own and learn from mistakes.

Our flat organizational structure promotes teamwork across the Firm and offers easy access to senior staff. descriptionHtml:
Business Unit Overview

Headquartered in Lakeville, Minn., Post Consumer Brands, a business unit of Post Holdings, Inc., is dedicated to providing people and their pets with delicious food choices for every taste and budget. The company's portfolio includes beloved brands such as Honey Bunches of Oats™, PEBBLES™, Grape-Nuts™ and Malt-O-Meal™ cereal and Peter Pan™ peanut butter, as well as Rachael Ray® Nutrish™, Kibbles 'n Bits™ and 9Lives™ dog and cat food. Post also provides private label solutions to customers in pet food, cereal, nut butters and granola. As a company committed to high standards of quality and to our values, we are driven by one idea: To make lives better by making delicious food accessible for all. For more information about our brands, visit www.postconsumerbrands.com and follow us on LinkedIn or Facebook for the latest news.

Location Description

Post Consumer Brands corporate headquarters in Lakeville, Minnesota, is about 20 miles south of Minneapolis and St. Paul, Lakeville has all the benefits of smaller town living with access to everything a large metropolitan area has to offer. Join more than 400 team members collaborating on the two-building campus to help put breakfast on the tables of millions of consumers in North America.

Responsibilities

Senior Network Engineer

As a Senior Network Engineer, you will design, build, secure, and support the enterprise network services that connect corporate offices, manufacturing facilities, distribution locations, data centers, cloud platforms, and third-party environments. You will bring hands-on expertise across LAN, WAN, wireless, firewalls, secure remote access, internet connectivity, cloud networking, and network monitoring.

Working across infrastructure, cybersecurity, applications, manufacturing/OT, and business teams, you will help deliver reliable, resilient, and secure connectivity. Your work will reduce recurring issues, strengthen network visibility, and support modernization, cloud adoption, site integrations, and technology refresh initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise LAN, WAN, wireless, internet, VPN, and cloud connectivity.
  • Support routers, switches, wireless infrastructure, firewalls, SD-WAN, secure web access, private application access, and Zero Trust Network Access technologies.
  • Maintain network availability, performance, capacity, and resiliency across corporate, manufacturing, warehouse, data center, cloud, and third-party environments.
  • Resolve complex routing, switching, latency, DNS, DHCP, wireless, firewall, and application communication issues; provide escalation support during incidents and outages.
  • Implement network security controls with cybersecurity partners, including segmentation, firewall policies, secure remote connectivity, vulnerability remediation, and audit support.
  • Develop scalable network designs, reference architectures, configuration standards, and technical recommendations based on security, supportability, performance, and cost.
  • Partner with infrastructure, cloud, security, application, and manufacturing/OT teams on hybrid connectivity, site integrations, acquisitions, expansions, and technology refreshes.
  • Use monitoring, analytics, telemetry, configuration management, and automation to improve reliability, consistency, reporting, deployment speed, and lifecycle management.
  • Maintain network diagrams, inventories, configurations, IP addressing, circuits, operating procedures, and troubleshooting documentation.
  • Coordinate with telecommunications carriers, managed service providers, hardware vendors, and project teams from planning and testing through transition to operations.


Why You’ll Love This Role

  • Own high-impact network solutions that connect a diverse enterprise spanning offices, plants, distribution sites, data centers, and cloud environments.
  • Help shape secure, modern connectivity through cloud networking, SD-WAN, Zero Trust, segmentation, automation, and observability.
  • Work across technical and business teams where your expertise can improve reliability, simplify operations, and influence enterprise standards.
  • Balance hands-on engineering and troubleshooting with architecture, modernization, and continuous improvement work.


Qualifications

Location Requirements:

  • Hybrid (2-3 days/week) at our Corporate Headquarters in Lakeville, MN.


Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.


Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of enterprise network engineering or network administration experience.
  • Strong knowledge of network segmentation, routing and switching, wireless networking, and network security concepts.
  • Experience supporting enterprise switches, routers, wireless networks, and firewalls.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex network, security, and application connectivity issues.
  • Understanding of high availability, redundancy, disaster recovery, network resiliency, and capacity planning.
  • Strong technical documentation and communication skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Cisco networking technologies, Cisco Meraki, Palo Alto Networks firewalls, Zscaler, SD-WAN, Zero Trust networking, and Microsoft Azure networking.
  • Experience with network monitoring and performance-management platforms, firewall policy management, or IT/OT segmentation in manufacturing environments.
  • Experience automating network tasks with PowerShell, Python, APIs, infrastructure-as-code, or configuration-management tools.
  • Relevant certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, Microsoft Azure, or equivalent.


Success in This Role

  • Approaches complex problems with strong analysis, structured troubleshooting, sound judgment, and a security-first mindset.
  • Takes ownership, manages competing priorities, and follows through on incidents, projects, documentation, and continuous-improvement opportunities.
  • Builds effective partnerships across infrastructure, cybersecurity, applications, manufacturing/OT, vendors, and business teams.
  • Communicates technical concepts clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences and adapts as networking technologies evolve.


Ready to Make an Impact?

Bring your network engineering expertise to complex, business-critical environments where secure, reliable connectivity matters every day. Apply to help strengthen the platforms, standards, and partnerships that keep Post Consumer Brands connected and moving forward.

The pay range for this position is $106,019 - $156,909 per year.

Post Consumer Brands corporate headquarters in Lakeville, Minnesota, is about 20 miles south of Minneapolis and St. Paul, Lakeville has all the benefits of smaller town living with access to everything a large metropolitan area has to offer. Join more than 400 team members collaborating on the two-building campus to help put breakfast on the tables of millions of consumers in North America.

Responsibilities

Senior Network Engineer

As a Senior Network Engineer, you will design, build, secure, and support the enterprise network services that connect corporate offices, manufacturing facilities, distribution locations, data centers, cloud platforms, and third-party environments. You will bring hands-on expertise across LAN, WAN, wireless, firewalls, secure remote access, internet connectivity, cloud networking, and network monitoring.

Working across infrastructure, cybersecurity, applications, manufacturing/OT, and business teams, you will help deliver reliable, resilient, and secure connectivity. Your work will reduce recurring issues, strengthen network visibility, and support modernization, cloud adoption, site integrations, and technology refresh initiatives.

Key Responsibilities



-  Design, implement, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise LAN, WAN, wireless, internet, VPN, and cloud connectivity.
-  Support routers, switches, wireless infrastructure, firewalls, SD-WAN, secure web access, private application access, and Zero Trust Network Access technologies.
-  Maintain network availability, performance, capacity, and resiliency across corporate, manufacturing, warehouse, data center, cloud, and third-party environments.
-  Resolve complex routing, switching, latency, DNS, DHCP, wireless, firewall, and application communication issues; provide escalation support during incidents and outages.
-  Implement network security controls with cybersecurity partners, including segmentation, firewall policies, secure remote connectivity, vulnerability remediation, and audit support.
-  Develop scalable network designs, reference architectures, configuration standards, and technical recommendations based on security, supportability, performance, and cost.
-  Partner with infrastructure, cloud, security, application, and manufacturing/OT teams on hybrid connectivity, site integrations, acquisitions, expansions, and technology refreshes.
-  Use monitoring, analytics, telemetry, configuration management, and automation to improve reliability, consistency, reporting, deployment speed, and lifecycle management.
-  Maintain network diagrams, inventories, configurations, IP addressing, circuits, operating procedures, and troubleshooting documentation.
-  Coordinate with telecommunications carriers, managed service providers, hardware vendors, and project teams from planning and testing through transition to operations.


Why You’ll Love This Role



-  Own high-impact network solutions that connect a diverse enterprise spanning offices, plants, distribution sites, data centers, and cloud environments.
-  Help shape secure, modern connectivity through cloud networking, SD-WAN, Zero Trust, segmentation, automation, and observability.
-  Work across technical and business teams where your expertise can improve reliability, simplify operations, and influence enterprise standards.
-  Balance hands-on engineering and troubleshooting with architecture, modernization, and continuous improvement work.


Qualifications

Location Requirements:



- Hybrid (2-3 days/week) at our Corporate Headquarters in Lakeville, MN.


Education



-  Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.


Required Qualifications



-  7+ years of enterprise network engineering or network administration experience.
-  Strong knowledge of network segmentation, routing and switching, wireless networking, and network security concepts.
-  Experience supporting enterprise switches, routers, wireless networks, and firewalls.
-  Experience troubleshooting complex network, security, and application connectivity issues.
-  Understanding of high availability, redundancy, disaster recovery, network resiliency, and capacity planning.
-  Strong technical documentation and communication skills.


Preferred Qualifications



-  Experience with Cisco networking technologies, Cisco Meraki, Palo Alto Networks firewalls, Zscaler, SD-WAN, Zero Trust networking, and Microsoft Azure networking.
-  Experience with network monitoring and performance-management platforms, firewall policy management, or IT/OT segmentation in manufacturing environments.
-  Experience automating network tasks with PowerShell, Python, APIs, infrastructure-as-code, or configuration-management tools.
-  Relevant certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, Microsoft Azure, or equivalent.


Success in This Role



-  Approaches complex problems with strong analysis, structured troubleshooting, sound judgment, and a security-first mindset.
-  Takes ownership, manages competing priorities, and follows through on incidents, projects, documentation, and continuous-improvement opportunities.
-  Builds effective partnerships across infrastructure, cybersecurity, applications, manufacturing/OT, vendors, and business teams.
-  Communicates technical concepts clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences and adapts as networking technologies evolve.


Ready to Make an Impact?

Bring your network engineering expertise to complex, business-critical environments where secure, reliable connectivity matters every day. Apply to help strengthen the platforms, standards, and partnerships that keep Post Consumer Brands connected and moving forward.

The pay range for this position is $106,019 - $156,909 per year.

descriptionHtml:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

  • Design, implement, and support scalable, resilient enterprise LAN, WAN, WLAN, internet edge, remote-access, and data center networks.
  •   Configure, manage, troubleshoot, and optimize Cisco routing, switching, wireless, and data center platforms.
  •   Administer Palo Alto Networks next-generation firewalls, Panorama, GlobalProtect VPN, security zones, NAT, security policies, URL filtering, threat prevention, decryption, and logging.
  •   Design and support high-availability firewall environments, including active/passive and active/active deployments where applicable.
  •   Implement and troubleshoot dynamic routing protocols, including BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, and route redistribution.
  •   Support Cisco enterprise switching technologies, including Catalyst switches, StackWise, EtherChannel, VLANs, STP/RSTP/MST, HSRP/VRRP, QoS, DHCP relay, multicast, and network segmentation.
  •   Support Cisco wireless environments, including wireless controllers, access points, RF troubleshooting, SSID design, authentication, guest access, and enterprise wireless security.
  •   Design and operate Cisco data center networking environments, including Nexus switching, vPC, VXLAN/EVPN, FabricPath where applicable, and UCS networking.
  •   Develop and maintain network standards, architecture diagrams, IP address management, runbooks, implementation plans, and operational documentation.
  •   Perform advanced incident troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for routing, switching, firewall, VPN, wireless, and application-connectivity issues.
  •   Monitor network performance, capacity, availability, and security events; identify opportunities for proactive improvement and automation.

Requirements And Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or IT;
  • Experience: 5–10+ years in network engineering, with specific experience in Cisco and Palo Alto technologies.
  • Technical Skills: Deep knowledge of TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, SD-WAN, and network security (firewalls, VPNs, IDS/IPS).
  • Certifications: CCNP, or Palo Alto certifications are highly valued or required.
  • Soft Skills: Strong leadership, mentoring, and communication abilities to manage stakeholder relationships.

Compensation & Benefits: Lucid offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability coverage; paid time off; paid holidays, paid sick leave; and a 401(k) retirement plan. Hourly/non-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours paid time off, and salaried/exempt employee accrue up to 160 hours paid time off. Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid’s equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program. Incentive and equity awards, if applicable, are determined based on individual performance, role scope, market considerations, and overall company results, in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.

Equal Opportunity: At Lucid, we believe diversity strengthens everything we build. Lucid Motors is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing an inclusive workplace for all. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable state or federal laws and regulations.

Accessibility: Lucid Motors is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need any accommodation to participate in the application process, please contact us at TA-Operations lucidmotors.com. This email address is designated solely for accommodation requests and is not monitored for job applications or resume submissions. To be considered for employment, all applications must be submitted through the Lucid Motors Careers website.

Candidate Data Privacy: By submitting your application, you understand and agree that your personal data will be processed in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice.

To all recruitment agencies: Lucid Motors does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Lucid Motors. Lucid Motors is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

descriptionHtml:
Summary

Under the direction of the Sr Manager Engineering and Infrastructure, this position proficiently applies IT methods, professional knowledge, and Valleywise Health Architectural Standards and practices and intuitively grasps familiar, stable system performance situations as it relates to converged infrastructure. The position focuses on how to design and manage complex systems over their life cycle taking into consideration topics such as requirements management, reliability management, logistics, coordination of different teams, evaluation measurements in terms of trade-off studies, and other disciplines and become critical tasks when dealing with large or complex projects. Also deals with work-processes, optimization methods, and risk management in every engineering engagement. Has and utilizes knowledge and capabilities in a specific knowledge domain or discipline to develop solutions. Considers multiple business domains viz., clinical management systems, business management systems, biomedical systems, and many frameworks such as architectural methods, engineering methods, SDLC, quality assurance, ITSM, Valleywise Health operational framework, and project management. Recognizes subtle problems with system design or performance and acts appropriately to improve the condition, seeking validation of actions in advance as appropriate. Manages relationships with business partners, professional peers, and other team members. Acts as escalation contact for dealing with challenging and complex technical issues. In addition, this position mentors team members and educates others on best practices.

Preferred Qualifications

The most important skill set is senior-level enterprise network infrastructure engineering in a complex, 24x7 healthcare environment.

We need someone whose primary strength is designing, operating, troubleshooting, and improving network and network-security infrastructure, including Cisco routing and switching, firewalls, VPNs, wireless, segmentation, high availability, monitoring, and lifecycle management.

This person must be able to lead complex incident resolution, perform root-cause analysis, develop and execute controlled change plans, work with vendors and application teams, document the environment, and mentor other engineers. Experience with compute and storage is useful, but this is not primarily a server or compute engineering role. We need a network engineer who understands infrastructure integration.

Advanced network certification, such as CCNP Enterprise, CCNP Security, or equivalent demonstrated experience.

Salary Range: $105,164.80 - $155,126.40

Local hybrid position within the Phoenix metro area only.

Qualifications

Education:

  • Requires a Master's Degree in Information Systems (IS) or related field; or an equivalent combination of training and progressively responsible experience that will result in the required specialized knowledge and abilities to perform the assigned work in lieu of degree. A Master's degree is preferred and may substitute for up to two (2) years of required experience; a Doctorate degree may substitute for all required experience.

Experience

  • Requires minimum eight (8) years of progressively responsible structured systems analysis, design, development, or systems engineering related experience that demonstrates an in-depth knowledge of more than two converged domains and a thorough understanding of the required knowledge, skills, and abilities.

Certification/Licensure

  • Must possess certification in a minimum of two (2) converged domains (advance level), and certifications in one (1) converged domain (expert level) that demonstrates a technical understanding and literacy within the areas of converged specialization viz. domains of Compute, Storage, Networking, Data Center and Infrastructure Services.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Must demonstrate expert understanding in the domains of Compute, Storage, Networks or Telecommunications and utilities by being able to design and implement its configurations.
  • Must have knowledge of methods viz.: Systems Engineering, and ITIL and an understanding and awareness of Project Management, Financial Management and Security.
  • Knowledge of biomedical devices is desirable.
  • Requires ability to conduct platform studies and performance analyses and recommends changes, and design methods/tunes systems/servers/networks to high performance.
  • Must be able to lead implementation and deployment efforts, and documentation and maintenance of hardware platform policies and procedures.
  • Must be able to create solutions to resolve complex operational problems, collaborating with vendors and users as required, and identify trends that warrant immediate attention.
  • Requires ability to provide guidance to management in predicting performance and capacity and addressing related issues.
  • Must be able to perform performance tuning, error tracking, and debugging; develop and executes complex change implementation plans; and resolve complex operational problems and determines root cause.
  • Must demonstrate an in-depth understanding of system/servers and utilities by designing and implementing configuration.
  • Must be able to execute thorough disaster recovery testing procedures, perform system management for complex development efforts, and set up most development environments with little or no supervision from lead system administrator.
  • Must be able to work with development team to configure and troubleshoot applications.
  • Requires ability to design complex hardware/platform infrastructure and interfaces.
  • Must be able to perform complex hardware sizing, troubleshoot complex hardware problems, perform as hardware resource lead on most projects, and develops high availability hardware platform designs.
  • Must be able to create, expand and maintain relationships with peers and stakeholders.
  • Must be attentive to communications interaction, demonstrate comprehension of detailed information, and adapt to a variety of verbal styles and modes of persuasion.
  • Must be able to bring conflict into the open and help resolve conflict; and create a friendly climate and good morale and cooperation.
  • Must be reliable, have ability to inspire performance and addresses issues effectively, and take bold and decisive action despite risks, conflicts and uncertainty.
  • Must be able to communicate a compelling vision that generates excitement, enthusiasm and commitment.
  • Requires the ability to guide others to setting goals that are aligned with organizational vision, culture, policies and practices.
  • Requires the ability to read, write and speak effectively in English.
