descriptionHtml:
Voloridge Investment Management was founded by David Vogel in 2009 and is based in Jupiter, FL. We incorporate advanced data science and mathematics into our systematic, market neutral investment strategies to exploit alpha opportunities we consider unique in financial markets. Our firm is comprised of award-winning predictive modelers, experienced data analysts, advanced technologists, and a group of dynamic business professionals.

Summary Of Job Functions

The Network Engineer is responsible for the day-to-day operation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of our enterprise network across datacenter, corporate offices, and cloud environments:

  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise LAN/WAN infrastructure including routers, switches, firewalls, and wireless
  • Support routing and switching across the datacenter and office networks
  • Design and manage networking within our cloud environments (VPCs, routing, connectivity, ACLs)
  • Build and maintain site-to-site VPN tunnels to vendors and partners
  • Assist with firewall administration, security policy, and secure remote access
  • Monitor network health and performance using enterprise monitoring tools, and respond to alerts, incidents, and outages
  • Manage network configuration backups, compliance, and IP address management
  • Support connectivity to cloud and third-party/partner circuits
  • Contribute to network design, implementation, and migration projects
  • Participate in scheduled maintenance windows, change management, and an on-call rotation
  • Maintain accurate network documentation, diagrams, and runbooks
  • Collaborate with systems, security, and infrastructure teams on cross-functional initiatives

Minimum Requirements

  • 4+ years of hands-on network engineering experience in an enterprise environment
  • Strong working knowledge of Cisco routing and switching (IOS/IOS-XE and NX-OS)
  • Solid understanding of routing protocols (BGP, OSPF) and Layer 2/3 fundamentals
  • Experience with enterprise firewalls and network security concepts
  • Experience with enterprise wireless
  • Hands-on experience designing and managing Cloud networking (VPCs, routing, hybrid connectivity)
  • Experience configuring and troubleshooting site-to-site VPNs
  • Experience with network monitoring and management tools (SNMP, NetFlow, config/compliance management, and alerting/monitoring platforms)
  • Strong CLI, troubleshooting, and packet-analysis skills
  • Clear documentation habits and disciplined change management
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience

Preferred Skills And Previous Experience

  • Experience with SD-WAN design and operations
  • Experience with Palo Alto firewalls and Panorama
  • Experience with Zscaler (ZIA/ZPA) or similar SSE/SASE platforms
  • Experience with Meraki Wireless Access Points and wireless networks
  • Exposure to modern datacenter fabrics (spine-leaf, high-speed Ethernet)
  • Cloud connectivity experience (AWS Direct Connect or equivalent)
  • Financial services or other low-latency, high-availability environment experience
  • Network automation / scripting (Python)
  • Relevant certifications (CCNP, PCNSE, AWS Advanced Networking, or equivalent)

Compensation And Benefits

  • Highly competitive base salary
  • Profit sharing bonus
  • Health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance
  • 401k

Voloridge Investment Management is an SEC registered investment advisor and an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply and will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic or status.

descriptionHtml:
Job Number: R0251951

Network Engineer

The Opportunity:

As a Network Engineer, you will be expected to configure and operate Cisco platforms such as ASA or Firepower, Nexus switches, and IOS‑based routers. You may also have responsibility in supporting routing protocols and tunneling technologies including OSPF, BGP or IBGP, GRE, and MPLS L3VPN. You will be expected to regularly troubleshoot complex network performance issues and implement corrective actions as well as support network architecture reviews, capacity planning, and performance optimization and integrate network security controls aligned to enterprise security and information assurance requirements.

What You'll Work On:

  • Support enterprise network modernization by designing, implementing, and maintaining secure and resilient network infrastructures across government environments.
  • Apply deep experience with Cisco technologies to configure, troubleshoot, and optimize routing, switching, and network security components.
  • Work closely with engineers, network operations staff, and technical leads to deliver reliable connectivity and ensure secure, scalable network performance for mission systems.


Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 5+ years of experience in network engineering, including designing, deploying, or providing advanced support of multi-protocol IP backbone and access networks
  • 2+ years of experience with Cisco network technologies
  • 2+ years of experience with security, routing, and switching protocols such as BGP, IS-IS, OSPF, MPLS, LDP, RSVP, VPLS, STP, or L3VPNs
  • Experience with network design, network performance management, or network planning
  • Experience with Juniper networks or MPLS L3VPN
  • Experience deploying, upgrading, and troubleshooting multivendor network equipment and solutions such as VMWare, Cisco, Palo Alto, Dell, HPE, or Juniper
  • Knowledge of network security principles
  • Secret clearance
  • Bachelor’s degree


Nice If You Have:

  • Experience with network operations support and enterprise network architecture
  • Experience with voice technologies such as Cisco TMS or Cisco Voice
  • Experience with network security auditing and information assurance
  • Knowledge of Cisco ASA Firepower, Cisco Nexus, Cisco routers, and Cisco IOS
  • Knowledge of LAN design, engineering principles, and hybrid delivery environments
  • Possession of excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills
  • TS/SCI clearance
  • Cisco Certifications, such as CCNA, CCNP, or CCIE Certification


Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Secret clearance is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $77,600.00 to $176,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

  • Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
  • Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen or customer facility, in alignment with your leadership's expectations and the needs of the role.
  • Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed full-time at a customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.


Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

Summary

Job Description

Oversees the evaluation, installation, and support of network communications equipment, including switches, routers, firewalls, and application delivery controllers/load balancers. Tests and evaluates the most complex network systems to eliminate problems and make improvements.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  • Installs and supports MPLS WAN (multiprotocol label switching for a wide area network) and IPsec VPNs.
  • Manages network architecture design and supporting network services including domain name system (DNS) and dynamic host configuration protocol (DHCP).
  • Uses diagnostic tools to monitor and troubleshoot network and security systems in a large network environment.
  • Gathers network reporting requirements in order to implement solutions to meet specified requirements.
  • Documents “acceptance test failures” and coordinates with vendors to correct defects.
  • Participates in the development, testing, and implementation of disaster recovery procedures.
  • Facilitates the selection and implementation of network, communications, security, and system’s infrastructure to match the global needs of the company.
  • Researches and recommends technologies for the development and performance maintenance of Company products.
  • In addition to the IT Infrastructure group, collaborates with engineering, architecture, product development, and marketing teams in proof of concept projects to prove out new technologies and how they may apply to future product.
  • Formulates designs by working with vendors and team members.
  • Collects and analyzes network utilization data; generates periodic reports for management; contributes to cost and technology analysis.
  • Executes changes to the environment within appropriate timeframes which may include non-standard business hours.
  • Adheres to change management and configuration management policies and procedures.
  • Keeps management informed through regular communication and status reports.
  • Provides rotational on-call support; responds during non-business hours to calls/texts/emails via a company-issued phone and pager.
  • Mentors and provides functional guidance and work direction to less experienced network and IT staff; acts as a lead in management’s absence.
  • Racks and cables network/server equipment as needed.

Supervisory Responsibilities

No supervisory responsibilities

Client Responsibilities

This is an internal and external client facing position that requires excellent customer service skills and interpersonal communication skills (listening/verbal/written). One must be able to; manage difficult or emotional client situations; Respond promptly to client needs; Solicit client feedback to improve service; Respond to requests for service and assistance from clients; Meet commitments to clients.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education And/or Experience

BS/BA and 8+ years’ experience or equivalent combination of education and experience, and 4 years of SME in respective areas

Computer Skills

  • Excellent working knowledge of a variety of networking technologies.
  • Efficient troubleshooting skills
  • Thorough knowledge of network communication protocols
  • Hardware architecture, disk arrays, drives and hardware capacity requirements.
  • High-level proficiency with relevant software, operating systems, and related technologies such as: Windows, Linux, Checkpoint, Citrix Netscalers, Cisco ACI, and UNIX among others
  • Experience with network design, development, and operational support
  • Strong proficiency in supporting applications from the network perspective and diagnosing performance issues
  • Solid working knowledge of current network technologies and application monitoring tools.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations

  • Cisco (CCNP or CCDP) or Checkpoint Certifications (CCSE or CCSE+) required
  • Cisco CCIE (preferred)

Other Skills And Abilities

  • Strong understanding of networking and routing protocols (EIGRP, OSPF, BGP, Ethernet).
  • Ability to read and comprehend packet captures.
  • Basic understanding of networking technologies with respect to server virtualization environments using VMWare.
  • Familiar with HIPAA, SOX and PCI requirements.
  • Good interpersonal and communication (written/verbal) skills.
  • Ability to work on a team and foster productive relationships with peers, management, and external clients.
  • Must be able to work beyond standard business hours as required.
  • Proven ability to train and mentor less experienced staff.

Reasoning Ability

  • Ability to apply principles of logical or scientific thinking to a wide range of intellectual and practical problems.

Mathematical Skills

  • Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.

Language Skills

  • Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.

Competencies To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:

Composure

Decision Quality

Organizational Agility

Problem Solving

Customer Focus

Drive for Results

Peer Relations

Time Management

Dealing with Ambiguity

Learning on the Fly

Political Savvy

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit and talk or hear. The employee is regularly required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel and reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Ability to maintain clear near visual acuity at approximately 20 inches or less (i.e., “close vision”) to accurately read fine print, view computer screens, and handle small objects. Requires adequate color vision and depth perception to support safety and precision in detail-oriented tasks.

Work Environment

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

This position may regularly be exposed to or encounter moving mechanical parts, high, precarious places, fumes, or airborne particles, toxic or caustic chemicals, outdoor weather conditions, risk of electrical shock or vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate (examples: business office with computers and printers, light traffic).

Work Location

This position must work on-site at the San Diego Headquarters for purposes of providing adequate support to internal clients; being available for face-to-face interactions and coordination of work with other employees, colleagues, clients, or vendors; as well as for facilitation of quick and effective decisions through collaboration with stakeholders. Remote work is not an option for these purposes.

Working Hours

This is an exempt level position requiring the incumbent to work the hours required to fully accomplish job responsibilities and meet deadlines for work deliverables. The individual must have the flexibility to work beyond traditional hours and be able to work nights, weekends or on holidays as required. Work hours may be changed from time to time to meet the needs of the business. Typical core business hours are Monday through Friday from 8:00am to 5:00pm.

Travel

This position requires domestic travel of up to 5% of the time.

descriptionHtml:
Overview

The Network Engineer will work to design, deploy, and support our hybrid networking environment, with a focus on on-premise data center, campus and SDWAN infrastructure and integration with Azure cloud networking. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience troubleshooting network solutions that bridge on-premises, branch, and cloud environments.

This role will be in our Saint Louis Park Office! This is not a remote position.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain Azure routing policies, particularly for vWAN architectures
  • Configure and manage Site-to-Site VPN, ExpressRoute,
  • Configure BGP routing, dynamic routing policies, and route propagation between SD-WAN campus and data center edges and cloud hubs
  • Troubleshoot routing, latency, and connectivity issues across on-prem and cloud environments
  • Monitor network performance and capacity
  • Maintain accurate network documentation, diagrams, and standard operating procedures
  • Respond to escalated network incidents
  • Partner with cloud, security, and application teams on network-related projects and migrations

Qualifications

  • 4-6 years of experience in network engineering, with direct experience in Azure cloud networking
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise scale WAN, LAN and vWAN
  • Strong understanding of network routing protocols, BGP, SMB, DNS, IPsec, OSPF
  • Experience with ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway, NGFW
  • Experience designing and supporting multi-region cloud networking
  • Familiarity with network segmentation principles
  • Working knowledge of IPsec and QoS in SDWAN environments
  • Excellent documentation and communication skills
  • Experience with multi-cloud networking (AWS/GCP) a plus
  • Relevant certifications such as AZ-700

descriptionHtml:
K2 is building the largest and highest-power satellites ever flown, unlocking performance levels previously out of reach across every orbit. Backed by over $1 billion in total funding from leading investors including Altimeter Capital, ICONIQ, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, and T. Rowe Price — and with over $1 billion in signed contracts across commercial and US government customers, we're mass-producing the highest-power satellite platforms ever built for missions from LEO to deep space.

The rise of heavy-lift launch vehicles is shifting the industry from an era of mass constraint to one of mass abundance, and we believe this new era demands a fundamentally different class of spacecraft. Engineered to survive the harshest radiation environments and to fully capitalize on today's and tomorrow's massive rockets, K2 satellites deliver unmatched capability at constellation scale and across multiple orbits.

With multiple launches in 2027 and plans to scale to 100 satellites a year, we're Building Bigger — helping develop the solar system and build toward a Kardashev Type II (K2) civilization. If you are a motivated individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment and you're excited about contributing to the success of a high-growth Series D-funded company, we'd love for you to apply.

The Role

You’ll help build and operate the networks that enable the design, testing, launch, and operation of high-powered satellites. You’ll be deeply hands-on – designing, deploying, and supporting resilient network infrastructure across production labs, factories, data centers, and cloud environments. You’ll work alongside Engineers pushing the limits of satellite capability, solving complex problems, and evolving our networks to keep pace with rapid iteration and mission-critical demands. As we scale, the systems you build and improve will directly enable faster development, more capable spacecraft, and reliable operations at every stage of the mission.

Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, and operate enterprise and mission-critical network infrastructure across offices, factories, data centers, and cloud environments
  • Provide hands-on support for day-to-day network operations, including troubleshooting connectivity, performance, and availability issues in production environments
  • Configure, manage, and maintain firewalls and network security controls, including policy design, rule management, segmentation, and integration with security tooling
  • Implement and support routing and switching infrastructure, including VLANs, BGP, OSPF, and high-availability network designs
  • Support hybrid and cloud networking environments, including VPNs, site-to-site connectivity, and secure access to cloud resources
  • Technology rollouts rollouts to support growing scale and complexity
  • Monitor network performance and health, leveraging logging and observability tools to proactively identify and resolve issues
  • Contribute to incident response efforts, performing root-cause analysis and implementing corrective actions to prevent recurrence
  • Maintain accurate network documentation, diagrams, and standard operating procedures
  • Support vendor and service provider relationships, including circuit provisioning, troubleshooting, and performance management
  • Promote operational best practices, including change management, configuration standards, and continuous improvement across the network environment

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in the Networking Architecture and Design, Network Implementation and Network Test Automation
  • Foundation in IT network and systems methodology (analysis, design, development, testing, implementation, and post-implementation support)
  • In-depth knowledge of networking protocols (e.g., BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, MPLS, TCP/IP).
  • Experience with logical design models (L2/L3, VPC, VDC, Datacenter Zones, Spanning Tree, VRF, VTP, VLANs, & cabling)
  • Working technical knowledge of network control protocols (QoS, PfR, PoE, NTP, DHCP), network management protocols (CDP, FTP, TFTP, SNMP) and security protocols (SSH, HTTPS, AAA, IPSec, TrustSec)
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., CCNP, CCIE, ITIL Foundations v3, etc.)

Nice to Have

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in computer science or engineering
  • Technical certifications (i.e., Network+, MCSE, Security+)

Compensation And Benefits

  • Base salary range for this role is $140,000 – $180,000 and equity in the company
  • Salary will be based on several factors including, but not limited to: knowledge and skills, education, and experience level
  • Comprehensive benefits package including paid time off, medical/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, paid parental leave, and many other perks

If you don’t meet 100% of the preferred skills and experience, we encourage you to still apply! Building a spacecraft unlike any other requires a team unlike any other and non-traditional career twists and turns are encouraged!

If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.

The person hired for this role will have access to information and items controlled by U.S. export control regulations, including the export control regulations outlined in the International Traffic in Arms Regulation (ITAR). The person hired for this role must therefore either be a “U.S. person” as defined by 22 C.F.R.

descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a skilled Network Engineer to support enterprise infrastructure and networking operations for a large federal healthcare program. The Network Engineer will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining secure and resilient network solutions that ensure high availability, performance, and scalability. This role will work closely with infrastructure, cloud, and security teams to integrate on-premise and cloud environments, supporting mission-critical applications and services.

The candidate must reside within the continental US.

Location: Remote (with occasional travel as required)

Responsibilities

  • Design, configure, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, and load balancers.
  • Support WAN, LAN, and wireless networking solutions across hybrid on-premise and cloud environments.
  • Implement and optimize network security controls, including firewall rules, VPNs, IDS/IPS, and segmentation strategies.
  • Manage F5 and other load balancing platforms to ensure high availability and application delivery.
  • Perform network monitoring, traffic analysis, and root cause investigations using tools such as SolarWinds, Nagios, and Wireshark.
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to ensure compliance with federal standards, including NIST and Zero Trust principles.
  • Support network upgrades, migrations, and modernization initiatives, including cloud-based networking in Azure and hybrid environments.
  • Create and maintain detailed network diagrams, runbooks, and standard operating procedures.
  • Provide Tier III escalation support, troubleshoot performance bottlenecks, and resolve incidents across enterprise environments.
  • Participate in change control processes, risk assessments, and disaster recovery planning.
  • Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance to team members.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field from an accredited college or university recognized by the U.S. Department of Education.
  • 5+ years of experience.
  • Hands-on experience as a Network Engineer supporting enterprise-scale environments.
  • Expertise in configuring and managing Cisco and Juniper routers/switches.
  • Strong experience with firewalls (e.g., Palo Alto, Checkpoint, Cisco ASA) and VPN solutions.
  • Proficiency in load balancing technologies, including F5 LTM/GTM/DNS, with the ability to troubleshoot persistence, SSL offload, and traffic steering.
  • Knowledge of WAN optimization, MPLS, QoS, and advanced routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP).
  • Familiarity with cloud networking (Azure, AWS, or similar), hybrid connectivity, and software-defined networking.
  • Strong understanding of network security principles, including Zero Trust, encryption, and segmentation.
  • Experience with network monitoring and analysis tools such as SolarWinds, Nagios, and Wireshark.
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex network issues.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate across teams and present technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Additional Qualifications

  • Relevant certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, JNCIE, PCNSE, or F5-CTS.
  • Experience supporting healthcare IT systems, EHR platforms, or large-scale federal data environments.
  • Familiarity with VA systems, policies, and compliance frameworks.
  • Experience using AI-assisted tools (for example, GitHub Copilot) to write and maintain network automation scripts and configuration templates (for example, Python or Ansible), including reviewing and validating AI-generated configurations in a lab or test environment before deployment.
  • Experience using AI-driven monitoring and AIOps capabilities to detect anomalies, correlate events, and speed root cause analysis across network monitoring data.
  • Experience using AI tools to analyze logs, packet captures, and traffic data during troubleshooting, with the engineer confirming findings before acting on them.
  • Experience using AI tools to draft and maintain network documentation, including diagrams, runbooks, and standard operating procedures.
  • Understanding of the network and security requirements for hosting and accessing AI services, such as secure connectivity to cloud AI endpoints, data egress controls, and segmentation.
  • Familiarity with secure and responsible AI use in federal environments, including using only agency-approved AI tools, never entering network configurations, credentials, or PHI/PII into unapproved tools, and following VA and federal AI guidance.

Benefits

  • Medical/Dental/Vision
  • 401k with Matching
  • Corporate Laptop
  • PTO + Federal Holidays
  • Training opportunities
  • Remote opportunity

Note: Selected candidates will be required to complete fingerprinting at a government facility and undergo a background check as part of the hiring process.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status.

  • Solid knowledge of VPNs, load balancers, NetScalers, and secure remote access solutions.

Daiwa Capital Markets America Inc. has a vibrant company culture made up of a diverse team of professionals. We seek to foster an atmosphere in which our employees understand, respect, and inspire each other. We will continue to build a culture that encourages everyone at DCMA to take pride in their work. How we work — individually, with each other, and with our communities — is just as important as what we do and shapes who we are as an organization.

  • Competitive Benefits Package (Medical, Dental and Vision)

  • Family building benefits

  • 401(k) with company match

DCMA has a hybrid work program in place, with opportunities for remote work depending on the nature of the role and needs of your department. This was implemented to provide operational efficiency while simultaneously giving employees flexibility. At a minimum, employees are expected to work in the office three days per week.

descriptionHtml:
About Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analysis that provide clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns.

Position Overview

The Information Technology (ITS) team at CRA is currently a Global team of 40 professionals dedicated to enhancing, maintaining, and developing the firm's technology infrastructure and security. The team is comprised of four functions: Service Delivery & Telecom, Enterprise Application Solutions, Infrastructure, Networking and Cloud Services and Security. Information Technology staff are based in the Boston, Chicago, London, Munich, New York, Oakland, and Washington, DC offices.

Responsibilities

We are seeking an experienced Network Engineer to join our small global networking team. The successful candidate will bring in-depth, hands-on expertise in planning, designing, implementing, documenting, securing, and troubleshooting enterprise network systems across campus, data center, wireless, WAN, and cloud environments. This position supports day-to-day operations and maintenance, advances security initiatives, and collaborates with IT colleagues and business stakeholders on a global scale. Typical responsibilities include:

  • Design, install, configure, test, document, and maintain secure network infrastructure across on-premises and cloud environments;
  • Identify, diagnose, and resolve complex network, wireless, firewall, DNS, and connectivity issues;
  • Produce and maintain Microsoft Visio network diagrams, implementation plans, configuration standards, and as-built documentation;
  • Administer and use Nexus Dashboard, Catalyst Center, Infoblox, and other management platforms for visibility, configuration, assurance, and lifecycle activities;
  • Maintain accurate configuration records, inventories, circuit information, support documentation, and vendor contacts;
  • Plan and execute upgrades while minimizing service disruption and maintaining tested rollback procedures;
  • Develop, implement, and maintain policies, procedures, and training plans for network resource administration, appropriate use, and disaster recovery;
  • Ensure network hardware, software, firmware, and configurations are current, supportable, and secure;
  • Monitor and test network performance and provide meaningful performance statistics, reports, and recommendations;
  • Coordinate with internal teams and external vendors to deliver projects and resolve incidents;
  • Coordinate across other teams within the IT department and across the firm; some travel to other CRA offices will be expected;
  • Some out-of-hours and weekend work will be required for scheduled upgrades and in response to unexpected outages.

Desired Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree (Master's desirable) in Computer Science, Information Systems or related discipline;
  • 4-6 years relevant work experience, preferably in a professional services environment;
  • Current Cisco certification at the CCNA level or a demonstrated track record of maintaining Cisco certifications at or above the CCNA level is required; CCNP preferred, relevant Microsoft Azure and AWS certifications highly desired;
  • Demonstrated knowledge of secure LAN/WAN, campus, data center, wireless, and cloud networking operations;
  • Hands-on experience designing, implementing, and supporting networking in both Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS);
  • Hands-on experience with Cisco Nexus data center switching, Cisco Catalyst switching, Cisco Catalyst wireless, and Cisco Firepower firewalls;
  • Experience with network management and automation platforms, including Cisco Nexus Dashboard, Cisco Catalyst Center, and Infoblox;
  • Demonstrated skill designing and documenting logical and physical networks using Microsoft Visio;
  • Strong practical knowledge of Cisco enterprise networking platforms across LAN/WAN, data center, wireless, firewall, and most importantly, cloud-connected environments;
  • Proficiency with network protocols and technologies, including Spanning Tree, DNS, DHCP, BGP, OSPF, HSRP, LACP, SNMP, NTP, IPsec VPN, and QoS;
  • Experience creating, reviewing, implementing, and troubleshooting firewall policies, preferably using Cisco Firepower;
  • Ability to create and maintain accurate network topology, rack, connectivity, and as-built documentation using Microsoft Visio;
  • Ability to propose and clearly communicate changes to existing network topology that improve availability, security, performance, and operational supportability;
  • Familiarity with ITIL change management practices, implementation planning, rollback planning, and pre-change risk assessment;
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across Layers 1 through 7, including packet capture and network performance analysis;
  • Must be comfortable in customer-facing scenarios and effectively collaborating in cross-functional technical teams;
  • Self-motivated, with a strong ability to prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment;
  • Ability to travel to other offices and execute project plans with minimal oversight.

Additional Preferred Skills

  • Demonstrated strong knowledge with Microsoft Azure networking, including virtual networks, routing, network security controls, and hybrid connectivity;
  • Demonstrated strong knowledge with Amazon Web Services networking, including VPCs, routing, security controls, and hybrid connectivity;
  • Cisco Nexus data center switches and Nexus Dashboard;
  • Cisco Catalyst switches, Catalyst wireless infrastructure, and Catalyst Center;
  • Cisco Firepower firewalls; Palo Alto firewall experience is also valued;
  • Infoblox DNS, DHCP, and IP address management (IPAM);
  • Cisco ISE and 802.1X network access control;
  • Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN;
  • Kemp LoadMaster load balancers;
  • Cisco Umbrella;
  • PKI, certificate lifecycle management, domain registration, DNS, and 802.1X fundamentals.

To Apply

To Be Considered For This Position, We Require

  • Resume – please include current address, personal email and telephone number;
  • Work Product (optional, submitted in cover letter field) – submit a sample set of diagrams generated with Visio.

Career Growth And Benefits

  • CRA’s robust skills development programs, encompassing both formal and informal programs, encourage you to thrive as an individual and team member. Training includes technical training, presentation skills, internal seminars, and career mentoring and performance coaching from an assigned senior colleague. Additional leadership and collaboration opportunities exist through internal firm development activities.
  • We offer a comprehensive total rewards program including a superior benefits package, wellness programming to support physical, mental, emotional and financial well-being, and in-house immigration support for foreign nationals and international business travelers.

Work Location Flexibility

CRA creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognize that individuals realize a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently expect that individuals spend at least 3 to 4 days a week working in the office (which may include traveling to another CRA office or to client meetings), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.

Responsible AI Use in Recruiting

We believe that recruiting is fundamentally a human process, and we are committed to a hiring process that is fair, transparent, and people-focused. While AI and other technology-enabled tools help our team operate more efficiently, we strive to provide every candidate with a personalized, thoughtful, and high-touch experience. As CRA invests significant human effort to find qualified members for our teams, we expect candidates to invest corresponding human effort to learn about CRA, prepare thoughtful application materials, and engage with our interviewers. Read more about appropriate hiring manager, recruiting team, and candidate AI at CRA on our website.

Our Commitment to Equal Employment Opportunity

Charles River Associates is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

Salary And Other Compensation

A good-faith estimate of the annual base salary range for this position is $130,000-$152,500. Starting pay within this range may vary based on factors such as education level, experience, skills, geographic location, market conditions, and other qualifications of the successful candidate. This position is eligible for additional bonus incentive compensation. CRA offers a comprehensive benefits package, subject to eligibility requirements, which includes: medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) retirement plan with employer match; life and disability insurance; paid time off (vacation, sick leave, holidays); paid parental leave; wellness programs and employee assistance resources; and commuter benefits.

Preferred qualifications:

  • CCIE/CCDE/PCNSE certifications.
  • Experience with planning and designing large scale networks (e.g., multiple sites, multiple products, etc.).

About the jobGoogle is proud to boast a network that provides service to millions of Internet users around the world. The Network Engineering team is responsible for operating that network reliably and at scale. As a member of the team, you have a direct impact on design and feature enhancements to keep our systems running smoothly. You also ensure that network operations are safe and efficient by monitoring network performance, coordinating planned maintenance, adjusting hardware components and responding to network connectivity issues. Google's complex network generates a constant stream of challenges which require you to continually be innovative with an evolving set of technologies. Keeping the network reliable ensures that our users stay connected with our suite of applications, products and services.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $150000 - $217000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .

  • Lead the requirement analysis, engineering design, and development of solutions for Google’s Enterprise network infrastructure, executing new feature qualification, deployment, and optimization.

  • Partner collaboratively across business units to analyze requirements, proactively develop solutions and policies, and lead assigned projects in all technical and communication aspects.
  • Coach peer engineers through effective knowledge transfer and cross-training, and participate in a 24x7 on-call rotation for subject matter expert Tier 3 support as needed.

  • Relationship Management

  • Audio Visual Services

  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams

  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience supporting IT Infrastructure Network environments and/or 6 years with advanced degree. Including but not limited to:
    • Design and implement network infrastructure: Plan, configure, and deploy Cisco networking equipment (switches, routers, wireless access points)
    • Network performance testing & validation: Ability to conduct site surveys and end-to-end testing to validate throughput, redundancy, and failover capabilities across all floors and workspaces

  • Collaboration with other IT teams: Work closely with systems, security, facilities and other operations teams to ensure seamless integration of their technology needs with existing infrastructure components
  • General understanding of Cisco Nexus 9000 series switches
  • General understanding of Cisco Catalyst switches (9300, 9200CX, etc.)
  • Eager to learn
  • Team oriented
  • Excellent communication skills (verbal and written)
  • Familiar with the following
  • Cisco Webex Calling, CUCM and UCCX
  • VMWare ESXi
  • Dell Storage systems
  • Brocade FC switches
  • SANNAV
  • Infor HMS and Sales & Catering platforms
  • Guestroom technology (InfoValue/Crave/JamF MDM solution)

  • Plan, design, and implement network technology related projects
  • Strong time management skills to manage multiple projects and tasks
  • Ensure future network related roadmap/strategy is sound
  • Fully document network related infrastructure
  • Support / troubleshoot network related infrastructure
  • Be a resource for the Engineering and QA teams with their projects, troubleshooting and implementations to production
  • Assist with other network and development projects as needed
  • Serve on-call duties to support the network for one week approximately every 4-5 weeks
  • After hours changes required on equipment that supports production
  • Occasional travel for network installations


Supervisory Responsibility

This position has no direct supervisory responsibilities but does serve as a coach and mentor for other positions in the department.

Travel Requirements

Travel Requirements: Less than 25%

Education

Experience

  • BGP, EIGRP and other dynamic routing protocols experience required
  • DHCP & DNS experience required
  • TCP/UDP experience required
  • Oracle Acme SBC and SIP protocol troubleshooting experience preferred
  • VMware Experience a plus
  • Excellent written and oral communication required
  • Network Documentation: Lucid Chart (or similar), Power Point, Excel, Word, etc.

  • Travel is required to support network project deployments to Call Centers, Data Centers and Training. (10% of time)

  • The qualified applicant should demonstrate a history of strong attendance.
  • Positive attitude, team player, good interpersonal communication skills and able to work across company departments and divisions with an inclusive attitude.
  • Locations:

The law offices of Marshall Dennehey, a leading defense firm, is seeking a Network Engineer for its Philadelphia, PA office.


Job Summary:

We are seeking a skilled Network Engineer to support, implement, and maintain our organization's systems and network infrastructure. The Network Engineer will be responsible for ensuring the stability, integrity, security, and efficient operation of servers, storage, firewalls and network security across multiple locations.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Support, implement, and maintain LAN, WAN, WLAN, VPN, and SD-WAN environments.
  • Configure and manage network hardware consisting of Cisco switches, Palo Alto firewalls, NetScaler load balancers and Meraki wireless access points.
  • Monitor network and system performance and troubleshoot connectivity, latency, and bandwidth issues. Respond promptly to alerts needing immediate attention.
  • Provide secondary assistance supporting the Exchange online email environment, including Mimecast email security.
  • Manage and maintain the storage infrastructure consisting of HPE Alletra, StoreOnce, Dell Compellent and Synology systems.
  • Support Microsoft Active Directory and domain services such as DNS, DHCP, and Group Policies.
  • Support Microsoft Azure environment, including synchronization between Active Directory and Entra, MFA, and Enterprise Applications.
  • Support Windows servers and Hyper-V environment, including cluster environment with multiple virtual machines and Hyper-V replication.
  • Administer and maintain Veeam backup and recovery solutions supporting both on-premises and cloud-based environments.
  • Provide hands-on support within data center environments, including the installation, racking, stacking, and decommissioning of network and server equipment.
  • Monitor and support data center infrastructure requirements, including power distribution, UPS systems, rack power utilization, and cooling requirements.
  • Participate in various Application and Development project upgrades, including configuring new servers, providing storage and performing network configuration changes.
  • Provide oversight of the Firm’s network and endpoint managed security products, and participate in regular security testing and remediation
  • Assist management by providing recommendations for future projects and budget planning.
  • Perform firmware upgrades, patch management, and network capacity planning.
  • Create, maintain and update accurate technical documentation in Visio, Excel and Word.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.


POSITION REQUIREMENTS:

  • Hybrid work environment consisting of working at the firm’s Philadelphia office and remotely.
  • Flexible schedule with the ability to work outside of standard business hours to support maintenance activities, upgrades, system migrations, and critical projects.
  • Must be willing and able to travel as needed to support branch offices, data centers, project implementations.
  • Must be capable of providing timely support during after-hours emergencies to ensure the availability and reliability of critical network infrastructure.


REQUIRED SKILLS:

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in order to effectively communicate with a wide range of personnel, including end users, IT personnel and vendors.
  • Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent time management skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines.
  • Ability to work independently and make wise decisions.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and to delegate them when appropriate.
  • Ability to function well in a high-paced and at times stressful environment.
  • Ability to follow process and procedures.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Minimum of 5 years network engineering experience in enterprise environments.
  • Experience supporting data center infrastructure.
  • Experience with cloud networking, such as Azure.
  • Previous experience working in legal environment preferred but not required.


Marshall Dennehey is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position.


Firm offers a sound future, competitive salary and an excellent benefits package.


Qualified candidates should submit cover letter and resume for consideration.


We are an Equal Opportunity Employer AA/M/F/D/V.

descriptionHtml:
Charter Manufacturing is a fourth-generation family-owned business where our will to grow drives us to do it better. Join the team and become part of our family!

Network Engineer II

Help Build the Network Foundation Powering a Growing Manufacturing Enterprise

At Charter Manufacturing, technology is critical to our success, and our network infrastructure is at the center of it all. We're looking for a Network Engineer II to help design, implement, and support the networks that connect our people, facilities, and operations across the enterprise.

This is more than a traditional network support role. You'll have the opportunity to contribute to strategic infrastructure initiatives, support new facility expansions, implement modern networking technologies, and collaborate with teams across IT, cybersecurity, and operations. If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, optimizing network performance, and building scalable solutions that support business growth, we'd love to talk with you.

What You'll Do

Design and Support Enterprise Network Infrastructure

  • Partner with senior engineers and architects to design, implement, and maintain enterprise WAN, LAN, WLAN, and cloud networking solutions
  • Help build secure, reliable, and scalable network environments that support business operations across multiple locations
  • Monitor network performance, availability, and capacity while proactively identifying improvement opportunities
  • Troubleshoot and resolve network incidents, outages, and performance issues

Support Growth and Expansion Initiatives

  • Play a key role in network deployments for new sites, facility expansions, and infrastructure upgrades
  • Configure, test, and deploy network hardware and connectivity solutions
  • Coordinate with business partners, vendors, and project teams to ensure successful implementations
  • Assist with technology integration efforts related to acquisitions, expansions, and modernization initiatives

Drive Continuous Improvement

  • Evaluate and recommend enhancements that improve reliability, scalability, and user experience
  • Support disaster recovery testing, failover exercises, and business continuity efforts
  • Maintain network standards, documentation, diagrams, and operational procedures
  • Participate in technology evaluations and vendor selection activities

Collaborate Across IT

  • Work closely with cybersecurity, infrastructure, cloud, and application teams to support enterprise technology initiatives
  • Mentor junior network team members and share technical expertise
  • Contribute to the adoption of emerging networking technologies and best practices

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; or equivalent experience
  • 3+ years of network engineering experience in enterprise environments
  • Strong knowledge of Cisco routing, switching, and wireless technologies
  • Demonstrated troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment
  • Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation and travel as needed

Preferred Qualifications

  • CCNA, CCNP, or similar networking certifications
  • Experience with: SD-WAN and SD-LAN technologies Azure and/or AWS networking F5 load balancing Riverbed WAN optimization
  • Experience supporting multi-site organizations
  • Manufacturing, industrial, or operational technology (OT) environment experience

Why Join Charter?

  • Work on high-impact projects that directly support business growth and expansion
  • Gain exposure to modern networking technologies across cloud, wireless, security, and enterprise infrastructure
  • Collaborate with a highly skilled IT organization in a manufacturing environment where technology drives operational success
  • Influence network strategy and infrastructure improvements across multiple locations
  • Join a company that values innovation, continuous improvement, and professional development

If you're looking for an opportunity to move beyond day-to-day network support and help build the infrastructure that powers a growing enterprise, we'd love to hear from you.

We offer comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits, along with a 401(k) plan that includes employer matching and profit sharing. Additionally, we offer company-paid life insurance, disability coverage, and paid time off (PTO).

We introduced precision medicine to the world and built an industry around the idea that every patient deserves answers as unique as their DNA. Backed by cutting-edge molecular science and AI, we ask ourselves every day: “What would I do if this patient were my mom?” That question drives everything we do.

But our mission doesn’t stop with cancer. We're pushing the frontiers of medicine and leading a revolution in healthcare—driven by innovation, compassion, and purpose.

Join us in our mission to improve the human condition across multiple diseases. If you're passionate about meaningful work and want to be part of something bigger than yourself, Caris is where your impact begins.

Position Summary

Given the forward-thinking business model, proprietary nature of the business, and the aggressive growth-oriented goals that Caris has, we have decided to expand the Information Technology team with the addition of an IT Network Engineer. This individual will take daily direction from the Manager of Networking, and be responsible for design, engineering, implementation and support of the Caris internal and external network. The goal of this role is to engineer, operate, monitor, and improve processes and technology related to Caris' network infrastructure. The Network Engineer will directly interface with IT internal customers, as well as Caris Life Sciences IT Leadership. This position reports to the Manager, IT Network and Security.

Job Responsibilities

  • Provides ongoing input into the formation and structure of the Caris Life Sciences internal and external network design.
  • Applies current computer science technologies to provide input into the design, development, evaluation, security, and integration of computer systems and networks.
  • Ensures successful implementation and system maintenance related to defined Standards, including participation in applying approved patches.
  • Support and monitors IT network systems to detect vulnerabilities and incidents in the areas of Cisco ASA Firewalls, Cisco Routers, Cisco Switches, Cisco Wireless, and Avaya CM systems.
  • Assists in defining processes and procedures to manage network security.
  • Provides technical support and consultation for enhancement of and changes to network configurations and associated processes.
  • Provides fault resolution and escalation.
  • Maintains documentation for assigned systems.
  • Maintains knowledge of current wired network designs, wireless network designs, network security designs.
  • Aggregates and correlates data streams with the goal of preventing network intrusion or exfiltration of data.
  • Monitors and resolves network metrics in the system and reports issues to management.
  • Responsible for providing timely, relevant network and analytical information.
  • Communicates complex technical information to team members and many levels of management.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in relevant field(s) of study such as healthcare administration, security management, management information systems, or business administration or equivalent professional experience required.
  • 3+ years of Cisco network experience including BGP, WAN routing, campus LAN, campus wireless access, firewalls, and VPN.
  • Technical background in network operations, campus network design, enterprise wide area network design, and network monitoring tools.
  • Demonstrated experience in network operations.
  • Maintain awareness and understand emerging trends and technologies in IT Networking and Healthcare and/or Life Sciences.
  • Demonstrated ability to apply IT in solving network and business problems.
  • Ability to conduct and document research into IT networking issues.
  • Skills in Microsoft Project, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio.
  • Ability to travel up to 10% occasionally, though generally less.
  • Knowledgeable in the practice of audit response, and application of appropriate Controls including people, process, and technology.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional certification in area of expertise is preferred (Cisco Certification, Network+ or equivalent), along with participation in nationally recognized networking organizations.
  • Proven abilities in problem management, process analysis and root cause analysis.
  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with the ability to manage up, down and across levels of the organization.
  • Highly self-motivated, self-directed, and attentive to detail.
  • Ability to work in a complex and matrix team environment; experience working in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.
  • Proven abilities in leading complex problem management and process analysis.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks, set priorities, schedule, and meet deadlines.

Physical Demands

  • Must possess ability to sit, stand, and/or work at a computer for long periods of time.
  • May have exposure to blood-borne pathogens, extreme temperatures, high noise levels, fumes and bio-hazardous material/chemicals including formalin in the lab environment.
  • Occasional lifting of items up to 35 lbs. is required when installing some IT equipment.

Required Training

  • All job specific, safety, and compliance training are assigned based on the job functions associated with this employee.

Other

  • Job may require after-hours response to emergency issues.
  • Periodically scheduled on-call may require after-hours response for technical emergencies not explicitly related to assigned job responsibilities.
  • Job may require periodic travel as needed.

Conditions of Employment: Individual must successfully complete pre-employment process, which includes criminal background check, drug screening, credit check ( applicable for certain positions) and reference verification.

This job description reflects management’s assignment of essential functions. Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

  • Utilizes network monitoring tools to proactively identify and address potential performance bottlenecks, security risks, and network outages

Through its subsidiaries, Ardent delivers care through a system of 30 acute care hospitals, 24,000+ team members and more than 280 sites of care with over 1,800 affiliated providers across six states.

POSITION SUMMARY: 

The Network Engineer plays a critical role in maintaining the stability, performance, and security of Ardent’s network infrastructure. This individual will be responsible for working outages, deploying new network hardware, and troubleshooting complex network problems.

Responsibilities



- Utilizes network monitoring tools to proactively identify and address potential performance bottlenecks, security risks, and network outages 
- Responds promptly to network incidents and outages, conducting thorough investigations to identifies root causes and implement effective solutions 
- Collaborates with other IT teams to resolve issues that span multiple infrastructure components 
- Maintains accurate network diagrams, configurations, and documentation 
- Troubleshoots LAN and WAN service issues on Cisco, Meraki, and Fortinet platforms 
- Configures switching platforms, Cisco 3750x, 9200 and 9300, Cisco Nexus, Fortiswitch 
- Configuration of routing platforms, Cisco ASR and ISR, Fortigate, Meraki 
- Installation of network hardware 
- Activation of leased WAN circuits 
- Participates in daily team meetings and various project meetings 
- Creates and reviews change scripts 
- Works with security team to mitigate active threats

- Associates’ degree in Information Systems / Computer Science or equivalent technical training.

- 5+ years of experience working in Information Systems, preferably in the healthcare industry. 
- 3+ years of hands on networking experience with Cisco and/or Fortinet products. 
- Experience troubleshooting and configuring LAN Infrastructures, STP, Ether-channel/Port Channel configuration, Dot1.Q Trunking, VTP, 802.1x, DHCP, DACLs. 
- Experience troubleshooting WAN infrastructures, routing protocols, IP ACLs, leased circuits 
- Experience troubleshooting AAA and TACACS+. 
- Experience designing basic IP schemes for branch locations. 
- Experience troubleshooting basic 802.11 wireless issues. 
- Experience configuring SNMP monitoring and logging. 
- Must demonstrate strong ownership of responsibilities. 
- Excellent documentation and communication skills. 
- Proficiency with Visio and Office applications.

About Legence

Legence (Nasdaq: LGN) is a leading provider of engineering, consulting, installation, and maintenance services for mission-critical systems in buildings. The company specializes in designing, fabricating, and installing complex HVAC, process piping, and other mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems—enhancing energy efficiency, reliability, and sustainability in new and existing facilities. Legence also delivers long-term performance through strategic upgrades and holistic solutions. Serving some of the world’s most technically demanding sectors, Legence counts over 60% of the Nasdaq-100 Index among its clients.

Location: Albuquerque, NM (Hybrid Flexibility with travel requirements)

Responsibilities

  • Design & Implementation: Evaluate, design, and implement network infrastructure with a focus on OSI Layer 2 and 3 protocols, ensuring seamless integration and optimal performance.
  • Configuration & Management: Configure and manage switches, wireless access points, and routers to maintain efficient data flow across the network.
  • Security: Implement and maintain security measures such as VLANs, ACLs, and firewall rules to protect network integrity and prevent unauthorized access.
  • Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve network issues promptly to ensure minimal downtime and optimal performance.
  • Performance Monitoring: Monitor network performance, identify potential bottlenecks, and optimize network traffic for efficiency.
  • Documentation: Maintain comprehensive documentation of network configurations, IP subnets, changes, and procedures for easy reference and compliance.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with IT teams to integrate network solutions with other systems and applications, fostering a cohesive technological environment.
  • Upgrades & Patches: Plan and execute network upgrades and patches, ensuring the latest features and security updates are applied.
  • Compliance: Ensure network infrastructure meets industry standards and complies with relevant regulatory requirements.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • A minimum of 5 years of experience working with networking equipment and related technologies.
  • Extensive experience in multi-vendor firewall configuration, with Palo Alto experience preferred.
  • Proficiency in configuring and managing multi-vendor switches and wireless solutions, with a preference for HPE, Aruba, and Cisco technologies.
  • Strong working knowledge of IPv4, VLANs, routing protocols, NAT, VPNs, and other related network technologies.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex network issues effectively.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a remote environment.

Compensation: $108k-$138k

Benefits Overview

401(k) Plan with Company Match: Currently match contributions dollar-for-dollar up to 4% of eligible pay; immediate vesting.

Health & Welfare Benefits: Employer provided medical, dental, vision, prescription drug, Employee Assistance Program and accident & illness coverage.

Life and Disability Insurance: Employer provided basic life insurance and AD&D valued at 50K coverage amount with the option for voluntary buy up for additional coverage.

Time Off: Flexible non-accrual vacation; company holidays per policy. (For California employees, this is separate from California paid sick leave, if applicable.)

Expenses: Business travel and related expenses reimbursed per company policy.

If you need assistance or accommodations during the application or interview process, please contact us at ta@wearelegence.com or your dedicated recruiter with the job title and requisition number.

Employment Eligibility

Candidates must have current work authorization in the U.S.; visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Third-Party Recruiting Disclaimer

Legence and its affiliates do not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies; any such submissions without a prior signed agreement authorized by Legence Holdings LLC's CHRO or Director of Talent Acquisition will not incur fees and are considered property of Legence.

Pay Disclosure & Considerations

Where pay ranges are indicated, please note that a successful candidate’s exact pay will be determined based relevant job-related factors, including any of the following: candidate’s experience, skills, and qualifications, as well as geographic and market considerations. We are committed to ensuring fair and competitive compensation for all employees and comply with all applicable salary transparency laws.

Legence and its affiliate companies are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

At the heart of Defining Possible is our commitment to missions. In rapidly changing global security environments, Northrop Grumman brings informed insights and secure technological solutions to enable strategic objectives. We’re looking for innovators who can help us keep building on our wide portfolio of secure, affordable, integrated, and multi-domain systems and technologies that fuel those missions. By joining in our shared mission, we will support your mission of expanding your personal network and developing skills, whether you are new to the field or an industry thought leader. At Northrop Grumman, you will have the resources, support, and team to do some of the best work of your career.

Northrop Grumman’s Corporate Sector's Chief Information & Digital Office (CIDO) is seeking a Principal Network Engineer to support its IT Infrastructure & Operations organization's Network Communications and Visibility (NCV) team in Redondo Beach, CA; please note that the candidate selected for this position will be required to work on-site, full-time at our Redondo Beach, CA campus – this is not a remote work opportunity.

The selected candidate’s primary focus will be on supporting the Redondo Beach campus and several remote sites. Additionally, the role will involve enterprise-wide responsibilities across the Northrop Grumman network footprint. The successful candidate will design, implement, and maintain high availability network infrastructure, work directly with customers and vendors, and contribute to continuous improvement of our secure communications environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, design, and deploy site and enterprise level network solutions in accordance with Northrop Grumman standards and best practices.
  • Produce comprehensive design review packages, including schematics, bill-of-materials, and implementation schedules.
  • Install and commission Cisco core network equipment (routers, multilayer switches, firewalls, wireless controllers, and access points).
  • Coordinate fiber‑optic and copper cabling projects with suppliers and internal construction teams.
  • Provide Tier 2/3 troubleshooting for WAN, LAN, and SD‑WAN environments, ensuring 99.9 % availability of firewalls, routing, and wireless services.
  • Execute corrective actions, hardware replacements, and software upgrades while maintaining accurate documentation in our configuration management database (CMDB).
  • Serve as the primary technical liaison with vendors (Cisco, Aruba, Juniper, etc.) for escalations, service definitions, and new service onboarding.
  • Work closely with the Redondo Beach sector customer base to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.
  • Implement and enforce security policies for network segmentation, access control, and vulnerability remediation in line with government and NIST guidelines.
  • Participate in after-action reviews, recommend process enhancements, and mentor junior engineers on best-in-class networking practices.

Basic Qualifications

  • Associate’s degree with 7 years of relevant experience, or a Bachelor’s degree with 5 years of relevant experience, or a Master’s degree with 3 years of relevant experience, or a PhD with 1 year of relevant experience; a High School Diploma or equivalent with 9 years of relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a completed degree.
  • Experience with managed network solutions and large-scale technical network engineering project experience.
  • Experience with Cisco Router and Switch equipment, Firewall Cisco Network Equipment, Cisco Wireless Technology, and Cellular Technology.
  • A strong knowledge of the TCP/IP protocol, Cisco Router and Switch products.
  • Knowledge and experience with LAN/WAN protocols and technologies such as multicast, QoS, CoS & OSPF.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Candidates must have the ability to obtain, and maintain, a U.S. Government Secret level security clearance as a condition of continued employment.
  • Experience with SDWAN methodologies/equipment a plus.
  • Experience leading enterprise projects for large networks.
  • Experience in designing network solutions.
  • Experience leading network implementation projects.
  • Project Management certification.
  • Experience using test equipment such as the Network Associates Sniffer, cable and fiber optics test sets, and other protocol analyzers.
  • A strong knowledge of Cisco and Palo Alto Firewalls.
  • Current U.S. government Top Secret security clearance.

We offer flexible work arrangements, phenomenal learning opportunities, exposure to a wide variety of projects and customers, and a very friendly team environment. At Northrop Grumman, we are on the cutting edge of innovation. Our diverse portfolio of programs means there are endless paths to cultivate your career. We also offer exceptional benefits/healthcare, a 9/80 work schedule, and a great 401k matching program. Come join us!

Primary Level Salary Range: $103,600.00 - $155,400.00

The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions.

Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business.

The application period for the job is estimated to be 20 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.

For our complete EEO and pay transparency statement, please visit http://www.northropgrumman.com/EEO. U.S. Citizenship is required for all positions with a government clearance and certain other restricted positions.
