About Us

Augusta University is Georgia's innovation center for education and health care, training the next generation of innovators, leaders, and healthcare providers in classrooms and clinics on four campuses in Augusta and locations across the state. More than 12,000 students choose Augusta for educational opportunities at the center of Georgia's cybersecurity hub and experiential learning that blends arts and application, humanities, and the health sciences. Augusta is home to Georgia's only public academic health center, where groundbreaking research is creating a healthier, more prosperous Georgia, and world-class clinicians are bringing the medicine of tomorrow to patient care today. Our mission and values https://www.augusta.edu/about/mission.php make Augusta University an institution like no other.

Augusta University's distinct characteristics in education and research include real-world experiences and community engagement, as well as a culture of building community, corporate and government partnerships that address health, security, economic and societal concerns locally and across the state.

The University System of Georgia https://www.usg.edu/hr/orientation/welcome_to_the_board_of_regents_university_system_office is comprised of our 26 institutions of higher education and learning as well as the System Office. Our USG Statement of Core Values are Integrity, Excellence, Accountability, and Respect. These values serve as the foundation for all that we do as an organization, and each USG community member is responsible for demonstrating and upholding these standards. More details on the USG Statement of Core Values and Code of Conduct are available in USG Board Policy 8.2.18.1.2 and can be found online at https://www.usg.edu/policymanual/section8/C224/#p8.2.18_personnel_conduct.

Additionally, USG supports Freedom of Expression as stated in Board Policy 6.5 Freedom of Expression and Academic Freedom found online at https://www.usg.edu/policymanual/section6/C2653 .

Location

Augusta University

Our Health Sciences Campus:

1120 15th Street, Augusta, GA 30912

Our Summerville Campus:

2500 Walton Way, Augusta, GA 30904

College/Department Information

The Division of Information Technology's mission at Augusta University is to anticipate and respond effectively to a changing world with agile, innovative, robust and secure services that educate and inspire students, empower clinicians, educators, researchers and administrators, advance learning, discovery and care.

Job Summary

The Network Engineer ensures the stability, security, and performance of data, voice, video, and wireless network services. This role designs, implements, supports, and maintains LAN/WAN infrastructure across the organization. Responsibilities include installing, monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimizing network systems while providing technical support and guidance.

Key Responsibilities:

Install, configure, test, document, and maintain network equipment and systems according to approved standards.

Support network upgrades and expansion projects, including hardware/software deployment and integration testing.

Create and maintain technical documentation, procedures, network diagrams, and troubleshooting guides.

Perform daily administration to ensure network reliability, availability, performance, and continuity.

Strengthen security by identifying vulnerabilities, mitigating cyber threats, and staying current on emerging risks.

Manage firewalls, internet connectivity, and security policies.

Respond to support tickets, diagnose network issues, and implement timely resolutions.

Monitor network performance, analyze data, and recommend improvements to enhance capacity, efficiency, and reliability.

Responsibilities

The duties include, but are not limited to:

OPERATIONAL MANAGEMENT:

Configure networks to ensure their smooth and reliable operation for fulfilling business objectives and processes.

Monitor network performance and troubleshoot problem areas as needed.

Under direction of senior engineer, install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot end user workstation hardware, software, and peripheral devices.

Ensure network connectivity of all servers, workstations, telephony equipment, fax machines, and other network appliances.

Practice network asset management, including maintenance of network component inventory and related documentation and technical specifications information.

Monitor and test network performance and provide network performance statistics and reports.

Participate in managing all network security solutions.

ACQUISITION AND DEPLOYMENT:

Design and deploy company LANs, WANs, and wireless networks, including servers, routers, switches, UPSs, and other hardware

Design, Implement, and support firewalls, site-to-site VPNs, and remote-access VPNs Conduct

research on network products, services, protocols, and standards to remain abreast of developments in the networking industry

Interact and negotiate with vendors, outsourcers, and contractors to secure network products and services.

NETWORK INFRASTRUCTURE SUPPORT:

Work with senior engineers to design and deploy company LANs, WANs, and wireless networks, including servers, routers, switches, UPSs, and other hardware

Support firewalls, site-to-site VPNs, and remote-access VPNs Conduct

research on network products, services, protocols, and standards to remain abreast of developments in the networking industry.

Interact and negotiate with vendors, outsourcers, and contractors to secure network products and services.

OTHER: Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university with two years of experience administering complex LAN/WAN environments.

Preferred Qualifications

Industry-related experience as a Senior Network Engineer or Network Administrator

Professional certification (e.g. CCNP, CCDP)

Solid background in network administration and architecture

In-depth understanding of communication protocols (mainly TCP/IP) and routing protocols (e.g. BGP, OSPF)

Familiarity with access control models and network security

Experience with network diagnostic, monitoring and analysis tools (e.g. SolarWinds network tools)

Solid understanding of network operating systems (Cisco IOS)

Sharp troubleshooting skills

Ability to work independently

Organizational and mentoring skills

Preferred Experience

Experience designing, implementing, managing and supporting enterprise level IP networks that include support of a heterogeneous distributed desktop computing environment required.

Proven experience and success with LAN, WAN, and WLAN design and implementation.

Experience with network security principles, and general network management best practices.

Excellent hardware troubleshooting experience.

Application support experience with network monitoring and analysis software.

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

Clearance: Secret Clearance

Location: Pearl Harbor, HI

Job Type: Full-Time

Target Salary Range*: $150,000 - $170,000

  • This represents the potential salary range for this position depending on education level, years of experience and/or certifications in addition to other position specific requirements which may impact salary

Position Overview

The Senior Network Engineer provides engineering expertise and operational support for a large-scale enterprise intranet environment. This role leads efforts to identify, troubleshoot, analyze, and resolve complex network issues across enterprise network infrastructure, including switches, routers, VLANs, wireless access points, firewalls, and network sensors.

The Senior Network Engineer serves as a Tier III escalation resource and subject matter expert for complex incidents, network troubleshooting, configuration management, pre-production validation, and enterprise network changes. This role collaborates with engineering, operations, architecture, vendor, and program teams to enhance network availability, performance, reliability, and security.

Key ResponsibilitiesNetwork Engineering and Troubleshooting

  • Lead efforts to identify, troubleshoot, analyze, and resolve complex network issues in a dynamic enterprise environment.
  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot network infrastructure, including switches, routers, VLANs, wireless access points, firewalls, and network sensors.
  • Provide engineering expertise and operational support for one of the world’s largest intranet environments.
  • Serve as a Tier III escalation resource for complex incidents, coordinating with vendors as necessary for incident resolution.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert and technical backstop for troubleshooting efforts involving multiple network disciplines and teams of CCNP/CCIE-level engineers.
  • Troubleshoot technologies and protocols, including routing, switching, SD-WAN, WLAN, MPLS, VPNs, OSPF, BGP, EIGRP, switching protocols, and multicast.

Network Security and Enterprise Collaboration

  • Apply extensive knowledge of defense-in-depth principles to secure enterprise network infrastructure.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional engineering and operations teams to enhance network availability, performance, reliability, and security.
  • Participate in engineering, architecture, and project meetings to design and develop future enterprise network solutions.

Implementation Planning and Change Management

  • Develop and maintain Engineering Implementation Plans supporting network changes and deployments.
  • Create and manage change management tickets for deployments, maintenance activities, upgrades, and other network changes.
  • Conduct Root Cause Analysis in support of problem management activities and recurring incident resolution.

Agile Delivery and Technical Communication

  • Track engineering and operational work within an Agile/SAFe framework using Jira.
  • Participate in Daily Stand-Ups, retrospectives, Program Increment activities, and other Agile ceremonies.
  • Develop and deliver detailed demonstrations and technical updates supporting Program Increment objectives.

Configuration Baseline Management

  • Maintain version-controlled configuration baselines for network infrastructure devices, including routers, switches, firewalls, and sensors.
  • Maintain accurate records of startup and running configurations, firmware versions, security policies, and associated network configuration data.
  • Ensure configuration changes are properly documented, peer-reviewed, approved, and backed up to a centralized repository.
  • Maintain change-tracking and rollback capabilities to support operational resilience and configuration recovery.
  • Ensure network configurations remain compliant with applicable DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides and organizational cybersecurity policies.

Lab Testing and Pre-Production Validation

  • Conduct pre-production validation testing for firmware upgrades, configuration changes, and security patches before deployment to production networks.
  • Perform testing within an isolated lab environment designed to mirror applicable production network topology and configurations.
  • Validate network functionality, security policies and controls, device interoperability, performance against established baselines, and deployment and rollback procedures.
  • Document testing results, identified risks, remediation requirements, and deployment recommendations prior to production implementation.

QualificationsEducation

  • Bachelor’s degree with 8–12 years of relevant professional experience; or
  • Master’s degree with 6–10 years of relevant professional experience.
  • Equivalent education and experience substitutions may be considered at the Hiring Manager’s discretion.

Experience

  • Subject matter expertise in BAN/LAN/WAN/WLAN and Network Boundary engineering. [Required]
  • Extensive experience performing highly technical network maintenance, configuration, troubleshooting, and engineering activities. [Required]
  • Experience providing Tier III escalation support in large-scale enterprise environments. [Required]
  • Experience supporting networks of comparable scale to 16,000+ devices across 450+ geographically dispersed locations. [Required]
  • Demonstrated ability to serve as a subject matter expert and escalation backstop for troubleshooting across multiple network disciplines. [Required]
  • Extensive hands-on troubleshooting experience with routing, switching, SD-WAN, WLAN, MPLS, VPNs, OSPF, BGP, EIGRP, switching protocols, and multicast. [Required]
  • Experience with SAFe Agile methodologies and Jira. [Required]

Skills

  • Strong understanding of network security and defense-in-depth principles. [Required]
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. [Required]
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills. [Required]
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts effectively to engineering teams, program leadership, customers, and other stakeholders. [Required]

Certifications

  • DoD 8570.01 IAT Level III certification, such as CASP+, CISSP, CCNP Security, or another qualifying certification. [Required]
  • Recognized network vendor certification, such as Cisco CCNA, CCNP, or CCIE. [Required]

Clearance

  • Active Secret security clearance. [Required]
  • Must be Top Secret eligible. [Required]

Other Requirements

  • Willingness and ability to participate in an on-call rotation. [Required]
  • Ability to perform scheduled and unscheduled work during off-hours, including maintenance windows, when required. [Required]
  • Ability to travel up to 10%. [Required]

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience supporting the Navy Marine Corps Intranet network.
  • Previous experience supporting Department of Defense programs and environments.
  • Experience with network automation and Infrastructure as Code technologies and practices.
  • Hands-on experience with automation technologies such as Ansible and Python.
  • Experience with Arista networking technologies.
  • Advanced Cisco networking certifications, including CCNP or CCIE.

About Us

AGE Solutions is a premier technology and professional services company, providing in-depth consulting, advanced technology solutions, and essential services throughout the U.S. government, defense, and intelligence sectors. Prioritizing innovation and client-focused solutions, we assist major agencies in addressing intricate issues and ensuring a more secure future.

The Corporate Enterprise Network (WAN): Network Engineer – Senior provides senior-level network engineering, implementation, modernization, and sustainment support for a DoD customer's global classified and unclassified WAN infrastructure. Responsible for ensuring secure, reliable connectivity between DoD facilities, networks, cloud environments, and mission-critical enterprise services.

Responsibilities Include

  • Design, configure, install, test, and maintain enterprise WAN routers, switches, firewalls, and associated infrastructure.
  • Support WAN connectivity across classified and unclassified networks as well as connectivity with DISN, NIPRNet, SIPRNet, and other DoD networks.
  • Configure and troubleshoot advanced routing and switching technologies, including BGP, OSPF, MPLS, multicast, QoS, and IPv4/IPv6.
  • Engineer and maintain Cisco networking platforms and Check Point firewall technologies.
  • Implement network technology refreshes, equipment replacements, and infrastructure modernization.
  • Perform Tier III/IV troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and restoration of network services.
  • Provide 24x7x365 on-call engineering support as required.
  • Conduct site surveys, infrastructure assessments, installation planning, and implementation activities.
  • Support DISA circuit provisioning, testing, activation, and troubleshooting.
  • Develop Engineering Change Requests, implementation plans, test plans, rollback procedures, and network diagrams.
  • Apply DISA STIGs, agency configuration standards, and cybersecurity requirements to network devices.
  • Evaluate network capacity, utilization, performance, and potential reliability improvements.
  • Support enterprise cloud connectivity, application delivery, and secure network integration.
  • Conduct laboratory testing, technology evaluations, and interoperability validation.
  • Provide technical support to Government and contractor WAN Management, NOC personnel, and other engineering teams.
  • Travel to CONUS or OCONUS locations for network installation or troubleshooting as required.

Required Skills, Qualifications And Experience

  • Experience:
    • Five years of progressive IT experience, including at least two projects involving Network and Telecommunications Services and Network Management. At least one qualifying project must have occurred within the previous three years.
  • Education:
    • High School Diploma.
  • Citizenship and Clearance:
    • US Citizenship is required.
    • DoD Top Secret clearance or Secret clearance with favorably adjudicated Tier 5/SSBI investigation.
  • Certification:
    • DoD 8570/8140: IAT Level III baseline certification.
    • Cisco Certified Network Professional – Enterprise (CCNP-E).
  • Location and Travel:
    • Candidates must be able to work daily from customer and/or contractor facilities as needed and be within commuting distance of one of the following locations:
      • Fort Belvoir, VA
      • Columbus, OH
      • Dayton, OH
      • New Cumberland, PA
      • Ogden, UT
      • Philadelphia, PA
      • Richmond, VA
      • Anniston, AL
      • San Diego, CA
      • Fort Bragg, NC
      • Robins AFB, GA
      • Tobyhanna, PA
    • Travel of up to approximately 40% may be required, both CONUS and OCONUS for network installation or troubleshooting as required.
Preferred Qualifications

  • Check Point Certified Security Administrator (CCSA) or higher certification.
    • If not attained prior to hire, must be attained after hire.
  • AWS Cloud Practitioner
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals
  • CompTIA Cloud+.
Work Environment And Physical Demand

  • Must be able to work from a computer for extended periods.
  • Must be able to work from office, comm closet, warehouse, and other environments associated with network deployment and sustainment.

The projected salary range for this position is $110,000+ annually. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including years of relevant experience, active security clearance level, certifications, technical skillset, contract requirements, and overall qualifications.

At AGE Solutions, we reward performance, invest in growth, and share success. Our benefits support the whole person, professionally, financially, and personally.

  • 26 Days Paid Leave: Includes vacation, sick, personal time, and holidays. You choose how to use it.
  • Performance Bonuses: Performance bonuses are awarded based on individual contributions and company-wide results, aligning recognition with impact.
  • 401(k) with Match: We match 3% of your contributions with immediate vesting.
  • Financial Protection: Company-paid life insurance up to $300K and options for additional coverage for you and your dependents.
  • Health Benefits: Multiple medical plans, dental, vision, FSA and HSA options to fit your needs.
  • Parental Leave: 15 days of fully paid leave for new parents, because family matters.
  • Military Differential Pay: We bridge the gap for employees on active duty, so they don’t take a financial hit while serving.
  • Professional Growth: Paid training and certifications, tuition reimbursement, and the tools and tech to get the job done right.
  • Shared Success: In the event of a company sale, our CEO has committed to returning 80% of net proceeds to employees. This ensures our team shares in the long term value they help create.

At AGE, you’ll do work that matters, supported by a company that delivers for its people.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Axon 911 brings together Prepared and Carbyne under Axon. Together, we are creating the only platform that combines modern 911 infrastructure with an AI intelligence layer, helping public safety agencies move faster, make better decisions, and deliver better outcomes in the moments that matter most.

911 is the backbone of public safety, yet the professionals behind it have long been held back by outdated technology. Axon 911 is here to change that. Joining this team means more than taking a job. It means helping shape the future of emergency response and building a safer, more connected world. 🚀

* This role will be hybrid: 4x a week in the NY office.

Your Impact

  • Lead network projects, including network establishment, upgrades, expansions, and migrations.
  • Configure and maintain traditional networking infrastructure, including Fortinet firewalls and Cisco switches and routers, and implement security best practices.
  • Monitor network performance and troubleshoot issues, ensuring maximum uptime and reliability in a mission-critical live system.
  • Thrive in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple tasks and shifting priorities while resolving complex problems independently.
  • Collaborate with vendors and service providers to build and resolve network-related challenges.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior network engineers.

What You'll Do

We are currently seeking a highly skilled Network Engineer to join our Global Operations team. In this role, you will focus primarily on network design and Infrastructure as Code, helping us scale the network that powers our innovative public safety products for national first responder systems (911) and government sectors worldwide. You will play a key part in designing, deploying, and supporting the infrastructure that delivers the highest level of service to our customers 24/7.

What You Bring

  • Cloud Network Engineering (top priority): Strong hands-on experience with AWS networking, including VPCs, Direct Connect, Route 53, and ingress/egress traffic flow.
  • Traditional Networking: Solid foundation in TCP/IP, VLANs, BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, VPNs, and DNS. Experience with Cisco and Fortinet equipment and SD-WAN solutions is a plus.
  • Experience: Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in network engineering, preferably in a fast-paced or critical service environment.
  • Responsibilities: Network design and deployment, with support as needed.
  • Troubleshooting Skills: Ability to analyze network logs, perform packet captures, and track down root causes for production issues. Exposure to monitoring tools (Datadog, PRTG) is a plus.

  • Competitive salary and 401k with employer match
  • Discretionary paid time off
  • Paid parental leave for all
  • Medical, Dental, Vision plans
  • Fitness Programs
  • Emotional & Mental Wellness support
  • Learning & Development programs
  • Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)
  • And yes, we have snacks in our offices

Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work.

 

Axon is a total compensation company, meaning compensation is made up of base pay, bonus, and stock awards. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: level, function, training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs, geographic market, and often a combination of all these factors. Our benefits offer an array of options to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. To see more details on our benefits offerings please visit https://www.axon.com/careers.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. Job Description

This is a full-time, on-site position based in Omaha, Nebraska. Candidates must reside in the Omaha area and be able to work in the office on a full-time basis.

This is a multi-level posting. Candidates may be considered for any of the levels posted, depending on their level of experience and depth of expertise.﻿

The Network Engineer is responsible for the design, implementation, operation, maintenance, and support of network infrastructure supporting operational technology (OT), SCADA, and other business-critical systems.

This position supports highly available and geographically distributed network environments and works closely with operations, SCADA, cybersecurity, telecommunications, engineering, and other technical teams. Responsibilities include network design, routing and switching, network segmentation, firewall connectivity, secure remote communications, troubleshooting, lifecycle management, documentation, and implementation of network infrastructure projects.

Higher levels of the position are expected to independently design complex network solutions, lead technical projects, troubleshoot advanced network issues, establish technical standards, and provide technical leadership and guidance to other personnel.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, maintain, and support network infrastructure supporting OT, SCADA, and other business-critical systems.
  • Design and support routed and switched network environments, including LAN, WAN, VLANs, Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking, network segmentation, and communications between network security zones.
  • Configure, maintain, troubleshoot, and upgrade network infrastructure, including switches, routers, firewalls, and associated network services.
  • Design and implement resilient and highly available network architectures appropriate for critical operational systems.
  • Troubleshoot complex network connectivity, routing, switching, firewall, performance, and communications issues and perform root-cause analysis.
  • Implement and maintain network security controls, including network segmentation, access controls, firewall connectivity, secure management methods, and network device hardening in accordance with company cybersecurity standards.
  • Support vulnerability management, configuration compliance, cybersecurity remediation, and lifecycle management activities associated with network infrastructure.
  • Plan, test, and implement network hardware, software, firmware, and configuration changes while minimizing impact to operational and production systems.
  • Develop and maintain accurate technical documentation, including network diagrams, configurations, IP addressing information, equipment inventories, technical standards, procedures, and project documentation.
  • Develop technical requirements, equipment specifications, bills of materials, and equipment recommendations for network infrastructure projects.
  • Perform network capacity, lifecycle, and technology planning and develop recommendations for future infrastructure requirements.
  • Participate in network infrastructure projects from design through implementation, including project scoping, technical requirements, cost estimates, implementation planning, testing, commissioning, and turnover to operations.
  • Coordinate with operations, SCADA, cybersecurity, telecommunications, engineering, vendors, and other technical teams to ensure network solutions meet operational, cybersecurity, reliability, and business requirements.
  • Provide technical support during network incidents and participate in troubleshooting and restoration of critical network services.
  • Evaluate emerging networking technologies, products, and architectures and make recommendations based on reliability, cybersecurity, interoperability, lifecycle, supportability, and operational requirements.
  • Maintain knowledge of networking technologies, cybersecurity practices, and industry developments applicable to operational and critical infrastructure environments.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field; or an equivalent combination of education and directly related network engineering experience. (Typically four years of additional related, progressive work experience would be needed for candidates applying for this position who do not possess a bachelor’s degree. A minimum of two years additional directly related technical experience is required.)
    • Network Engineer 1: 0 - 3 years' experience
    • Network Engineer 2: 3-5 years' experience
    • Network Engineer 3: 5 years' experience
    • Sr Network Engineer: 6+ years' experience; Professional engineering licensing preferred. Demonstrated advanced knowledge of trunking, circuit design, optical networking, carrier services (Ethernet, T1, ISDN, et al.) and microwave and radio communication.
  • Technical skills including programming, installation, configuration, and data base management.
  • Demonstrated understanding and knowledge of telecommunication engineering technology terms, equipment, systems, functions and major vendors.
  • Effective oral and written communication skills.
  • Effective analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks and projects concurrently.
  • Applied knowledge of electric grid energy management systems or similar for the purpose of configuring and engineering SCADA systems used for electric grid monitoring, protection, and control.
  • Demonstrated advanced knowledge and application of principles in area of SCADA engineering.
About Us

BHE Pipeline Group consists of Berkshire Hathaway Energy’s interstate natural gas pipeline companies, BHE GT&S, Kern River Gas Transmission Company and Northern Natural Gas Company. Combined, BHE Pipeline Group operates approximately 21,200 miles of pipeline with a design capacity of approximately 21.1 billion cubic feet of natural gas per day, owns assets in 27 states and is an industry leader in natural gas transportation. BHE Pipeline Group also operates 22 natural gas storage facilities with a total working gas capacity of 515.6 billion cubic feet and a liquefied natural gas export, import and storage facility.

About The Team

Northern Natural Gas is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or religious creed, age, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status (except as required by law), gender (including gender identity and expression), sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, genetic information, physical or mental disability, veteran or military status, familial or parental status, marital status or any other category protected by applicable local, state or U.S. federal law. Employees must be able to perform the essential functions of the position, with or without an accommodation.

Job Description


At BAE Systems, we believe your career should be filled with innovation and discovery. And that's exactly what you'll find here. Join us as our team develops, maintains, and protects the latest technology that directly aids in the defense of national security.

As part of our team, you’ll be joining a diverse group of driven professionals who are modernizing legacy infrastructure and applications as part of a ‘no fail’ mission, all the while protecting systems with the most-current cybersecurity practices. With us, you’ll be able to make an impact while you hone your skills and grow in your career.

Job Description

Work directly with the Network Manager and Lead Network Engineer on various projects including system rollouts, upgrades and infrastructure changes. Conduct analysis, administration, management, and maintenance of computer network systems and data circuits. Analyze, design, install, configure and repair key systems to meet user specifications. Consult with end users to assess system functionality. Maintain daily performance, monitor network and system performance and administers security on multiple platforms.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Consult with users to determine hardware, software, or system functional specifications
  • Work with appropriate business partners when rolling out new systems or system changes in order to address issues and fix bugs. Must perform necessary testing and analysis to ensure system stability before transferring support responsibility to the support desk
  • Manage complex network projects from beginning to end including refresh, infrastructure, and process projects
  • Ability to work across Unified Communications, Route, Switch, Wireless, SD WAN, and Network Security platforms
  • Strong Firewall and Routing skills. Understand BGP and EVPN technologies
  • Maintaining current knowledge and understanding of security and networking best practices to offer the best solutions and protection to company systemsMentor junior network engineers/operations to be able to further their skillsets
  • Translate business requirements into network designs and solutions
  • Collaborating with a group of network engineers delivering new solutions to support manufacturing networking
  • Work directly with lead network engineer on developing new processes and project
  • Partner with equipment manufactures and internal customers to test and certify IoT solutions
  • Contribute to the research and design of future generation network roadmaps
  • Provide Tier 2 network engineering escalation support
  • Design and deliver network infrastructure to support new and existing initiatives
  • Translate technical knowledge into support procedures
  • Work alongside Site Reliability Engineers to automate manual activities
  • Collaborate with network hardware and services providers
  • Create and maintain network documentation and reports
  • Communicate with internal customers and present solutions in a non-technical manner
  • Troubleshoot malfunctions of network hardware and software applications
  • Investigate, analyze, recommend and install enhancements and operating procedures that regulate or enhance network performance
  • Stay current with disaster recovery procedures. Be available to assist in recovery of major systems in the event of a disaster.
  • Document project in ADO Wiki including troubleshooting information for technical support
  • Manage trouble tickets when escalated from support group
  • Monitor computer networks using network management and analysis products.
  • Identify and resolve basic network problems such as ethernet loop failures, device connectivity problems, Network Addressing (IP), DNS, DHCP, and slow response time. Assists in resolution of complex network problems.
  • Monitor and track system performance looking for network slow downs and bottle necks.
  • Administers security by way of access control for all network appliances. Maintains user lists and security logs, and follows up on security violations.


Travel Expectations:

15-30%


Education and Experience:

  • B.S. in Information Technology or professional experience equivalent
  • 5-8 years Network Engineering experience
  • CCNP required
  • Proven experience with ability to learn how to use/implement new software and hardware quickly


Necessary Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Good communication and problem solving skills
  • Ability to perform multiple technical and highly complex tasks
  • Review and interpret complex technical information
  • Ability to work independently and within groups as needed
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Requires good project management and time management skills
  • Makes routine decisions using own reasoning and judgment
  • Comprehensive understanding of network services and networks such as TCP/IP, OSPF, BGP, and EIGRP
  • In-depth understanding and practical knowledge of networking systems such as LAN, firewalls, routers, and wireless
  • Ability to analyze and evaluate networks, identify issues, and provide solutions to ensure networks are operating efficiently
  • Ability to design, implement and troubleshoot Wi-FI and security infrastructure
  • Time management
  • Ability to manage several projects simultaneously from design to implementation
  • Ability to communicate technical information to other technical team members but also to coworkers in other departments who may not have knowledge of networking technical terminology
  • Working knowledge of Azure cloud networking, including virtual networks, ExpressRoute, VPN gateways, and hybrid on-premises/cloud connectivity
  • Experience with Infoblox IPAM/DDI for IP address management, DNS, and DHCP administration
  • Familiarity with OT (Operational Technology) networking and industrial control system network security practices


An Equal Opportunity Employer including Disabled/Veterans


Salary:

$130000-$150000/ year

descriptionHtml:
About Sphinx

Sphinx builds software to solve complex national security problems in Space. Founded by engineers and technologists with deep experience across commercial and defense technology, we were frustrated by the outdated and insecure technology America's service members are forced to rely on. We're here to do better.

We’re focused on building modern, scalable products with an emphasis on using open source technologies. Expect talented, motivated, and interesting colleagues who emphasize collaboration, transparency, and individual responsibility.

About The Role

Sphinx is hiring a Senior Network Engineer to help design, build, secure, and maintain resilient network infrastructure supporting next-generation national security space systems. This role will support mission-critical systems across classified and unclassified networks, and will require closely collaborating with software, infrastructure, products teams to ensure reliable and secure connectivity for operational systems.

We’re looking for someone who enjoys owning complex infrastructure challenges and can bring a strong mix of hands-on networking expertise and systems thinking to the team. You will ensure that the infrastructure underpinning critical national security space missions is performant and secure. This role is designed for someone with deep technical experience supporting enterprise or mission-focused environments, particularly within government, defense, or highly regulated spaces.

What You Will Be Focusing On

  • Designing, configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting secure network infrastructure
  • Supporting routers, switches, firewalls, gateways, and other enterprise networking technologies, including Cisco, Juniper, and Palo Alto network devices
  • Investigating and resolving network performance, reliability, and connectivity issues across LAN/WAN environments
  • Supporting secure classified network environments and maintaining compliance with government security requirements
  • Performing network monitoring, packet analysis, and root cause troubleshooting using industry-standard tools
  • Collaborating with cloud, infrastructure, and cybersecurity teams to support modernization and scalability efforts
  • Assisting with implementation and maintenance of network security controls and segmentation strategies, VPNs, and IPSec tunnels
  • Supporting documentation, technical analysis, and operational reporting for internal and customer stakeholders
  • Contributing to infrastructure improvements that increase reliability, automation, and operational efficiency
  • Supporting DNS, DHCP, IP management, and other core network services in enterprise environments

You Might Be a Good Fit If You

  • Have 10+ years of experience supporting enterprise or mission-critical network infrastructure
  • Have hands-on experience with network troubleshooting, routing and switching, firewalls, and secure network architectures
  • Have experience configuring and supporting Cisco, Juniper, and/or Palo Alto network technologies
  • Have experience implementing and troubleshooting VPNs, IPSec tunnels, and network segmentation
  • Have hands-on network security experience, including identifying and mitigating routing-based threats such as BGP hijacking and route leaks
  • Have experience working in classified or highly secure environments
  • Have experience with Cisco networking technologies and enterprise networking protocols
  • Have experience analyzing network traffic and troubleshooting complex connectivity issues
  • Have hands-on experience supporting AWS cloud and hybrid infrastructure environments, including networking and connectivity between cloud and on-premises systems
  • Can clearly communicate technical issues, risks, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Are highly collaborative, self-motivated, and comfortable operating in fast-paced environments with evolving priorities
  • Hold an active TS/SCI clearance or are eligible to obtain one

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Experience designing or supporting complex AWS and/or multi-cloud networking environments
  • Have experience with network automation tools and protocols such as Ansible, RESTCONF and NETCONF
  • Experience supporting space, defense, or government mission environments
  • Hold an active DOD 8570 IAT Level II certification or higher (i.e. Security+)

LOCATION

This is a hybrid role based in Colorado Springs, CO, with a combination of onsite and remote work.

Compensation

This role is between $144,000 - $195,000 base salary.

Benefits

Compensation includes competitive salary, meaningful equity ownership, profit sharing, employer 401(k) contribution, and 100% employer covered medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your dependents.

ELIGIBILITY

Must be a US Citizen.

Must be able to obtain and hold a U.S. TS/SCI security clearance.

EEO STATEMENT

At Sphinx Defense, we are devoted to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Sphinx Defense is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, and gender identity.

CLEARANCE ELIGIBILITY - This position requires eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance. For more information about U.S. Security Clearances: click here.

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C.

  • 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C.
  • 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

Summary of Job Duties:

The Senior Network Engineer is responsible for supporting and monitoring the UAMS Network Engineering environment. The environment includes but is not limited to, networking equipment from Brocade, HP, Juniper, and Cisco; networking software from Brocade, HP, Aruba, StatSeeker, and InMon. Responsible for working with all areas of IT and the entire campus to ensure maximum network uptime - both local and wide area networks. Keeps up-to-date on emerging technologies that would benefit UAMS and compliment UAMS’ mission/goals. This position participates in a group 24 hours a day 7 days a week 365 days a year on-call rotation where each member of the group takes call for 1 week at a time.

Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma/GED plus nine (9) years of Information Technology experience or other relevant experience in a large data network environment, with four (4) years specifically in two of the following: Network Engineering Equipment support (Brocade, Cisco, Juniper, Nortel, HP, 3Com, etc.), or IT project management, or
  • Associate degree in Computer Science or related field plus seven (7) years of Information Technology experience or other relevant experience in a large data network environment with four (4) years specifically in two of the following: Network Engineering Equipment support (Brocade, Cisco, Juniper, Nortel, HP, 3Com, etc.), or IT project management, or
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field plus five (5) years of Information Technology experience or other relevant experience in a large data network environment with four (4) years specifically in two of the following: Network Engineering Equipment support (Brocade, Cisco, Juniper, Nortel, HP, 3Com, etc.), or IT project management, or
  • Master's degree in Computer Science or related field plus three (3) years of Information Technology experience or other relevant experience in a large data network environment with four (4) years specifically in two of the following: Network Engineering Equipment support (Brocade, Cisco, Juniper, Nortel, HP, 3Com, etc.), or IT project management required.
  • Must have a vehicle to commute from UAMS campus office to off-campus UAMS offices for meetings.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Certifications - Network+ and A+ certifications
  • Experience with MS Office Tools: Outlook, Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint, and Visio
  • Configuration, troubleshooting, and certification of network equipment from Brocade Networks, Brocade, Cisco, Aruba Networks, Juniper, HP, 3Com, and Nortel.
  • Network monitoring software such as Inmon, Ciscoworks, Brocade BNA, Cacti, and Nagios.
  • Network troubleshooting tools such as a fox/hound toner, wire scanners, and network packet sniffers.

descriptionHtml:
General Summary

The Network Engineer for Peñasco Valley Telephone Cooperative, Inc. and its subsidiaries designs, monitors and troubleshoots equipment and servers associated with the Internet, voice, and data networks to determine network stability, security, traffic loads and potential outages; responsible for IP addressing and network documentation.

Essential Job Functions

  • Builds and maintains data networks.
  • Monitors the ISP network and all associated equipment to determine network stability, traffic throughput, link outages, and all other events that are detrimental to customer service.
  • Installs, maintains, and troubleshoots routers, switches, firewalls, servers, and cabling.
  • Evaluates and tests network and protocol related functions and processes.
  • Provides technical software and hardware design, installation, implementation, and support to customers and their networks.
  • Works with other communications companies’ teams to provide solutions for PVT’s technology requirements.
  • Investigates, designs, plans, and implements physical and logical IP networks.
  • Prepares documents to define and illustrate network design solutions.
  • Creates method of procedures (MOP) for implementation to configure network hardware and software.
  • Performs router/switch network hardware/software upgrades.
  • Performs server hardware/software upgrades.
  • Understands virtual server environments and must be able to install/maintain/upgrade associated hardware/software in such environments.
  • Researches, recommends, installs, and maintains software applications to support automation efficiencies in system management & reporting functions.
  • Supports network protocols including but not limited to TCP, IP, UDP, BGP, OSPF, and HSRP.
  • Proactively stays current with, recommends, and implements security best practices.
  • Attends training sessions on new products and technology to maintain a high degree of knowledge and competence.
  • Establishes and maintains effective working relationships with customers and personnel.
  • Collaborates with cross-functional teams for projects & services.
  • Author useful documentation for internal peers and external partners.
  • Uses safety equipment; utilizes safety practices; attends and participates in designated cooperative safety and training meetings; abides by the company’s safety manual.
  • Places a premium on customer satisfaction; and makes every attempt to perpetuate PVT’s and its subsidiaries’ positive image in all subscriber customer-related service activities.
  • Completes other projects and activities as needed.

Other Responsibilities

  • Other duties as assigned by Management.

descriptionHtml:
Optiver’s industry-leading proprietary trading systems depend on reliable and scalable networks to power our trading activities on financial exchanges around the world. As a Network Engineer, your job will be to ensure Optiver has the fast connectivity and physical infrastructure to allow our traders and engineers to get market data accurately and quickly, making a direct impact to our business.

What you’ll do:

Optiver’s bespoke trading infrastructure requires diverse network engineering experience. From low-latency, network automation and WAN technologies to data center and colocation design, you’ll l work on critical projects that will help us scale our trading business:


  • Deploy, monitor, troubleshoot and manage our network infrastructure
  • Work on designing new colocations and improving connectivity in existing colocations as well as our Data Center network
  • Identify, recommend and implement network system optimizations and focus on network solutions that provide fast information
  • Assist with planned maintenances (migrations, expansions, hardware and software upgrades)
  • Provide technical expertise and support to a high frequency trading floor in a competitive market-making environment
  • Ensure all aspects of our WAN network link together across our global data center presence
  • Contribute to capacity planning and traffic flow optimization
  • Help push us towards intelligent automation
  • Tackle technical debt while removing complexity


Who you are:


  • Strong network and performance monitoring skills and knowledge of network capacity planning
  • Experience working across LAN and global WAN networks
  • Cisco and Arista network equipment experience preferred
  • Experience troubleshooting network transport protocols – TCP/UDP
  • Deep understanding and experience with routing protocols (such as OSPF, BGP) and network protocols (such as Multicast, Spanning Tree, HSRP)
  • Network automation experience with strong Python scripting experience preferred
  • Networking monitoring and alerting systems experience
  • A belief that good documentation helps successful project delivery
  • A drive for improvement and motivation to push through friction


What You’ll Get:

You’ll join a culture of collaboration and excellence, surrounded by curious thinkers and creative problem-solvers. Motivated by a passion for continuous improvement, you’ll thrive in a supportive, high-performing environment alongside talented colleagues, collectively tackling some of the toughest challenges in the financial markets.

In addition, you’ll receive:


  • The opportunity to work alongside best-in-class professionals from over 40 different countries
  • A highly competitive compensation package
  • Global profit-sharing pool and performance-based bonus structure
  • 401(k) match up to 50%
  • Comprehensive health, mental, dental, vision, disability, and life coverage
  • 25 paid vacation days alongside market holidays
  • Extensive office perks, including breakfast, lunch and snacks, regular social events, clubs, sporting leagues and more


Who we are:

At Optiver, our mission is to improve the market by injecting liquidity, providing accurate pricing, increasing transparency and stabilizing the market no matter the conditions. With a focus on continuous improvement, we prioritize safeguarding the health and efficiency of the markets for all participants. As one of the largest market making institutions, we are a respected partner on 100+ exchanges across the globe.

Our differences are our edge. Optiver does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, physical or mental disability, or other legally protected characteristics.

$200,000—$200,000 USD

descriptionHtml:
AMAX is an IT infrastructure and advanced computing solutions company serving enterprise and OEM customers with customized systems, from servers and workstations to rack solutions and HPC/GPU-accelerated infrastructure. Our work sits at the intersection of hardware, infrastructure, and advanced computing, helping customers deploy systems built for demanding technical environments.

In this role, you will help strengthen the network foundation behind a cloud-like infrastructure environment while working closely with teams responsible for infrastructure, security, and operations. This is an opportunity to contribute to a hands-on engineering function with meaningful ownership, supporting both the underlying platform and the operational needs that keep the datacenter running smoothly.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate the on-prem network infrastructure underpinning our cloud-like environment
  • Own VLAN design, routing, firewall policy, and load balancer configuration across the datacenter
  • Manage network segmentation and access control in support of security and compliance needs
  • Build and maintain configuration-as-code for network devices and infrastructure using Ansible (and Terraform/Terragrunt where applicable)
  • Collaborate closely with the infrastructure/DevSecOps engineer(s) on shared tooling, monitoring, and automation
  • Support and monitor network health using Prometheus, Grafana, and Alertmanager
  • Troubleshoot network issues across routing, switching, firewalls, and load balancing
  • Provide general datacenter support for customers co-located in the HostMax datacenter — things like cabling, hardware swaps, rack/stack work, and basic troubleshooting
  • Participate in business-hours (M-F) on-call rotation for customer and network support
  • Participate in an SDLC/Scrum-based workflow, using Jira and Confluence for planning and documentation
  • Help define network standards, runbooks, and best practices as the team and topology grow
  • Take on increasing ownership of network architecture and scope as the team matures and responsibilities shift from the infra engineer(s) to this role


Requirements

  • Solid working knowledge of networking fundamentals: VLANs, routing, firewalls, and load balancers
  • Hands-on experience with configuration-as-code for infrastructure using Ansible
  • Exposure to on-prem/datacenter network operations
  • Proficiency with Git and standard version control workflows
  • Willingness to do hands-on datacenter/hardware work (cabling, rack/stack, hardware troubleshooting) in addition to network engineering
  • Prior colocation/datacenter smart-hands experience


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes) and how networking applies within them
  • Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, and Alertmanager (or equivalent monitoring stacks)
  • Familiarity with HashiCorp tooling (Vault, Boundary) as it relates to network access and secrets
  • Familiarity with Keycloak or other identity/access management platforms
  • Networking certifications (e.g., CCNA or equivalent) or formal networking coursework
  • Familiarity with Scrum, SDLC practices, and tools like Jira/Confluence (admin experience a plus)
  • Experience with Terraform/Terragrunt
  • Prior experience joining or building an infrastructure/network team from scratch


Benefits

  • Medical Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • 401(k)
  • Flexible spending account
  • Commuter benefits
  • Disability insurance

The annual salary range for this position is between $120,000 and $150,000. This may be subject to change based on the candidate's education, experience and skill set.

We also have a perfect location for all types of commuters: AMAX is located right between I-680 and I-880. Warm Springs/South Fremont BART station and bus stops are within a 10-minute walking distance. 5 grocery stores, 6+ coffee/tea places, and numerous restaurants within 1 mile. Feel free to try the delicious fusions or grab your daily groceries after work!

About AMAX

Established in 1979, AMAX is a globally recognized leader in GPU-accelerated IT infrastructure, specializing in transforming standard IT systems into advanced, high-performance computing solutions. Catering to industries such as AI, cloud computing, autonomous vehicles, and high-performance computing, AMAX has set benchmarks in innovation, including pioneering liquid-cooled HPC systems for the semiconductor industry. With a global footprint spanning North America, Europe, and Asia, AMAX offers end-to-end services from design and manufacturing to deployment. Committed to addressing the growing demands of AI, AMAX delivers advanced solutions that help organizations achieve their technology goal and drive progress on a global scale.

Join Us

Become part of a diverse and inclusive team that values your technical expertise and innovative thinking. Together, we'll push the boundaries of what's possible in the hardware industry.

AMAX is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome all applicants and provide equal employment opportunities regardless of age, race, gender, or other legally protected characteristics.

As a Network Engineer Level 3 at Independent Software, you will configure, deploy, and maintain Cisco and Arista network infrastructure supporting mission-critical operational systems. You will work alongside government and contractor engineering teams to support network installations, troubleshooting, security, and ongoing operations across local and remote locations.

You will also contribute to network modernization initiatives, including the design of new environments and the transition toward containerized and cloud-based technologies.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Configure, deploy, troubleshoot, and maintain Cisco and Arista network equipment
  • Prepare, configure, and test networking systems in a lab environment before deployment
  • Support installation and deployment of network equipment at local and remote locations
  • Maintain operational networks, including firewalls and cryptographic equipment
  • Monitor network operations, troubleshoot issues, and manage service requests through Jira
  • Support network upgrades, infrastructure design, and modernization initiatives
  • Collaborate with government personnel and engineering teams to maintain secure, reliable network operations
  • Participate in on-call operational support and occasional OCONUS travel as required

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • Strong professional Network Engineering experience
  • Hands-on experience configuring and maintaining Cisco and Arista networking equipment
  • Ability to troubleshoot network infrastructure and operational connectivity issues
  • Willingness to travel occasionally to OCONUS locations and participate in on-call support

Desired Skills:

  • Experience with Cisco Call Manager and Cisco ASA firewalls
  • Network design and architecture experience
  • Experience automating network administration, inventory collection, and compliance tasks
  • Familiarity with cloud technologies, hyperconverged infrastructure, and containerized environments
  • Experience with LatteArt, STE/STN environments, and SSP compliance requirements

Education and Experience:

Candidates must meet one of the following education and experience combinations:

  • Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Assurance, Information Security Systems Engineering, or a related discipline, plus ten (10) years of relevant Network Engineering experience
  • Bachelor's Degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering Science, Engineering Management, or a related discipline, plus twelve (12) years of relevant Network Engineering experience
  • No Degree: Sixteen (16) years of relevant Network Engineering experience and an industry-recognized networking certification, such as Arista Configuration Essentials, Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), or an applicable Juniper certification

Certifications:

  • Must possess a current DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level III baseline certification

Clearance Requirement:

  • Must possess an active TS SCI with appropriate Polygraph to be considered for this role

  • Support critical national security missions that matter

  • Expand your skills through ongoing training, mentorship, and career development
  • Enjoy competitive compensation, generous benefits, and work-life balance

Ready to take the next step in your career? Join us and be part of something bigger.

Apply today.

descriptionHtml:
Join Aristocrat, a global leader in regulated gaming entertainment, where innovation, reliability, and alignment to regulations are essential to our operations. As an MSP Network Engineer, you will play a crucial role in developing and maintaining the network framework that supports MSP gaming operations. This position offers an exceptional opportunity to work in a highly regulated, 24x7 production environment. You will direct network builds and operational plans across our data centers and customer locations. Your knowledge will ensure the smooth performance and security of our vital systems, greatly influencing our worldwide gaming networks.

What You'll Do
  • Construct, align, and improve secure, scalable network builds for Class 3 MSP gaming systems.
  • Take ownership for network build decisions from start to finish across primary and secondary data centers as well as customer environments.
  • Define technical standards, reference architectures, and guidelines applicable to networking of MSP devices.
  • Maintain high uptime, fault resistance, and efficiency of vital MSP network infrastructure.
  • Lead complex triage efforts across routing, VPNs, firewalls, and Multi Site networks.
  • Drive root cause analysis, corrective actions, and long-term reliability improvements.
  • Analyze performance and resource trends; lead proactive efforts to improve resource use and efficiency.
  • Build and maintain resilient network infrastructures aligned with cybersecurity guidelines and gaming regulatory requirements.
  • Lead network change planning and risk assessment within formal change and configuration management processes.
  • Partner with gaming regulators and internal compliance teams to ensure compliant system operation.
  • Lead technical execution of new site deployments, infrastructure upgrades, and network modernization efforts.

What We're Looking For
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • CCNA or equivalent networking certification preferred.
  • 5+ years of hands-on enterprise network engineering experience.
  • Expert-level understanding of routing and networking protocols (BGP, OSPF, IPSec, QoS, TCP/IP).
  • Deep hands-on experience with enterprise Palo Alto firewalls, Arista Products, and F5 Products.
  • Strong experience with network monitoring, diagnostics, and analytics platforms.
  • Proven experience crafting and supporting highly available, regulated, or critically important environments.
  • Strong security approach and experience implementing secure network architectures.
  • Ability to work independently, lead technical initiatives, and influence cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to obtain required Tribal Gaming licenses which may include providing fingerprints, background checks, financial statements, and any other applicable licensing requests.

Travel Expectations
  • None

Additional Information

This role is subject to mandatory background screening and regulatory approvals. As part of moving into this role, you may be required to complete a criminal background check, submit fingerprints, and obtain licenses or registrations with applicable gaming regulatory authorities.

Aristocrat operates in a highly regulated environment and holds licenses in over 340 gaming jurisdictions worldwide. To meet our global compliance obligations, you will be required to provide the disclosure of relevant personal and background information to government agencies, sovereign nations/tribal regulators, and other applicable gaming regulatory bodies. This is a condition of Aristocrat’s gaming licenses. The specific information required may vary depending on the jurisdiction and project assignment.

This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat.

Compensation Philosophy

We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits.

Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

At ZOLL, we're passionate about improving patient outcomes and helping save lives. We provide innovative technologies that make a meaningful difference in people's lives. Job Summary

The Senior Network Engineer will work with the team to design, configure, deploy, maintain and support our comprehensive enterprise network infrastructure. Your work will encompass supporting business infrastructure needs, regular care and maintenance of these areas, and acting as a project leader for new initiatives. You will need to ensure reliability in the network communication systems, operational compliance with business standards, and will contribute to the advancement of our infrastructure through development of supporting procedures, best practices, and road map strategy planning. You will complete your work responsibilities in tight partnership with other IT colleagues and business stakeholders while also mentoring more junior members of the technical team.

Essential Functions

  • Implement and maintain network infrastructure configurations according to established best practices and enterprise standards, proactively identifying and resolving potential configuration issues to ensure optimal system stability and performance.
  • Monitor and analyze network infrastructure performance and configuration data to identify potential issues and proactively address them.
  • Conduct routine system maintenance and resolve operational incidents, ensuring minimal disruption to business operations.
  • Utilize established ITIL-based processes and corporate ticketing systems to ensure consistent and efficient resolution of IT issues and requests.
  • Work to resolve complex incidents and escalated tickets, leveraging expertise and collaborating with colleagues to ensure timely resolution and minimal impact on business operations.
  • Represent the IT Infrastructure team and technologies to business stakeholders and in large global projects.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation and diagrams to support operational procedures.
  • Provide advanced technical support and guidance to internal teams and external stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business stakeholders, internal IT teams, and external vendors, to design, implement, and maintain IT infrastructure solutions.
  • Participate in disaster recovery planning and execution.
  • Promote and implement automation to enhance efficiency, create self-service capabilities, and improve the reliability of IT systems.
  • Stay current with developments in network technology and recommend ways to take advantage of new innovations and advancements.
  • Respond to network failures and provide after-hours support, including participating in an on-call rotation, as required.
  • Work with colleagues in team-based focus groups to address specific initiatives and contribute to shared goals.
  • Contribute to high-performing teams through collaboration, communication, and knowledge sharing with colleagues across the organization
  • Provide mentoring and guidance to other team members, sharing expertise and supporting professional development as needed.

Required/Preferred Education And Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in CIS, MIS, IT, or a related field or equivalent experience required
  • 10+ years prior industry experience (Enterprise preferred) required and
  • 7-9 years proven record of developing and maintaining complex documentation for network topology required and
  • 7-9 years proven ability to manage project timelines, deliverables, and resources to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget required
  • 7-9 years proven experience in configuring, deploying, and troubleshooting enterprise network infrastructure in datacenters and office locations required
  • 4-6 years possessing a current certification relevant to the support technology field is preferred (e.g., Cisco and/or Palo Alto) preferred
  • 4-6 years experience in multi-site datacenter operations, including onsite hands-on support for network equipment and cabling preferred
  • CCNP - Cisco Certified Network Professional Possess current Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) certification or equivalent level of industry certification (desired) Preferred

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to exchange ideas and information and effectively relate to others to accomplish work responsibilities.

Network Engineer (Palo Alto, Cisco, Azure)


Our client is seeking a hands-on Network Engineer to design, implement, and support secure, high-performing enterprise networks. This role offers the opportunity to work on network modernization, cloud networking, and security initiatives while helping establish network standards across a distributed environment. The ideal candidate brings strong networking fundamentals, technical problem-solving skills, and the ability to independently deliver network engineering solutions.


  • Job Type: Direct Hire
  • Openings in Multiple Locations: Port Washington, NY/ Grand Rapids, MI / Lancaster, PA– Onsite (20% travel required)
  • Compensation: This job is expected to pay about $87,000–$120,000 annually, plus a 10% bonus.
  • This position does not offer sponsorship


What You’ll Do:

  • Design, implement, and maintain secure LAN, WAN, WLAN, and SD-WAN network infrastructure across multiple locations.
  • Configure, manage, and troubleshoot Cisco routers and switches, Palo Alto firewalls, and Panorama to ensure network performance and security.
  • Support cloud networking initiatives across Azure and GCP, including network provisioning, connectivity, and integration.
  • Lead network segmentation, security enhancements, and troubleshooting initiatives to improve network reliability and protection.
  • Establish network standards, collaborate with vendors and internal teams, and support the integration of acquired companies into standardized network environments.

What Gets You the Job:

  • 3–5+ years of hands-on network engineering experience with strong LAN/WAN fundamentals, TCP/IP, routing, switching, and protocols such as OSPF, BGP, and HSRP.
  • Strong experience configuring and troubleshooting Cisco routers and switches, Palo Alto firewalls, and Palo Alto Panorama.
  • Experience with Azure cloud networking, including network connectivity, routing, and infrastructure provisioning.
  • Solid understanding of network security, intrusion detection/prevention systems (IDS/IPS), network segmentation, and access controls.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills. Experience with GCP, Palo Alto Prisma Access, Meraki, or VeloCloud SD-WAN is preferred.

The Darkwing program seeking a highly motivated network engineer to join our team. Weekend/evening or call in work occasionally required supporting 24X7 operations or maintenance activities.

  • Knowledge and understanding of TCP/IP, LAN protocols
  • Security+, Network+
  • Experience with BGP and OSPF routing protocols
  • Juniper Switches
  • TS/SCI with CI Poly

Desired Skills

  • Working knowledge of Data Centers
  • Layer 2 and Layer 3 VLANS
  • Experience with Windows, LINUX, DNS, DHCP
  • Recent hands-on experience in the areas of network integration, verification, and validation of large, complex systems into enterprise infrastructures
  • Capable of representing ES2 in meetings to provide status of action items and issues
  • Skills related to network design, diagnostics and optimization
  • Knowledge of system engineering processes
  • Subnets

  • Experience in planning of network system development activities

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

At the heart of Defining Possible is our commitment to missions. In rapidly changing global security environments, Northrop Grumman brings informed insights and secure technological solutions to enable strategic objectives. We’re looking for innovators who can help us keep building on our wide portfolio of secure, affordable, integrated, and multi-domain systems and technologies that fuel those missions. By joining in our shared mission, we will support your mission of expanding your personal network and developing skills, whether you are new to the field or an industry thought leader. At Northrop Grumman, you will have the resources, support, and team to do some of the best work of your career.

Northrop Grumman’s Corporate Sector's Chief Information & Digital Office (CIDO) is seeking a Principal Network Engineer to support its IT Infrastructure & Operations organization's Network Communications and Visibility (NCV) team in Sunnyvale, CA.

Please note that the candidate selected for this position will be required to work on-site, full-time at our Sunnyvale campus – this is not a remote work opportunity.

The selected candidate’s primary focus will be on supporting the Sunnyvale campus. Additionally, the role will involve enterprise-wide responsibilities across the Northrop Grumman network footprint. The successful candidate will design, implement, and maintain high availability network infrastructure, work directly with customers and vendors, and contribute to continuous improvement of our secure communications environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, design, and deploy site and enterprise level network solutions in accordance with Northrop Grumman standards and best practices.
  • Produce comprehensive design review packages, including schematics, bill-of-materials, and implementation schedules.
  • Install and commission Cisco core network equipment (routers, multilayer switches, firewalls, wireless controllers, and access points).
  • Coordinate fiber‑optic and copper cabling projects with suppliers and internal construction teams.
  • Provide Tier 2/3 troubleshooting for WAN, LAN, and SD‑WAN environments, ensuring 99.9 % availability of firewalls, routing, and wireless services.
  • Execute corrective actions, hardware replacements, and software upgrades while maintaining accurate documentation in our configuration management database (CMDB).
  • Serve as the primary technical liaison with vendors (Cisco, Aruba, Juniper, etc.) for escalations, service definitions, and new service onboarding.
  • Work closely with the Sunnyvale sector customer base to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.
  • Implement and enforce security policies for network segmentation, access control, and vulnerability remediation in line with DoD and NIST guidelines.
  • Participate in after-action reviews, recommend process enhancements, and mentor junior engineers on best-in-class networking practices.

Basic Qualifications

  • Associate’s degree with 7 years of relevant experience, Bachelor’s degree with 5 years of relevant experience, Master’s degree with 3 years of relevant experience, or a PhD with 1 year of relevant experience; a High School Diploma or equivalent with 9 years of relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a completed degree.
  • Experience with managed network solutions and large-scale technical network engineering project experience.
  • Experience with Cisco Router and Switch equipment, Firewall Cisco Network Equipment, Cisco Wireless Technology, and Cellular Technology.
  • A strong knowledge of the TCP/IP protocol, Cisco Router and Switch products.
  • Knowledge and experience with LAN/WAN protocols and technologies such as multicast, QoS, CoS & OSPF.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Candidates must have the ability to obtain, and maintain, a U.S. Government Secret level security clearance as a condition of continued employment.
  • Experience with SDWAN methodologies/equipment a plus.
  • Experience leading enterprise projects for large networks.
  • Experience in designing network solutions.
  • Experience leading network implementation projects.
  • Project Management certification.
  • Experience using test equipment such as the Network Associates Sniffer, cable and fiber optics test sets, and other protocol analyzers.
  • A strong knowledge of Cisco and Palo Alto Firewalls.
  • Current U.S. government Top Secret security clearance.

We offer flexible work arrangements, phenomenal learning opportunities, exposure to a wide variety of projects and customers, and a very friendly team environment. At Northrop Grumman, we are on the cutting edge of innovation. Our diverse portfolio of programs means there are endless paths to cultivate your career. We also offer exceptional benefits/healthcare, a 9/80 work schedule, and a great 401k matching program. Come join us!
