descriptionHtml:
At YETI, we believe that time spent outdoors matters more than ever and our gear can make that time extraordinary. When you work here, you’ll have the opportunity to create exceptional, meaningful work and problem solve with innovative team members by your side. Together, you’ll help our customers get the high-quality gear they need to make the most of their adventures. We are BUILT FOR THE WILD™.

About The Role

The Network Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, supporting, and optimizing the company's network infrastructure across U.S. corporate, retail, and distribution center locations. This role ensures reliable, secure, and high-performing network connectivity that supports business operations and employee productivity.

The Network Engineer serves as a technical expert for network operations and infrastructure initiatives, leveraging strong analytical and troubleshooting skills to resolve complex issues and implement scalable solutions. This position partners closely with IT teams, business stakeholders, vendors, and managed service providers to maintain a resilient and secure network environment.

What You'll Do

Network Infrastructure Management

  • Design, implement, maintain, and optimize enterprise network infrastructure, including LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, wireless networks, VPNs, and internet connectivity.
  • Ensure the stability, availability, and performance of network services across headquarters, retail stores, and distribution center locations.
  • Manage network hardware and software lifecycle activities, including upgrades, patching, configuration management, and decommissioning.
  • Maintain network documentation, architecture diagrams, standards, and operating procedures.

Network Operations & Support

  • Monitor network performance and proactively identify opportunities to improve reliability, scalability, and efficiency.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex network incidents, outages, and performance issues using structured root-cause analysis methodologies.
  • Serve as an escalation point for advanced network-related support issues.
  • Participate in incident response activities and provide on-call support as required.

Network Security & Compliance

  • Administer and support firewalls, network segmentation, access controls, VPN solutions, and other security technologies.
  • Partner with Cybersecurity teams to implement and maintain secure network architectures and security controls.
  • Monitor and remediate network vulnerabilities and configuration risks.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, security standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.

Cloud & Connectivity Solutions

  • Support network connectivity for cloud platforms, SaaS applications, and hybrid infrastructure environments.
  • Design and maintain connectivity solutions between on-premises and cloud-based environments.
  • Partner with Infrastructure and Cloud Engineering teams to support business-critical applications and services.

Project Delivery & Continuous Improvement

  • Lead or contribute to network infrastructure projects, site deployments, technology refreshes, and business expansion initiatives.
  • Evaluate emerging networking technologies and recommend solutions that improve performance, security, and operational efficiency.
  • Develop implementation plans, testing strategies, and deployment procedures for network changes.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance service reliability and end-user experience.

Vendor & Stakeholder Partnership

  • Manage relationships with telecommunications providers, hardware vendors, managed service providers, and technology partners.
  • Collaborate with IT teams and business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver effective network solutions.
  • Provide technical guidance and knowledge sharing to other members of the IT organization.
  • Communicate project status, technical recommendations, and operational impacts to stakeholders.

Business Continuity & Resilience

  • Support disaster recovery and business continuity planning related to network infrastructure.
  • Ensure appropriate network redundancy, failover, and recovery capabilities.
  • Participate in testing and validation activities to ensure network resilience and readiness.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering preferred, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Greater than 5 years of experience supporting enterprise network infrastructure in a multi-site environment.
  • Strong knowledge of routing, switching, wireless networking, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, and firewall technologies.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex network issues and implementing scalable, reliable solutions.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, Azure Network Engineer Associate, AWS Advanced Networking, or similar.
  • Experience supporting enterprise networks across corporate offices, retail locations, and distribution centers.
  • Hands-on experience with SD-WAN, network monitoring platforms, and network automation tools.
  • Knowledge of network security best practices, Zero Trust principles, and cybersecurity frameworks.
  • Experience leading network infrastructure projects, site deployments, and technology upgrades.

descriptionHtml:
Job Purpose

Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. (ICE) presents a unique opportunity to work on cutting-edge technology and business challenges in the financial sector. The Engineer role within the ICE Network Engineering team provides leadership in network design, validation, deployment, maintenance and 24x7 operational support.

The successful candidate will work on further advancing one of the largest and global financial networks with a wide variety of critical services as well as help drive large scale office refreshes and migrations. The successful candidate will be able to multitask in a dynamic team-based environment demonstrating strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities and the highest degree of professionalism.

Responsibilities

  • Deploy, support and maintain mixed vendor network infrastructure
  • Document and publish standards and designs
  • Assist ICE staff with problem solving and escalation procedures
  • Understand and follow operational policies/procedures and promote adherence to same
  • Provide technical knowledge needed to ensure safe, effective, and efficient changes to the network infrastructure
  • Collaborate and work closely with all other IT teams
  • Lead incident investigations, diagnosis, and service restoration and always give priority to the resolution of incidents

Knowledge And Experience

  • In depth knowledge of general network principles and technology, and how to apply them in a service-oriented mission critical environment

  • Experience with switching protocols - L2/L3 Vlans, Spanning tree
  • Strong Knowledge of NAT, route maps/ACLs, and routing policies

  • Strong knowledge and experience developing in Python
  • Proficient with GIT for software collaboration and version control
  • 3+ years’ experience hands on support and troubleshooting of production networks
  • 3+ years' experience with design and implementation on complex works
  • Running and analyzing sniffer traces with deep TCP/IP protocol understanding
  • Basic Unix/Linux system administration
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills
  • Excellent customer service attitude
  • Ability to operate effectively and professionally under pressure

Preferred Skills

  • Experience working with Firewalls and Load balancers
  • Expert level network certifications

  • In-depth hardware knowledge of switches and routers: (Internal chipsets specifications, TCAM and memory details, buffering capabilities and multicast replication details)

companySlogan: Making the most advanced medicines in the world accessible and affordable to every American
descriptionHtml:
About BlinkRx:

BlinkRx is rebuilding how Americans access life-changing medicines. Today, only one in five prescriptions for new branded therapies are ever filled. The problem isn't the medicine. It's insurance barriers, affordability challenges, fragmented pharmacy experiences, and inadequate support that keep patients from starting and staying on treatment. Our mission is to change that.

We built RxOS, the first AI-powered prescription operating system. RxOS connects the largest network of doctors, patients, pharmacies, payers, and pharmaceutical manufacturers, intelligently orchestrating every step to guarantee a seamless prescription journey for every script.

Our teams solve complex, high-stakes problems at the intersection of artificial intelligence, healthcare operations, logistics, payments, and regulation. The impact is transformative: BlinkRx more than doubles the rate at which patients take their medications and lowers their out-of-pocket expenses by hundreds of dollars every month.

BlinkRx created and leads a rapidly growing $80+ billion category, with exceptional momentum:

  • Built for scale: Over the past decade, we have invested nearly $1 billion in building the technology and operational platform required to serve patients at scale.

  • Proven growth and economics: We have grown 100% annually for the past five years, are profitable, and support more than 60 pharmaceutical brands.

  • Trusted with category-defining programs: Our technology powers a leading pharmaceutical manufacturer’s direct-to-patient platform for its GLP-1 portfolio, providing the infrastructure to expand patient access as demand for these therapies grows.

We are a dynamic team of technologists and industry experts seeking to build a generational company that delivers a genuine step change in American health. 

About the Role

Blink Health is looking for a Senior Network Engineer who will be responsible for managing Blink’s routing, switching, VPN, and firewall infrastructure at our office locations and in the cloud.

What You'll Do
  • Manage, monitor, and maintain Blink’s network infrastructure, including Meraki switches/WAP, Palo Alto firewalls/VPN, AWS VPC, and AWS Transit Gateway
  • Serve as a technical architect and consultant to other engineering teams by assisting them with network design and troubleshooting in a microservices & container-based environment (AWS, Kubernetes)
  • Work with IT leadership on projects, identify new products & solutions, and research solutions
  • Promote good network design practices by emphasizing Secure & compliant implementations, Redundancy/high availability, and Automation
  • Mentor and train service desk technicians to help them provide level 1 support
  • Act as the technical escalation point for network issues
  • Configure, harden, and patch network devices & services according to security best practices and recommendations
  • Monitor security alerts and investigate security incidents
  • Maintain technical documentation about the systems you manage
  • Communicate with stakeholders by keeping them informed of incident progress, notifying them of upcoming changes or scheduled downtime
  • Participate in on-call support rotation
  • Duties will be primarily focused on Network administration while providing backup to the systems engineering colleagues for Windows and Linux server administration.
What You'll Need
  • 5+ years of experience managing on-prem & cloud network environments
  • Experience in network design and troubleshooting in a cloud-based microservices environment (AWS, Kubernetes)
  • Expert-level knowledge of enterprise network protocols & platforms such as IPSec, VPN, DNS, SNMP, OSPF, BGP, AWS VPC, Security Groups, peering, and routing
  • Deep understanding of cloud and virtualization technologies and how they impact network performance and design
  • Ability to manage an integrated cloud-based (AWS) and physical office-based infrastructure
Logistics
  • Comfortable working in the Eastern Time Zone
  • Ability to travel up to 10% to office sites (Due to Rapid Growth)
  • Ability to work up to 4 days a week in our office locations; NYC, St. Louis, or Pittsburgh

Why Join Us:

It is rare to have a company that both deeply impacts its customers and is able to provide its services across a massive population.  At Blink, we have a huge impact on people when they are most vulnerable: at the intersection of their healthcare and finances. We are also the fastest growing healthcare company in the country and are driving that impact across millions of new patients every year.  Our business model not only helps people, but drives economics that allow us to build a generational company. We are a relentlessly learning, constantly curious, and aggressively collaborative cross-functional team dedicated to inventing new ways to improve the lives of our customers.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity of all kinds. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Winston Taylor is a transatlantic law firm built for the businesses, people, and markets driving capital and innovation. Here, you're in the room. In the action. Sleeves rolled up.

You'll work with leading clients. Disruptors. Fast-growth companies. And help them to stay one step ahead of the moment and make critical decisions that shape their future. You'll be trusted with real responsibility from the outset and build experience through hands-on work. We take your progression personally. We provide the platform. You shape the work around your goals and aspirations.

Step into the moments that matter. Join Winston Taylor.

Position Summary

The Network Engineer is responsible for designing, maintaining, and continuously improving the firm’s global network infrastructure to ensure secure, highly available, and scalable connectivity across offices, data centers, cloud platforms, and remote access environments. This role supports enterprise-class data centers, Azure cloud compute, Cisco and Palo Alto firewalls, switching, routing, VoIP, Microsoft Teams, SSL tunnels and VPN, wireless and wired connectivity, and Aruba SD-WAN. Success in this role requires operational excellence, disciplined change management, strong troubleshooting capability, and a forward-looking approach to automation, resiliency, security, mobility, and global growth.

Position Responsibilities

  • Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot network-related hardware, software, and connectivity services across the firm’s global environment.
  • Perform network maintenance and system upgrades, patches, hot fixes, firmware updates, and security configurations.
  • Monitor network performance, availability, capacity, and reliability, and proactively address issues that may affect service continuity.

descriptionHtml:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. NETWORK ENGINEER (STARSHIELD)

Starshield leverages SpaceX’s Starlink technology and launch capability to support national security efforts. While Starlink is designed for consumer and commercial use, Starshield is designed for government use, with an initial focus on earth observation, communications, and hosted payloads. The Starshield team is building highly reliable in-space mesh networks, designing secure systems to guarantee access to space, designing next-gen communication and sensing software, and more.

As a Sr. Network Engineer you will drive the operation, build and deployment of the Starshield service provider network, which supports critical national security missions. You and your teammates will own the network design and be responsible for proposing and implementing continual improvements to add more capabilities and customers. You will also be responsible for monitoring and improving network security, improving network performance and reliability, and optimizing network deployments.

Responsibilites

  • Manage and expand network interconnections, network co-location sites and points of presence (POPs)
  • Manage network infrastructure and deployments to Top Secret datacenters
  • Improve network performance and reliability based upon system performance metrics, including capacity planning, failure detection and remediation
  • Assist in capacity augmentation and network optimization deployments
  • Lead network integration and troubleshooting efforts
  • Collaborate with hardware, software, and network engineers to improve the Starshield network design
  • Assist in updating system configuration and firmware
  • Build automation for network devices, operational and deployment tools
  • Mentor and train junior network engineers

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical or engineering discipline AND 5+ years of professional networking experience deploying enterprise network solutions or cloud and web-scale networks; OR 7+ years of professional networking experience deploying enterprise network solutions or cloud and web-scale networks in lieu of a degree
  • Professional Layer-1 experience (e.g., transport, DWDM, optical fiber, circuit troubleshooting, activations, etc.)
  • Hands-on experience with the build-out and deployment of hardware at datacenters and interacting with datacenters (e.g., remote hands, cross-connect execution, etc.)
  • Experience bringing up switches, routers, firewalls and servers

Preferred Skills And Experience

  • Master’s degree in a technical or engineering discipline
  • Experience with physical troubleshooting of fiber & circuits
  • Deep understanding of service provider networks including but not limited to:
    • Connectivity (Ethernet, IPv4, IPv6 and MPLS)
    • Routing (BGP, OSPF, IS-IS)
    • Switching and routing
    • Internet services (subscriber provisioning, BRAS, DNS, DHCP, NTP)
  • Experience implementing network security functions
  • Cisco, Juniper, Arista or other industry certification
  • Ability to work independently and in a team, take initiative, and communicate effectively
  • Active Top Secret or Top Secret SCI clearance
Additional Requirements

  • This position requires successfully obtaining and maintaining a Top Secret Security Clearance as a condition of employment. While the clearance may not be immediately necessary upon hire, we encourage you to initiate the application process promptly upon accepting this offer. Your ability to secure the necessary clearance is essential for fulfilling key responsibilities of the role. Should you be unable to obtain it, SpaceX reserves the right to modify or terminate your employment to align with operational needs.
  • Must be willing to travel domestically and globally in the future when needed
  • Must be available for on-call rotations
  • Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed

Compensation And Benefits

Pay Range:

Level 3: $165,000.00 - $265,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. Those with an active clearance will receive a 10% differential, up to an additional $20,000 annually, once officially briefed into a classified program

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

Itar Requirements

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C.
  • 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C.
  • 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

SENIOR NETWORK ENGINEER

Job Details

Full Time / Part Time: Full Time

FLSA Classification: Exempt

Business Unit: IT

Reports to: Director, IT Infrastructure

Travel Requirement: Yes

Job Description

Select Water Solutions is seeking a highly skilled IT Infrastructure Senior Network Engineer to design, implement, and support enterprise network infrastructure across corporate offices, field locations, and remote operations. This role is responsible for ensuring the reliability, security, and performance of the company’s network environment while supporting business-critical operations throughout Select’s footprint.

The Senior Network Engineer will serve as a technical leader within the IT Infrastructure team, providing expertise in network architecture, troubleshooting, security best practices, and system optimization. This position collaborates with cross-functional teams to support operational technology, cloud connectivity, and scalable infrastructure solutions.

The essential job functions include, but are not limited to

  • Design, implement, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure including LAN, WAN, VPN, and wireless environments.
  • Monitor network performance and proactively identify and resolve issues affecting availability, latency, or security.
  • Configure and manage routers, switches, firewalls, and other networking hardware across corporate and remote operational locations.
  • Support connectivity for field operations, including remote sites, mobile equipment, and operational technology systems.
  • Lead network infrastructure projects including upgrades, expansions, and new site deployments.
  • Maintain and improve network security posture through firewall management, segmentation, monitoring, and compliance with company policies.
  • Troubleshoot complex network issues and provide advanced technical support for escalated incidents.
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity, cloud, and systems teams to support hybrid infrastructure environments.
  • Maintain network documentation including diagrams, configuration standards, and operational procedures.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements to enhance reliability, scalability, and performance.
  • Support disaster recovery planning and ensure network resilience across business operations.
  • Provide mentorship and technical guidance to junior IT staff and other team members.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Requirements

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field preferred.
  • Minimum 7–10 years of experience in network engineering or infrastructure support.
  • Strong experience with enterprise networking technologies including routing, switching, VPNs, and firewalls.
  • Experience supporting multi-site and remote operational environments.
  • Proficiency with network monitoring and diagnostic tools.
  • Knowledge of network security best practices and secure architecture design.
  • Experience with cloud networking environments such as Azure or AWS preferred.
  • Industry certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, or equivalent strongly preferred.

About Agile Defense


 


At Agile Defense we know that action defines the outcome and new challenges require new solutions. That’s why we always look to the future and embrace change with an unmovable spirit and the courage to build for what comes next.


 


Our vision is to bring adaptive innovation to support our nation's most important missions through the seamless integration of advanced technologies, elite minds, and unparalleled agility—leveraging a foundation of speed, flexibility, and ingenuity to strengthen and protect our nation’s vital interests.




Requisition #: 1798



Job Title: Senior Network Engineer


Location: Hybrid, Ashburn, VA


Clearance Level: Ability to successfully receive a DHS Customs and Border Protection background check (CBP BI), Public Trust 



Job DescriptionServe as a Senior Network Engineer enabling the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) mission and enterprise network infrastructure. The applicant will be responsible for engineering, maintaining, configuring, and troubleshooting wide-area networks (WAN), local-area networks (LAN), SDWAN, Virtual Private Networks, wireless networks (WLAN), and perimeter security controls in accordance with customer standards and mandates.


Education and Background

  • Bachelor’s degree in management information systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (e.g. Networking and Telecommunications) with 10+ years of experience performing network engineering or 14+ years of network engineering experience without a bachelor’s degree

  • Minimum of ten (10) years of verifiable network engineering experience supporting a large, complex Federal agency. Strong knowledge of networking protocols, such as TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, MPLS, VPNs and VLANs

  • Expertise and experience with Cisco technology and Firewall technologies. Ability to perform firewall changes

  • Hands-on experience with SDN technologies such as Cisco ACI or VMware NSX. Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex network issues

  • Delivers high-level technical leadership to meet or exceed establishes project goals. 



Years of Experience10 years


Required SkillsThe Senior network engineer will be the technical lead performing the following:

  • Network Engineering & Maintenance: Configure, deploy, and support enterprise-grade switches, routers, firewalls, VPN gateways, adhere to logging baselines and load balancers across DHS operational environments. 

  • Troubleshooting & Incident Management: Provide Tier 2/Tier 3 escalation support for network outages, circuit degradations, and performance issues; conduct root cause analyses (RCA) and coordinate vendor support

  • Architecture & Upgrades: Support the planning, installation, and cutover of network hardware upgrades, SD-WAN transitions, cloud interconnects (AWS/Azure/GCP), remote field sites and infrastructure modernization

  • Software Defined Wide Area Networking (SD-WAN): Design, implement, and maintain an SD-WAN solution that extends the principles of software-defined networking and supports multiple network transports (e.g., Dedicated Internet Access (DIA), Broadband Internet, MPLS, 4G/LTE/5G, and satellite) at remote sites. Use SD-WAN network virtualization capabilities, the SD-WAN solution to route traffic based on application type, pre-defined routing policies, and network performance requirements

  • Documentation & Asset Management: Maintain accurate network diagrams (Visio), topology maps, inventory databases, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and change control tickets (ServiceNow/Remedy)

  • Support On-Call & Escalation Management: support 24/7/365 on-call rotation readiness to respond to Tier 3 critical network incidents within SLA limits and coordinating cross-functional escalation pathways. When needed to restore services, the Senior Network Engineer will provide a solution and implement an Emergency Change Request (ECR), Emergency Break Fix (EBF), or Change Request

  • Root Cause Analysis (RCA) or Post Incident Reporting: Participate in the Root Cause Analysis (RCA) or post incident analysis of problems for mission critical applications, mission essential applications, and mission essential network infrastructure as well as recurring issues on the enterprise IT infrastructure. 

  • Project Support: Partner with program and project managers to align network engineering deliverables, milestone schedules, and resource planning with enterprise project objectives

  • Scheduled and Adhoc Travel: Ability to travel within the United States either on short notice or scheduled, up to 35% of the time. 



Preferred Skills

  • Active CBP BI or within the past 3 years

  • Active Industry certifications, such as CCNA, CCNP (routing and switching)

  • Nice to have: experience and expertise with Zero Trust (Zscaler) and Palo Alto technologies

  • Previous experience CBP highly desired, followed by DHS or DoW

  • Advance skills in 3 or more of the following:

    • Cisco SD-WAN

    • Cisco Hyperflex

    • Cisco StealthWatch

    • Cisco Application Centric Infrastructure

    • Cisco Firepower




  • Willing to be cross trained in the above technologies, 



Working ConditionsAbility to sit for long periods of time



Our Core Values


 


Employees of Agile Defense are our number one priority, and the importance we place on our culture here is fundamental. Our culture is alive and evolving, but it always stays true to its roots. Here, you are valued as a family member, and we believe that we can accomplish great things together. Agile Defense has been highly successful in the past few years due to our employees and the culture we create together. 


 


What makes us Agile? We call it the 6Hs, the values that define our culture and guide everything we do. Together, these values infuse vibrancy, integrity, and a tireless work ethic into advancing the most important national security and critical civilian missions. It's how we show up every day. It's who we are.


 



  • Happy - Be Infectious. Happiness multiplies and creates a positive and connected environment where motivation and satisfaction have an outsized effect on everything we do.

  • Helpful - Be Supportive. Being helpful is the foundation of teamwork, resulting in a supportive atmosphere where collaboration flourishes, and collective success is celebrated.

  • Honest - Be Trustworthy. Honesty serves as our compass, ensuring transparent communication and ethical conduct, essential to who we are and the complex domains we support.

  • Humble - Be Grounded. Success is not achieved alone, humility ensures a culture of mutual respect, encouraging open communication, and a willingness to learn from one another and take on any task.

  • Hungry - Be Eager. Our hunger for excellence drives an insatiable appetite for innovation and continuous improvement, propelling us forward in the face of new and unprecedented challenges.

  • Hustle - Be Driven. Hustle is reflected in our relentless work ethic, where we are each committed to going above and beyond to advance the mission and achieve success.



 


Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities


We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

descriptionHtml:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. NETWORK ENGINEER (STARSHIELD)

Starshield leverages SpaceX’s Starlink technology and launch capability to support national security efforts. While Starlink is designed for consumer and commercial use, Starshield is designed for government use, with an initial focus on earth observation, communications, and hosted payloads. The Starshield team is building highly reliable in-space mesh networks, designing secure systems to guarantee access to space, designing next-gen communication and sensing software, and more.

As a Sr. Network Engineer you will drive the operation, build and deployment of the Starshield service provider network, which supports critical national security missions. You and your teammates will own the network design and be responsible for proposing and implementing continual improvements to add more capabilities and customers. You will also be responsible for monitoring and improving network security, improving network performance and reliability, and optimizing network deployments.

Responsibilites

  • Manage and expand network interconnections, network co-location sites and points of presence (POPs)
  • Manage network infrastructure and deployments to Top Secret datacenters
  • Improve network performance and reliability based upon system performance metrics, including capacity planning, failure detection and remediation
  • Assist in capacity augmentation and network optimization deployments
  • Lead network integration and troubleshooting efforts
  • Collaborate with hardware, software, and network engineers to improve the Starshield network design
  • Assist in updating system configuration and firmware
  • Build automation for network devices, operational and deployment tools
  • Mentor and train junior network engineers

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical or engineering discipline AND 5+ years of professional networking experience deploying enterprise network solutions or cloud and web-scale networks; OR 7+ years of professional networking experience deploying enterprise network solutions or cloud and web-scale networks in lieu of a degree
  • Professional Layer-1 experience (e.g., transport, DWDM, optical fiber, circuit troubleshooting, activations, etc.)
  • Hands-on experience with the build-out and deployment of hardware at datacenters and interacting with datacenters (e.g., remote hands, cross-connect execution, etc.)
  • Experience bringing up switches, routers, firewalls and servers

Preferred Skills And Experience

  • Master’s degree in a technical or engineering discipline
  • Experience with physical troubleshooting of fiber & circuits
  • Deep understanding of service provider networks including but not limited to:
    • Connectivity (Ethernet, IPv4, IPv6 and MPLS)
    • Routing (BGP, OSPF, IS-IS)
    • Switching and routing
    • Internet services (subscriber provisioning, BRAS, DNS, DHCP, NTP)
  • Experience implementing network security functions
  • Cisco, Juniper, Arista or other industry certification
  • Ability to work independently and in a team, take initiative, and communicate effectively
  • Active Top Secret or Top Secret SCI clearance
Additional Requirements

  • This position requires successfully obtaining and maintaining a Top Secret Security Clearance as a condition of employment. While the clearance may not be immediately necessary upon hire, we encourage you to initiate the application process promptly upon accepting this offer. Your ability to secure the necessary clearance is essential for fulfilling key responsibilities of the role. Should you be unable to obtain it, SpaceX reserves the right to modify or terminate your employment to align with operational needs.
  • Must be willing to travel domestically and globally in the future when needed
  • Must be available for on-call rotations
  • Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed

Compensation And Benefits

Pay Range:

Level 3: $165,000.00 - $265,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. Those with an active clearance will receive a 10% differential, up to an additional $20,000 annually, once officially briefed into a classified program

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

Itar Requirements

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C.
  • 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C.
  • 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

The Data Center Network Engineering (DNE) is a pod within the Physical Networking team and owns the design, deployment, and operation of Roblox's large-scale data center network. This includes server-layer connectivity, intra and inter-DC connectivity. The team is building High-Performance Networking (HPN) fabrics, deploying 400G/800G networking, and scaling GPU clusters to support AI training and inference.

You will

  • Drive the design, deployment, and operations of Roblox's large-scale data center network, including the networking for GPU clusters that support training and inference workloads.
  • Design, qualify, and validate new technologies and hardware for scalable solutions.
  • Coordinate data center builds and projects with multiple teams, including weekly cross-team calls.
  • Work with Network Reliability Systems, Data Center Ops, Capacity Planning, Supply Chain, and Compute/ML teams to address network challenges early.
  • Contribute to automation and telemetry that improve efficiency, reliability, and visibility.

You have

  • 6+ years of expertise designing and deploying large-scale data center fabrics (CLOS).
  • Experience with GPU clusters or AI/ML networking.
  • Proficiency deploying and managing 400G and 800G hardware.
  • Skilled in configuring and troubleshooting large-scale BGP deployments.
  • Strong knowledge of network protocols (TCP/IP, UDP, DHCP, DNS), with hands-on experience in IPv4 and IPv6.

descriptionHtml:
Role Summary

The Senior Network Engineer designs, implements, and maintains a scalable, secure network infrastructure across our distribution centers, branches, and cloud environments. This role owns troubleshooting, leads meaningful pieces of network projects (data center connectivity, SD-WAN rollouts, capacity expansions), while partnering closely with the security team on network-security integration.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect, implement, and maintain scalable and secure network infrastructure across Cisco switching/routing, Cisco/Meraki SD-WAN, and Cisco ACI data center fabric.
  • Lead diagnosis and resolution of complex network issues, including intermittent connectivity problems, performance bottlenecks, and multi-site routing/switching faults.
  • Design and support enterprise wireless architecture across Cisco and Meraki wireless controllers, including RF planning input, policy, and segmentation.
  • Own the day-to-day administration and operational health of SolarWinds NPM/NTA, including monitoring coverage, alerting, dashboards, device onboarding, and platform maintenance; use SolarWinds, Wireshark, and related tools for capacity planning and advanced traffic analysis.
  • Own configuration standards and version control for network devices, ensuring consistent, secure, and auditable network operations.
  • Administer and optimize Infoblox DDI (DNS, DHCP, IPAM) for enterprise-scale environments.
  • Partner with the network security to integrate network devices with Cisco ISE, Palo Alto firewalls, and PKI/certificate-based authentication, and to implement segmentation aligned with Zero Trust principles.
  • Lead or significantly contribute to network projects such as data center migrations, SD-WAN expansions, and branch network builds, coordinating with IT operations, security, and application teams.
  • Direct the relationship with the managed services provider (MSP) for new site builds, escalations, and complex troubleshooting.
  • Evaluate emerging network technologies and provide recommendations to management on adoption for future growth.
  • Begin introducing automation (Ansible, Python, or similar) to streamline recurring configuration tasks and reduce manual error.
  • Support cloud network connectivity for Azure and/or AWS environments (VPN/ExpressRoute/Direct Connect, VNets/VPCs) in partnership with cloud teams.
  • Maintain thorough network documentation, diagrams, and runbooks; ensure changes follow change management standards.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation, serving as an escalation point above the MSP's first-line support.

Required Qualifications AND SKILLS

  • 8-15 years of hands-on experience in enterprise Cisco network infrastructure, including routing, switching, wireless, and SD-WAN.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
  • Deep working knowledge of TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, DMVPN, QoS, and policy-based routing.
  • Proven expertise with Cisco SD-WAN, Meraki, Cisco ACI (or comparable data center fabric), and Cisco/Meraki wireless.
  • Strong experience with SolarWinds (NPM/NTA) or comparable monitoring platforms, and packet-capture analysis (Wireshark).
  • Hands-on experience with F5 BIG-IP/LTM administration and troubleshooting, plus solid working knowledge of Cisco ISE, Infoblox DDI, and Palo Alto firewalls sufficient to partner effectively with security engineering.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical workstreams within larger projects, including data center or SD-WAN initiatives.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and root-cause-analysis skills for complex, multi-layered network issues.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical detail for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Comfortable managing vendor and MSP relationships for equipment delivery and escalations.
  • Experience with PKI/certificate lifecycle management.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code and automation tooling (Ansible, Python, Terraform).
  • Experience with Azure or AWS networking at a design/implementation level.
  • CCNP required; progress toward or possession of CCIE strongly preferred.

Posted Salary Range

USD $110,000.00 - USD $130,000.00 /Yr.

descriptionHtml:
Department: Information Technology

Location: Redondo Beach

Compensation: $125,000 - $155,000 / year

Description

As a Network Engineer (Corporate IT) at Impulse, you are responsible for implementing, operating, troubleshooting, and continuously improving network infrastructure across enterprise, inter-site, manufacturing, lab/test, mission-critical, data center, and cloud-adjacent environments.

This is an execution-focused engineering role working within company reference architectures and standards defined in partnership with Network Architecture and Security leadership. The engineer is expected to independently handle routine-to-complex network changes and troubleshooting, contribute to design decisions, and partner with senior engineers or architects on larger initiatives. The ideal candidate thrives in environments where uptime, performance, segmentation, and security are important and is comfortable supporting event-driven, operationally critical activities.

While the environment is Cisco-leaning, strong experience with other enterprise networking platforms is valued, and candidates are not required to have exclusively Cisco backgrounds.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure, including Layer 2/3 switching, routing, wireless, WAN, and high-availability solutions, in alignment with established network architectures and standards
  • Configure and optimize routing protocols such as OSPF and BGP, site-to-site and site-to-cloud connectivity, VPNs, and SD-WAN to ensure scalable, resilient, and reliable communications
  • Configure and maintain network segmentation using VLANs, VRFs, ACLs, firewalls, NAC/802.1X, and zero-trust-aligned access controls to protect corporate, manufacturing, laboratory, restricted, and guest environments
  • Monitor network health, availability, capacity, and performance; troubleshoot issues across Layers 1–7; and implement improvements to minimize downtime and maintain operational continuity
  • Provide network support during test campaigns, mission-critical activities, and other time-sensitive operations; participate in incident response, root cause analysis, and post-incident reviews
  • Partner with Security and Compliance teams to implement security controls, logging, monitoring, and documentation that support applicable requirements, including ITAR, NIST SP 800-171, and CMMC
  • Develop and maintain network automation using tools such as Python, Ansible, and Terraform, and support monitoring and telemetry solutions to improve configuration consistency, visibility, and operational efficiency
  • Execute firmware upgrades, hardware refreshes, capacity planning, and infrastructure expansions while supporting new site builds, relocations, and laboratory deployments
  • Configure and optimize QoS and, where applicable, precision-timing technologies such as PTP/IEEE 1588 and 802.1AS to support latency-sensitive telemetry, control systems, and other critical workloads
  • Maintain accurate network diagrams, IP address management records, configurations, and operational runbooks while collaborating with Infrastructure, Security, Facilities, IT Operations, and senior network engineering teams

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands-on network engineering or network administration experience in production environments
  • Hands-on experience supporting multi-site, on-prem, and cloud-adjacent networks
  • Experience working in change-controlled, security-sensitive, or similarly structured production environments
  • Strong working knowledge of Layer 2/3 networking technologies including VLANs, trunking, STP, link aggregation, OSPF, and familiarity with BGP
  • Hands-on experience implementing and supporting high-availability technologies such as HSRP/VRRP, MLAG, or stacking
  • Working knowledge of network segmentation, VRFs, ACLs, and exposure to NAC or 802.1X
  • Experience with enterprise wireless networks, VPNs, and WAN connectivity
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across multi-site or distributed network environments
  • Experience in Cisco-leaning environments, including traditional enterprise platforms and Meraki or other cloud-managed solutions. Experience with other enterprise networking platforms (for example Juniper, Arista, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Aruba, or similar) is also acceptable

Preferred Skills And Experience

  • 5+ years of hands-on network engineering or network administration experience in production environments
  • Industry certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, or equivalent hands-on experience
  • Experience with SD-WAN, data center fabrics, or EVPN/VXLAN
  • Familiarity with precision time protocols (PTP / IEEE 1588, 802.1AS) and QoS or traffic engineering
  • Experience with automation frameworks, scripting, or infrastructure-as-code concepts
  • Experience in aerospace, defense, manufacturing, or other regulated, mission-critical environments

Additional Information

Compensation bands are determined by role, level, location, and alignment with market data. Individual level and base pay is determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on job-related skills, education, experience, technical capabilities and internal equity. In addition to base salary, for full-time hires, you may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of stock options, and access to medical, vision & dental coverage as well as access to a 401(k) retirement plan.

This position requires applicants to be either U.S. Persons (i.e., U.S. citizen, U.S. national, lawful permanent U.S. resident (green card holder), an individual granted asylum in the U.S., or an individual admitted in U.S. refugee status) or persons eligible to obtain an export license from the U.S. Departments of State, Commerce, or other applicable U.S. government agencies. descriptionHtml:
Category/Area of Expertise: IT & Technology

Job Requisition: 561503

Address: USA-NC-Salisbury-2110 Executive Drive

Store Code: Infrastructure - Network (5118716)

Ahold Delhaize USA, a division of global food retailer Ahold Delhaize, is part of the U.S. family of brands, which includes five leading omnichannel grocery brands - Food Lion, Giant Food, The GIANT Company, Hannaford and Stop & Shop. Our associates support the brands with a wide range of services, including Finance, Legal, Sustainability, Commercial, Digital and E-commerce, Technology and more.

Primary Purpose:

The Network Engineer II supports ADUSA's large-scale network across retail stores, distribution centers, offices, data centers, Equinix, and Azure. The role implements and troubleshoots LAN, WAN/SD-WAN, wireless, firewall connectivity, DNS/DHCP/IPAM, and network monitoring services. The engineer assigned incidents and changes through diagnosis, validation, documentation, and closure, and participates in critical incident response and on-call support.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Troubleshoot Layer 2 and Layer 3 connectivity across Cisco, HPE/Aruba, Arista, Fortinet, and Palo Alto environments, including VLANs, STP, LACP, SDWAN, Routing, and NAT.
  • Support retail WAN and SD-WAN across MPLS, broadband, and LTE, including path selection, failover, latency, packet loss, and brownout conditions.
  • Implement approved ServiceNow changes with tested steps, validation evidence, backout plans, and accurate closure records.
  • Support Aruba wireless and ClearPass/NAC, including AP health, client connectivity, authentication, RF performance, and coverage issues.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot with SolarWinds, Datadog, FortiAnalyzer, SNMP, syslog, NetFlow, and packet captures.
  • Support Infoblox DNS/DHCP/IPAM and F5 load-balancing dependencies during incidents and changes.
  • Own assigned incidents through service restoration, technical updates, root-cause analysis, and prevention actions.
  • Maintain network diagrams, inventories, standards, SOPs, MOPs, and configuration records.
  • Build reporting, and repetitive operational tasks. Drive ADUSA MSP to maintain, SOP, runbooks
  • Participate in after-hours changes, on-call rotation, and critical incident support.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of enterprise network operations or engineering experience in a multi-site environment.

descriptionHtml:
Join Aristocrat, a global leader in regulated gaming entertainment, where innovation, reliability, and alignment to regulations are essential to our operations. As an MSP Network Engineer, you will play a crucial role in developing and maintaining the network framework that supports MSP gaming operations. This position offers an exceptional opportunity to work in a highly regulated, 24x7 production environment. You will direct network builds and operational plans across our data centers and customer locations. Your knowledge will ensure the smooth performance and security of our vital systems, greatly influencing our worldwide gaming networks.

What You'll Do

  • Construct, align, and improve secure, scalable network builds for Class 3 MSP gaming systems.
  • Take ownership for network build decisions from start to finish across primary and secondary data centers as well as customer environments.
  • Define technical standards, reference architectures, and guidelines applicable to networking of MSP devices.
  • Maintain high uptime, fault resistance, and efficiency of vital MSP network infrastructure.
  • Lead complex triage efforts across routing, VPNs, firewalls, and Multi Site networks.
  • Drive root cause analysis, corrective actions, and long-term reliability improvements.
  • Analyze performance and resource trends; lead proactive efforts to improve resource use and efficiency.
  • Build and maintain resilient network infrastructures aligned with cybersecurity guidelines and gaming regulatory requirements.
  • Lead network change planning and risk assessment within formal change and configuration management processes.
  • Partner with gaming regulators and internal compliance teams to ensure compliant system operation.
  • Lead technical execution of new site deployments, infrastructure upgrades, and network modernization efforts.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • CCNA or equivalent networking certification preferred.
  • 5+ years of hands-on enterprise network engineering experience.
  • Expert-level understanding of routing and networking protocols (BGP, OSPF, IPSec, QoS, TCP/IP).
  • Deep hands-on experience with enterprise Palo Alto firewalls, Arista Products, and F5 Products.
  • Strong experience with network monitoring, diagnostics, and analytics platforms.
  • Proven experience crafting and supporting highly available, regulated, or critically important environments.
  • Strong security approach and experience implementing secure network architectures.
  • Ability to work independently, lead technical initiatives, and influence cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to obtain required Tribal Gaming licenses which may include providing fingerprints, background checks, financial statements, and any other applicable licensing requests.

Travel Expectations

  • None

Additional Information

This role is subject to mandatory background screening and regulatory approvals. As part of moving into this role, you may be required to complete a criminal background check, submit fingerprints, and obtain licenses or registrations with applicable gaming regulatory authorities.

Aristocrat operates in a highly regulated environment and holds licenses in over 340 gaming jurisdictions worldwide. To meet our global compliance obligations, you will be required to provide the disclosure of relevant personal and background information to government agencies, sovereign nations/tribal regulators, and other applicable gaming regulatory bodies. This is a condition of Aristocrat’s gaming licenses. The specific information required may vary depending on the jurisdiction and project assignment.

This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat.

Compensation Philosophy

We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits.

Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

descriptionHtml:
Saronic Technologies is a leader in revolutionizing autonomy at sea, dedicated to developing state-of-the-art solutions that enhance maritime operations through autonomous and intelligent platforms.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Network Engineer to support the day-to-day operation, security and reliability of our enterprise network. You will administer wired, wireless and perimeter infrastructure across multiple locations, respond to incidents, contribute to network design and improvement projects in partnership with our senior network engineers, and help move our network toward infrastructure as code and automation.

You are a hands-on engineer who is equally comfortable in a device console, a monitoring dashboard and a root-cause investigation, who looks for opportunities to automate routine work and brings a customer-service mindset to supporting our employees. As Saronic grows, you will help keep our network available, optimized and secure at scale.

Responsibilities

  • Administer and support the security, performance and availability of our switching, routing, wireless and firewall infrastructure using industry-leading enterprise networking platforms.
  • Build and manage network infrastructure as code using tools like Terraform, so that network changes are repeatable, peer reviewed and version controlled.
  • Identify and deploy automation opportunities using tools like Ansible (or similar) to reduce manual work and configuration errors.
  • Manage secure remote access, including site-to-site and client-based VPN connectivity.
  • Monitor network health and performance using monitoring and observability tools, respond to alerts, and resolve issues before they impact users.
  • Troubleshoot network incidents, escalate complex issues to senior engineers, and document root cause and resolution.
  • Contribute to network design, upgrade and expansion projects, and implement changes in line with change management practices and with minimal disruption to operations.
  • Support network segmentation and access control policies in partnership with Information Security.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Information Security, Systems Engineering and IT Support, to resolve enterprise-level issues.
  • Maintain network documentation, including topology diagrams, IP schemas and operating procedures.
  • Support compliance requirements and internal and external audits as needed.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 3+ years of experience in network engineering, network operations or a similar role.
  • Hands-on experience administering enterprise switching, routing and wireless infrastructure.
  • Experience managing firewalls and VPN solutions.
  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, spanning tree and routing protocols such as BGP and OSPF.
  • Experience with network automation and infrastructure as code, using tools such as Terraform and Ansible (or similar) alongside source control.
  • Experience with network monitoring, alerting and observability platforms.
  • Familiarity with security principles, access control policies and network segmentation.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong documentation and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience applying CI/CD practices to network changes, including automated validation and testing of configurations.
  • Industry certifications such as CCNA, CCNP or equivalent.
  • Experience with network access control and 802.1X implementations.

descriptionHtml:
ABOUT US:

LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a commitment to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, handle risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years.

Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.

LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 70 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG.

Our People:

People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our culture of connecting, creating opportunity and delivering excellence shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential.

We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and exciting experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.

We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise.

As a global organization spanning 70 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with relevant careers.

Role Summary:

As a highly skilled principal network engineer, you will be responsible for the ongoing support and reliability of all components within the LSEG ecosystem, encompassing platforms, networks, applications, and services. In this role, you will provide escalation support for important network services, ensuring the operational stability and performance of the LSEG global network. You will also find opportunities and improvements, then define requirements for software automation to enhance the features, functions and reliability of the network, underpinning LSEG’s digital platforms.

What You will be Doing:

We will play a pivotal role in designing, building, and maintaining systems, software, and applications across various domains, ensuring the highest quality outcomes. We will independently make technical design and amendment decisions, effectively leading the workload.

By analysing data and understanding business requirements, we will translate them into technical specifications, ensuring alignment with infrastructure and network capacity needs. We will develop dashboards to provide near real-time network status.

Collaborating closely with network operations and service teams, we will provide in-depth technical support and guidance for all multicast- and WAN-related issues and implementations. This role requires a proactive problem solver with a deep understanding of multicast protocols, WAN infrastructure, and a passion for delivering exceptional service.

When necessary, we will lead upgrades, coordinating efforts with internal teams and third parties. Building accurate documentation and monitoring system performance are essential to support business activities and continuous improvement.

We will support the deployment of engineering patterns and contribute to creating solutions by coordinating design requirements to be automated, tested and released.

What You will Bring:

  • Proven experience in network products and services, with specific focus on Cisco WAN technologies, including ASR and Nexus9K.
  • Expertise in LAN, WAN, MPLS, VPLS, LDP, GRE, BGP, OSPF, and ISIS within a VRF context for L2/L3VPN services, Traffic Engineering, and RSVP.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of multicast concepts, including PIM-SM, PIM-SSM, IGMP, MVPN, and MLDP.
  • Proficiency in product-aligned, service-focused work, with a solid grasp of network automation, SRE, and DevOps or equivalent experience.
  • Working with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and project management tools like JIRA.
  • Excellent skills in network packet analysis and packet capture tools for troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with load balancing technologies, TCP/IP, and multicast in internet environments.
  • Understanding of low-latency technologies commonly used in the financial sector.
  • Experience in Data Centre Networking, including Software-Defined Networking (SDN), Cisco ACI, VxLAN, and related technologies.
  • Proficiency in Service Management processes, preferably with ITIL knowledge.
  • Excellent spoken and written English skills, enabling meaningful collaboration.

Preferred Skills And Experience

  • A bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in a technology-related field is essential.
  • CCIE certification, is highly desirable (including actively pursuing accreditations).
  • Significant experience in technology-focused positions is crucial.
  • Extensive knowledge of routing and switching protocols.
  • Substantial experience (5+ Years) as a WAN Network Engineer.
  • Exposure to Network Service Providers or the Financial Services Sector.

Career Stage:

Manager

London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:

Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.

LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.

Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.

Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.

You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering.

LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives.

Contributes to architectural decisions, mentors junior engineers, and leads small to medium-sized infrastructure projects across LAN, WAN, wireless, VPN, and cloud-integrated environments. Working closely with senior engineering staff, vendors, and cross-functional IT teams, ensures high availability, performance, and security of network services while driving operational improvements and adherence to industry best practices. 

Principal Job Functions

  • *Commits to the mission, vision, beliefs and consistently demonstrates our core values.
  • *Leads the deployment, configuration, and optimization of Layer 2 and Layer 3 network infrastructure, including switches, routers, wireless controllers, and firewalls. 
  • *Performs advanced troubleshooting of network incidents and performance issues across LAN, WAN, VPN, and wireless environments, escalating to senior staff when necessary. 
  • *Implements and maintains network segmentation, VLAN strategies, and routing protocols such as OSPF and BGP. 
  • *Leads routine network maintenance and lifecycle management, including firmware upgrades, device replacements, and structured cabling improvements. 
  • *Designs, implements, and maintains secure site-to-site and remote-access VPN connections with third-party vendors and partners. 
  • *Configures and manages SD-WAN infrastructure (e.g., Palo Alto ION), optimizing network traffic and failover policies. 
  • *Utilizes advanced monitoring and diagnostic tools (e.g., SolarWinds, Wireshark, Palo Alto Panorama) to proactively identify and resolve network issues. 
  • *Maintains detailed and accurate network documentation including topology diagrams, configuration standards, and change control records. 
  • *Assists in the design and execution of enterprise network projects and infrastructure upgrades, collaborating across IT disciplines and with external vendors. 
  • *Contributes to the development and enforcement of network security practices, including firewall policies, access controls, and segmentation strategies. 
  • *Provides Tier 2 and Tier 3 network support, serving as an escalation point for Network staff and mentoring junior team members. 
  • *Participates in network architecture discussions and capacity planning to support organizational growth and technology initiatives. 
  • *Contributes to the evaluation and testing of emerging networking technologies and makes recommendations for adoption where appropriate. 
  • *Participates in the on-call rotation for after-hours network support and planned maintenance windows. 
  • Enters restricted access areas without supervision to perform advanced network-related tasks. 
  • Provide end-to-end network support for Community Connect partners, including design validation, secure connectivity (SD-WAN/VPN), troubleshooting, and ongoing optimization of network paths to ensure reliable and secure access to hosted applications such as EPIC and other Bryan owned services and solutions.
  • Maintains professional growth and development through seminars, workshops, and professional affiliations to keep abreast of latest trends in field of expertise.
  • Participates in meetings, committees and department projects as assigned.
  • Performs other related projects and duties as assigned.

(Essential Job functions are marked with an asterisk “*".

Required Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

  • Knowledge of networking protocols and concepts, including TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, VRRP, EIGRP, and MPLS. 
  • Knowledge of Layer 2 and Layer 3 technologies, including VLAN design, trunking, spanning-tree protocol, static and dynamic routing, and inter-VLAN routing. 
  • Knowledge of enterprise-grade networking equipment from vendors such as Extreme, Aruba, and Palo Alto. 
  • Knowledge of SD-WAN architecture and implementation, particularly Palo Alto ION deployment and policy configuration. 
  • Knowledge of network security principles, including segmentation, firewall zoning, zero-trust access, and vulnerability mitigation strategies. 
  • Knowledge of authentication, authorization, and accounting (AAA), 802.1X, and network access control systems. 
  • Skill in configuring and maintaining enterprise firewalls, NAT policies, and access control rules—preferably in Palo Alto environments using Panorama. 
  • Skill in verbal and written communication to interface with technical staff, management, vendors, and non-technical stakeholders. 
  • Skill in using advanced network diagnostic and monitoring tools (e.g., Wireshark, SolarWinds, NetFlow analyzers) to resolve complex issues and ensure high availability. 
  • Ability to design, implement, and troubleshoot secure VPN solutions (site-to-site and remote-access) in multi-vendor environments. 
  • Ability to design and maintain comprehensive network documentation, including topology diagrams, IP schemas, and standard operating procedures. 
  • Ability to manage and execute infrastructure projects from planning to implementation, including vendor coordination, budgeting input, and milestone tracking. 
  • Ability to mentor junior staff, share technical knowledge, and lead troubleshooting or implementation efforts. 
  • Ability to work independently on complex tasks and make sound technical decisions with minimal oversight. 
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality relevant to sensitive information.
  • Ability to maintain regular and punctual attendance.

Education And Experience

Associate degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Networking, or a related field required. Bachelor’s degree preferred. Minimum of three (3) years of progressively responsible experience supporting, configuring, and troubleshooting enterprise network infrastructure in a multi-site or complex environment required. In lieu of Associates degree, an additional two (2) years of progressively responsible experience in these same areas required. 

Experience with one or more enterprise networking platforms (e.g., Extreme, Cisco, Aruba, Palo Alto) in production environments required. Experience leading technical tasks or projects, mentoring junior staff, or contributing to network architecture discussions preferred. 

Other Credentials / Certifications

The following certifications are preferred.

  • Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA)
  • Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP Enterprise)
  • CompTIA Security+
  • Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Administrator (PCNSA)
  • Extreme Networks Certified Specialist (ECS)
  • Aruba Certified Professional (ACP)

Physical Requirements

(Physical Requirements are based on federal criteria and assigned by Human Resources upon review of the Principal Job Functions.)

(DOT) -- Characterized as medium work requiring exertion of 20 to 50 pounds of force occasionally, and / or 10 to 25 pounds of force frequently, and / or greater than negligible up to 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects.

Involves sitting most of the time but may involve walking or standing for brief periods as well as working above your head while on a ladder.
