descriptionHtml:
Overview

Systems Planning and Analysis, Inc. (SPA) delivers high-impact, technical solutions to complex national security issues. With over 50 years of business expertise and consistent growth, we are known for continuous innovation for our government customers, in both the US and abroad. Our exceptionally talented team is highly collaborative in spirit and practice, producing Results that Matter . Come work with the best! We offer opportunity, unique challenges, and clear-sighted commitment to the mission. SPA: Objective. Responsive. Trusted.

SPA is hiring a Network Engineer to provide design, implementation, monitoring, and management support of secure change-controlled local and wide area networks to ensure maximum uptime for users and mission. This position is aligned with the Operations Research and Cyber Analysis (ORCA) division in Chantilly, VA. The role will include designing secure system configurations, documenting and managing the installation of a network, and maintaining and upgrading existing systems. The ideal candidate will be a subject matter expert, providing technical solutions to meet the requirements of the company and clients.

SPA has an immediate need for the a Network Engineer. #KS

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement new network solutions and/or improving the efficiency of current networks.
  • Install, configure, test, maintain, monitor, troubleshoot and support network equipment including virtual and physical routers, switches, firewalls (Cisco, Dell).
  • Configure firewalls, routing and switching to maximize network efficiency and security.
  • Maximizing network performance through ongoing monitoring and troubleshooting.
  • Accurately document instances of network equipment or component failure, repair, installation, and removal.
  • Investigating faults in the network, perform analysis, diagnose, and resolution of complex network problems, and recommend and implement corrective actions.
  • Coordinate services, troubleshooting, and resolutions with 3 rd party transport providers.
  • Perform capacity analysis and planning to ensure growing traffic demand.
  • Coordinate and execute scheduled upgrades.
  • Reporting network status to key stakeholders.
  • Accurately document and maintain ATO documentation including standard operating procedure development, artifact creation, submission of artifacts to ISSM and/or government representatives.
  • Assist in preparing, maintaining, and upholding procedures for monitoring and responding to Cybersecurity continuous monitoring requirements (SIEM, Log review, validation of security controls, required hardening, etc.).
  • Interface with third-party support and equipment vendors as needed.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in information technology, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Minimum of 8-10 years directly related experience
  • Experience with routing, switching, and firewall configuration in multi-vendor environment (i.e. Dell, Cisco, Juniper)
  • Experience in WAN, LAN, out-of-band management, and Storage architecture and environments
  • Problem solving and time management capabilities
  • Experience working independently and in team-oriented, collaborative environment
  • US Citizenship required, successful candidates will be subject to a security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information
  • Must possess and maintain DoD 8570 / 8140 compliant certification
  • Active security clearance (Top Secret//SCI Required) and the ability to maintain it throughoutemployment
  • Ability to work onsite up to 5 days per week, depending upon client needs

Pay Range Information

At SPA, we strive to deliver a robust total compensation package that will attract and retain top talent. Elements of the compensation package include competitive base pay and variable compensation opportunities. SPA provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and a number of programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work. The specific programs and options available to any given employee may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, etc. Please note that the salary information shown below is a general guideline only. Salaries are commensurate with experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations. Virginia, Pay Transparency Salary range: USD $150,000.00/Yr. - USD $195,000.00/Yr.

descriptionHtml:
About Us

At Viasat, the work you do helps people stay connected in ways that matter, from everyday moments to critical missions across air, land, sea, and space.

We’re a place for people who are curious, bold, and motivated by meaningful work. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, explore new possibilities, and grow your career in ways that align with your interests and goals. When you're ready to take on something new, you'll find leaders who support your development and help you turn your ambition into action.

What You'll Do

As a Network Engineer within Viasat Government, you will support a wide range of mission-critical programs and diverse service offerings by delivering optimal network performance, reliability, and customer experience. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, implement, troubleshoot, and optimize complex network solutions that enable secure and resilient communications for government customers around the globe.

The day-to-day

Troubleshooting and correcting complex failures of Hardware, Software, and Network systems.

Work is performed locally on site, via remote login, or via phone with "smarthands" located on site. Complexity is based on standard and non-standard configurations of both ViaSat and Customer owned equipment. Problems are on multiple platformsand include the integration between them. Changes to policy-based routing and in-depth understandings of abstract concepts and equipment interaction can be required. Workperformed is considered at an Advanced to Expert level in many disciplines including IP networking and Satcom/RF. Advising and supporting remote field service engineers atmanned locations. Aid customers and/or vendors to resolve issues with their equipment or networks to help restore our services.

Analyzing the root cause of failures.

In the process of fixing the problem, hardware or software may need to be replaced, upgraded, reconfigured, etc. Once service is restored, atrue root cause must be identified. Root cause is essential to understanding why something happened and how to mitigate it in the future. The analysis of root cause can becomplex and can require the re-creation of issues in labs, analysis of logs, repair information, and interacting with development team. Once root cause is identified, proceduresare updated and training provided as mitigation.

Performing preventative maintenance of hardware, software, and networks.

This is accomplished via routine inspection, backup, physical maintenance, etc. We have setprocedures to calibrate systems, take measurements, verify operation, and check for redundancy. This is performed by telephone with "Smart Hands", remotely via computers,and in person.

Performance Trending and Analysis.

The networks maintained by the team are very complex. This results in a multitude of parameters, any of which can cause the performanceof the network, hub, or terminal to perform at sub optimal levels. This position is responsible for continuously trending the performance of the overall system and the individualhubs that comprise it. This is done using log files, historical cases, direct observation, test terminals, trending software, and dashboards.

Managing Network projects. Global Network Operations has numerous mid to long term initiatives underway at any given moment. The staff is assigned to a project, and theyare expected to champion that project from start to finish. This includes coordinating resources and staff both within the staff and external to it.

Documenting procedure creation, corrective actions, configurations, diagrams, etc.

The documentation consists of rouble tickets and logs, equipment configurations, wiringdiagrams, block and level diagrams, logic diagrams, rack elevation drawings, physical interconnection diagrams, backhaul circuit information, System Change Control, CorrectiveAction Reports. The documents are used within the team, other groups within ViaSat, and external partners and customers. Accuracy is vitally important as these are primedocuments used for troubleshooting issues. Ensuring that procedures are created and maintained is important to the scalability of the Services group.

What You'll Need

  • 4+ years' experience implementing, administering, and troubleshooting network infrastructure devices, including: firewalls, routers, switches, wireless access points and controllers, and monitoring applications
  • Demonstrated knowledge in configuration, installation, resolution and support of satellite earth station equipment and RF performance analysis
  • Proven experience deploying and administering virtual machines and hypervisors
  • Working knowledge of spectrum analyzer
  • Outstanding written and verbal communications skills
  • Ability to be on-call in a rotating schedule with a response time of less than one (1) hour
  • IAT Level II Certification within 90 days of hire.
  • Associates Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology or equivalent experience
  • US Government position; US Citizenship required
  • Active DoD Secret Clearance with ability to obtain Top Secret when administratively feasible
  • Ability to travel up to 30% both domestic and international


What Will Help You On The Job

  • Understanding of bandwidth traffic shaping protocols and implementation.
  • Hands-on technical experience working and troubleshooting with VPN technologies (IPSEC, SSL VPN), VRF, routing protocols (OSPF, EIGRP, BGP).
  • Experience with programming languages such as Python, Powershell, and SQL
  • Experience with automation tools such as Ansible
  • Active CCNA, Sec+, Net+ and/or A Certifications
  • Ability to work variable and/or extended hours, with teammates or alone.


Salary range

$121,000.00 - $191,000.00 / annually. For specific work locations within San Jose, the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, the base pay range for this role is $150,000.00- $225,000.00/ annually

At Viasat, we consider many factors when it comes to compensation, including the scope of the position as well as your background and experience. Base pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Additional cash or stock incentives may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position offered. Learn more about Viasat’s comprehensive benefit offerings that are focused on your holistic health and wellness at https://careers.viasat.com/benefits.

descriptionText:
About Us

At Viasat, the work you do helps people stay connected in ways that matter, from everyday moments to critical missions across air, land, sea, and space.

We’re a place for people who are curious, bold, and motivated by meaningful work. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, explore new possibilities, and grow your career in ways that align with your interests and goals. When you're ready to take on something new, you'll find leaders who support your development and help you turn your ambition into action.

What You'll Do

As a Network Engineer within Viasat Government, you will support a wide range of mission-critical programs and diverse service offerings by delivering optimal network performance, reliability, and customer experience. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, implement, troubleshoot, and optimize complex network solutions that enable secure and resilient communications for government customers around the globe.

The day-to-day

Troubleshooting and correcting complex failures of Hardware, Software, and Network systems.

Work is performed locally on site, via remote login, or via phone with "smarthands" located on site. Complexity is based on standard and non-standard configurations of both ViaSat and Customer owned equipment. Problems are on multiple platformsand include the integration between them. Changes to policy-based routing and in-depth understandings of abstract concepts and equipment interaction can be required. Workperformed is considered at an Advanced to Expert level in many disciplines including IP networking and Satcom/RF. Advising and supporting remote field service engineers atmanned locations. Aid customers and/or vendors to resolve issues with their equipment or networks to help restore our services.

Analyzing the root cause of failures.

In the process of fixing the problem, hardware or software may need to be replaced, upgraded, reconfigured, etc. Once service is restored, atrue root cause must be identified. Root cause is essential to understanding why something happened and how to mitigate it in the future. The analysis of root cause can becomplex and can require the re-creation of issues in labs, analysis of logs, repair information, and interacting with development team. Once root cause is identified, proceduresare updated and training provided as mitigation.

Performing preventative maintenance of hardware, software, and networks.

This is accomplished via routine inspection, backup, physical maintenance, etc. We have setprocedures to calibrate systems, take measurements, verify operation, and check for redundancy. This is performed by telephone with "Smart Hands", remotely via computers,and in person.

Performance Trending and Analysis.

The networks maintained by the team are very complex. This results in a multitude of parameters, any of which can cause the performanceof the network, hub, or terminal to perform at sub optimal levels. This position is responsible for continuously trending the performance of the overall system and the individualhubs that comprise it. This is done using log files, historical cases, direct observation, test terminals, trending software, and dashboards.

Managing Network projects. Global Network Operations has numerous mid to long term initiatives underway at any given moment. The staff is assigned to a project, and theyare expected to champion that project from start to finish. This includes coordinating resources and staff both within the staff and external to it.

Documenting procedure creation, corrective actions, configurations, diagrams, etc.

The documentation consists of rouble tickets and logs, equipment configurations, wiringdiagrams, block and level diagrams, logic diagrams, rack elevation drawings, physical interconnection diagrams, backhaul circuit information, System Change Control, CorrectiveAction Reports. The documents are used within the team, other groups within ViaSat, and external partners and customers. Accuracy is vitally important as these are primedocuments used for troubleshooting issues. Ensuring that procedures are created and maintained is important to the scalability of the Services group.

What You'll Need



- 4+ years' experience implementing, administering, and troubleshooting network infrastructure devices, including: firewalls, routers, switches, wireless access points and controllers, and monitoring applications
- Demonstrated knowledge in configuration, installation, resolution and support of satellite earth station equipment and RF performance analysis 
- Proven experience deploying and administering virtual machines and hypervisors
- Working knowledge of spectrum analyzer
- Outstanding written and verbal communications skills
- Ability to be on-call in a rotating schedule with a response time of less than one (1) hour
- IAT Level II Certification within 90 days of hire.
- Associates Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology or equivalent experience
- US Government position; US Citizenship required
- Active DoD Secret Clearance with ability to obtain Top Secret when administratively feasible
- Ability to travel up to 30% both domestic and international


What Will Help You On The Job



- Understanding of bandwidth traffic shaping protocols and implementation. 
- Hands-on technical experience working and troubleshooting with VPN technologies (IPSEC, SSL VPN), VRF, routing protocols (OSPF, EIGRP, BGP).
- Experience with programming languages such as Python, Powershell, and SQL
- Experience with automation tools such as Ansible
- Active CCNA, Sec+, Net+ and/or A Certifications
- Ability to work variable and/or extended hours, with teammates or alone.


 Salary range

$121,000.00 - $191,000.00 / annually. For specific work locations within San Jose, the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, the base pay range for this role is $150,000.00- $225,000.00/ annually

At Viasat, we consider many factors when it comes to compensation, including the scope of the position as well as your background and experience. Base pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Additional cash or stock incentives may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position offered.   • Expertise in VLAN, MLAG (Multi-Chassis Link Aggregation Group), LAG (Link Aggregation Group) configuration, and troubleshooting.

  • Strong understanding of Trunk/Access ports, their functions, and how to configure them for optimal performance in various network environments.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills; ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

  • Proficiency with network telemetry and analysis tools (Wireshark, SNMP, NetFlow, and Solarwinds) for deep packet inspection and network optimization.

  • Mentorship: As a Senior role, the ability to guide and mentor junior engineers, share knowledge, and foster best practices.
  • Proactive & Ownership: Proactive approach to identifying and addressing potential issues, with a strong sense of ownership over the platform.
  • Adaptability & Continuous Learning: Eagerness to learn new technologies and adapt to a rapidly evolving cloud-native landscape.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience deploying, managing, and monitoring a diverse ecosystem of networking technologies to guarantee maximum availability, performance, and security of the network.
  • Extensive hands-on experience configuring enterprise-grade core/edge routers, firewalls, and switches (Cisco, Juniper, and Arista).
  • Experience implementing secure WAN transport mechanisms such as IPSEC site-to-site VPNs, GRE/DMVPN tunnels, QoS traffic shaping, and ACL policies.
  • Candidates must be able to lift up to 25lbs.

We offer

  • A dynamic and collaborative working environment that fosters professional growth and development.
  • Opportunities for personal and technical skill enhancement through ongoing training and professional development opportunities.
  • A supportive and inclusive team culture that values diversity and encourages individual contributions.

If you are passionate about technical leadership and networking, have a strong technical background, and thrive in a collaborative environment, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

Job Description: Senior Network Engineer

Position Title: Senior Network Engineer

Department: Network Engineering

About The Role

We are seeking a Senior Network Engineer who brings deep technical expertise, sound operational judgment, and the ability to deliver reliable, scalable network services across multi-region and global environments, including regulated and compliant FedRAMP-authorized platforms. This role is primarily operations‑focused, encompassing ownership of day‑to‑day network reliability, performance, and incident response, while also incorporating engineering and build responsibilities as required - such as evolving routing architectures, developing and maintaining automation pipelines, troubleshooting complex network behaviors, and executing major initiatives across data centers and cloud platforms.

Beyond technical capability, we are looking for the right cultural fit: someone who embodies our core expectation to "be kind" - a teammate who collaborates openly, communicates respectfully, supports others, and contributes to a positive, inclusive engineering culture.

You will work closely with Architecture, Product, Security, Compliance, and Operations teams to ensure our global backbone, data center networks, cloud connectivity, and FedRAMP environments remain secure, resilient, automated, compliant, and well-documented. You will be empowered to own meaningful problems end-to-end, influence design patterns, and mentor engineers across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Network Design & Implementation

  • Engineer, build, operate, and deliver network solutions for global data centers, cloud platforms, FedRAMP-authorized environments, build environments, and product connectivity needs.
  • Engineer and optimize routing for a global IP backbone, including multi-region route propagation, redundancy, and traffic-engineering strategies.
  • Engineer, build, and operate scalable, highly available L3 topologies using BGP, OSPF, and robust routing policy (communities, AS-path manipulation, MED/local-pref tuning, ECMP, route-reflector hierarchy).
  • Design and implement secure network segmentation, boundary controls, and traffic isolation required for FedRAMP Moderate/High environments.
  • Implement hybrid and cloud-native routing across AWS/Azure/GCP using Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, VPN, Transit Gateway, Virtual WAN, and cloud router constructs - ensuring alignment with FedRAMP architectures and security control requirements.
  • Develop and maintain automated provisioning, configuration, compliance, and validation pipelines using Python, Ansible/AWX, and Git-driven CI/CD workflows, including FedRAMP configuration baselines.


Network Operations & Reliability

  • Ensure connectivity, availability, and performance across multi-region data centers, backbone sites, cloud platforms, and regulated FedRAMP environments using proactive monitoring, telemetry, and lifecycle management practices.
  • Operate networks in accordance with FedRAMP continuous monitoring requirements, including configuration drift detection, vulnerability mitigation, and audit readiness.
  • Troubleshoot complex routing, TCP, and connectivity issues using tools such as netcat, ping/ICMP, logs, and packet captures.
  • Lead or support major incident response when needed, including FedRAMP-relevant incident handling, escalation, and reporting procedures.
  • Execute changes, upgrades, and migrations safely using structured procedures (MOPs), documented approvals, automated workflows, and validated rollback mechanisms.
  • Remediate vulnerabilities and maintain compliance across network OS versions, configurations, firmware, and security posture in coordination with Security and Compliance teams.


Engineering, Build & Automation

  • Engineer enhancements, new capabilities, and service-driven connectivity features supporting product, platform evolution, and FedRAMP boundary services.
  • Design automation that enforces least privilege, segmentation, encryption-in-transit, logging, and configuration compliance for regulated environments.
  • Replace manual operational steps with automated workflows incorporating pre/post-checks, compliance gates, evidence collection, and safe-rollback logic.
  • Test new network OS versions, automation logic, routing changes, and security controls in controlled environments prior to production and FedRAMP deployment.
  • Partner with Build, Engineering, Architecture, Product, Security, and Compliance teams to ensure reliability, scalability, and alignment with FedRAMP control objectives.


Execution, Planning & Vendor Management

  • Translate product, regulatory, and platform requirements into network designs that meet FedRAMP architectural and security expectations with clear timelines and dependencies.
  • Conduct capacity planning across links, devices, cloud gateways, backbone segments, routing domains, and FedRAMP boundary components.
  • Manage procurement cycles, RMA workflows, vendor escalations, and equipment lifecycle, ensuring vendors and solutions support FedRAMP use cases.
  • Evaluate vendor technologies for performance, resiliency, automation compatibility, FedRAMP eligibility, and cost-effectiveness.


Documentation & Knowledge Management

  • Create and maintain high-quality runbooks, architectural diagrams, and troubleshooting guides, including FedRAMP boundary diagrams and network control documentation.
  • Maintain accurate documentation required for FedRAMP audits, assessments, and continuous monitoring activities.
  • Define lifecycle standards for network roles, routing constructs, appliances, and platform components.
  • Ensure monitoring, alerting, and operational procedures are documented, auditable, and continuously improved.
  • Mentor engineers through structured troubleshooting, technical deep dives, FedRAMP design considerations, and post-incident learning sessions.


Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • 10+ years in network engineering with experience in large-scale, multi-region, and global routing environments.
  • Experience engineering, operating, or supporting FedRAMP Moderate and/or High environments is strongly preferred.


Technical Skills

  • Deep hands-on expertise with BGP and OSPF in global IP backbone environments, including traffic engineering and multi-vendor interoperability.
  • Strong operational and engineering experience with JunOS (MX, QFX, SRX preferred).
  • Proficiency with additional network OS platforms (e.g., EOS, NX-OS, IOS-XE) is a plus.
  • Strong troubleshooting across routing, switching, TCP/IP, asymmetric paths, latency, packet loss, MTU/fragmentation, and QoS behaviors.
  • Experienced with hybrid cloud and cloud-native networking across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP.
  • Hands-on automation skills using Python, Ansible/AWX, configuration templating, Git workflows, and automated testing/validation pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of network security controls, boundary protection, encryption, logging, and segmentation concepts required for FedRAMP.
  • Familiarity with firewalls, VPNs, DDoS mitigation, IDS/IPS, and NIST 800-53-based security frameworks.


Soft Skills

  • Strong incident leadership skills, able to coordinate cross-functional teams under pressure.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication across Architecture, Product, Security, Compliance, Operations, and Build teams.
  • Ability to mentor and elevate peers and junior engineers.
  • Effective in fast-paced environments with competing priorities and regulatory constraints.
  • Strong analytical thinking, structured problem-solving, and continuous-improvement mindset.
  • Reinforces a positive culture and demonstrates our expectation to "be kind."

descriptionHtml:
At H&P, our people are our strength.

Since 1920, Helmerich and Payne has been the industry’s most trusted partner in drilling productivity and reliability. As the world changes, so does our approach. We are changing the landscape of drilling by using cutting-edge rig technologies and drilling solutions to build upon a century of success, all while continuing to deliver better outcomes for our customers.

At H&P, our people are our strength. We strive to continually lead with our Core Values that enable employees to develop on their H&P Journey. We believe that doing the right thing means creating a more diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace that empowers our people to bring their authentic selves to work every day.

Some companies offer career paths. We offer a Journey of a Lifetime. Let's go far, together.

Hear directly from our employees, and leaders about their unique journeys at Helmerich and Payne.

At a Glance

This is a senior, hands-on engineering role critical to the implementation, operation, and optimization of our global network infrastructure. The Principal Network Engineer will design and support enterprise global networks across complex hybrid environments. The ideal candidate will combine deep technical expertise with a strict adherence to IT governance, ensuring all network architecture aligns with industry standards, security frameworks, and business objectives. You will serve as a technical authority within a collaborative network team responsible for maintaining large-scale enterprise platforms, with a paramount focus on ensuring rig connectivity and continuity of drilling operations globally.

Location: Tulsa, OK

Work Type: On-Site

  • Site

What You Will Do

  • Architectural Design & Implementation: Design, configure, and maintain enterprise-grade network infrastructure (Cisco, Aruba, Meraki, and F5 platforms) across global data centers, cloud environments, and remote operating sites in strict adherence to approved design standards.
  • Operational Excellence & Optimization: Ensure high availability, redundancy, and performance through proactive capacity planning and monitoring. Oversee complex hybrid WAN architectures, including MPLS, SDWAN, DIA, and LEO Satellite, optimizing traffic flow while maintaining security policies.
  • Governance, Security & Compliance: Drive network security posture through macro/micro-segmentation, Zero Trust Network Architecture (ZTNA), and regular compliance audits. Manage incident response protocols and ensure network modifications strictly follow formal IT change management processes.
  • Documentation & Standardization: Responsible for precise, comprehensive documentation of network topologies, configurations, disaster recovery plans, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Champion the adoption of best practices and standardization across the networking team.
  • Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Lead the technical execution of cross-functional infrastructure projects and data center migrations. Mentor peers and junior engineers, conducting structured technical reviews to ensure architectural integrity and professional development.
  • Strategic Evaluation: Systematically evaluate emerging technologies, perform risk assessments, understands ROI and fiscal responsibilities, and present formal business cases and solution proposals to IT leadership to improve network scalability and security.

What You Need

  • Experience: 10+ years of progressive enterprise networking experience within highly regulated environments, including at least 10 years serving in a Lead Network Engineer capacity required
  • Education & Certifications: Active Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) certification is required.
  • Not a must, but a plus:
    • Additional experience in energy sectors and experience with IT/OT networking a plus.
    • CCIE a plus.
    • Degree in MIS, Computer Science, or similar a plus.
    • Cloud certifications in Azure, GCP, or AWS a plus.
  • Routing & Switching Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in Cisco technologies, specifically Cisco ACI. Deep understanding of dynamic routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP), route redistribution, policy-based routing, and BGP peering in hybrid cloud environments.
  • SD-WAN & Wireless: 5+ years of hands-on operational experience with Aruba and Meraki solutions (including Aruba SD-WAN and Meraki Wireless). Deep understanding of SDWAN with experience in Juniper SDWAN and Aruba SDWAN a plus.
  • Application Delivery: Proven expertise in designing, configuring, and operating F5 load balancing platforms.
  • Security & Identity Integration: Extensive experience with AAA services (RADIUS, TACACS+) and seamless integration with identity platforms such as Cisco ISE or Azure AD. Strong understanding of Internet edge design, BGP multihoming, cloud-based firewalls, and DDoS mitigation.
  • Core Network Services & Connectivity: Deep understanding of heavy-duty Ethernet technologies (1/10/40/100GbE, VLANs, VXLAN, 802.1Q trunking) and foundational enterprise services including DNS, DHCP, NTP, and IPAM platforms (e.g., Infoblox).
  • Diagnostic Expertise: Advanced proficiency in network packet analysis and performance diagnostics using enterprise tools such as Wireshark, LiveAction, and Cisco Stealthwatch.
  • Automation (Preferred): Experience applying infrastructure-as-code principles and utilizing scripting tools (Python, Ansible, Terraform) to standardize deployments and automate routine network operations.
  • Zero Trust and Purdue Model: In-depth knowledge of the Purdue model and other Zero Trust best practices
What You Will Bring To The Team

  • Analytical Problem Solving: Approaches complex network anomalies using a logical, methodical sequence. Identifies root causes accurately and mitigates risks while anticipating the long-term implications of technical decisions.
  • Process & Detail Orientation: Highly conscientious regarding technical accuracy and documentation. Focuses on delivering complete, high-quality work that aligns with organizational goals and compliance requirements.
  • Change & Risk Management: Adapts professionally to operational shifts. Manages uncertainty effectively and proactively prepares contingency plans for critical infrastructure systems.
  • Executive Communication: Communicates highly technical concepts clearly and accurately, both orally and in writing, to a variety of stakeholders. Capable of preparing, leading, and following up on structured business meetings to ensure strategic outcomes are met.
  • P1/P2 and on-call expectations: This position is expected to lead P1 and P2 level outage incidents and be on call for those outages to lead the troubleshooting and restoration of services to ensure timely resolution, root cause analysis, and corrective actions for future prevention.
  • Accountability and Excellence: This position should model the highest levels of accountability and excellence within the team, showcasing a strong work ethic and a focus on doing what’s right while pushing forward through iterative improvements.
  • Hybrid office & Global expectations: This position is expected to work closely with a global team through virtual collaboration as well as being a hybrid employee. The expectation is that this position will be in the Tulsa office on a hybrid schedule subject to manager discretion and could change over time.
    • Travel will be minimal but could involve regional & global travel up to 10%.
  • Vendor Relationship: This position is expected to maintain strong vendor relationships with the network vendors and OEM’s to ensure lifecycle management, fiscal insight, and support models through healthy customer-vendor relations including recurring check-ins, business reviews, etc.
What We Offer

At H&P, our commitment to our people is at the forefront, and that includes benefits that provide employees a sense of health and financial security. We know that life continues outside of employment and actively caring of our people is our priority.

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
  • Flexible Spending or Health Savings Accounts
  • 401k match Paid
  • Leave Plans
  • Parental & Adoption Benefits
  • Disability Coverage
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Educational Assistance
  • Learning & Development Opportunities
  • Flex-scheduling available for qualifying positions to achieve work-life integration

The job level and associated compensation for this position will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and alignment with the role’s requirements. Final compensation for this role may vary depending on individual factors.

H&P is committed to employing a diverse workforce. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

Thank you for your interest in joining our team!

Sapient Logic has a career opening for a Senior-level Network Engineer to support the Joint Fires Network (JFN) program in San Diego, CA. At Sapient Logic, we welcome individuals who are open minded, think “outside the box”, and are eager to explore new challenges.

descriptionHtml:
About NCR VOYIX

NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a global platform-powered leader in unified commerce for shopping and dining. Combining a flexible, intelligent platform with end-to-end payments capabilities and services developed through its deep industry experience, NCR Voyix empowers retailers and restaurants to accelerate new possibilities for their operations, experiences and business outcomes. NCR Voyix is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and serves customers in more than 35 countries worldwide.

Job Summary Designs and implements network solutions for moderately complex environments, including LAN/WAN configurations, firewalls, and routing protocols. Leads troubleshooting efforts and contributes to network optimization and documentation. Job Responsibilities

  • Design, configure, and troubleshoot complex network environments, including LAN, WAN, WLAN, and data center networks.
  • Implement and manage network security solutions, including firewalls, VPNs, and intrusion detection/prevention systems.
  • Develop and maintain network documentation, including network diagrams, configurations, and operational procedures.
  • Monitor network performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement solutions to optimize network efficiency and reliability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support application deployment, infrastructure projects, and system integrations.
  • Participate in on-call rotation for critical network incidents and provide timely resolution.
  • Evaluate new network technologies and recommend solutions to enhance network capabilities and security posture.
  • Mentor junior network engineers and contribute to their professional development.
  • Adhere to ITIL best practices for incident, problem, and change management processes. Job Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field; or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4+ years of experience in the role or a related field.
  • Expert-level knowledge of networking protocols and technologies (TCP/IP, OSPF, BGP, MPLS, VPNs, VLANs, QoS, etc.).
  • Extensive experience with Cisco networking equipment (routers, switches, firewalls – Catalyst, Nexus, ASA).
  • Proven experience with network security principles and technologies (e.g., Palo Alto, Checkpoint, Fortinet).
  • Hands-on experience with network monitoring tools (e.g., SolarWinds, PRTG, Splunk).
  • Scripting and automation experience (e.g., Python, Ansible) is a plus.
  • Industry certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, or equivalent are highly desirable.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to diagnose and resolve complex network issues.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment. This job description outlines the primary duties and responsibilities of the role and is not intended to be exhaustive. descriptionHtml:
MicroVision in Orlando, Florida seeks an experienced Network Engineer for our global IT team to design, manage, and optimize our enterprise network infrastructure, ensuring a secure, scalable, and highly available network environment while supporting strategic infrastructure initiatives across the organization.

Who we are

MicroVision is a leader in advanced lidar and perception technologies, developing innovative solutions for automotive, industrial, and defense applications. Our team combines deep expertise in sensors, software, and intelligent systems to create technology that advances safety, autonomy, and operational performance. We foster a collaborative, innovative environment where talented professionals have the opportunity to solve complex challenges and help shape the future of intelligent mobility and automation.

What we need

You are a highly collaborative professional who combines deep technical expertise with strong business acumen and communication skills. You understand that network infrastructure is more than technology; it is a critical enabler of business operations, security, scalability, and organizational success. Building strong partnerships across departments, communicating complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and approaching challenges with a customer-service mindset is just how you operate. You thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment because you have exceptional analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to manage competing priorities. You are proactive, solutions-oriented, and able to balance operational priorities with long-term strategic objectives.

In this role, you will

  • Design, implement, and support enterprise LAN, WAN, wireless, and SD-WAN environments
  • Develop and execute network infrastructure strategies that align with business objectives
  • Deploy, configure, and maintain Cisco Meraki, Cisco Catalyst, and Cisco Nexus platforms
  • Lead network modernization, upgrade, and security enhancement projects
  • Monitor network performance, availability, and capacity; recommend and implement improvements
  • Troubleshoot complex networking issues involving routing, switching, wireless connectivity, VPNs, and remote access
  • Configure and maintain secure VPN and firewall solutions
  • Manage ISP relationships, telecommunications services, and network vendors
  • Maintain accurate network documentation, standards, and operational procedures
  • Partner with IT and business stakeholders to support infrastructure and operational needs
  • Provide after-hours support for planned maintenance and critical incidents as needed


To be successful in this role requires

  • A bachelor’s degree in a technical field or equivalent experience/certifications
  • 7+ years of experience supporting and administering enterprise network environments
  • Advanced experience with Cisco Meraki switches, wireless access points, and security appliances
  • Demonstrated experience with Cisco Nexus and Cisco Catalyst platforms
  • Expertise in enterprise routing and switching technologies
  • Experience designing and supporting SD-WAN and multi-site network architectures
  • Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, SSL/TLS, SSH, NFS, and CIFS
  • Experience managing ISP circuits and vendor relationships
  • Expertise in VPN technologies, firewall administration, and network security best practices
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and documentation skills
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively across teams
  • Ability to lift and transport networking equipment up to 50 pounds when required


Even better if you have

  • CCNP, CCIE, or comparable networking certification
  • Experience with Fortinet firewalls and advanced security solutions
  • Hands-on experience with Palo Alto firewalls
  • Experience supporting Azure networking environments
  • Knowledge of network monitoring, automation, and infrastructure management tools
  • Familiarity with encryption technologies and secure data transmission practices


What we offer

At MicroVision, you'll have the opportunity to work alongside talented professionals, contribute to innovative technology, and grow your career in an environment that values curiosity, accountability, and teamwork. We offer a competitive pay and a benefits package designed to support employees and their families (more detail here)

MicroVision participates in E-Verify. Upon hire, all employees are required to complete the Form I-9 employment eligibility verification process and provide documentation demonstrating authorization to work in the United States.

MicroVision is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. MicroVision is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, creed, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, status as a disabled veteran or Vietnam-era veteran or any other basis prohibited by local, state or federal law. Who is Swire Coca-Cola? We are a family-owned bottling company with a story spanning over two centuries. We are one of the largest bottlers of Coca-Cola in North America and distribute more than 50 beverage brands and flavors creating joy for our customers every day. Our 8,000+ driven employees work hard as part of a team that delivers refreshment to over 30 million consumers across 13 states. Begin a journey with us at Swire Coca-Cola and belong to a community of dedicated team members who think big and believe in winning together.

Job Details:

Job Level:

Why you’ll love working at Swire Coca-Cola:

Swire Coca-Cola is committed to providing balance to support you in all aspects of your life, both at work and beyond. We offer the benefits you need for physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

  • Health coverage (3 medical options, dental and vision). 401(k) Retirement Plan w/company match
  • Health Savings Accounts w/company match
  • FREE virtual primary care, acute care and physical therapy
  • FREE Employee Assistance Program
  • Company paid (vacation, holidays, sick time, bereavement, jury duty, maternity/parental, disability leave and volunteer time)

In addition to health benefits, Swire Coca-Cola is proud to offer you opportunities where you help give back directly to the communities and causes you care about. Note: Enrollment in a Swire Medical Plan is required for some benefits.

What does a Senior Network Engineer do at Swire Coca-Cola?

The Senior Network Engineer at Swire Coca-Cola is responsible for implementing, managing, and optimizing a complex, multi-state network infrastructure that supports thousands of users across our enterprise. This role is critical in designing and maintaining secure, high-performing local, wireless, and wide-area networks, ensuring maximum uptime and reliability. You’ll leverage your expertise in TCP/IP network functionality, VoIP systems (Cisco CUCM), SD-WAN, and Conditional Access technologies to shape scalable solutions that drive business continuity. Beyond technical excellence, you’ll prioritize and process work requests and escalations efficiently, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on problem solving. If you’re passionate about building resilient networks and influencing the architecture of a growing organization, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.

Responsibilities:

  • Establish the networking environment by designing system configuration, directing system installation and defining, documenting and enforcing system standards
  • Design and implement new solutions and improve resilience of the current environment. Provides all required network support for switches and routers including configuring, troubleshooting and maintaining network devices, software and protocols
  • Maximize network performance by monitoring performance, troubleshooting network problems and outages, scheduling upgrades and collaborating with internal and external partners on network optimization. Technical support and troubleshooting of Voice over IP (VoIP) systems and all network connectivity
  • Provide support for wireless communication devices including, but not limited to, wireless access points, laptops, handhelds, voice pick phones, printers, and warehouse devices
  • Secure all network systems by collaborating with the internal and/or external security teams to establish and enforce policies and monitor access, including timely upgrading of software and firmware on all network devices
  • Maintains a current and accurate inventory of all network devices under their responsibility
  • Order and distribute equipment to sites as necessary
  • Maintains accurate and current documentation on process, procedure, and infrastructure
  • Processes and prioritizes work requests and escalations in a timely and efficient manner

Requirements:

  • Bachelor Degree Information Systems, Computer Science, related discipline required
  • 5+ years’ work related networking experience required
  • 1+ year's of OT (Operational Technology) experience in a manufacturing environment required
  • 1+ year’s experience in network security preferred
  • CCNA and/or related networking certifications preferred
  • Experience with network firewall, routers, switches, wireless and other devices (preferably Cisco)
  • Experience with DOT1x preferred
  • Experience with layer 1, 2 and 3 of OSI Model

Come and join our Sparkling team!

Due to the nature of our work and to help maintain a safe workplace for our employees and customers, after a candidate receives a conditional offer of employment, they will be required to complete pre-employment screening. This includes a criminal background check, drug screening, and for certain roles, a motor vehicle record review.

Screening results are evaluated based on several factors, including the nature and severity of an offense, how much time has passed, the relevance to the position, patterns of repeated offenses, and driving history for roles that require operating a vehicle.

All results are reviewed fairly and in accordance with applicable state and federal laws, including the Fair Credit Reporting Act.

Swire Coca-Cola is an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer that participates in the E-Verify program as required by law. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, Veteran status or other legally protected characteristics. Swire Coca-Cola does not sponsor applicants for work visas.

Position Description

Western & Southern Financial Group has an immediate opportunity for a Cisco Network Engineer.


Summary of Responsibilities:

Responsible for the design, installation, maintenance, and support of Western & Southern Financial Group’s (W&SFG) network infrastructure. Works with minimal supervision and is responsible to make an established range of decisions, escalates to manager when necessary and updates manager on a regular basis.


Position Responsibilities:

  • Designs, installs, maintains, and supports a large enterprise network infrastructure.
  • Architects and engineers next generation networking solutions.
  • Analyzes network performance data and statistics, prepares reports and recommends changes and improvements to ensure performance and availability objectives.
  • Stays current with network trends to support new applications, incorporating industry standards and best practices.
  • Interfaces with vendor support service groups for contract renewals and to ensure proper escalation during outages or periods of degraded system performance.
  • Participates in the implementation of disaster recovery solutions and the execution of periodic disaster recovery tests.
  • Provides training and mentoring to other staff on technical topics and network design.
  • Performs Tier 3 support for the network infrastructure when problems or issues cannot be resolved by Help Desk or Tier 2 support staff.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by management.

Selection Criteria:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, ability to grasp new concepts and apply them.
  • Ability to work under multiple deadlines and minimal supervision.
  • Demonstrated ability to understand and analyze customer requirements and provide appropriate solutions.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.
  • Demonstrated calm and professional demeanor when handling demanding situations.
  • Proven experience in completing assigned tasks accurately and on a timely basis. Cite examples of project management experience in planning, executing and maintaining a project from start to finish.

Educational Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or commensurate selection criteria experience.

Desired Skills & Experience:

  • Proven experience supporting a large enterprise network infrastructure that includes Cisco Catalyst and Nexus platforms.
  • Proven experience installing, configuring, and troubleshooting VPN or SASE services is a plus.
  • Proven experience installing, configuring, and troubleshooting firewalls. Check Point experience is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of Software Defined Networking and/or supporting Cloud environments is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of Cisco Catalyst Center is a plus.
  • Proven experience with Cisco security products such as Identity Services Engine (ISE) is a plus.
  • Proven experience with Juniper Mist wireless technologies is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of network flow analysis tools.
  • Strong understanding of network routing protocols: OSPF, BGP, EIGRP, OMP, and/or MPLS.
  • Understanding of VMware vCenter, ESXi 7.x, and Cisco Unified Computing Systems (UCS) is a plus.


Certifications & licenses:

  • Cisco CCNA or CCNP certification desirable.

Position Demands:

  • Extended hours required during peak workloads or special projects and off-hour support
  • Handle problems, installations, calls, etc., off-hours as required either remotely or by returning to work
  • Some travel required on an as needed basis (less than 10%) to support remote sites as well as training and/or technology conferences for skill building and industry knowledge

Network Engineer

Build and optimize the networks that keep world-class aviation connectivity running.

At Gogo, connectivity is more than technology. It's how pilots, passengers, and flight departments stay connected to the people, systems, and information they rely on every day. As a leader in business aviation connectivity, Gogo delivers advanced networking solutions that keep aircraft connected across North America and beyond.

As our Network Engineer, you'll play a critical role in designing, implementing, maintaining, and optimizing the network infrastructure that powers Gogo's products and services. You'll work closely with Network Operations, Engineering, Security, Cloud, and Product teams to ensure our networks remain reliable, scalable, secure, and ready to support the next generation of connected aviation.

If you're someone who thrives in fast-paced technical environments, enjoys solving complex networking challenges, and is passionate about delivering highly available systems, we'd love to meet you.

What You'll Do

  • Design, implement, and support enterprise and service provider network infrastructure to ensure high availability and performance.
  • Configure, monitor, and troubleshoot LAN, WAN, wireless, routing, and switching environments.
  • Partner with Network Operations, Security, Cloud, and Engineering teams to deliver reliable and scalable network solutions.
  • Lead and support network upgrades, migrations, and infrastructure modernization initiatives.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex network performance, availability, and connectivity issues.
  • Develop and maintain network documentation, diagrams, standards, and operational procedures.
  • Identify opportunities to automate network administration, monitoring, and deployment processes.
  • Contribute to capacity planning, disaster recovery, cybersecurity initiatives, and continuous improvement efforts.
  • Participate in on-call support and incident management activities as required.
  • Ensure network environments meet performance, security, and compliance requirements.

What You'll Bring

  • This is a hybrid position based in our Broomfield or Chicago office. Team members are expected to work onsite three days per week and remotely two days per week.
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Network Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in network engineering, network administration, or a related infrastructure role.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and troubleshooting complex network environments.
  • Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP), and switching technologies.
  • Experience with enterprise networking equipment from vendors such as Cisco, Juniper, Arista, or similar.

descriptionHtml:
When you join the growing BILH team, you're not just taking a job, you’re making a difference in people’s lives.

This key contributor role will work as part of a regional team to support and maintain the network

services assigned to their region. These services include but are not limited to routers, switches, DNS/DHCP, wireless,

and Radius/TACACS. Each region will assigned specific hospitals and remote offices to support.

Job Description

Essential Duties & Responsibilities including but not limited to:

  • Install, configure, and support of layer 2 and layer 3 routers, switches.
  • Install, configure, and support of wireless controllers and access points.
  • Install, configure, and support of appliances dealing with DHCP and DNS services.
  • Install, configure, and support of racked based uninterrupted power supplies.
  • Install, configure, and support of Radius and TACACS servers.
  • Assist with network design as requested.
  • Assist with mentoring Network Engineers.
  • Providing exceptional customer service for services supported by the Networking department.
  • Creating and maintaining network documentation, including network diagrams.
  • Updates databases for items such as equipment inventory, circuit ids, pictures and IP addressing.
  • Upgrade all network equipment operating systems for security and increased functionality.
  • Monitor all equipment and data circuits assigned to the region.
  • Will be part of a second level rotating on-call system to provide off hours support to Network Engineers on weekends and evenings (required to carry a pager and be reachable by cellphone).
  • Assist other network regions as required.

Education

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High School diploma or GED required.

Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years supporting and configuring Cisco network equipment running at layer 2 and 3
  • Minimum of 3 years supporting routing protocols, including OSPF and EIGRP

Skills, Knowledge & Abilities

  • Experience support Wireless LAN Controllers and Access Point, running 802.1X.
  • Experience in network design

Preferred Qualifications & Skills

  • Experience supporting Brocade network equipment.
  • Experience with Ekahau Pro for wireless planning and support

Pay Range

$120,000.00 USD - $145,000.00 USD

The pay range listed for this position is the annual base salary range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at this time. Actual compensation is determined based on several factors, that may include seniority, education, training, relevant experience, relevant certifications, geography of work location, job responsibilities, or other applicable factors permissible by law.

More than 35,000 people working together. Nurses, doctors, technicians, therapists, researchers, teachers and more, making a difference in patients' lives. Your skill and compassion can make us even stronger.

Job Description

Why GMF Technology?

Innovation isn’t just a talking point at GM Financial, it’s how we operate. From generative AI and cloud-native technologies to peer-led learning and hackathons, our tech teams are building real solutions that make a difference. We’re committed to AI-powered transformation, using advanced machine learning and automation to help us reimagine customer interactions and modernize operations, positioning GM Financial as a leader in digital innovation within a dynamic industry.

Join us and discover a workplace where your ideas matter, your development is prioritized, and you can truly make a global impact.

This position will be posted until filled.

Responsibilities

About the Role

The Global Network Engineer III, under the general direction of the Manager, will assist in the day-to-day tasks critical to the team's success. This individual is responsible for providing assistance and technical support for moderately complex network analysis and design activities. The Global Network Engineer III assists in the review/assessment of user needs and may conduct feasibility studies for projects and may assist in the evaluation and selection of equipment.

This team member is responsible primarily for the assessment and optimization of Network and Communication platforms through review and assessment of customer needs. They are also responsible for developing requests for proposal, evaluating vendor products, and making recommendations on selection. This team member may function in a lead position providing guidance, direction and training to less experienced engineers. Timely completing company training, this individual will become thoroughly familiar with all compliance, regulatory and security requirements adhering to all corporate policies and standards. Additionally, the engineers will focus on sustainability and improvement of processes, along with task automation to improve process efficiency.

In This Role You Will

  • ﻿Serve as Global Network Engineer III for the multi-disciplinary project teams they are assigned
  • Evaluate, review and if appropriate, implement recommendations for improvements to existing network procedures and documentation for efficient and cost effective delivery of highly available network services
  • Provide third tier technical support to GM Financial and its other information technology teams to resolve network issues and to support the implementation of new network solutions
  • Follow established change procedures to implement network maintenance, upgrades and changes
  • Author policy, procedure and standards documents based on industry best practices and personal research and experience
  • Lead development, testing, documentation, and QA functions to ensure that projects are securely delivered and fulfill expectations
  • Provide recommendations to management team to increase effectiveness of organization and technology solutions
  • Participate in company provided training and perform independent training as appropriate
  • Participate in an on-call support rotation for providing after-hours support
  • Resolve incident management tickets as they arise and ensure timely resolution
  • Collaborates with external and internal customers to analyze information needs and functional requirements and deliver the artifacts as needed
  • Uses a broad and deep understanding of technical concepts in multiple specialized fields to develop solutions to problems and critical design issues

Qualifications

Knowledge and Skills

  • ﻿Must have proven expert level knowledge in at least two of the following areas
  • Major routing protocols EIGRP, OSFP, BGP. This includes advanced routing techniques such as Policy Based Routing, VRF, and QoS
  • Campus network switching design and configuration including FHRPs, VSS, vPC, VTP, Multicast, and Spanning Tree
  • SD-WAN (Viptela/Cisco preferred)
  • SDN configuration, troubleshooting, and design (Cisco ACI preferred)
  • Network automation tools Ansible, Terraform, and RestAPI
  • Network Access Control using Cisco ISE, 802.1X, AAA, and ACS
  • Advanced skill in architectural design, installation, maintenance of Cisco network infrastructure within an organization
  • Experience with current networking best practices in IT standards and principles
  • Experience with packet capture, e.g., Wireshark and log analysis products
  • Experience with network monitoring tools, e.g. NetMRI, LiveNX and NNMi
  • Experience with IP Management/DHCP tools
  • Excellent technical documentation skills
  • Knowledge and understanding of industry trends and new technologies and ability to apply this to day-to-day work activities
  • Knowledge of enterprise platforms and operating systems as well as knowledge of key business functions and processes
  • Ability to balance priorities in order to meet multiple requirements and deadlines while ensuring priority objectives receive proper emphasis
  • Partner with customers to provide value and meet customer goals

AI Skills Preferred

  • Experience with AI assisted software development or automation
  • Knowledge of prompting techniques to improve output quality
  • Awareness of emerging GenAI capabilities and limitations

Experience & Education

  • 7-10 years of experience in Network Engineering and Design preferred
  • High School Diploma or equivalent required
  • Bachelor’s Degree in related field or equivalent work experience preferred

What We Offer: Generous benefits package available on day one to include: 401K matching, bonding leave for new parents (12 weeks, 100% paid), tuition assistance, training, GM employee auto discount, community service pay and nine company holidays.

Our Culture: Our team members define and shape our culture — an environment that welcomes innovative ideas, fosters integrity, and creates a sense of community and belonging. Here we do more than work — we thrive.

Compensation: Competitive pay and bonus eligibility.

Work Life Balance: Flexible hybrid work environment, 3 days a week (Tuesday/Wednesday/Thursday)

NOTE: We are unable to consider candidates who require visa sponsorship for this position

This position is not open to agency submissions

descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Sauron protects your family and home, bringing the innovations of autonomous robots and self-driving cars to residential security. Our team is led by veteran operators and engineers, alumni of Sonos, Paypal, Tesla, Apple, and Google. Sauron has raised an $27M seed round led by A* and Atomic with participation from other leading venture capital firms.

About The Role - Network Engineer

Sauron is looking for a mid-level Network Engineer to own the design, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing management of our network infrastructure across both customer environments and corporate offices.

This person will be responsible for building and maintaining the networks that power our residential security deployments, ensuring reliable connectivity across autonomous devices, edge infrastructure, and operational systems. They will also own the network infrastructure supporting our corporate offices.

This is a hands-on role for an engineer who enjoys working across architecture and implementation, can troubleshoot complex networking issues, and takes ownership of infrastructure from initial setup through ongoing operations.

What You'll Do

Client Network Architecture & Deployment

  • Design, configure, and deploy network infrastructure across Sauron's residential customer environments, owning the process from initial site assessment through installation and ongoing maintenance.
  • Configure and manage routers, switches, firewalls, wireless access points, VLANs, and other networking equipment.
  • Ensure reliable connectivity between autonomous devices, edge infrastructure, sensors, cameras, and cloud-based systems.
  • Develop repeatable network architectures and deployment standards that can scale across customer installations.
  • Troubleshoot field connectivity issues and partner with hardware, software, and security operations teams to resolve them.

Network Monitoring, Security & Reliability

  • Own monitoring and visibility across deployed customer networks, proactively identifying issues before they impact service.
  • Implement monitoring, alerting, and diagnostic tools to track uptime, latency, bandwidth, packet loss, and network health.
  • Design secure network architectures using segmentation, firewall policies, VPNs, access controls, and secure remote access.
  • Establish incident response, root-cause analysis, and network recovery processes.
  • Maintain network documentation and continuously improve infrastructure performance, reliability, and security.

Corporate Network & Infrastructure Operations

  • Own network infrastructure across Sauron's corporate offices, including Wi-Fi, switches, routers, firewalls, VPNs, and internet connectivity.
  • Manage office network deployments, expansions, employee connectivity, and ongoing troubleshooting.
  • Oversee relationships with internet service providers, networking vendors, and external IT partners.
  • Build repeatable processes and tooling for network provisioning, configuration management, and infrastructure documentation.
  • Identify opportunities to automate network monitoring, configuration, and troubleshooting as the company scales.

What We're Looking For

  • 3–6+ years of experience in network engineering, infrastructure engineering, or network operations.
  • Hands-on experience designing, deploying, and maintaining enterprise or distributed network environments.
  • Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, switching, subnetting, and wireless networking.
  • Experience configuring firewalls, VPNs, access points, and network security policies.
  • Experience with network monitoring, observability, and troubleshooting connectivity and performance issues.
  • Comfortable with physical network installation, hardware configuration, and troubleshooting in the field.
  • Experience supporting corporate IT infrastructure and managing office network environments.
  • Strong understanding of network segmentation, secure device connectivity, and access control.
  • Ability to independently own infrastructure problems from diagnosis through resolution and work cross-functionally with software, hardware, and operations teams.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Ubiquiti / UniFi or similar PoE equipment
  • Experience supporting IoT, robotics, smart home, edge computing, or connected-device environments.
  • Familiarity with Linux networking, cloud networking (AWS/GCP/Azure), and infrastructure automation.
  • Experience managing networks across multiple physical locations.
  • Experience in environments where network uptime directly impacts customer-facing products or services.
  • Experience with tools like Ansible

What Success Looks Like

  • First 90 Days: Take ownership of existing network infrastructure, establish visibility into customer and corporate networks, and identify reliability, security, and architecture gaps.
  • First 6 Months: Own network deployments for new customer installations, implement consistent monitoring and troubleshooting processes, and improve network reliability and standardization.
  • First 12 Months: Establish a scalable network architecture and deployment framework that supports customer growth while maintaining reliable, secure infrastructure across customer environments and corporate offices.

Compensation

The base pay range for this role is $160,000 – $190,000 per year.
