We are looking for an experienced Senior IT Network Engineer to own and support Spire’s corporate and back-office network environment.

Reporting to the Global IT Director, this is a hands-on role with primary responsibility for the design, implementation, operation, reliability, and lifecycle management of the corporate network. You will own the networking that supports Spire’s offices, remote users, corporate services, and back-office systems, while working closely with Security, Infrastructure, Facilities, and other technical teams.

The role includes responsibility for corporate routing, firewalls, VPN and remote access, office-to-office connectivity, DNS, wireless networking, network authentication, and related network infrastructure. You will also help modernize legacy and bespoke network services, improve resiliency, and reduce operational dependency on individual subject-matter experts.

We are looking for someone who is proactive, self-directed, and comfortable owning complex technical problems from architecture through implementation and ongoing operation. The right person will combine strong network-engineering fundamentals with disciplined operational practices, including documentation, change management, monitoring, lifecycle management, and follow-through.

Role & Responsibilities

  • Own the architecture, implementation, operation, and reliability of Spire’s corporate and back-office network environment.
  • Design, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot corporate routing, switching, wired and wireless networking, firewalls, VPNs, and office-to-office connectivity.
  • Own the corporate remote-access environment, including VPN architecture, operation, authentication integration, user connectivity, and troubleshooting.
  • Manage corporate firewall platforms and policies in partnership with Security, including implementation, rule changes, lifecycle management, and troubleshooting.
  • Design and maintain network segmentation and routing between corporate offices, corporate cloud services, remote-access environments, and approved external connections.
  • Own corporate DNS operations and related network services supporting identity, email, SaaS, endpoints, and other business systems.
  • Manage office-to-office and corporate site-to-site VPN connectivity, including IPsec tunnels and related routing.
  • Support corporate cloud networking for IT-owned systems and services, including routing, connectivity, security controls, and integration with office and remote-access networks.
  • Maintain and improve corporate wireless networking and network-authentication services.
  • Serve as the senior technical escalation point for complex corporate network outages and connectivity issues.
  • Troubleshoot difficult problems involving routing, VPNs, firewalls, DNS, authentication, certificates, wireless networking, cloud connectivity, and interdependent network services.
  • Partner closely with Security on network-security architecture, firewall policy, segmentation, secure-access requirements, PKI, and other security controls.
  • Partner with Infrastructure and Engineering teams on connectivity between corporate and engineering environments, ensuring secure, reliable, and well-defined network boundaries.
  • Maintain accurate network diagrams, configurations, IP addressing, circuit information, operating procedures, and recovery documentation.
  • Develop and maintain scripts, infrastructure-as-code, and automation used to deploy, configure, monitor, or manage corporate network services.
  • Implement and maintain monitoring and alerting to identify network availability, reliability, capacity, and performance issues.
  • Plan and execute network hardware, software, certificate, circuit, and service lifecycle activities.
  • Support office openings, moves, expansions, consolidations, closures, and network infrastructure changes in partnership with End User Technology, Facilities, carriers, and vendors.
  • Manage or coordinate ISP, carrier, circuit, and network-vendor relationships where required.
  • Follow disciplined change-management practices, including planning, peer review, testing, documentation, rollback planning, and post-change validation.
  • Proactively identify architectural, reliability, lifecycle, capacity, and operational risks and drive them through resolution.
  • Participate in after-hours escalation or on-call support for critical corporate network incidents when required.
  • Contribute to broader IT initiatives involving infrastructure modernization, reliability, automation, cloud services, workplace technology, and security.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in network engineering, network operations, infrastructure engineering, or a similar hands-on technical role.
  • Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, NAT, VPNs, firewalls, VLANs, and network segmentation.
  • Hands-on experience designing, operating, and troubleshooting enterprise routing and switching environments.
  • Experience administering enterprise firewall platforms and implementing firewall policy and rule changes.
  • Experience designing, operating, and troubleshooting remote-access and site-to-site VPN technologies, including IPsec and SSL-based VPNs.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to diagnose complex connectivity and network-service issues across multiple layers and systems.
  • Experience supporting multi-site corporate networks, including office connectivity, WAN services, wireless networking, and Internet circuits.
  • Experience with cloud networking in AWS, Azure, or similar environments.
  • Working knowledge of identity, authentication, MFA, certificates, and PKI as they relate to network access and infrastructure services.
  • Experience with network monitoring, logging, alerting, and operational troubleshooting tools.
  • Experience with scripting, infrastructure-as-code, or automation using Terraform, Python, PowerShell, shell scripting, APIs, or similar tools.
  • Demonstrated ability to take ownership of technical systems and projects through completion with limited supervision.
  • Strong documentation, change-management, and operational practices.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and collaborate effectively across IT, Security, Infrastructure, Facilities, Engineering, vendors, and carriers.
  • Ability to participate in after-hours escalation or on-call support for critical network incidents.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Palo Alto Networks firewalls or similar enterprise firewall platforms.
  • Experience with BGP and other dynamic routing protocols.
  • Experience with OpenVPN or other enterprise remote-access platforms.
  • Experience with AWS networking, including VPCs, Transit Gateway, Route 53, security groups, routing, and related services.
  • Experience with enterprise wireless platforms and 802.1X or certificate-based network authentication.
  • Experience with DNS administration, domain-management platforms, and related infrastructure services.
  • Experience managing PKI, certificates, or certificate-based authentication for network services.
  • Experience modernizing legacy or bespoke network environments and migrating toward more standardized enterprise platforms.
  • Experience supporting geographically distributed offices and hybrid cloud environments.
  • Experience managing network hardware lifecycle, carrier circuits, Internet providers, and vendor relationships.
  • Experience designing resilient corporate networks and reducing single points of failure or operational dependency.
  • Experience supporting environments with security, regulatory, or compliance requirements.
  • Experience working closely with Security teams on segmentation, firewall policy, secure access, infrastructure hardening, and incident response.

Spire operates a hybrid work model, and this position will require you to work a minimum of three days per week in the office.

Access to US export-controlled software and/or technology may be required for this role. If needed, Spire will arrange the necessary licenses—this is not something candidates need to have before applying.

The anticipated base salary range for this position is listed below. Final base salary for this role will be based on the location, skills, experience and qualifications. In addition to base compensation, this role may be eligible for annual equity awards and our employee benefits program, including vacation, sick, and personal time off; optional medical, dental, vision, life, and disability coverage; a 401(K) plan; health and wellness reimbursement program; and participation in Spire’s Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

Iridium serves commercial markets through a worldwide network of hundreds of partners, and provides services to the U.S. Department of Defense, and other U.S. and international government agencies. 

The company's worldwide customer base represent a broad spectrum of industry, including maritime, aeronautical, government/defense, public safety, utilities, oil/gas, mining, forestry, heavy equipment and transportation.

Iridium has been a profitable company since 2004. These individuals recognize the value of a system that is global, secure and reliable.

descriptionHtml:
Company Overview

Iridium is an award-winning satellite communications company operating the world's only truly global voice and data network, delivering reliable connectivity anywhere on Earth. For more than 20 years, Iridium has powered mission-critical communications for governments, businesses, aviation, maritime, and the rapidly expanding Internet of Things.

Now part of Iridium, Aireon is the world’s only space-based air traffic surveillance system, providing real-time visibility of aircraft over oceans, the poles, and remote regions. Together, Iridium and Aireon are helping build a safer, more connected, and more efficient future for global aviation.

Join our team and help shape how the world stays connected. We foster a collaborative, inclusive culture where employees are empowered to innovate, grow professionally, and make a meaningful impact.

What We’re Looking For:

We are looking for a Senior Network Administrator to partner with our Network Infrastructure team in support of a Space Development Agency (SDA) project. Responsibilities include autonomously implementing and maintaining functional network infrastructure and equipment as well as performing network and security testing, validation, and troubleshooting to ensure a fault-tolerant, reliable, scalable, and automated infrastructure across SDA networks. In this role, you will provide support to the overall SDA and remote Teleport networks by configuring and maintaining Local and Wide Area Network infrastructure equipment and devices. In addition, you’ll participate in, and at times lead, the implementation of solutions that follow Government best practice guiding principles.

This position requires an active/current Top Secret Security Clearance with the ability to obtain TS/SCI clearance (A U.S. Security Clearance that has been active in the past 24 months is considered active).

What You’ll Do:

  • Be responsible for day-to-day support and maintenance for SDA Network Infrastructure systems to support Local Area Networks (LAN) and Wide Area Networks (WAN) across multiple sites
  • Be responsible for day-to-day support and maintenance for a DevSecOps link to facilitate software deliveries to the Operational System
  • Work independently to perform installation, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of networking and security hardware including, but not limited to, Juniper EX4400, ACX, and Juniper SRX firewalls
  • Create and maintain documentation, audit logs, and adhere to Configuration Management rules required to meet compliance and to enable team members to assist in problems and apply consistent solutions across a different environments and teams
  • Conduct research on network products, services, protocols, and standards to remain abreast of developments in the DevOps and network industries, technologies, and best practices
  • Play a key role in real-time troubleshooting and problem resolution as required and provide 24x7 on call assistance as needed

What You’ll Need to Succeed:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related field; or equivalent, relevant, and progressively responsible experience in lieu of degree
  • 8+ years of experience with managing and maintaining mid-to-large scale LAN/WAN networks and security that include Juniper Routers, Switches, and other vendors networking technologies
  • 8+ years of experience working with various Firewall vendors including Juniper, Cisco ASA, Check Point, Palo Alto, and Fortinet platforms
  • 3+ years of experience working with Juniper Firewalls and associated management platforms
  • Strong knowledge and multi-year hands-on experience with IP communication protocols such as OSI Model, Spanning-Tree, VDC, VFR, VTP, VSS, and routing protocols such as OSPF, EIGRP, and BGP are required
  • Experience working with Netconf/Yang
  • Well versed in use of MS PowerPoint, Excel, and Visio
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly convey products, deliverables, analyses, and/or issues to groups outside of your team or those who are unfamiliar with the topic

Network Engineer | Jupiter, FL (Hybrid - 3 Days On Site) | $80,000-$120,000 + Bonus


The Opportunity

We are working with a fast-growing, technology-led financial services business in South Florida seeking an experienced Network Engineer to join its infrastructure team.


This is more than a standard network support role. You will work alongside a senior network engineer, sharing ownership of the enterprise network and bringing extra capacity to both day-to-day support and project work.


The role covers datacentre, office and cloud networking in a high-availability environment. We are looking for someone with solid hands-on experience, strong troubleshooting skills and the confidence to work autonomously, without needing close supervision.


Key Responsibilities

  • Configure, maintain and troubleshoot LAN/WAN infrastructure, including switches, firewalls and wireless.
  • Support Layer 2 and Layer 3 switching and routing across the datacentre and office networks.
  • Design and manage cloud networking, including VPCs, routing, connectivity and ACLs.
  • Build and maintain site-to-site VPN tunnels to vendors and partners.
  • Support firewall administration, security policy and secure remote access.
  • Monitor network health and performance, responding to alerts, incidents and outages.
  • Manage configuration backups, compliance and IP address management.
  • Contribute to network design, implementation and migration projects.
  • Participate in maintenance windows, change management and an on-call rotation.
  • Maintain accurate network documentation, diagrams and runbooks.


Requirements

  • Strong hands-on network engineering experience in an enterprise environment, ideally 6+ years.
  • Strong working knowledge of the following:
  • Cisco switching, including Layer 3 routing on core switches
  • Routing protocols, including BGP and OSPF
  • Palo Alto firewalls, or equivalent experience with Fortinet or Check Point
  • Enterprise wireless, ideally Meraki
  • Site-to-site VPN configuration and troubleshooting
  • Strong CLI, troubleshooting and packet analysis skills.
  • Clear documentation habits and disciplined change management.
  • Experience with Zscaler, SD-WAN, Panorama, AWS Direct Connect or Python automation is an advantage.
  • Must live locally and be able to work on site 3 days per week, with occasional evening and weekend work.


What’s on Offer

  • Base salary of $80,000-$120,000, depending on experience.
  • A performance and profit-based bonus programme with significant upside potential.
  • Hybrid working, with 3 days on site and 2 days from home.
  • Full-time, permanent position with a growing, well-established business.
  • Comprehensive benefits, including health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, plus a 401(k).
  • The chance to work closely with and learn from a senior network engineer.
  • Join an infrastructure team that is investing and growing.

Network Engineer- TS/SCI

Xcelerate Solutions is looking for a Senior Network Engineer to join our team in supporting the National Digital Exploitation & OSINT Center (NDOC). The Senior Network Engineer provides senior-level technical expertise in the planning, coordination, implementation, and sustainment of major computer network initiatives.

Location:

This is a 100% on-site in Bethesda, MD

Clearance:

TS/SCI

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide senior-level technical expertise in the design, implementation, and sustainment of highly available, scalable, and secure data center and enterprise network environments, including spine-leaf topologies, virtualized environments, and fabric networks.
  • Support the planning and integration of LAN/WAN infrastructure, ensuring seamless and secure connectivity among on-premises systems, cloud environments, and external mission networks.
  • Provide technical leadership in the configuration, optimization, and troubleshooting of Cisco ACI, routers, switches, firewalls, and load balancers in support of mission-critical operations.
  • Analyze and optimize network connectivity and performance across servers, storage, hypervisors, and data center interconnects to support network throughput, availability, and reliability requirements.
  • Oversee the use of network monitoring and ITSM tools such as ServiceNow, SolarWinds, NetBox, and PRTG to monitor network health, availability, performance, and incident resolution.
  • Lead technical troubleshooting and incident resolution for complex network and data center issues, coordinating root cause analysis, corrective actions, and recovery activities as appropriate.
  • Develop and maintain contingency and continuity plans and procedures to support network resilience and minimize service disruptions during outages, maintenance events, and other operational activities.
  • Provide technical oversight of network infrastructure standards and practices, including cabling, patch management, structured wiring, equipment configuration, documentation, and data center operations.
  • Analyze network segmentation, performance, capacity, and latency requirements and recommend optimization strategies across physical and virtual environments.
  • Coordinate with IT, Systems Engineering, Cybersecurity, and Application teams to support cross-functional projects and ensure network implementations align with established security, technical, and mission requirements.
  • Provide technical oversight of ServiceNow ITSM activities, including work assignment, incident and change tracking, documentation, escalation, and resolution in accordance with established procedures and SLAs.
  • Prepare and present technical status reports, incident summaries, performance metrics, and recommendations to program leadership and government stakeholders.
  • Provide technical support and leadership for network modernization and data center consolidation initiatives, helping to develop implementation approaches and ensuring assigned activities meet established technical, budgetary, and schedule requirements.
  • Evaluate emerging network technologies and provide recommendations regarding solutions that may improve data center efficiency, scalability, availability, and cybersecurity posture.
  • Provide technical guidance, mentoring, and work direction to network engineers and technicians, assisting with complex technical issues and supporting professional development.
  • Assist leadership with resource planning, work schedules, and personnel coverage to support operational and mission requirements.
  • May support the evaluation of resumes and technical qualifications for network engineering vacancies and participate in candidate interviews as a technical subject matter expert.
  • May provide input to leadership regarding the performance and development of assigned personnel, including periodic feedback and assessments against established employee goals and corporate guidelines.
  • May review and approve timesheets for assigned personnel in accordance with corporate standards and established procedures.
  • Provide after-hours or on-call technical support as required for critical outages, service interruptions, and other mission-impacting events.

Minimum Requirement:

  • Requires a Bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of relevant experience. Additional years of relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a degree
  • Proven experience designing, implementing, and maintaining data center network architectures with a focus on scalability, redundancy, and security.
  • Hands-on experience with Cisco ACI, Nexus, and Catalyst platforms, including configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
  • Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, OSPF, BGP, VLANs, HSRP, SNMP, and multicast protocols.
  • Proficiency with network monitoring and ITSM tools such as ServiceNow, SolarWinds, and NetBox.
  • In-depth knowledge of network security principles, including firewall rules, ACLs, VPNs, and secure remote access.
  • Familiarity with network asset lifecycle management, capacity planning, and hardware procurement processes.
  • Experience leading teams and managing performance under shifting operational priorities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to brief senior leadership and government stakeholders.
  • Candidate must meet DoD 8140/8570.11- IAT Level II certification requirements (Security+ CE, CCNA Security, GSEC, or SSCP) with a valid Computing Environment (CE) certification.
  • Due to the nature of the government contracts we support, US Citizenship is required.
  • TS/SCI with CI Poly is required for position or a TS/SCI and willingness to obtain a Poly.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Active Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) certification
  • CCNP or CCIE certification

This strong commitment to our employees has been recognized by our inclusion on the Washington Business Journal’s “50 Best Places to Work” list as well as being a “Great Place to Work” certified company with a 4.6 star, and a 99% CEO approval Glassdoor rating. The Network Engineer role will be a competent individual with great passion for technology. An analytical mindset will be essential to effectively troubleshoot, architect, and improve the network’s functions. The goal is to create and sustain a well-functioning and reliable Network to ensure the unobtrusive operation of business.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Provide support for enhancements by maximizing functionality of Network equipment such as routers, switches, and access points.
  • Interface with vendors and suppliers to ensure adequate delivery and maintenance of equipment and services.
  • Creation of processes and procedures for network operations.
  • Ensure Network department support tickets are resolved within acceptable timeframes.
  • Architect, install, maintain, and troubleshoot Local Area Networks, Wireless Networks, Wide Area Networks and data/voice communications equipment.
  • Support installation and maintenance of Network hardware and software.
  • Install and troubleshoot IP based LAN/WAN/WLAN and IP-based routing and bridging solutions.
  • Assist with routine and emergency maintenance of all data center equipment.
  • Manage network performance monitoring and analysis.
  • Architect new solutions in-line with industry best practices.
  • Identify and correct faults and provide resolution to incident and request tickets escalated from the Support Desk.
  • Maintaining current knowledge and understanding of security and networking best practices to offer the best solutions and protection to company systems.

Job skills required:

  • Comprehensive understanding of network services and networks such as TCP/IP, OSPF and EIGRP.
  • In-depth understanding and practical knowledge of networking systems such as LAN, firewalls, routers, and printers.
  • Ability to analyze and evaluate networks, identify issues and provide solutions to ensure networks are operating efficiently.
  • Ability to design, implement and troubleshoot LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi and security systems infrastructure.
  • Ability to manage several projects simultaneously from design to implementation.
  • Ability to communicate technical information to other technical team members but also to coworkers in other departments who may not have knowledge of networking technical terminology.

  • Bachelor’s degree in IT/Computer Operations preferred; or equivalent from college or technical school
  • Three to five years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Join Children's Wisconsin as a Principal Network Engineer and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of our enterprise network infrastructure. This is an exciting opportunity for a builder and strategic thinker who enjoys evaluating existing environments, identifying opportunities for improvement, and driving meaningful change. You'll assess the current network landscape, make recommendations for modernization and optimization, and lead the design and implementation of secure, scalable solutions that support critical patient care and business operations across the organization.

Location: Hybrid but must be local to the Milwaukee area.

What you will do:

The Principal Network Engineer will provide advanced engineering and technical leadership for the networks that support clinical and business operations across Children's Wisconsin. This position will design and troubleshoot complex Cisco networks, develop network automation and hybrid cloud connectivity, and mentor engineers through design reviews, shared problem solving, and knowledge transfer. The role will improve network reliability, security, and repeatability while strengthening the team's ability to deliver and support critical services. Scope includes enterprise routing and switching, campus and data center networking, wireless connectivity, wide area networks, and connectivity to Azure and AWS. Serves as a senior technical escalation resource and leads assigned engineering work in partnership with Infrastructure, Cloud Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Information Security, and Client Services. Exercises technical judgment within approved standards and change authority.

Essential Functions

  • Network engineering. Designs, implements, and maintains enterprise Cisco network services. Evaluates routing, switching, segmentation, redundancy, capacity, and performance across clinical and business locations. Produces practical designs that account for application dependencies, operational support, security, and recovery requirements.
  • Technical leadership and mentoring. Provides hands on technical guidance to network engineers. Reviews designs, configurations, automation code, and implementation plans; explains tradeoffs and develops team capability through pairing, troubleshooting, and knowledge sharing. Helps the manager sequence technical work and identify skills gaps. Builds shared ownership and reduces dependence on individual experts.
  • Advanced troubleshooting. Leads technical diagnosis of complex network incidents and recurring problems. Uses packet captures, telemetry, logs, and routing analysis to isolate causes across network, application, security, and cloud boundaries. Coordinates restoration with service owners and the major incident process, documents root causes, and implements corrective actions.
  • Network automation. Develops and maintains reusable automation for provisioning, configuration, validation, inventory, and operational tasks. Uses infrastructure as code, scripting, and APIs with tools such as Terraform, Ansible, and Python as appropriate. Applies version control, peer review, testing, secure credential handling, and rollback practices so automated changes are controlled and repeatable.
  • Cloud and hybrid connectivity. Develops and applies Azure and AWS networking skills to design and support connectivity between CW locations and cloud environments. Works with cloud and security engineers on address planning, routing, private connectivity, DNS dependencies, segmentation, and resilient access to cloud services. Validates end to end connectivity and documents support responsibilities.
  • Change and delivery discipline. Leads assigned network implementations, upgrades, and migrations. Prepares implementation procedures, impact assessments, test plans, rollback steps, and support handoffs. Follows enterprise ITSM and change processes, coordinates maintenance with affected teams, and validates service performance after changes.
  • Standards and lifecycle planning. Maintains network diagrams, configuration standards, operating procedures, and accurate inventory and configuration records. Evaluates lifecycle risks, capacity needs, and technology options; provides technical recommendations and cost inputs to management and Enterprise Architecture. Tests proposed solutions before production adoption.
  • Security and resilience. Implements approved network safeguards and addresses assigned vulnerabilities in coordination with Information Security. Validates redundancy, failover, configuration backups, and recovery procedures. Supports secure connectivity for clinical systems and connected medical devices with application owners and Clinical Engineering.
  • Cross team and vendor coordination. Works with carriers, vendors, and internal teams to resolve technical issues and deliver network changes. Coordinates network dependencies for wireless, voice and collaboration, endpoints, applications, and cloud platforms. Reviews vendor technical deliverables and communicates risks, dependencies, and progress in terms stakeholders can act on.

What you will need:

Education:

  • Bachelor's Degree in information technology, computer science, engineering, or a related field required or relevant experience

Experience:

  • 7+ years of progressively responsible network engineering experience, including advanced design, implementation, and troubleshooting in a complex enterprise environment required
  • 7+ years Experience serving as a technical escalation resource, leading significant network changes, and mentoring or providing technical guidance to other engineers required
  • 7+ years Advanced hands on experience with Cisco enterprise routing and switching, IP addressing, routing protocols, network segmentation, high availability, Cisco ACI and datacenter networking technologies required
  • 7+ years Advanced Working knowledge of wireless networking, VPN connectivity, DNS and DHCP dependencies, and network security principles required
  • 7+ years Practical experience developing and maintaining network automation used in an operational environment through infrastructure as code, configuration management, scripting, or APIs required
  • 7+ years Experience with one or more tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Python, or comparable technologies, including version control, testing, and documentation preferred
  • 7+ years Experience following controlled change practices and coordinating across technical teams required

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

  • Healthcare or other environments requiring continuous service availability are preferred. Relevant Cisco certifications, including CCNP or CCIE, and cloud networking certifications are preferred; certifications are not required.
  • Ability to explain technical decisions, document designs and procedures and guide peers constructively
  • Ability and willingness to develop and apply Azure and AWS networking skills as part of the role

  • Employment is at-will. This document does not create an employment contract, implied or otherwise.

descriptionHtml:
Our Company


Established in 2009, EXOS is a family of companies, formerly known as Sondhi Solutions, that provides cybersecurity, talent and IT solutions across the United States. The brand EXOS is shorthand for nature's answer to providing critical support, protection and growth for many living organisms: exoskeletons. At EXOS we believe we provide that same answer for our clients. EXOS core values are built around the importance of that symbiotic relationship with our clients and one another. We realize that the foundation of all success, both for our clients and our team, is found in people connecting, building trust, and focusing on a common purpose.

EXOS CYBER partners with businesses to solve security concerns through innovative technology and specialist expertise. Our cybersecurity offerings are designed around a defense-in-depth strategy to provide a multi-layered, robust security framework.

EXOS TALENT connects organizations with exceptional individuals, champion diversity, and unlock the full potential of human resources. Together, we are building a more inclusive and prosperous future. EXOS IT empowers organizations with strategic IT direction and industry-leading service across public, private and nonprofit sectors. We focus on partnership to understand and achieve your goals, address challenges, and drive meaningful outcomes, together.


Our Values


We are Empowering:


At EXOS we empower our clients by providing them with essential strategic IT guidance, reliable service, and the talent necessary to achieve their business goals. We empower our team by living a culture of collaboration, trust, and learning, creating growth opportunities, and charting a clear career path for all our team members.


We are Connected:


At EXOS we are connected to our clients and their purpose. We are not just a talent and technology partner; we are an extension of your business. We seek to understand where leadership is driving the company, and we connect across all aspects of the business necessary to make that goal a reality. We


are connected to the communities we serve and invested in organizations that make them great places to live. As the EXOS team, we are connected through our common commitment to our cultural imperatives: the 'Three Ps' - Be Positive, Be Productive and Be Progressive in the since that we are always challenging each other to learn and grow.


We are Trusted:


For more than fifteen years EXOS has been a trusted partner in providing Talent, IT and Cybersecurity solutions for our clients. Whether it's servicing large-scale enterprise clients or start up professional firms, our team is there to help solve pain points and provide strategic direction. The trust we have with one another as a team is earned. We live a culture of accountability with a goal of excellence. We are invested in one another's success, personally and professionally. We are a trust first, learn together and celebrate collectively team.


Summary:

We are looking for a highly experienced and driven Senior IT Network Engineer to join our Infrastructure (INF) Team. This role requires an expert-level understanding of network infrastructure, exceptional problem-solving skills, and thought leadership abilities. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring Client and EXOS network performance and reliability, as well as being primary lead on network consultations and deployments.


What You Will Do


· Network Design and Implementation:

o Design, deploy, and maintain complex network infrastructure, including LAN, WAN, and wireless networks.

o Implement and oversee network solutions that are secure, scalable, and aligned with business objectives.

o Collaborate with other IT teams to ensure seamless integration of network services across the organization.

· Incident and Problem Management:

o Lead the response to major network incidents, ensuring timely resolution and minimizing business impact.

o Analyze network performance data to identify trends, recurring issues, and areas for improvement.

o Develop and implement strategies to prevent network incidents and enhance overall reliability.

· Network Security and Compliance:

o Oversee the implementation of network security measures to protect against unauthorized access, cyber threats, and vulnerabilities.

o Ensure compliance with industry standards, regulatory requirements, and company policies.

o Conduct regular security assessments and audits, and implement corrective actions as needed.

· Documentation and Reporting:

o Maintain detailed and accurate documentation of network configurations, processes, incident reports, and service records.

o Develop and maintain comprehensive disaster recovery and business continuity plans.

o Provide guidance and mentoring on Network Issues to INF Engineers and other IT staff.

o Collaboration and Strategic Planning: Work closely with IT and business leaders to develop and implement strategic network plans.

o Collaborate with vendors and service providers to ensure high-quality network services and support.


Qualifications:

? Education and Experience:

o Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field OR equivalent experience.

o Minimum of 7-10 years of experience as a Network Engineer, with at least 3 years in a senior or lead role

? Technical Skills:

o Expert knowledge of network infrastructure and operations.

o Extensive experience with Fortinet, Cisco, Juniper, or similar advanced networking equipment.

o Advanced proficiency in networking protocols (e.g., BGP, OSPF, MPLS) and network monitoring tools.

o Strong understanding of network security practices, incident management, and disaster recovery planning.

? Certifications (preferred but not required):

o Advanced certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, or similar.

o Security certifications such as CISSP, CEH, or equivalent.

? Soft Skills:

o Excellent leadership and team management skills.

o Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

o Effective communication and interpersonal skills.

o Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities.

o Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

At Man Group, we respect your privacy and we are committed to protecting and safeguarding your Personal Data. We have developed policies and processes which are designed to provide for the security and integrity of your Personal Data. We are committed to Processing your Personal Data fairly and lawfully, and being open and transparent about such Processing. For further information on how we process your data, please see the privacy notice for applicants here.

  • As at 30 June 2026

The Team

Platform Engineering is the powerhouse behind our technology infrastructure. We equip investment teams with the tools to scale their strategies and operate effectively, from expansive data storage and high-performance computing in our data centres to massive on-premises database deployments and cutting-edge end-user devices. We are also responsible for keeping Man Group secure and automating infosec processes, ensuring seamless operations across the firm.

Join us as a Network Engineer in the Infrastructure Engineering department and you'll be part of a team that builds and runs the platform powering Man Group's hedge funds. You will be member of an existing engineering team where you have direct responsibility and accountability for a complex and high-performance network infrastructures. You will be able to demonstrate expert knowledge of delivering complex network architectures delivered via software driven and agile methodology. You should have the enthusiasm for leveraging AI development tools to accelerate delivery and driving their adoption across the team.

Role Responsibilities

  • Promote and adhere to best practice across Technology, by aligning strong engineering skills, attention to detail and knowledge of industry trends and best practices to build reliable, high performance and robust solutions.
  • Building and managing Man Group’s infrastructure, both on-premises and in the cloud, using technologies such as Python.
  • Integrate Ansible, Terraform, and other automation tools with Network systems and services.
  • Working closely with business stakeholders in a dynamic environment
  • You will be able to demonstrate expert knowledge of delivering complex network architectures delivered via software driven and agile methodology.

Key Competencies

Essential

  • Operating and deploying network infrastructure
  • Great understanding of common layer 2 and layer 3 network protocols (OSPF, BGP, PIM, IGMP, RoCEv2, spine-leaf architecture) and best practices for them
  • Overlay networks (EVPN, VXLAN)
  • Troubleshooting transport protocols (TCP/UDP)
  • Experience with packet decoding and analysis tools such as tcpdump and Wireshark
  • Arista (EOS), Cisco (IOS/IOS-XE/NX-OS), Palo Alto (PAN-OS) and SONiC-based switches, as well as an interest in exploring new platforms

Advantageous

  • Proven ability to select and work with vendors to engineer switches for next-generation computing environments
  • Knowledge of fibre optics technology and cabling standards ranging from 1 to 800 Gbps, with the ability to evaluate specs and make recommendations on appropriate purchases
  • Understanding of basic power consumption and cooling issues in a data centre environment
  • Eagerness to automate your workflow to increase efficiency
  • Clear communication skills with the ability to maintain a high degree of customer feedback
  • A flexible and reliable team player who enjoys working in a collaborative environment but is also self-motivated and can work independently when needed
  • Familiarity with Python, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, and GitHub is desirable
  • REST/Ansible/Terraform/YAML

The anticipated based salary range for this position is listed below. Compensation packages would also include benefits and a discretionary bonus. This is the base salary range that the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting based on the location and requirements of the position as well as the skills, qualifications, and experience of the applicant. The Firm reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time.

US Pay Range: $160,000 USD - $170,000 USD

Inclusion, Work-Life Balance And Benefits At Man Group

You'll thrive in our working environment that champions equality of opportunity. Your unique perspective will contribute to our success, joining a workplace where inclusion is fundamental and deeply embedded in our culture and values. Through our external and internal initiatives, partnerships and programmes, you'll find opportunities to grow, develop your talents, and help foster an inclusive environment for all across our firm and industry. Learn more at www.man.com/diversity.

You'll have opportunities to make a difference through our charitable and global initiatives, while advancing your career through professional development, and with flexible working arrangements available too. Like all our people, you'll receive two annual 'Mankind' days of paid leave for community volunteering.

Our comprehensive benefits package includes competitive holiday entitlements, pension/401k, life and long-term disability coverage, group sick pay, enhanced parental leave and long-service leave. Depending on your location, you may also enjoy additional benefits such as private medical coverage, discounted gym membership options and pet insurance.

infrastructure; researches and evaluates current and emerging technologies and methodologies and makes

recommendations for technology initiatives to meet network needs.

  • Analyzes capacity and forecasts growth requirements while monitoring technology and industry trends and works


closely with technology stakeholders to evaluate the uses of emerging technology to meet long-term business and

operating strategies.

standards; interoperability, reliability, and availability; supportability and expected return on investment; recommends

hardware, software and communication media upgrades and enhancements to meet long-term needs; participates in

lifecycle replacement planning processes.

  • Serves multiple clients as an administrator for large, complex, multi-segment, wired and wireless network


infrastructures, including Firewalls, Switches, and Access Points and internet connections; designs, develops, installs,

integrates and maintains the infrastructure incorporating multiple technologies, components, protocols and vendor

products and systems; collaborates on establishment of network standards, including naming conventions and address

protocols; utilizing a variety of software and tools, monitors and analyzes network traffic and capacity utilization to

achieve optimal performance and availability; analyzes data to identify and resolve reasons for communications

bottlenecks.

participates in development of network contingency and disaster recovery plans; advises on specifications for network

hardware, software and cabling upgrades and enhancements; participates with the IT Leadership to evaluate and

recommend network and systems hardware and software; recommends cabling and connectivity standards, uses and

levels.

security; develops and maintains network documentation and reference tools.

Juniper, or Aruba.

Job Summary

The Senior Network Engineer is responsible for leading the design, deployment, implementation, and lifecycle management of complex network infrastructure systems. Oversees advanced network architecture, configuration, optimization, and maintenance activities. Identifies and resolves complex technical issues, performs in‑depth system assessments, and implements durable solutions to ensure reliability and performance. Responsibilities include managing system updates and patching, executing vulnerability management tasks, monitoring and analyzing system health and logs, and maintaining accurate architecture diagrams and documentation. Contributes to long‑term infrastructure strategy, provides expert‑level troubleshooting support, and guides best practices throughout the environment.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

  • Models the mission, vision, values, and culture of the organization

Advanced-Level Support For Information Technology (IT) Environments

  • Provide advanced support to the infrastructure team, assisting staff with complex problems using advanced skills and extensive experience.
  • Provide advanced networking support, troubleshooting/resolving incidents, and mentoring lower-level system engineers.

System Design and Development for IT

  • Lower-level design implementation and deployment of complex systems, ensuring alignment with project objectives and industry best practices.
  • Collaborates with project management, stakeholders, applications, service desk, and cybersecurity teams for project scoping, Low-level design understanding, and ensuring standards are accurate and well-documented.

Monitoring and Configuration for IT

  • Ensure systems are properly configured and proactively monitored in the environment, supporting the team in maintaining these standards.
  • Manage the maintenance and patching process, including researching, documenting, and communicating changes; handle change tickets and implement patches in the IT environment.
  • Help maintain new and existing monitoring tools

Network Analysis and Troubleshooting for IT

  • Perform system analysis, troubleshooting, and debugging to ensure system performance and reliability.
  • Recommend new tools and participate in vendor evaluations with the team of new innovative tools.

Network Engineering and Management for IT

  • Collaborate with the team and vendors for current industry trends and emerging technologies, recommending their integration into our systems.
  • Participate in the evaluation and selection of third-party tools and components.
  • Buildout of low-level design and network diagrams, new project integration, and innovative deployments.
  • Collaborate with the Information Governance group to develop and follow retention policies and processes.
  • Adhere to and contribute to change management processes and procedures.

Network Engineering and Administration

  • Deploy and implement the overall network infrastructure. This includes LAN, WAN, WLAN, and data center network solutions.
  • Implement routing, switching, wireless, and network segmentation strategies throughout the network.
  • Deploy the architected network design for the installation, configuration, testing, and management of network equipment across the organization.
  • Deploy advanced features such as high availability, wide-area routing, route redistribution, and link aggregation.
  • Manage and maintain routers, firewalls, and assist with defining/implementing complex firewall rules and ACLs.
  • Deploy and configure wireless networking management and monitoring technologies.
  • Develop and test device hardening standards and processes.
  • Advanced understanding of networking concepts, including layer 2/3, wireless, firewalls, ACLs, VPNs, WAN, OSI/TCP/IP models, IP address management, DHCP, DNS, servers, storage systems, network equipment, and datacenter hardware.

Additional Requirements

  • Effectively collaborates with cross-functional stakeholders, manages competing priorities, and consistently delivers high-quality work within established deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Serve as a technical mentor to junior engineers.
  • Lead technical aspects of infrastructure projects.
  • Continuously develop new skills through training and collaboration with experienced systems engineers.
  • Demonstrate safe work practices and comply with established safety procedures
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Requirements

Knowledge, skills, and abilities

  • Delivers reliable and secure information technology solutions combined with the highest levels of customer service
  • Produces clear, accurate, and professional written communications, delivers information effectively to diverse audiences, and demonstrates active listening skills to ensure understanding and successful collaboration.
  • Willingness to learn new technologies and obtain and maintain required technical certifications
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships, exhibit a positive attitude, and collaborate with others to provide high level of customer service
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously and work with frequent interruptions.
  • Ability to work occasionally during the evenings, weekends, after hours and on-call for both scheduled and unscheduled events
  • Possess intermediate troubleshooting skills in areas of assignment and basic troubleshooting skills of other areas
  • Considered a subject matter expert in at least one of the assignment areas
  • Experience using Visio or similar tools for creating diagrams and documentation

Network Architecture and Engineering

  • Advanced understanding of OSI or TCP/IP networking models
  • Design, implement, and support enterprise network infrastructure include LAN, WAN, wireless, VPN, and data center networks.
  • Manage data center technologies including VXLAN, BGP, and OSPF.
  • Comprehensive understanding of IP address management, DHCP and DNS
  • Advanced understanding of monitoring and logging tools
  • Develop scalable network solutions aligned with business objectives and technology roadmaps.
  • Lead network modernization initiatives, upgrades, migrations, and infrastructure refresh projects.
  • Advanced understanding of wireless networking and management technologies
  • Advanced understanding of firewalls, ACLs, and VPNs
  • Advanced understanding of WAN and routing technologies
  • Provide Tier 3 support for complex network issues and outages; follow up with root cause analysis and develop corrective action plans.

Network Security

  • Implement and maintain network security controls including next-generation firewalls, network segmentation, NAC solutions, and VPN services
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to ensure compliance with security standards and policies

Qualifications

Required

  • Six to seven years of experience as a systems engineer or equivalent in an enterprise computing environment
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer information systems, Computer Science, Engineering or related field or equivalent combination of education and experience
    • Relevant experience may be substituted for education
  • Current valid driver’s license and ability to remain insurable under the vehicle liability policy
Preferred Education, Licenses, And Work Experience

  • Master’s degree in computer information systems, Computer Science, Engineering or related field or equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Certifications from CompTIA, Microsoft, Palo Alto, and Cisco i.e. CompTIA Server+

Physical demands

Minimal physical effort typically found in clerical work. Primarily sedentary, may occasionally lift and carry light objects. Minimal walking or standing as needed.

Hazards

Minimal exposure to hazards are typically found in general office environment where there is rarely to no exposure to injury or accident.

Work environment

Exposure to routine office noise and equipment

Pay

Salaries are paid bi-weekly and are annualized below for reference. Factors that may be used to determine actual salary include special skills, years of experience, education, and certifications.

  • Full range: $124,820 to $180,991
  • Hiring range: $124,820 to $152,906

The Opportunity

CACI is seeking an experienced Network Engineer to join our team in Fort Meade, MD, supporting critical intelligence systems and our nation's intelligence capabilities.

  • Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve network connectivity, performance, and operational issues.
  • Monitor network health and performance to ensure reliability and availability.
  • Analyze network traffic patterns to identify potential performance issues and opportunities for improvement.
  • Improve network visibility through performance metrics, monitoring tools, and alerting capabilities.
  • Support network maintenance activities, system upgrades, and infrastructure improvements.
  • Create, update, and maintain network documentation, policies, procedures, and technical specifications.
  • Ensure network solutions align with communication system requirements and support the distributed software engineering environment.

Qualifications

Required:

  • TS/SCI with Polygraph
  • Minimum of 12 years of experience supporting programs and contracts of similar scope, type, and complexity.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience as a Network Engineer within the last 3 years.
  • Bachelor's degree in Network Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Information Technology from an accredited college or university.
  • Four additional years of network engineering experience may be substituted for a bachelor's degree.
  • Proficiency with Linux operating systems.
  • CCNA or CCNP certification.
  • Security+ certification.
  • Experience supporting network design, implementation, maintenance, and upgrades.
  • Knowledge of network infrastructure, communication systems, and network troubleshooting.

Desired

  • Hands-on experience with Juniper and Cisco routers, switches, and firewalls, including Palo Alto firewalls.
  • Experience supporting Dell and HPE Linux servers, including Linux system administration, patching, and upgrading Linux servers and networking resources.
  • Working knowledge of Ansible and SALT scripts for automation and configuration management.
  • Familiarity with Nutanix for virtual machine management, Rubrik for data storage, and Nomad containers.

 A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Position Summary

MAG Aerospace is seeking to identify a Senior Network Engineer to support operations based out of Webster Outlying Field (WOLF), MD.

This position will manage and support a high level NAWCAD program while designing local, regional, network systems and subsystems supporting voice, video, data, and imagery information. Additionally, lead teams to address complex projects.

  • This position is contingent upon receipt of government funding and hiring authorization.

At this time, a start date has not been determined.

We are seeking to identify and engage highly qualified professionals for a talent pipeline. Applicants may be contacted as program funding and hiring approvals are finalized.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

 Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  • Analyzes users' needs and makes recommendations on appropriate network configurations to meet users’ needs and departmental standards
  • Designs, configures, monitors, and optimizes local and wide area networks and printers for optimal performance, maximum availability, minimal maintenance, and reasonable costs
  • Designs, configures, maintains, and manages network security features for local and wide area networks
  • Adds and deletes users as required on network servers and applications
  • Troubleshoots network issues
  • Installs and upgrades network equipment and software
  • Analyzes, recommends, and evaluates new hardware, software, and communications products for network compatibility and applicability
  • Establishes, documents, and maintains network technical support processes and procedures
  • Provides network asset management including maintenance of network component inventory and related documentation and technical specifications
  • Establishes phone (voice) and network standards regarding new technologies and applications
  • Monitors and tests network performance and provides network performance statistics and reports
  • Works with cross-functional teams in the design and implementation of information technology
  • Assist in the training of other information systems personnel to improve their technical skills
  • Assist departmental management with development of systems standards, short- and long-term goals, project management, and strategic directions
  • Keeps current on new developments and techniques in information technology
  • Acts as technical liaison between company, customers, and vendors
  • As required provides technical support for bids and proposals

Requirements

 Minimum Requirements

Experience

  • Of the minimum ten (10) years of required experience, ten (10) years of the experience must be in designing local, regional, network systems and subsystems supporting voice, video, data, and imagery information.
  • Additionally, must have at least five (5) years of experience with leading teams to address complex projects
  • Experience in deploying wireless networks in industry or government environments
  • Experience deploying encode and ended
  • Experience working knowledge of CDMA, GSM, and LTE - Prefer working knowledge of commercial solutions for classified and NSA capability packages
  • Proven knowledge of network infrastructure and network hardware
  • Excellent problem-solving skills
  • Ability to explain technical issues to all levels
  • Ability to quickly learn new or unfamiliar technology and products using documentation and internet resources
  • Strong understanding of network infrastructure and network hardware
  • Ability to implement, administer, and troubleshoot network infrastructure devices
  • Ability to create network maps
  • Keeps abreast of technology trends

Education And Certifications

  • MUST HAVE an Active Cisco Certified Network Professional (CNNP) Certification.
  • Master's Degree in an Engineering or Computer Science Discipline.

Clearance

  • Must currently have a Top Secret Security Clearance
  • US Citizenship required

Special Note

The position is contingent upon candidate’s ability to meet physical and medical requirements as needed by the position; including compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local jurisdictional requirements.

Benefits And Compensation

At MAG Aerospace, we value your contributions providing our employees with a robust Total Rewards package that supports your total well-being. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 30 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in MAG's Total Rewards programs. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits as well as paid leave, professional development, and tuition assistance. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our Total Rewards Program by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site: https://www.magaero.com/benefits/. Salary at MAG Aerospace is determined by various factors including but not limited to location, the particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $120,000 to $150,000 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of MAG's total compensation package for employees.

Job Summary

A Network Engineer in Avangrid’s telecommunications organization is responsible for basic designing, implementing, and maintaining secure, resilient, and utility-grade communications systems that support electric and gas grid operations across a large, distributed service territory. The role spans IP networking, telecom transport, mobile radio systems, and point-to-point communications, ensuring high availability for mission-critical SCADA, field operations, and corporate connectivity.

Key Responsibilities

  • Network architecture – Design and optimize enterprise WAN/LAN, MPLS, fiber, microwave, and supporting grid and corporate systems.
  • Mobile radio systems – Engineer, maintain, and troubleshoot LMR systems (VHF/UHF, P25, DMR) used by field crews, substations, and emergency response teams.
  • Point-to-point communications – Deploy and maintain microwave, licensed/unlicensed RF, and fiber P2P links for substation backhaul, SCADA, and operational telemetry.
  • Routing & switching – Implement BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, VLANs, ACLs, and QoS across Cisco enterprise and industrial platforms.
  • Network security – VPN encryption, MACsec, 802.1X, and NERC-CIP-aligned security controls.
  • Transport technologies – Support DWDM, SONET, and carrier-grade Ethernet services for high-capacity backhaul.
  • Monitoring & reliability – Use SNMP, DPI, and analytics tools to ensure uptime, capacity planning, and rapid incident response.
  • Documentation & standards – Create Visio diagrams, engineering packages, method-of-procedure (MOP) documents, and telecom standards.
  • Cross-functional coordination – Partner with operations, field crews, IT security, NMC, and external carriers to support projects and resolve issues.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field is preferred.
  • Relevant experience and training.
  • Must be self-directed and demonstrate initiative.
  • Strong written and verbal skills required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Cisco CCNA – Foundational networking, routing, switching, and security.
  • NERC-CIP Training Certificates – Directly relevant to utility compliance.
  • Strong analytical and communication skills.

ROCHESTER GAS & ELEC CORP

Job Description

CLA is a top 10 national professional services firm where our purpose is to create opportunities every day, for our clients, our people, and our communities through industry-focused wealth advisory, digital, audit, tax, consulting, and outsourcing services. Even with more than 8,500 people, 130 U.S. locations, and a global reach, we promise to know you and help you.

CLA is dedicated to building a culture that invites different beliefs and perspectives to the table, so we can truly know and help our clients, communities, and each other.

CLA is seeking a Lead Network Engineer to lead the design, implementation, and support of our enterprise networking environment. This role will provide technical leadership across routing, switching, wireless, cloud networking, SD-WAN, and network security technologies while driving infrastructure modernization, automation, and operational excellence. The ideal candidate possesses deep technical expertise, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate across teams to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable network solutions that support CLA's continued growth and transformation.

About The Role

As a Lead Network Engineer, you will:

  • Lead the design, implementation, optimization, and support of CLA's enterprise network infrastructure across office, datacenter, and cloud environments
  • Provide technical leadership for routing, switching, wireless, SD-WAN, and network security initiatives.
  • Administer and support Cisco networking technologies including Catalyst, Nexus, Meraki, and related platforms.
  • Design and manage enterprise WAN, LAN, WLAN, VPN, and internet connectivity solutions.
  • Support and optimize Microsoft Azure networking services, including ExpressRoute, Virtual Networks (VNets), Virtual WAN, DNS, and hybrid cloud connectivity.
  • Configure and troubleshoot routing and switching protocols including BGP, OSPF, VLANs, STP, HSRP, and QoS.
  • Partner with cybersecurity teams to implement and maintain secure network architectures, firewalls, segmentation, and Zero Trust initiatives.
  • Lead network modernization, cloud transformation, office integration, and infrastructure lifecycle management projects.
  • Develop and maintain network automation solutions using PowerShell, Python, Ansible, Terraform, or similar technologies.
  • Utilize network monitoring and performance management tools such as SolarWinds, ThousandEyes, LogicMonitor, or similar platforms.
  • Serve as a technical escalation point for complex network incidents, performance issues, and critical outages.
  • Mentor network engineers and contribute to architectural standards, operational procedures, and network roadmaps.
  • Ensure high availability, resiliency, disaster recovery, and business continuity requirements are met across the enterprise network.
  • Participate in the on-call rotation.

What You Will Need

  • 6 years of relevant experience required
  • 8+ years of enterprise network engineering experience, including design, implementation, and support of large-scale multi-site environments preferred
  • Bachelor's degree is required. A combination of relevant experience, education, and training may be accepted in lieu of a degree
  • Degrees in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field preferred.

Our approach to compensation emphasizes collaboration and career growth. We pay competitive wages and view compensation as an investment in our people. Factors such as geography, experience, education, skills, and knowledge may impact position of pay within the range.

The compensation range for this position in Minnesota is: $89,000.00 – $153,000.00

Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities

Click here to learn about your hiring rights.

To support our CLA family members, we focus on their physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being and offer comprehensive benefit options that include health, dental, vision, 401k and much more.

To view a complete list of benefits, click here.

Position Title: Network Engineer 2

Business Unit: Technology

Reports to: Manager of Network Engineering

Position Overview

This position is primarily responsible for providing advanced network support for the corporation. The incumbent collaborates on defining Technology plans and strategies, participates with the development of long range infrastructure plans and consults with Technology and lines of business partners to appropriately provide network functionality. The incumbent has a significant impact on Technology, operational effectiveness, resources, lines of business and the corporation's reputation.

Primary Responsibilities

Directs resolution activities of junior staff. Consults to determine the priorities of the Technology networking project plans. Has excellent understanding of network functionality and devices, is skilled in project management and has a detailed understanding of network analysis, protocols, reporting and network architecture.

Troubleshoots and distinguishes between network and application issues. Traces and resolves security issues. Has a solid understanding of Technology patching methodologies and vulnerabilities and resolves patching vulnerabilities and coordinates schedule.

Updates network diagrams and department procedures. Acts a vendor liaison for assigned systems/platforms. Works day shift but can be required for after hours and weekend efforts. Works independently or as part of a team to achieve results.

Follows change control procedures, contributes to Change Control meetings and participates as required. Works with Technology, Project Management Office and lines of business. Work with vendors and external support personnel.

Leads complex strategic initiatives, patching and infrastructure projects. Purchases, installs and supports network communications including LAN/WAN systems.

Performs regular assignments using own judgment. Determines methods and procedures on new projects and is held accountable for end results. Determines when manager or others should be consulted. Tuvli is seeking a highly motivated, self-directed and experienced individual to fill the role of a Network Engineer SME for our existing government client in the Alexandria, VA. To join our team of outstanding professionals, apply today!

Responsibilities

Network Engineer SME will be responsible for ensuring the stable operation and efficient performance of data networks; monitoring and managing all network hardware and equipment, including routers, switches, and encryptors; analyzing network performance across the organization’s LANs and WANs; and identifying and developing remedies for network performance bottlenecks. The network engineer SME shall have a solid working knowledge of network security measures, experience with network management and analysis tools such as Solar Winds.

  • Setup and configure Juniper network devices like MX series routers, SRX firewalls and QFX switches.
  • Design, implement, and maintain robust network infrastructures, including LAN, WAN, and VPNs.
  • Monitor network traffic and performance, troubleshoot connectivity issues, and optimize network resources to minimize downtime.
  • Implement and manage security measures, such as firewalls, access controls, and intrusion prevention systems.
  • Inspect, maintain, and, where necessary, replace network cabling and other network-related equipment.
  • Administer hardware and software upgrades for network equipment.
  • Create and maintain detailed network documentation, including network topology, IP schemas, and firewall rules.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain policies, procedures and associated training plans for network resource administration, appropriate use and disaster recovery.
  • Perform network asset management, including maintenance of network component inventory and related documentation and technical specifications information.
  • Administer and maintain user accounts, permissions, and access rights.
  • Recommend, schedule, and perform network improvements, upgrades, and repairs.
  • Interact with vendors, outsourcers, and contractors to secure network products and services.
  • Design, configure, troubleshoot, and expand IP address schemas for a WAN/LAN network
  • Develop functional, systems, and technical requirements documents based on operational and architectural requirements.
  • Perform technical analysis of IT alternatives in support of strategic modernization efforts.
  • Provide expert analysis and advice on the feasibility of system designs and capacity planning.
  • Perform detailed engineering to optimize enterprise network topologies and develop engineering design documentation to produce, install, test, integrate, and support a complete functional enterprise or processing system or subsystem.
  • Provide technical support and quality control checks to ensure information systems designs and specifications meet the necessary standards.
  • Troubleshoot and analyze network and communication issue and assist in their resolution.
  • Perform firmware upgrades, apply patches, and conduct routine maintenance to keep network systems up to date.
  • Work with other IT teams, such as security, system administrators, and applications, to ensure integrated network operations.
  • Other related duties as assigned.
  • Available for rotating on-call support.

Qualifications

  • A degree in the field of computer science or other IT related discipline is preferred.
  • Certifications: Juniper Networks Certified Specialist: Enterprise Routing and Switching (JNCIS-ENT), Juniper Network Certified Internet Expert (JNCIE) or the Cisco equivalent Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP), Cisco Certified Internet Expert (CCIE) is preferred.
  • Experience with Juniper network solutions is preferred.
  • Strong communication and written skills.
  • Key Technical Skills:
    • Juniper Hardware & Software: Proficiency with Juniper routers (MX), switches (EX), and firewalls (SRX).
    • Junos OS: Knowledge of Juniper’s operating system for network device management.
    • Protocols: strong understating of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, BGP, and OSPF.
    • Security Tools: Experience with firewalls, Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and Intrusion Prevention Systems (IPS).
  • Able to obtain a DoD Interim Secret clearance with upgrade to Top Secret.
