descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Network Engineer for the Pacific Region to support the Department of War medical mission by ensuring the reliability, security, performance, and operational effectiveness of highly complex network infrastructure a DOW agency. This position is designated as Key Personnel and serves as a technical lead for LAN, WLAN, and WAN engineering, network operations, routing, security, troubleshooting, and standards implementation.

Responsibilities

  • Identify and resolve complex network issues, provide advanced installation and configuration support, manage communications interconnection and routing
  • Serve as the regional point of contact for network issues, configuration management, addressing, multiprotocol routing, and network management
  • Advisor to the Government staff, agencies, and contractor personnel on network design, implementation, deployment, and management to ensure the network environment fully supports the Military Health System mission
  • Evaluate network performance, provide technical recommendations for operational improvements and upgrades
  • Support the development of procedures and standards, and lead or participate in special projects as required

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, a technical discipline, or a related field. In lieu of a bachelor’s degree, successful completion of a certified technical or vocational school and ten years of directly related experience gained through progressively higher levels of complexity may be substituted. At least five years of directly related experience.
  • Comply with Department of War Directive 8570.01 for Information Assurance Training, Certification, and Workforce Management and must hold an Information Assurance Manager Level III certification, or equivalent, in accordance with current DoW requirements. The candidate must also possess current CCNP and CISSP certifications
  • SECRET security clearance required.
  • Demonstrate mastery of standard networking protocols and technologies, including TCP IP, XDM, HTTP, HTTPS, SMTP, SNMP, DNS, DHCP, RSTP, VRRP, BIND, EIGRP, BGP, OSPF, PPP, HDLC, V35, and RS 449.
  • Understand communications and Internet standards is required, along with direct experience in synchronous and asynchronous communications and network media used in DoW and DHA environments.
  • Have advanced experience working in routed, switched, and shared LAN environments and must be proficient in environments that use current supported versions of Microsoft operating systems, Windows Active Directory, UNIX, and OpenVMS. Experience supporting routers, switches, terminal servers, and both local and long-haul WAN connectivity is required.
  • Direct experience with Optical Time Domain Reflectometers, cable testers, network sniffers, and EIA TIA cable standards and specifications. Expertise in Windows networks, Cisco Systems, and Orion SolarWinds is required, along with the ability to configure and support firewalls, VPN devices, and intrusion detection systems.
  • Experience with DoW Health Care Information Systems is required.
  • Ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues across all layers of the OSI model using diagnostics and network administration tools such as Orion SolarWinds, ARMIS, and Ansible. A strong understanding of Management Information Blocks and MRTG is also required to support network measurement, planning, performance optimization, and downtime reduction.
  • Communicate effectively with a broad audience, including Government officials, medical professionals, and highly specialized technical personnel. Strong verbal and written communication skills are essential, along with the ability to provide technical recommendations, document changes, contribute to standards development, and support best practices for enterprise network operations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Zero Trust Architectures and Methodologies
  • Experience developing technical policies, procedures, and standards for enterprise network environments.
  • Experience leading regional or enterprise network modernization initiatives.
  • Experience with automation and orchestration tools in complex network environments.
  • Experience collaborating across Government, contractor, and operational support teams in mission critical environments.
  • Strong ability to provide technical recommendations for network tuning, enhancement, and upgrade planning.
  • Experience supporting enterprise network standardization and compliance initiatives.

Pay Transparency Statement

AMERICAN SYSTEMS is committed to pay transparency for our applicants and employee-owners. The salary range for this position is USD $110,800.00/Yr. - USD $185,100.00/Yr. Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors permitted by law. AMERICAN SYSTEMS provides for the welfare of its employees and their dependents through a comprehensive benefits program by offering healthcare benefits, paid leave, retirement plans, insurance programs, and education and training assistance.

descriptionHtml:
Overview

The Network Engineer will work to design, deploy, and support our hybrid networking environment, with a focus on on-premise data center, campus and SDWAN infrastructure and integration with Azure cloud networking. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience troubleshooting network solutions that bridge on-premises, branch, and cloud environments.

This role will be in our Warrenville, Illinois (IL)! This is not a remote position.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain Azure routing policies, particularly for vWAN architectures
  • Configure and manage Site-to-Site VPN, ExpressRoute,
  • Configure BGP routing, dynamic routing policies, and route propagation between SD-WAN campus and data center edges and cloud hubs
  • Troubleshoot routing, latency, and connectivity issues across on-prem and cloud environments
  • Monitor network performance and capacity
  • Maintain accurate network documentation, diagrams, and standard operating procedures
  • Respond to escalated network incidents
  • Partner with cloud, security, and application teams on network-related projects and migrations

Qualifications

  • 4-6 years of experience in network engineering, with direct experience in Azure cloud networking
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise scale WAN, LAN and vWAN
  • Strong understanding of network routing protocols, BGP, SMB, DNS, IPsec, OSPF
  • Experience with ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway, NGFW
  • Experience designing and supporting multi-region cloud networking
  • Familiarity with network segmentation principles
  • Working knowledge of IPsec and QoS in SDWAN environments
  • Excellent documentation and communication skills
  • Experience with multi-cloud networking (AWS/GCP) a plus
  • Relevant certifications such as AZ-700

The base salary range for this position is: $80,000-$95,000 depending on experience and location.

Description

Hickam, Hawaii.

(All qualified candidates MUST POSSESS a CCNA and/or CCNP; Sec+ or higher certification, a Secret Clearance and be a US Citizen).

This position supports US and coalition exercise networks as well as USAF and DoW operational systems including Non-Secure Internet Protocol Network (NIPRNET), Secure Internet Protocol Network (SIPRNET), commercial internet, and video teleconferencing (VTC).

The Network Engineer will

  • Design, plan, build, deploy, configure, test, monitor, and maintain DoW and USAF network systems and related hardware, software, licenses, and certifications.
  • Implement network upgrades, system software patching, and security compliance in accordance with USAF Instructions, Information Assurance Vulnerability Management requirements, and maintenance task orders.
  • Coordinate with USAF IT Technical Planners to plan and complete exercise-related networking tasks and requests.
  • Research, analyze, recommend, and document possible resolutions or actions to resolve network problems and improve network performance.
  • Coordinate and communicate with external organizations to submit network issue tickets, diagnose network problems, and then resolve network problems.
  • Monitor status of projects and tasks, prepare milestone status reports, and present status to DoW and USAF officials.

Qualifications

Required Experience and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s and 14 or relevant years of experience in lieu of degree.
  • Must be a US Citizen, currently possess an active Secret Security Clearance with the ability to obtain a TS/SCI.
  • Must possess a major certification Certifications may include Sec+, CASP+, CCIE, CCISO, CCSP, CFR, CISM, CISSP, CySA+, CNP, GCED, GCFA, GCIH, GCIG, JNCIE-SEC, Google Professional Cloud Engineer, M365 Enterprise Administrator Expert, M365 Modern Desktop Admin Associate, Microsoft Azure Developer Associate, Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert, RCHA, RHCSA, VMware CP – Data Center.
  • Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) or Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) Certification.
  • Proficiency using MS Office, including Word, PowerPoint, Excel, SharePoint, Visio, and Teams.
  • Network engineer experience supporting DoW and USAF networks.

Desired Experience And Qualifications

  • Practical experience with enterprise level networking such as Cisco Call Manager, Cisco Meeting Servers, Nexus, Cisco Firewalls, Cisco DNA Center, Cisco Identity Service Engine, and Cisco Web Security Applications.
  • Experience with Unicast, Broadcast, and Multicast networks.
  • Experience with Network Address Translation, and Virtual Route Forwarding.
  • Experience with routing protocols such as EIGRP, OSPF, and BGP.
  • Experience with VTC systems.
  • Experience with Virtual Infrastructure such as vSphere, vCenter, and ESXi.
  • Experience with KG-175 encryption devices.

Target salary range $160,001 - $200,000. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.

Network Engineer Responsibilities:

  • Maintaining and administering computer networks and related computing environments including systems software, applications software, hardware, and configurations.
  • Performing disaster recovery operations and data backups when required.
  • Protecting data, software, and hardware by coordinating, planning and implementing network security measures.
  • Troubleshooting, diagnosing and resolving hardware, software, and other network and system problems.
  • Replacing faulty network hardware components when required.
  • Maintaining, configuring, and monitoring virus protection software and email applications.
  • Configuring and installing various network devices and services (e.g., routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, VPN, QoS)
  • Monitoring network performance to determine if adjustments need to be made.
  • Conferring with network users about solving existing system problems.
  • Operating master consoles to monitor the performance of networks and computer systems.
  • Coordinating computer network access and use.
  • Designing, configuring and testing networking software, computer hardware, and operating system software.
  • Perform network maintenance and system upgrades including service packs, patches, hot fixes and security configurations
  • Monitor performance and ensure system availability and reliability
  • Monitor system resource utilization, trending, and capacity planning
  • Provide Level-2/3 support and troubleshooting to resolve issues
  • Work within established configuration and change management policies to ensure awareness, approval and success of changes made to the network infrastructure
  • Select and implement security tools, policies, and procedures in conjunction with the company's security team


Network Engineer Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in information technology or a related field of study with a network engineering focus or relevant work experience.
  • CCNP or higher (CCIE and/or CISSP highly valued)

  • Strong understanding of network architecture and design
  • Deep understanding of networking protocols (e.g., IPSEC, HSRP, BGP, OSPF, 802.11, QoS)
  • Solid understanding of the OSI or TCP/IP model
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring, network diagnostic and network analytics tools
  • Strong understanding of network infrastructure and network hardware.
  • Ability to think through problems and visualize solutions.
  • Ability to implement, administer, and troubleshoot network infrastructure devices, including wireless access points, firewall, routers, switches, controllers.
  • Knowledge of application transport and network infrastructure protocols.
  • Ability to create accurate network diagrams and documentation for design and planning network communication systems.
  • Provides specific detailed information for hardware and software selection.
  • Ability to quickly learn new or unfamiliar technology and products using documentation and internet resources.
  • Ability to work with all levels of staff within and outside of IT and outside the organization.

  • Network security experience.
  • LAN and WAN experience.

  • Cisco Focus Controllers
  • Wireless background

descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Central Ohio, we’re a privately-owned, independent healthcare navigation organization. We believe that no one should have to navigate the cost and complexity of healthcare alone, and we’re on a mission to make healthcare simpler and more effective for our millions of members. Our big-hearted, tech-savvy team fights to ensure that our members get the care they need, when they need it, at the most affordable cost – that’s why we call ourselves Healthcare Warriors®.

We’re committed to building diverse and inclusive teams – more than 2,000 of us and counting – so if you’re excited about this position, we encourage you to apply – even if your experience doesn’t match every requirement.

About The Role

As a Senior Network Engineer at Quantum Health, you’ll help design, secure, and evolve the network infrastructure behind an organization that millions of members depend on.

You’ll work hands-on with Arista EOS, spine-leaf architecture, Arista CloudVision, Palo Alto firewalls, Strata Cloud Manager, routing, VPNs, and cloud connectivity while leading complex projects and serving as an escalation point when the toughest problems show up.

You’ll also help set technical standards, mentor other engineers, strengthen automation, and continuously improve the reliability, security, and visibility of our network.

If you enjoy solving difficult infrastructure problems and building networks that are secure, resilient, and ready to scale, we’d love to meet you.

Location: Work remotely anywhere in the United States or hybrid from our Dublin, Ohio campus.

What You'll Do (Essential Responsibilities)

  • Build for reliability. Design, configure, and support enterprise switching environments using Arista EOS and spine-leaf architecture.
  • Own the network fabric. Support MLAG, VLANs, VRFs, segmentation, high availability, and routing across complex data center environments.
  • Put CloudVision to work. Use Arista CloudVision for configuration management, compliance, upgrades, telemetry, provisioning, and change validation.
  • Strengthen network security. Configure and optimize Palo Alto firewalls, including security policies, NAT, App-ID, User-ID, URL filtering, threat prevention, GlobalProtect, IPsec VPN, and Strata Cloud Manager.
  • Solve the tough problems. Lead troubleshooting across Layer 2/3, BGP, OSPF, VPNs, firewalls, routing, application connectivity, performance issues, and security events.
  • Lead high-impact change. Support segmentation, firewall and data center migrations, circuit turn-ups, hardware refreshes, cloud connectivity, and other network initiatives.
  • Raise the technical bar. Develop standards, diagrams, implementation plans, operational procedures, validation plans, and troubleshooting documentation while mentoring other network engineers.
  • Keep making the network better. Identify opportunities to improve reliability, observability, security, automation, performance, and operational maturity.
  • All other duties assigned

What You'll Bring (Qualifications)

  • Education: A bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience: 5+ years of hands-on network engineering experience, ideally including significant enterprise firewall and data center networking responsibility.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Arista EOS and CloudVision, including modern spine-leaf environments.
  • Experience configuring and supporting Palo Alto firewalls and Strata Cloud Manager.
  • Deep understanding of BGP, OSPF, VLANs, VRFs, MLAG, NAT, VPNs, segmentation, high availability, and enterprise routing.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex network, application-connectivity, firewall, VPN, routing, and performance issues.
  • Experience planning and executing network changes with clear risk analysis, implementation, validation, and backout procedures.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills, with the ability to partner across Security, Cloud, Systems, Applications, Service Desk, and external vendors.
  • A high level of accountability and commitment to protecting the sensitive information entrusted to Quantum Health.

Preferred Qualifications

  • You have experience with VXLAN/EVPN in an Arista environment.
  • You’ve worked with Prisma Access, GlobalProtect, or other cloud-delivered security technologies.
  • You’ve automated network tasks using Python, Ansible, APIs, or CloudVision workflows.
  • You have experience with monitoring and ITSM tools such as Grafana, LibreNMS, PRTG, ServiceNow, or Jira.
  • You hold certifications such as Palo Alto PCNSE/PCNSA, Arista ACE, CCNP Enterprise, CCNP Security, CCIE, Network+, or Security+.

What’s In It For You

  • Compensation: Competitive base and incentive compensation
  • Coverage: Health, vision and dental featuring our best-in-class healthcare navigation services, along with life insurance, legal and identity protection, adoption assistance, EAP, Teladoc services and more.
  • Retirement: 401(k) plan with up to 4% employer match and full vesting on day one.
  • Balance: Paid Time Off (PTO), 7 paid holidays, parental leave, volunteer days, paid sabbaticals, and more.
  • Development: Tuition reimbursement up to $5,250 annually, certification/continuing education reimbursement, discounted higher education partnerships, paid trainings and leadership development.
  • Culture: Recognition as a Best Place to Work for 15+ years, dedication to diversity, philanthropy and sustainability, and people-first values that drive every decision.
  • Environment: A modern workplace with a casual dress code, open floor plans, full-service dining, free snacks and drinks, complimentary 24/7 fitness center with group classes, outdoor walking paths, game room, notary and dry-cleaning services and more!

What You Should Know

  • Internal Associates: Already a Healthcare Warrior? Apply internally through Lever
  • Process: Application > Recruiter Video Interview > Online Assessment(s) > Interview(s) > Offer > Background Check.
  • Diversity, Equity and Inclusion: Quantum Health welcomes everyone. We value our diverse team and suppliers, we’re committed to empowering our ERGs, and we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer .
  • Tobacco-Free Campus: To further enable the health and wellbeing of our associates and community, Quantum Health maintains a tobacco-free environment. The use of all types of tobacco products is prohibited in all company facilities and on all company grounds.
  • Compensation Ranges: Compensation details published by job boards are estimates and not verified by Quantum Health. Details surrounding compensation will be disclosed throughout the interview process. Compensation offered is based on the candidate’s unique combination of experience and qualifications related to the position.
  • Sponsorship: Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a permanent and ongoing future basis without requiring sponsorship.
  • Agencies: Quantum Health does not accept unsolicited resumes or outreach from third-parties. Absent a signed MSA and request/approval from Talent Acquisition to submit candidates for a specific requisition, we will not approve payment to any third party.

Reasonable Accommodation

Should you require reasonable accommodation(s) to participate in the application/interview/selection process, or in order to complete the essential duties of the position upon acceptance of a job offer, click here to submit a recruitment accommodation request.

Recruiting Scams

Unfortunately, scams targeting job seekers are common. To protect our candidates, we want to remind you that authorized representatives of Quantum Health will only contact you from an email address ending in @quantum-health.com. Quantum Health will never ask for personally identifiable information such as Date of Birth (DOB), Social Security Number (SSN), banking/direct/tax details, etc. via email or any other non-secure system, nor will we instruct you to make any purchases related to your employment. If you believe you’ve encountered a recruiting scam, report it to the Federal Trade Commission and your state’s Attorney General .

If you are a California resident, Quantum Health may collect personal information in connection with your application for employment and, if hired, during the course of your employment. The categories of personal information collected and the purposes for which that information is used are described in our California Employee and Job Applicant Notice of Collection of Personal Information.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. descriptionHtml:
MANTECH seeks a motivated, career and customer-oriented Lead Network Engineer, Centrix to join our team in Doral, FL.

Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To

  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior IT staff and help desk technicians, establishing best practices for daily operations.
  • Designing, deploying, configuring, and maintaining enterprise network infrastructure supporting CENTRIXS Combined Federated Server/Combined (CFS/C) capabilities.
  • Managing enterprise routers, switches, firewalls, network crypto devices, and cross-domain coalition network architectures.
  • Troubleshooting complex network routing, switching protocols, coalition data flows, and hardware connectivity issues.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional technical teams, coalition partners, and leadership to ensure secure multinational network interoperability.
  • Conducting routine network maintenance, firmware upgrades, vulnerability patching, and configuration management controls.
  • Maintaining system baselines, configuration management records, and engineering documentation across CENTRIXS network nodes.
  • Recommending and implementing continuous engineering process improvements to enhance coalition network performance and security compliance.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Network Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field with 7+ years of experience in enterprise network engineering.
    • OR a master’s degree and 5+ or more years of relevant experience
    • OR an associate’s degree and 9+ or more years of relevant experience
    • OR a high school diploma and 11+ or more years of relevant experience
  • Proven experience configuring, administering, and troubleshooting CENTRIXS network systems, coalition WAN/LAN environments, or cross-domain networks.
  • Strong background in enterprise routing/switching protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP), VPNs, firewalls, and network access control.
  • Experience maintaining network baselines, baseline documentation controls, and security patch deployment schedules.
  • Experience creating, maintaining, and communicating complex technical engineering documentation and coalition network topology diagrams.
Preferred Qualifications

  • Relevant professional certifications such as Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP Enterprise/Security), or CompTIA Security+.

Job Summary

Galapagos Federal Systems LLC is seeking a highly qualified and motivated Network Engineer to support the Mission System Research and Development requirement at the Blossom Point Satellite Command and Tracking Facility (BPTF).

In this critical role, the Network Engineer will provide technical expertise in the administration, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of network infrastructure supporting multi-mission enclave operational environments. The successful candidate will ensure reliable Local Area Network (LAN) and Wide Area Network (WAN) connectivity between mission systems, Government satellite operations remote ground entry points, and commercial vendor ground entry points supporting antenna access networks.

The ideal candidate will possess hands-on experience with network hardware, software, protocols, and security within complex client/server environments. This individual will demonstrate strong technical troubleshooting capabilities, attention to detail, and the ability to maintain secure, reliable network operations supporting mission-critical satellite command-and-control activities.

Key Responsibilities

The Network Engineer will

  • Administer, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot LAN and WAN infrastructure supporting multi-mission enclave operational environments
  • Support reliable network connectivity between Government satellite operations remote ground entry points, commercial vendor ground entry points, and associated antenna access networks
  • Install, configure, maintain, and upgrade network hardware, software, and associated systems to support operational requirements
  • Monitor network performance, connectivity, and system availability to identify and resolve technical issues affecting mission operations
  • Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve mission-unique LAN/WAN service disruptions, network connectivity issues, and system performance problems
  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot network infrastructure components, including servers, modems, switches, firewalls, and routers
  • Apply Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol (TCP/IP) networking principles to support network configuration, troubleshooting, and operational performance
  • Support network security practices and procedures to maintain the integrity, availability, and reliability of mission-critical network environments
  • Perform network software updates, configuration changes, and system upgrades in accordance with operational requirements and established procedures
  • Collaborate with network administrators, systems engineers, satellite operations personnel, and other technical stakeholders to resolve network-related issues and maintain mission continuity
  • Assist in identifying network performance deficiencies, connectivity risks, and opportunities for infrastructure improvements
  • Maintain accurate technical documentation, network configurations, troubleshooting records, and operational procedures
  • Provide technical support and recommendations to address network infrastructure requirements and operational challenges
  • Communicate network status, technical findings, and recommended corrective actions to appropriate stakeholders
  • Demonstrate strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and responsiveness when supporting mission-critical network operations


Skills And Experience

The Network Engineer must have

  • Active Top Secret/Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) security clearance
  • 3+ years of professional experience performing Network Engineer responsibilities within a multi-platform environment
  • Thorough knowledge of network protocols, particularly Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol (TCP/IP), and their application within complex network environments
  • Demonstrated experience supporting multi-mission enclave operational environments
  • Working knowledge of LAN/WAN administration, including connectivity to Government satellite operations remote ground entry points and commercial vendor ground entry points supporting antenna access networks
  • Experience administering, maintaining, and troubleshooting network hardware, software, protocols, and network security within client/server environments
  • Working knowledge of network infrastructure components, including servers, modems, switches, firewalls, and routers
  • Demonstrated ability to diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve mission-unique LAN/WAN connectivity and service issues
  • Experience installing, configuring, maintaining, and upgrading software on network systems
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify technical issues and implement effective corrective actions
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple technical priorities in mission-critical environments
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams, Government personnel, and mission stakeholders
  • Demonstrated commitment to customer service, operational reliability, and mission success


Education and Certifications

Required Education

The Network Engineer must meet the following

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Management Information Systems (MIS), Computer Science, or a related technical discipline; OR
  • Equivalent military technical school training in a relevant Navy Enlisted Classification (NEC), Military Occupational Specialty (MOS), or Air Force Specialty Code (AFSC), plus a minimum of two (2) years of relevant systems experience
  • Possession of a current, qualifying computer or network-related certification satisfying the applicable DoD Manual 8140.03 qualification requirements, as specified for the position


Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • 401(k)
  • PTO
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Military Differential
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Paid federal holidays


Security Clearance

Must be a U.S. Citizen. A high-level Department of War active security clearance is/may be required. Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to government information.

Physical Requirements

Work may involve sitting or standing for extended periods of time and typing and reading from a computer screen. The candidate must have enough mobility, including bending, reaching, and kneeling, to complete daily duties in a prompt and efficient manner, and that may include lifting up to thirty pounds, as necessary.

We deliver professional services in IT Design & Installation, Cybersecurity Engineering & Support, Application Integration & Development, Software & Hardware Engineering, Network & Systems Management, Information Systems Security, and Business Management Services.

Leveraging over 30 years of providing IT services to the federal & commercial market with projects found around the world, our team has innovative expertise in the development of a wide range of technological solutions. Galapagos Federal Systems, LLC is an equal opportunity employer.

Our service commitment is simple - "Quality IT Solutions... On Time & On Budget."

("SONIFI"​) is the leader in innovative guest experience and engagement solutions for the hospitality and healthcare industries - serving 500 million travelers in over one million hotel rooms annually. Core services include internet services, streaming, interactive television, and free-to-guest solutions along with unparalleled nationwide technical support and professional services.

descriptionHtml:
SONIFI is known around the world as the best guest technology provider in hospitality, and it’s all because of the people behind the technology. For more than 45 years, SONIFI has been where employees thrive on collaboration and curiosity, helping hotels solve challenges with patented innovations that shape technology experiences for staff, guests, and the best companies in the industry. For the next step in your career, it’s time to set a new standard with SONIFI.

Help shape the future of hospitality technology by designing, configuring, and supporting the networks that keep hotels and their guests connected. We’re looking for a Network Engineer with a strong foundation in wired and wireless networking who enjoys tackling technical challenges across all layers of the OSI/TCP models. This role combines network implementation, remote configuration and troubleshooting, customer support, and continued exposure to evolving wired and wireless technologies.

What You'll Do

As a Network Engineer, you’ll provide full-stack network configuration engineering with focused attention on wireless configurations and optimizations while supporting network solutions throughout the customer lifecycle.

  • Implement network solutions including Wi-Fi, Ethernet, PON, and G.HN, along with IP addressing schemes, RF channel plans, and proposals to provide accurate services.
  • Produce accurate installation documents and design information generated through the site survey and installation processes.
  • Conduct remote configuration and troubleshooting of networks at customer sites during the deployment phase of projects.
  • Configure network components including switches, firewalls, and user experience gateways.
  • Stay current on new technologies supporting the deployment of wired and wireless Internet access.
  • Provide pre-sales, installation, and post-sales network engineering support as needed.
  • Travel occasionally when necessary to perform essential job functions or attend training.

What You'll Need

We’re looking for a Network Engineer who can troubleshoot across wired and wireless environments, communicate technical concepts clearly, and successfully manage project responsibilities with minimal supervision.

  • Proficiency with WLAN, LAN, WAN, TCP/IP addressing and subnetting, along with network diagnostics and troubleshooting.
  • Strong oral, written, and electronic communication skills, along with organizational, multitasking, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to complete milestones and meet project deadlines with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to clearly communicate technical concepts to nontechnical employees and translate nontechnical business and user requirements into technical specifications.

Preferred

  • A two or four-year technical degree and two years of relevant experience, although an equivalent combination of education and experience will also be considered.
  • Experience in customer-facing integration roles and installation support.
  • Experience with Wi-Fi 802.11 technologies.
  • Experience with UNIX, Microsoft Office, Microsoft Visio, and Wi-Fi tools such as Ekahau.
  • CWNA, ECSE, RCWA, RCNI, ACA-Campus Access, ACSA, or the ability to obtain relevant certifications.

Together, we can build your future!

SONIFI offers a competitive compensation package based on factors including location, experience, education, specialty, and training. Compensation for this position generally ranges from $60,000 to $100,000 annually. This position is also eligible for PTO, holidays, health, dental, vision, retirement plans, pet insurance, on-demand pay, and other benefits.

SONIFI and SONIFI Health value diversity and are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will be considered regardless of age, race, color, national origin, sex, religion, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any protected status.

If you require assistance with the online application due to a disability, please contact Human Resources at 605-988-1000.

SONIFI participates in E-Verify to confirm authorization to work in the United States.

It’s not everyday that you consider starting a new career. We’re RingCentral, and we’re happy that someone as talented as you is considering this role. First, a little about us, we’re a $2 Billion annual revenue company with double digit Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) and a $93 Billion market opportunity in UCaaS, Contact Center and AI-powered adjacencies. We invest more than $250 million annually to ensure our AI-enabled technology and platforms meet or exceed the needs of our customers.

RingSense AI is our proprietary AI solution. It’s designed to fit the business needs of our customers, orchestrated to be accurate and precise, and built on the same open platform principles we apply to our core software solutions.

This is where you and your skills come in. We’re currently looking for Senior Network Engineer, NetOPS Infrastructure

Our data centers carry real-time voice, video, and messaging for customers worldwide. When a call degrades, someone notices immediately. Our availability target is 99.999%, and we hold it.

You'll join an infrastructure team that owns routers, switches, firewalls, and load balancers across our global data center footprint. This is production infrastructure.

The NetOPS Infra team spans the US, EU, and India. Because we're distributed across time zones, coverage follows the sun: you work your own business hours, five days a week. No night shifts. Occasional weekend work during planned maintenance windows, and that's rare.

Job Duties:


  • Troubleshoot production issues end to end — from the routing table through the firewall policy down into the Linux network stack on the host
  • Handle the operational work that keeps five nines real: firewall access changes, patching, config reviews, capacity checks
  • Deliver infrastructure projects — hardware refresh and replacement, platform migrations, new DC capacity
  • Work directly with platform and application teams instead of handing tickets across a wall
  • Support Lab, Stage, and Regression alongside production


To succeed in this role you must have experience in:


  • 3+ years running production networks — ISP, enterprise, or data center
  • Real depth in TCP/IP. You should be able to explain why BGP picked that path and what a packet capture is actually telling you, not just configure the feature
  • Routing and switching in practice: OSPF, iBGP/eBGP, VRFs, PBR, STP/RSTP, VRRP, link aggregation
  • Tunneling: GRE, IPIP, IPSec
  • Firewalls, both vendor platforms and iptables / firewall
  • Strong Linux, including the network stack — interfaces, routing tables, netfilter, socket state, tcpdump. This is what separates a good troubleshooter from a config engineer
  • Enough server-side context (bare metal, hypervisors, containers) to follow a problem past the switch port
  • Hands-on Juniper experience across routing, switching, and security platforms


Nice to have


  • EVPN/VXLAN, MC-LAG, ECMP, MPLS
  • High availability and clustering
  • Load balancing (A10, F5, IPVS)
  • Scripting for your own workflows — Bash, Python, NETCONF, PyEZ, Ansible
  • Cloud networking
  • NetBox, Zabbix, VictoriaMetrics, Grafana
  • You'll sit in an infrastructure team, not automation — but if you like writing scripts to make your own work easier, you'll be in good company.


Working with AI

We're an AI-forward engineering org, and we mean it operationally. Engineers get free access to AI assistants under our company usage policies, and we expect them to be part of your daily workflow — config review, log analysis, scripting, documentation.

What we care about:


  • You've used AI assistants on real engineering work, not just tried them
  • You can scope a prompt well and iterate when the first answer is wrong
  • You verify before you trust. Confidently wrong output is the failure mode that matters in production. Validate against docs and lab testing
  • You follow data-handling policy on what goes into external tools


Why this team

Global scale, real-time traffic, and an availability bar that makes the work interesting. You'll own systems rather than tickets, and there's a strong automation and tooling practice next door if you want to move that way later.

If most of this fits and some of it doesn't, apply anyway.

What we offer:


  • Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance
  • Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Account (FSAs) and Commuter benefits
  • Voluntary supplemental health coverage and life insurance
  • 401K match and ESPP
  • Paid time off and paid sick leave
  • Paid parental and pregnancy leave
  • Family-forming benefits (IVF, Preservation, Adoption etc.)
  • Emergency backup care (Child/Adult/Pets)
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with counseling sessions available 24/7
  • Free legal services that provide legal advice, document creation and estate planning
  • Employee bonus referral program
  • Student loan refinancing assistance
  • Employee 1:1 coaching, perks and discounts program


RingCentral’s IT team ensures company data is accessible, secure, and optimized in ways that provide maximum competitive advantage. We are constantly discovering, developing and deploying innovations that power productivity and drive better decisions for our customers. Our IT professionals are talented, ambitious, out-of-the-box thinkers who love to learn on the job—planning, deploying and maintaining state-of-the-art technology to deliver flawless performance 24/7/365.

RingCentral’s work culture is the backbone of our success. And don’t just take our word for it: we are recognized as a Best Place to Work by Glassdoor, the Top Work Culture by Comparably and hold local BPTW awards in every major location. Bottom line: We are committed to hiring and retaining great people because we know you power our success.

About RingCentral

RingCentral, Inc. (NYSE: RNG) is a leading provider of business cloud communications and contact center solutions based on its powerful Message Video Phone™  (MVP™) global platform. More flexible and cost effective than legacy on-premises PBX and video conferencing systems that it replaces, RingCentral® empowers modern mobile and distributed workforces to communicate, collaborate, and connect via any mode, any device, and any location. RingCentral is headquartered in Belmont, California, and has offices around the world.

RingCentral is an equal opportunity employer that truly values diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

If you are hired in Belmont, CA, the compensation range for this position is between $136,100 and $166,000 for full-time employees, in addition to eligibility for variable pay, equity, and benefits. Benefits may include, but are not limited to, health and wellness, 401k, ESPP, vacation, parental leave, and more! The salary may vary depending on your location, skills, and experience.

descriptionHtml:
Summary:
The Senior Engineer, Network is responsible for the implementation and support of network infrastructure, including LAN, WAN, WLAN and SDWAN to support critical healthcare operations across The Guthrie Clinic (TGC). This role ensures high availability and performance for clinical systems, patient care services, and administrative functions across the hospital network. The Sr. Engineer collaborates with IT teams, vendors, and hospital stakeholders to align network solutions with organizational goals and regulatory requirements. This position will be a technology advocate throughout the organization for the effective application of technology to meet business needs and to support business changes and growth. Technology functions include network infrastructure, architecture and protocols (routers, switches, wireless controllers, access points, firewalls, network appliances), network automation and operations, patch management, application delivery, monitoring and cloud computing.

Experience:
1. Preferred five to seven (5 to 7) years of experience in implementing and managing complex network infrastructure in an enterprise environment; healthcare experience preferred.
2. Highly experienced information systems professional with a strong technical background and proven track record of accomplishments in a large, complex multi-level organization.
3. Experience in network protocols (e.g., TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, MPLS) and technologies (e.g., Cisco, Extreme, Palo Alto).
4. Proficiency in network security tools (e.g., firewalls, IDS/IPS, NAC).
5. Experience with software-defined networking (SDN) and cloud-based network solutions (e.g., AWS, Azure).
6. Knowledge of Azure networking services (e.g., MS Azure VNET, ExpressRoute, vWAN, etc.)
7. Proficient with monitoring and logging tools for access management and troubleshooting using such tools as Syslog, ACS, Netflow, Solarwinds and protocol analyzers.
8. Knowledge of network security and encryption standards.
9. Advanced troubleshooting skills.
10. Ability to work with network security devices such as Palo Alto, Cisco ASA.
11. Experience with ITSM functionalities such as change control, CMDB and ticketing systems.
12. Strong knowledge of healthcare information systems (e.g., Epic, Cerner), cybersecurity and clinical operations.
13. Prior experience delivering high availability systems in a 24/7 environment across geographically dispersed business units.
14. Demonstrated ability to facilitate evaluation of technologies and achieve consensus on technical standards and solutions among a diverse group of information technology professionals.
15. Demonstrated commitment to customer service who has provided responsive and effective support, developed solid working relationships with customers, and delivered high quality, value-added services that met/exceeded customer expectations.
- Equally adept at developing technology strategies and the operation of existing technical infrastructures. Significant experience and knowledge of computing architecture and implementation of networked computing structures.
1. Polished professional with demonstrated information technology experience and strong communication skills that can rapidly gain and maintain credibility with customers and IT colleagues.
Education:
1. Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Healthcare Administration or related field strongly desired or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Licenses/Certifications:
1. Preferred certifications include CCNP, CCIE, CISSP
Essential Functions:
- Responsible for installation and maintenance of network devices.
- Monitors functions of network devices to ensure acceptable performance.
- Creates and maintains documentation related to network configuration and network topologies.
- Serves as subject matter expert across network technologies and solutions supporting LAN, WAN, WLAN and SDWAN.
- Troubleshoots and resolves LAN, WAN, WLAN and SDWAN incidents.
- Collaborate with network architect to design and build functional networks.
- Provide level 3 escalation support and troubleshooting to resolve complex network incidents and tasks.
- Mentors team members designing and building technical solutions.
- Anticipates and provides solutions for complex problems and issues, recommends upgrades and enhancements. Rapidly absorbs complex technical and conceptual information to identify issues and implications. Able to present understandable alternatives to both technical and non-technical individuals at all levels of the organization.
- Monitors industry trends, maintains knowledge of developments in network infrastructure, architecture and protocols, network automation and operations, patch management, application delivery, monitoring and cloud computing.
- Maintain current working knowledge of IT best practices and innovative solutions within both healthcare and industry. Identifies leading edge technologies for potential early adoption that will result in service differentiation and create competitive advantage. Collaborates with other TGC IT departments, TGC management and business leaders assisting in the evaluation and validation of emerging technologies. Identifies strategies to mitigate risk associated with leading edge technologies.
- Promotes the use of TGC’s PMO methodology and standards to manage IT initiatives.
- Demonstrates commitment to customer service by providing responsive and effective support, developing solid working relationships with customers and IT colleagues, and delivering high quality, value-added services that exceed customer expectations.
- Demonstrates a commitment to excellence in Customer Service with all internal and external customers of TGC.
- Willingness to travel between sites in the TGC Pennsylvania/New York regional footprint (Sayre, Towanda, Troy, Corning, Cortland, Binghamton, etc.)
- Performs related duties as assigned and unrelated duties as requested.

Other Duties: Other duties as assigned

Winston Taylor is a transatlantic law firm built for the businesses, people, and markets driving capital and innovation. Here, you're in the room. In the action. Sleeves rolled up.

You'll be trusted with real responsibility from the outset and build experience through hands-on work. We take your progression personally. We provide the platform. You shape the work around your goals and aspirations.

Step into the moments that matter. Join Winston Taylor.

Position Summary

The Network Engineer is responsible for designing, maintaining, and continuously improving the firm’s global network infrastructure to ensure secure, highly available, and scalable connectivity across offices, data centers, cloud platforms, and remote access environments. This role supports enterprise-class data centers, Azure cloud compute, Cisco and Palo Alto firewalls, switching, routing, VoIP, Microsoft Teams, SSL tunnels and VPN, wireless and wired connectivity, and Aruba SD-WAN. Success in this role requires operational excellence, disciplined change management, strong troubleshooting capability, and a forward-looking approach to automation, resiliency, security, mobility, and global growth.

Position Responsibilities

  • Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot network-related hardware, software, and connectivity services across the firm’s global environment.
  • Perform network maintenance and system upgrades, patches, hot fixes, firmware updates, and security configurations.
  • Monitor network performance, availability, capacity, and reliability, and proactively address issues that may affect service continuity.
  • Improve the efficiency, automation, resiliency, and security of network services across on-premises infrastructure and Azure environments.
  • Follow established configuration, change management, and documentation standards to ensure changes are approved, communicated, successful, and supportable.
  • Partner with the security team to select, implement, and maintain network security tools, policies, and procedures.

Experience, Skills, And Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED with a compTIA Network+ Certification or Bachelors Degree in a Computer Science discipline required.
  • 3+ years of information technology network experience with configuration of LAN,
  • WAN, and Internet protocol technologies are required.
  • Ability to work outside of standard business hours, and travel to various firm business locations as required
  • Must live within commutable distance to local office and come in 3-4 days per week.
  • Ability to lift 50lbs
  • CCNA certification preferred.
  • Azure Administrator certification preferred.
  • Solid understanding of the OSI and TCP/IP models.
  • Ability to troubleshoot issues related to the installation, configuration, performance, and maintenance of network systems.
  • Experience with network automation concepts
  • Strong knowledge and experience configuring and maintaining Cisco routers, switches, VoIP, QoS, wireless standards, DHCP, IPsec and VPN tunnels, data cabling, SDWan, network management tools, and high-availability, disaster-ready environments.
  • Working knowledge of networking concepts, LAN/WAN/Security design considerations, and interoperability with server and virtualization technologies.
  • Understanding of a micro-segmentation.
  • Experience with Palo Alto firewalls and VPN solutions.
  • Understanding Zero Trust architectures and solutions.
  • Experience coding in Ansible, Powershell, Python or similar languages.

Proposes recommendations based on research, including identifying areas for improvement and which options will have a significant impact on technology direction.

Requires a bachelor's degree preferably in computer science, information technology or a related field or equivalent experience plus six years of experience. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Must have expert knowledge in one or more of the following areas: computer networking, cloud computing, disaster recovery, data warehouse architecture, programming/scripting languages, change management principles, automation, computing, networking, and database systems.

Must be able to work effectively with staff.

Able to lead user technical support, hardware and software support, technical problem solving, software development, technology evaluation, and information security.

Requires a bachelor's degree, preferably in computer science, information technology or a related field or equivalent experience plus eight years of experience. Leads highly complex efforts. Works with a high degree of independence under the guidance of the manager; is self-directing, with no technical, and little business or management guidance needed from the manager. Suggests new initiatives. Plans, designs, and carries out programs, projects, studies, and other work independently. Responsible for handling most problems and coordinating with others. Directs tasks for lower-level staff.

Remarks

The Senior Network Engineer is a member of the IT Network Infrastructure (NI) team, responsible for supporting the stability, performance, and security of the Board's enterprise and data center network infrastructure. This role provides engineering expertise in the design, implementation, and operation of complex network systems across hybrid infrastructure.

The position supports and maintains Cisco based environments, including Catalyst and Nexus platforms, wireless networks, ISE, and IPS. The engineer ensures high availability and operation reliability across switching, routing, firewall, wireless and optical infrastructure, while contributing to network design, modernization, and continuous improvement efforts. Advanced experience in BGP, OSPF, STP, VXLAN, and network design is essential.

Preferred candidates will also have experience with technologies such as AWS networking, Cisco DNA, Zscaler, and Cisco Wireless. Certification such as CCNP or CCIE, or equivalent, is highly desirable.

Highly Desirable

  • Expert level, hands-on experience with BGP, OSPF and VXLANs in production environments including route design, policy control, traffic engineering and failover scenarios.
  • Extensive experience configuring, deploying, and supporting enterprise and data center networks, particularly Cisco Nexus and Catalyst platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex routing and switching initiatives, including architecture, design, deployment, and optimization.
  • Strong problem solving and analytical skills, with the ability to prevent outages and improve network reliability.
  • Deep expertise in TCP/IP and packet level troubleshooting (PCAP/Wireshark analysis).
  • Experience managing hybrid network environments, including on-premises and cloud-based infrastructure.
  • Ability to develop and implement network designs focused on scalability, resiliency, and fault tolerance.
  • Familiarity with cloud and modern networking technologies such as AWS networking, Cisco DNA, and Zscaler.
  • Experience with network monitoring and observability tools, including performance analysis, capacity planning, and proactive issue detection. Familiarity with network automation and AIOps concepts leveraging scripting, and telemetry to optimize network performance and reliability.
  • Experience developing technical documentation and presenting complex technical information clearly and concisely.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams and build productive working relationships to achieve mission objectives.
  • Demonstrated initiative, learning agility, and commitment to continuous professional development.
  • Industry certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, or equivalent.

This role entails participating in on-call rotations, including some night and weekend shifts according to rotation schedules and ad hoc requirements. US Citizenship is required. This position requires an in-office presence in Washington, DC.

descriptionHtml:
JMARK is a leading provider of managed IT services, cybersecurity solutions, cloud technologies, and strategic IT consulting. Founded on the principle of People First. Technology Second., JMARK partners with businesses to transform technology into a true driver of growth, resilience, and competitive advantage.

With a focus on proactive strategies, exceptional customer experience, and business value, JMARK helps organizations reduce risks, increase efficiency, and plan for the future. Our team combines technical expertise with a people-centric approach, ensuring that every solution aligns with client goals, culture, and long-term success.

At the heart of JMARK’s philosophy are our core values:

  • Honesty – honoring commitments and building trust
  • Passion – loving what we do and where we do it
  • Teamwork – working together to prevent problems and create solutions
  • Excellence – exceeding expectations through initiative and follow-through
  • Accountability – doing what we say we will do
  • Fun – celebrating success and enjoying the journey

For more than three decades, JMARK has served as a trusted IT partner across industries, helping businesses thrive with secure, reliable, and future-ready technology solutions.

Take Your Networking Expertise to the Next Level with JMARK!

Are you an experienced Network Engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, building secure and reliable networks, and making a real impact on business operations?

JMARK is looking for a Network Engineer III to join our Tulsa team! In this role, you'll have the opportunity to work primarily with one of our large banking clients, supporting and improving the network infrastructure that keeps their business running.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys getting hands-on with advanced networking technologies, troubleshooting complex issues, and taking ownership of critical infrastructure in an environment where reliability, security, and performance matter.

While experience working in banking or financial services would certainly be beneficial, previous banking experience is not required. We're more interested in finding a talented engineer who understands complex network environments, takes pride in their work, and enjoys being part of a collaborative team.

What You'll Be Doing

As a Network Engineer III, you'll serve as a senior technical resource responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, securing, and improving complex network environments. You'll work closely with other JMARK engineers, technical teams, and client stakeholders to ensure network infrastructure is performing at its best.

Your Responsibilities Will Include

  • Network Infrastructure Management: Configure, maintain, troubleshoot, and optimize enterprise network environments, including switches, routers, firewalls, VPNs, and other critical networking technologies.
  • Advanced Troubleshooting: Serve as an escalation point for complex network issues, identifying root causes and implementing long-term solutions that improve reliability and performance.
  • Network Security: Support and maintain secure network infrastructure, including firewalls, intrusion prevention systems, secure remote access, and network security best practices.
  • Routing and Switching: Configure and troubleshoot advanced networking technologies, including VLANs, spanning tree, routing protocols, and network segmentation.
  • Proactive Network Management: Monitor network health, identify potential issues before they become major problems, and recommend improvements to strengthen performance, security, and availability.
  • Project Implementation: Participate in network infrastructure projects, including upgrades, deployments, migrations, and technology improvements from planning through implementation.
  • Documentation and Collaboration: Maintain accurate technical documentation, communicate effectively with internal teams and client stakeholders, and ensure service activities are properly recorded.
  • Technical Leadership: Share knowledge, mentor other engineers, and serve as a trusted technical resource when challenging networking issues arise.
  • Client Experience: Provide professional, responsive support while translating technical challenges into practical solutions that support business operations.
  • Critical Systems Support: Assist with resolving high-priority incidents and participate in an assigned on-call rotation to support business-critical systems.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who brings strong technical expertise, excellent troubleshooting abilities, and a proactive approach to managing network infrastructure.

Technical Skills And Experience

  • Approximately 3–5 years or more of relevant network engineering experience, or demonstrated equivalent technical expertise.
  • Advanced knowledge of enterprise networking technologies, including LAN, WAN, routing, switching, and network security.
  • Strong experience configuring and troubleshooting Cisco networking equipment or comparable enterprise networking technologies.
  • Experience with routing protocols such as OSPF, BGP, and EIGRP.
  • Advanced understanding of VLANs, STP, network segmentation, TCP/IP, subnetting, and IPv4/IPv6.
  • Experience implementing, administering, and troubleshooting firewalls, VPNs, and secure network connectivity.
  • Familiarity with Cisco ASA, Fortinet, or similar enterprise firewall platforms.
  • Experience utilizing network monitoring and troubleshooting tools such as Wireshark, SSH, and other network management platforms.
  • Understanding of network security principles, access controls, intrusion prevention, and vulnerability mitigation.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex network issues in environments where uptime and reliability are critical.
  • Ability to document network configurations, technical solutions, and troubleshooting activities clearly and accurately.

Experience That Would Be a Plus

  • Previous experience supporting banking, financial services, or other highly regulated industries.
  • Experience supporting large, multisite enterprise networks.
  • Familiarity with Cisco Firepower, FMC/FTD, or other next-generation firewall technologies.
  • Experience working within a Managed Services Provider (MSP) environment.
  • Knowledge of network redundancy, disaster recovery, and business continuity planning.
  • Cisco certifications such as CCNA or CCNP, or equivalent industry certifications.
  • Experience working with network monitoring, security logging, or intrusion prevention technologies.

Beyond the Technical Skills

At JMARK, technical ability is important, but how you approach your work and interact with others matters just as much.

The Ideal Candidate Will

  • Be a natural problem solver who enjoys digging into challenging technical issues.
  • Take ownership of problems and follow through until they're resolved.
  • Communicate effectively with both technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Understand the importance of security, reliability, and attention to detail.
  • Work independently while recognizing the value of teamwork and collaboration.
  • Be proactive in identifying opportunities to improve systems and processes.
  • Enjoy learning new technologies and continually expanding their technical expertise.
  • Take pride in delivering an exceptional client experience.

The Pay Range For This Role Is

80,000 - 115,000 USD per year(Tulsa Office)

Join Peloton’s Global Network Services team as a Senior Engineer, sitting at the unique intersection of high-scale enterprise networking and high-stakes media production. In this role, you will architect and support the global infrastructure that powers our corporate offices, warehouses, and flagship New York Broadcast Studio.

Acting as the key bridge between Global Cloud Engineering and Studio Operations, you will deploy highly resilient, scalable architectures that deliver live streaming content seamlessly to millions of members worldwide.

Your Daily Impact

  • Global Architecture & Deployment: Design, optimize, and secure Peloton's global network footprint, integrating Cisco, Meraki, Aruba, and Palo Alto Networks across hybrid on-premises and AWS environments.

  • Studio & Broadcast Reliability: Lead deep-dive traffic analysis and troubleshooting for our NY studio, ensuring 24/7 uptime for live broadcasts, real-time video streaming, and OTT media delivery.

  • Operational Leadership & Lifecycle Management: Manage the end-to-end network project lifecycle—from traffic shaping and SD-WAN optimization to establishing SOPs, security policies (with InfoSec), and handling Tier-3 disaster recovery.

You Bring To Peloton

  • Broad & Deep Network Expertise: 8+ years in Network Engineering, including 6+ years in complex SaaS environments and 4+ years designing public cloud networking (specifically AWS).

JOB SUMMARY:

The Network Engineer III will support the implementation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of enterprise network infrastructure for the program. This role is responsible for ensuring reliable connectivity across LAN/WAN environments while collaborating with senior engineers on network design and optimization. The ideal candidate brings strong networking fundamentals and a hands-on approach to supporting production environments.

SUMMARY OF ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  • Configure and maintain network devices including routers, switches, and firewalls from vendors such as Cisco and Juniper Networks.
  • Monitor network performance and availability, proactively identifying and resolving connectivity, latency, and packet loss issues.
  • Implement and support core networking technologies including VLANs, routing protocols such as OSPF and BGP, and basic network security controls.
  • Troubleshoot network incidents across LAN/WAN environments, performing root cause analysis and documenting resolutions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional IT teams to support network changes, upgrades, and infrastructure projects.
  • Travel to remote locations to lead and perform network installations, independently perform troubleshooting, and provide status updates to program personnel.
  • Support critical activities outside of standard business hours, including evenings and weekends, as needed.
  • Perform additional tasks as required by the program.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Must be a US Citizen and maintain a valid US passport.
  • Must possess a CCNA or JNCIA certification or be willing to attain within 60 days of starting
  • Proven network engineering experience with hands-on knowledge of network design, development, and testing methodologies.
  • Understanding of the OSI Model, TCP/IP, and routing protocols including BGP and OSPF.
  • Experience with network traffic analysis, diagnostics, and troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on firewall experience, specifically with Juniper, Fortinet, and Palo Alto technologies.
  • Experience with UDP multicast, SONET, MSPP, VLANs, GRE tunnels, and TCP/IP network designs.
  • Hands-on experience with multi-vendor switching and routing environments including Juniper and Cisco platforms, WAN optimizers, TACLANEs, and optical transport equipment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with proficiency using Microsoft Office products, especially PowerPoint and Visio.
PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience with Foundation, NSX, vSAN, and Aria technologies.
  • Experience with network automation using Ansible.
  • Understanding of standard DoD security practices including STIG compliance and system accreditation implementation efforts.
  • Prior experience supporting the program.

EDUCATION: Bachelors with  3+ or Master with  1+ Years of Experience

LOCATION: Full Time/ On-Site in Colorado Springs, CO

CLEARANCE REQUIRMENT:  Secret

DOD 8570 REQUIREMENT: IAT - Level II within 30 days of start

SALARY RANGE: $105,000 to $122,500

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to:

  • Remain in a stationary position for extended periods of time.
  • Operate a computer, keyboard, and other office equipment using hands and fingers.
  • Communicate effectively in person, over the phone, and through electronic means.
  • Occasionally move about the office to access files, office equipment, and meeting spaces.
  • Lift and/or move up to 15 pounds as needed.
  • Maintain specific vision abilities, including close vision and the ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

This position is performed within a secure, classified workspace. Employees must comply with all applicable security protocols and access control procedures, including restrictions on personal electronic devices and the handling of sensitive information.

Actual salary will be based on a variety of factors, including location, experience, skill set, performance, licensure and certification, and business needs. The range for this position in other geographic locations may differ. Certain positions may also be eligible for variable incentive compensation, such as bonuses or commissions, that is not included in the base salary.

Estimated Pay Range: $105,000 USD - $122,500 USD

The Perks

  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision plans for you and your dependents
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan with Employer Match, 529 College Savings Plan, Health Savings Account, Life Insurance, and Long-Term Disability
  • Competitive Compensation
  • Training and development programs
  • Major offices stocked with snacks and beverages
  • Collaborative and cool culture
  • Work-life balance and generous paid time off

 

Our Commitment

At the core of Trace3's DNA is our people. We are a diverse group of talented individuals who understand the importance of teamwork and demonstrating leadership, character, and passion in all that we do.

We’re committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to grow. We recognize that embracing diversity drives innovation, improves outcomes, fosters collaboration, boosts teammate satisfaction, and builds a more inclusive culture.

As an equal opportunity employer, Trace3 bases all employment decisions based on individual qualifications, merit, and business requirements. We do not engage in discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including gender identity, sexual orientation, and pregnancy), national origin, age (40 or older), disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

Any demographic information provided is strictly voluntary, kept confidential in accordance with Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) regulations, and will not be used in employment decisions, including hiring, promotions, or mentorship programs. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all.

If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete the application process or participate in an interview, please email recruiting@trace3.com.

JOB SUMMARY:

 

The Network Engineer III serves as a Network Development Engineer supporting the buildout, deployment, and sustainment of network capabilities within the program. This role operates within an agile team environment and is responsible for planning, integrating, and testing network upgrades across operational sites.

 

SUMMARY OF ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

 

  • Support network buildout and deployment activities to operational environments
  • Work within an agile scrum team to plan and execute tasks based on customer and contractual requirements
  • Serve as a primary Network Engineer supporting the program
  • Plan, deploy, integrate, and test network upgrades at operational sites
  • Travel to remote locations to lead and perform network installations such as Guam, Alaska, Europe, etc
  • Perform independent troubleshooting and diagnostics of network systems
  • Provide status updates and reporting to program personnel

 

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 

  • Proven experience as a network engineer with hands-on mid-level experience in network design, development, and testing methodologies
  • Strong understanding of OSI Model, TCP/IP, and routing protocols including BGP and OSPF
  • Experience with network traffic analysis, diagnostics, and troubleshooting
  • Hands-on firewall experience, especially with Juniper, Fortinet, and Palo Alto
  • Experience with UDP multicast, SONET, MSPP, VLANs, GRE tunnels, and TCP/IP network design
  • Experience with multi-vendor switching and routing (Juniper, Cisco)
  • Experience with WAN optimizers, TACLANEs, and optical transport equipment
