descriptionHtml:
About Rocket Lab

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

IT

Rocket Lab’s IT team is responsible for how our global teams access information and run operations across our computer systems, networks, and devices. Our hardworking IT team is a group of flexible problem-solvers working in a fast-paced environment but who also thrive under the challenge of supporting all of our proprietary systems and people, from finance to launch operations.

SENIOR IT NETWORK ENGINEER II

Located onsite at Rocket Lab's Long Beach, CA facility, the Senior IT Network Engineer will be responsible for the design, implementation, and operation of all networks and firewalls relating to Corporate IT, Launch, Space Systems and their related Operations. These systems include support of the infrastructure required at related sites across the USA so some travel may be required. Related systems include flat sat networks, loggers/telemetry servers, on orbit operations, remote operators, mission control room infra, and customer connectivity.

What You’ll Get To Do

  • Be a senior member of the team that delivers a global focus on all the network infrastructure and software that will enable Rocket Lab Engineers and Space Ops Personnel to deliver our world class Launch and Space System capabilities
  • Provides subject matter expertise, advice, and guidance to deliver and support for our highly reliable and available IT network infrastructure that support the Space Systems team
  • Lead upgrades, maintenance, and with a focus on continuous improvement to provide a reliable and secure network infrastructure
  • Lead project scoping, planning, and deployment for network infrastructure in support of Annual Operating Plan goals
  • Champion the IT Infrastructure Standards at Rocket Lab through the implementation of Standards for the deployment and management of the infrastructure environments to ensure:
    • Compliance with Rocket Lab Policies
    • Compliance with Cybersecurity policies, standards, and procedures
    • Simplified and consistent environment management practices
    • Automated build and maintenance processes
    • Improvements to increase reliability of systems
    • System High Availability and Disaster Recovery
    • That the team is providing effective support
    • Clear and concise reporting on usage, uptime, support levels, etc.
    • Comprehensive documentation of environments and support
    • Efficient cost control
  • Work with the other Network Engineers to establish WAN and LAN networking Standards
  • Work with a team of world class IT, engineering, and business professionals

You’ll Bring These Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in IT and a bachelor's degree OR equivalent years of work experience (12+ years total experience)
  • 5+ of those years of experience in a network focused technology role
  • In-depth knowledge of Fortinet, Juniper or Cisco network switching and firewall setup, configuration, and management
  • Expert knowledge of WAN, SD-WAN, routing, IPSEC, SSL VPNs, firewalls, etc.


These Qualifications Would Be Nice To Have

  • Specialist qualification in area of expertise: CISM, AWS, Azure, Microsoft, etc.
  • AWS and/or O365 & Azure enterprise environments
  • Advanced problem solving and analytical skills – able to see the big picture, make connections and appropriate decisions
  • One or more of the following: Kubernetes, VMware, Linux, Windows, Configuration Management, Automation, and/or Infrastructure as Code
  • One or more of the following: Server and Storage hardware, Backups, HA\DR\BC, Active Directory, Group Policy, Certificate Management (PKI), DNS, or DHCP
  • Security frameworks / technology: ISO 27001, NIST 800-171, etc.


This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.

Join one of the world's fastest-growing space companies and own a piece of it. In addition to competitive base pay, you'll receive company stock as part of your total compensation package, giving you a direct stake in our success. As we expand to new launch sites, groundbreaking missions, and global markets, your ownership has the opportunity to grow alongside the company.Our comprehensive benefits package includes our industry-leading Employee Stock Purchase Program (with a 15% discount on company stock), top-tier medical plans (HMO, PPO, and a zero cost HDHP option with a significant HSA company contribution), dental and vision coverage, paid vacation and sick time, 11 paid holidays, flexible spending and dependent care accounts, paid parental leave, disability and life insurance, and a 401(k) retirement plan with company match.Additional perks include subsidized EV charging, onsite fitness centers (where available), discounted gym memberships, complimentary snacks and beverages, 50% employee discount on our popular merch store, and a variety of other employee discounts.Level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base Pay Range (CA Only): $124,500 USD - $160,000 USD

What To Expect

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

Important Information

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY:

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. Learn more about ITAR here.

Rocket Lab provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment at Rocket Lab, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation for the application/interview process for a job in the United States should contact Giulia Johnson at g.biow@rocketlabusa.com.This dedicated resource is intended solely to assist job seekers with disabilities whose disability prevents them from being able to apply/interview. Only messages left for this purpose will be considered. A response to your request may take up to two business days.

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN NEW ZEALAND OFFICES ONLY:

For security reasons, background checks will be undertaken prior to any employment offers being made to an applicant. These checks will include nationality checks as it is a requirement of this position that you be eligible to access equipment and data regulated by the United States' International Traffic in Arms Regulations.

Under these Regulations, you may be ineligible for this role if you do not hold citizenship of Australia, Japan, New Zealand, Switzerland, the European Union, or a country that is part of NATO, or if you hold ineligible dual citizenship or nationality. For more information on these Regulations, click here ITAR Regulations.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Network Engineering role supports all daily network operational activities delivering, managing, monitoring, and supporting all essential and company network infrastructure. This role will work to identify errors that are often difficult to detect and performs root cause analysis in finding a resolution to problems. This position supports REV’s internet product suite including voice, video, and data, along with day-to-day operation support across all GPON and DOCSIS platforms.


Location: Capital Region, LA

  • Area Served: Baton Rouge, Gonzales, Prairieville, Plaquemine, and surrounding communities.
  • Work Arrangement: Remote eligible within the assigned region.
  • Residency Requirement: Must reside within the Capital Region or within 60 miles of a REV office.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES, FUNCTIONS & KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES: (include but are not limited to)

  • Responsible in supporting all network hardware components, network operating systems, performance network availability, patch management and security updates according to standards and current best practices
  • Performs installation, configuration and upgrades to network routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, VPN terminators and any other types of network and transports infrastructure in both LAN and WAN environments
  • Works in a high availability data center environment and in the areas of system backup, customer network installation, performance monitoring/tuning, security monitoring, network capacity management, user technical support, general network troubleshooting and infrastructure maintenance
  • Responsible for ensuring availability of both customer network connectivity and access to the production server environment in accordance with documented SLA’s for clients
  • Works with network systems such as: Calix (E7’s), Adtran (TA5000’s), Arris (E6000’s) Cisco (cBR-8 ‘s, ASR’s, Nexus, ASA’s), Fortinet, Juniper (EX’s and SRX’s)
  • Performs network problem troubleshooting, including a cooperative work effort with the server group and support desk
  • Participates in efforts in the identification of network security issues, as well as the design and implementation of effective solutions
  • Assists with configuration, maintenance, and upkeep of several enterprise class network environments
  • Performs required software maintenance, including installation and upgrades of products and NOS’s, at both the datacenter and customer level
  • Coordinates testing by users in preparation for installations and upgrades to live system
  • Manages production problems when they occur, escalate issues to the proper support personnel when situations arise
  • Other duties as assigned


BEHAVIORS:

  • Upholds and acts in accordance with REV’s Guiding Principles.


EVALUATION:

Performance of this job will be evaluated in accordance with procedures established by the company on the evaluation of management personnel.


QUALIFICATIONS & PREREQUISITES

Required (All Levels):

  • High School Diploma or equivalent with a well-rounded technical background
  • Must be able to pass a full background check
  • Real-world network and Data Center Network Operations experience
  • Solid understanding of change management concepts and practices
  • Outstanding ability to perform logical troubleshooting in pressure situations
  • Ability to work in a multi-vendor and multiple-network environment
  • General knowledge of various Linux operating systems

Network Engineer I

  • 3+ years of experience in supporting complex network infrastructure environments

Network Engineer II

  • 5+ years of experience in supporting complex network infrastructure environments

Network Engineer III

  • 7+ years of experience in supporting complex network infrastructure environments

Network Engineer IV

  • 10+ years of experience in supporting complex network infrastructure environments


Preferred (All Levels):

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering/Information Technology/Computer Science

Network Engineer I

  • Understanding of the protocols and technologies including, but not limited to: FTTH, DOCSIS, TCP/IP, OSPF, BGP, STP, SIP, MPLS, HSRP, LDAP, DHCP, DNS, VRFs Understanding of security concepts including, but not limited to: IDS/IPS, Antivirus, Web-filtering, SSL encrypt/decrypt, two-factor authentication, SSL VPN.
  • Security Certification(s) are a plus
  • Experience with VMWare Network Virtualization

descriptionHtml:
Who Are We?

RZR is an AI-native advertising platform built for the next era of performance marketing. We operate at the intersection of machine learning, programmatic media, and full-funnel mobile growth, powering campaigns for some of the world's most ambitious advertisers. Our platform is purpose-built to deliver outcomes at scale, not just impressions.

We are a team of builders, operators, and technologists who believe the advertising industry is overdue for a fundamental rethink. We move fast, operate with a high degree of ownership, and hold ourselves to an exceptionally high standard of craft.

RZR is scaling aggressively with an active M&A pipeline and a platform vision that puts us on a path to becoming an industry leader. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at an inflection point and help shape what it becomes.

Role Overview

We are looking for a skilled Network Engineer to join our San Francisco engineering hub. In this role, you will own the design, implementation, and day-to-day management of the high-performance network infrastructure that powers our programmatic Demand-Side Platform — a real-time bidding environment where milliseconds matter and reliability is non-negotiable.

You will work hands-on with modern open networking technologies — including Mellanox Spectrum hardware, Cumulus Linux, and Netris — to build and maintain a low-latency, highly automated data center fabric. You will collaborate closely with global infrastructure and backend engineering teams to deliver a network environment that scales with the business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Network Infrastructure: Design, deploy, and maintain high-density data center networks utilizing Mellanox switches and adapters.
  • Network OS Management: Administer and optimize network nodes running Cumulus Linux, ensuring stable and high-performance routing and switching.
  • Software-Defined Networking: Manage and orchestrate network operations using Netris for automated, controller-based networking.
  • Performance Optimization: Monitor and tune network performance for real-time systems, with a focus on throughput and latency.
  • Security & Compliance: Implement and manage firewall rules, VPNs, and access control lists (ACLs) to protect infrastructure and data assets.
  • Automation & Scripting: Develop automation workflows to eliminate manual configuration, improve consistency, and accelerate deployment cycles.

Required Skills And Experience

  • 3+ years of professional network engineering experience (6+ years for Senior-level consideration).
  • Deep familiarity with Mellanox Spectrum switches and ConnectX adapters.
  • Strong proficiency in Cumulus Linux (Debian-based) and general Linux system administration.
  • Hands-on experience with Netris for VPC-style networking on-premises or in hybrid cloud environments.
  • Expert-level knowledge of BGP, OSPF, EVPN-VXLAN, and LACP.
  • Proficiency in Python or Go for network automation.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

Why Join RZR ?

  • Own the core US data center network infrastructure — this is a high-ownership, high-visibility role, not a support function.
  • Work daily with best-in-class open networking hardware and software: Mellanox Spectrum, Cumulus Linux, and Netris in a live production environment.
  • Directly shape the backbone of a programmatic platform processing billions of real-time bid requests, where your engineering decisions have immediate, measurable impact.
  • Join a small, senior infrastructure team where ideas get implemented — not committee'd to death.
  • Be part of a company scaling aggressively, with the scope and trajectory to grow into a broader infrastructure leadership role.

RZR Behaviors

RZR operates by eight core behaviors: Extreme Ownership

  • Move Fast
  • Drive for Excellence
  • Proactive Communication
  • Courage
  • Curiosity
  • Deliver Results
  • Manage Ambiguity

RZR is an equal opportunity employer

RZR is a place where everyone can grow. However you identify, and whatever background you bring with you, we invite you to apply if this role excites you.

RZR provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Job Description

Designs, implements, and operates resilient L3/L4 network services across data centers and cloud environments with broader influence beyond the immediate team. Leads moderately complex projects, drives automation and observability at scale, and contributes to standards and architectures. Mentors junior engineers, provides input on team decisions, and collaborates with SRE, platform, and security partners to deliver secure, compliant, and highly available network services with measurable impact on both team and group outcomes.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

L3/L4 Network Topologies and Overlays:

  • Lead designs for IP addressing, routing policies (BGP/OSPF/IS-IS), EVPN/VXLAN fabrics, and SDN overlays spanning on-prem and cloud.
  • Define HA, ECMP, and traffic-engineering patterns; validate through lab/sandbox testing, failure modeling, and staged rollouts.
  • Author design docs and drive reviews involving related teams; de-risk changes with method-of-procedure (MOP), rollback, and verification plans.


Cloud Networking Implementation and Operations:

  • Implement and operate VPC/VNet topologies, subnets, routing tables, NAT, Transit/Hub-and-Spoke (e.g., TGW/VCN), PrivateLink/service endpoints, and inter-cloud connectivity.
  • Design and tune L4/L7 load balancing and service insertion (proxies, firewalls) to meet defined SLOs and cost targets.
  • Ensure consistent network policy and connectivity across environments using standard blueprints and golden configs.


Network Security Controls and Compliance Guardrails:

  • Engineer segmentation (VRFs/security zones), ACLs/policies, encryption (IPsec/TLS), and DDoS/WAF integrations aligned to zero-trust.
  • Embed compliance guardrails (change control, access least privilege, evidence collection) and partner with security/GRC to pass audits.
  • Periodically review rulebases and routing policies; eliminate shadow/duplicate rules and reduce attack surface.


Automation, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code:

  • Develop reusable Terraform modules and Ansible playbooks; enforce code reviews, linting, policy-as-code, and test gates in pipelines.
  • Build validation and drift-detection tooling using APIs and scripting (e.g., Python); integrate automated rollbacks and canary changes.
  • Champion GitOps practices, configuration data modeling, and inventory source of truth.


Monitoring, Telemetry, and SLOs:

  • Implement SNMP/streaming telemetry, NetFlow/IPFIX, and flow logs for health, capacity, and security analytics.
  • Define SLIs/SLOs (availability, latency, loss, jitter) and build dashboards/alerts/runbooks; lead capacity/perf reviews and right-sizing actions.
  • Correlate telemetry with incidents; drive problem management and reduction of repeat issues.


Cross-Team Collaboration and Operations Excellence:

  • Partner with SRE, platform, and security teams on architecture reviews, incident response, post-incident remediation, and capacity planning.
  • Lead portions of on-call response and complex change events; coordinate with related teams to minimize risk and downtime.
  • Contribute to cross-LOB standards, reference architectures, and service onboarding patterns.


Documentation, Reviews, and Standards:

  • Produce and maintain high-quality design docs, network diagrams, runbooks, and inventories; ensure traceability to requirements and controls.
  • Facilitate and participate in design/change reviews; capture decisions and lessons learned; evolve patterns and modules accordingly.
  • Mentor junior engineers via code/document reviews, pairing, and knowledge shares.


Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution:

  • Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.


Collaboration & Partnership:

  • Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.


Problem Solving:

  • Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.


Continuous Learning:

  • Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.


Continuous Improvement:

  • Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.


Performance and Development:

  • Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.

Hermeus is a venture-backed defense aviation company reclaiming the lost art of rapid iterative prototyping to build the fastest aircraft in the world today. By prioritizing relentless hardware iteration, we deliver high-speed systems at the pace of the modern battlefield. We work with the Department of War to provide the high-speed capabilities our nation and its allies need to maintain a durable, asymmetric advantage.

As a Network Engineer at Hermeus you will be responsible for installing, configuring, analyzing, and maintaining local and wide area networks. As part of the Information Team you will ensure growth, security, and scalability of all Hermeus networks as well as support cross-org needs for network engineering. 

Responsibilities

  • Configure, and maintain network hardware and software, including routers, switches, firewalls, Access Points (wireless), and VPNs.
  • Monitor network performance and ensure system availability and reliability.
  • Perform network troubleshooting to isolate and diagnose common network problems.
  • Implement and maintain network security, including access controls, intrusion detection systems, and threat prevention.
  • Manage and administer network services such as DNS, DHCP, and IP address management (IPAM).
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for network configurations, processes, and procedures.
  • Collaborate with other IT teams to support infrastructure projects and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Participate in on-call rotation for after-hours support and critical incident response.
  • Stay up-to-date with emerging network technologies, best practices, and NIST guidelines.



Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience as a Network Engineer or similar role.
  • Strong understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, OSPF, BGP, EIGRP) and network hardware.
  • Experience with network security principles and practices.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.



Preferred Skills And Experiences

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Active security clearance strongly preferred
  • Familiarity with cloud networking concepts (AWS, Azure).
  • Familiarity with Palo Alto and Juniper network devices
  • Background in government or cleared contractor networks
  • Experience with FedRAMP authorized cloud solutions (AWS Govcloud, Azure GCC-H, etc..) is a plus
  • Experience with network cybersecurity tools such as Wireshark, Nmap, AWS network security tools, Microsoft Defender, etc.
  • Palo Alto Certification (PCCET, PCNSA, PCNSE, etc.)
  • Cisco Certifications (CCENT, CCT, CCNA, etc.)
  • SANs Certification (GSEC, GCIA, GMON, GDSA, etc.)
  • CompTIA Certification (Network+, Security +, CASP+, etc.)

descriptionHtml:
Costco Travel IT is responsible for the technical future of Costco Wholesale, the third largest retailer in the world with wholesale operations in fourteen countries. Despite our size and explosive international expansion, we continue to provide a family, employee centric atmosphere in which our employees thrive and succeed.

This is an environment unlike anything in the high-tech world and the secret of Costco’s success is its culture. The value Costco puts on its employees is well documented in articles from a variety of publishers including Bloomberg and Forbes. Our employees and our members come FIRST. Costco is well known for its generosity and community service and has won many awards for its philanthropy. The company joins with its employees to take an active role in volunteering by sponsoring many opportunities to help others.

Come join the Costco Travel IT family. Costco IT is a dynamic, fast-paced environment, working through exciting transformation efforts. We are building the next generation retail environment where you will be surrounded by dedicated and highly professional employees.

The Network Engineer is responsible for maintaining, building, and operating Costco Travel’s global wired and wireless networks. They provide local and remote network access, routing, switching, DNS, firewall, global WAN, cloud transit, and load balancing services to Costco Travel’s locations, including the data centers, call centers, and campus/regional offices.

Our successful employees are service-oriented people with integrity and commitment toward a common goal of excellence. This position performs analysis and other tasks necessary to configure, implement, and maintain Costco Travel network infrastructure. This will involve working closely with Infrastructure Architects to ensure we adhere to technical, compliance, and security best practices.

If you want to be a part of one of the worldwide BEST companies “to work for”, simply apply and let your career be reimagined.

ROLE

  • Collaborates with the Infrastructure Architects to develop strategies and direction for network systems solutions using current and emerging technologies.
  • Collaborates with the Infrastructure Architects to translate technical requirements into low-level network designs.
  • Collaborates with the Infrastructure Architects to plan and recommend network hardware, systems management software, and architecture.
  • Configures and maintains physical and virtual network infrastructure such as routers, switches, firewalls, and load balancers.
  • Implements and maintains wireless infrastructure for corporate locations.
  • Analyzes network capacity and availability to meet networking requirements while maintaining a secure environment.
  • Configures and maintains tools for network monitoring, reporting, performance, and troubleshooting.
  • Handles Tier 3 support and escalations for troubleshooting of network infrastructure.
  • Collaborates with the Infrastructure Architects to implement networks that comply with security and compliance requirements such as PCI and HIPPA.
  • Assists in identifying root cause of network operational issues, resolves problems, and recommends and implements mitigation of issues.
  • Implements and configures network security products including stateful and next-generation firewalls.
  • Creates, implements, and maintains automation scripts for network configuration and management using automation tools such as Python, Ansible, and Git.
  • Creates network diagrams and documentation.
  • Leads and/or participates in RFPs/RFIs, PoCs, lab testing, and validation.
  • Implements and configures network infrastructure services such as 802.1X, NAC, IPSEC VPN, RADIUS, NTP, SDWAN, IPAM, monitoring, and logging.
  • Participates in 24x7 on-call rotation.
  • Works closely with Infrastructure Architects to analyze network capacity and create plans for growth and improvement in a proactive manner.

Required

  • Minimum 5 years’ Networking experience supporting complex medium to large enterprises.
  • Minimum 5 years’ experience with networking technologies (Fortinet, Arista, Aruba, Checkpoint).
  • Strong troubleshooting skills to isolate network faults.
  • Thorough understanding of the OSI model, as well as Ipv4 protocol suite.
  • Knowledgeable on Security Best Practices, procedures, and compliance.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule to meet the needs of the business.
  • Occasional travel may be required to our Data Centers and other locations.
  • CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate) or Arista Certification

Recommended

  • Network+ Certification.
  • Fortigate Certification.
  • Checkpoint Certification.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Workspace applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams.

Required Documents

  • Cover Letter
  • Resume

Costco Travel IT is responsible for the technical future of Costco Wholesale, the third largest retailer in the world with wholesale operations in fourteen countries. Despite our size and explosive international expansion, we continue to provide a family, employee centric atmosphere in which our employees thrive and succeed.

This is an environment unlike anything in the high-tech world and the secret of Costco’s success is its culture. The value Costco puts on its employees is well documented in articles from a variety of publishers including Bloomberg and Forbes. Our employees and our members come FIRST. Costco is well known for its generosity and community service and has won many awards for its philanthropy. The company joins with its employees to take an active role in volunteering by sponsoring many opportunities to help others.

Come join the Costco Travel IT family. Costco IT is a dynamic, fast-paced environment, working through exciting transformation efforts. We are building the next generation retail environment where you will be surrounded by dedicated and highly professional employees.

The Network Engineer is responsible for maintaining, building, and operating Costco Travel’s global wired and wireless networks. They provide local and remote network access, routing, switching, DNS, firewall, global WAN, cloud transit, and load balancing services to Costco Travel’s locations, including the data centers, call centers, and campus/regional offices.

Our successful employees are service-oriented people with integrity and commitment toward a common goal of excellence. This position performs analysis and other tasks necessary to configure, implement, and maintain Costco Travel network infrastructure. This will involve working closely with Infrastructure Architects to ensure we adhere to technical, compliance, and security best practices.

If you want to be a part of one of the worldwide BEST companies “to work for”, simply apply and let your career be reimagined.

ROLE



- Collaborates with the Infrastructure Architects to develop strategies and direction for network systems solutions using current and emerging technologies.
- Collaborates with the Infrastructure Architects to translate technical requirements into low-level network designs.
- Collaborates with the Infrastructure Architects to plan and recommend network hardware, systems management software, and architecture.
- Configures and maintains physical and virtual network infrastructure such as routers, switches, firewalls, and load balancers.
- Implements and maintains wireless infrastructure for corporate locations.
- Analyzes network capacity and availability to meet networking requirements while maintaining a secure environment.
- Configures and maintains tools for network monitoring, reporting, performance, and troubleshooting.
- Handles Tier 3 support and escalations for troubleshooting of network infrastructure.
- Collaborates with the Infrastructure Architects to implement networks that comply with security and compliance requirements such as PCI and HIPPA.
- Assists in identifying root cause of network operational issues, resolves problems, and recommends and implements mitigation of issues.
- Implements and configures network security products including stateful and next-generation firewalls.
- Creates, implements, and maintains automation scripts for network configuration and management using automation tools such as Python, Ansible, and Git.
- Creates network diagrams and documentation.
- Leads and/or participates in RFPs/RFIs, PoCs, lab testing, and validation.
- Implements and configures network infrastructure services such as 802.1X, NAC, IPSEC VPN, RADIUS, NTP, SDWAN, IPAM, monitoring, and logging.
- Participates in 24x7 on-call rotation.
- Works closely with Infrastructure Architects to analyze network capacity and create plans for growth and improvement in a proactive manner.

Required



- Minimum 5 years’ Networking experience supporting complex medium to large enterprises.

descriptionHtml:
An exciting career awaits you

At MPC, we’re committed to being a great place to work – one that welcomes new ideas, encourages diverse perspectives, develops our people, and fosters a collaborative team environment.

Position Summary

The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of networking and be able to assist the Enterprise Networking team in many ways to include, but not limited to, delivering designs, assessments, remediation and standardization efforts, documentation creation, leading other team members in discussion and concept visualization. This position will serve as a subject matter expert in the Enterprise Network Team and provide guidance to various divisions within our organization, will require minimal guidance and supervision, be pro-active, show initiative, maintain a positive attitude, possess excellent communication skills and serve as a mentor to other team members.

This position is a part of a job family with multiple levels. The successful candidate will be placed at a level commensurate with experience and qualifications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deploy complex network configurations for on-premise or cloud-based networks and assists in the development of playbooks for network systems (Cloud Computing).
  • Assists in the integration of new systems and tools. Develops and maintains scripts to facilitate network administrative tasks and automate repetitive processes.
  • Participate and assist with troubleshooting of ZTNA and SASE based deployments (Cloud Computing, Network Installation and Configuration, Network Traffic Analysis, Network Transformation, Network Security Management).
  • Monitors performance identifies areas for improvement for the network and implements performance tuning.
  • Identifies trends in issues and determines the root cause to reduce future issues.
  • Adheres to network policies, standards, and standard operating procedures for how-to documents.
  • Undertakes the regular analysis and interpretation of traffic and utilization of services on network connections.
  • Assist in troubleshooting and deploying other network technologies, such as Wireless Infrastructure, Digital Experience Tooling, WAN optimization systems and Azure Cloud integration (Network Transformation, Troubleshooting, Network Protocols, Network Security Management)
  • Engage in discussions and participate in development of Private SaaS, Edge Computing and other advanced cloud capabilities (Cloud Computing, Network Installation and Configuration, Network Transformation).
  • Deploying, Engineering, Troubleshooting SDWAN & SASE systems and architectures (Programming/Scripting, Network Testing, Network Management, Network Traffic Analysis, Troubleshooting).
  • Adheres to network policies, standards, and standard operating procedures for how-to documents.
  • Analyzes alternative hardware, platforms, and technologies for the network infrastructure (Network Transformation, Network Testing, Network Traffic Analysis).

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology preferred, related field or equivalent experience.
  • Five (5) or more years of relevant experience required.
  • Experience with enterprise scale data centers, network topologies and architectures required.
  • Deep understanding of Routing Concepts, Switching Concepts, Quality of Service, Traffic Engineering, Filtering and Tuning (Network Traffic Analysis, Network Testing, Network Protocols) required.
  • Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) or equivalent certifications preferred.
  • Experience in deploying Azure and AWS (Cloud) direct connect, express routes, private links and other more advanced network centric cloud-based architectures preferred.
  • Experience with Zero Trust Networking or SASE experience preferred

Skills

Adaptability - Maintaining effectiveness when experiencing major changes in work responsibilities or environment (e.g.,

people, processes, structure, or culture); adjusting effectively to change by exploring the benefits, trying new

approaches, and collaborating with others to make the change successful.

AI Fundamentals - Understanding of core AI concepts and methods, ability to apply AI to job-relevant use cases and capacity to contribute to organizational AI reimagination.

Change Management - Change Management refers to a systematic approach for defining and implementing procedures and/or technologies to deal with changes in the environment. It can mean adapting to change, controlling change and/or effecting change.

Authentic Communicator - Expresses ideas and information, both verbally and in writing, clearly and credibly. Listens to understand and fosters constructive dialogue.

Cost Optimization - The process to analyze, plan and manage costs for cost efficiency and expense reduction, while maximizing business value.

Internet of Things (IoT) - Familiarity with IoT concepts and protocols, as well as experience designing architectures that incorporate IoT devices and enable seamless connectivity and data exchange.

IT Service Management (ITSM) - IT Service Management (ITSM) refers to the set of processes, policies, and procedures that an organization implements for designing, delivering, managing, and improving IT services it provides to its customers or internal users. ITSM aims to align the delivery of IT services with the needs of the business and ensure that IT services are delivered efficiently, effectively, and in a way that adds value to the organization.

Network Administration - Organizing, installing, and supporting the organization's computer systems, including local area networks (LANs), wide area networks (WANs), network segments, intranets, and other data communication systems.

Network Automation - Automating the configuration and management of network resources in LAN and WAN environments. This ensures consistency and scalability of the network.

Network Design - Provided network design, bandwidth allocation, IP address allocation, supervising installation, configuration and maintenance on major network technologies.

Network Engineering - The process of orchestrating network traffic and data flow across the enterprise ecosystem.

Network Installations - Configure network hardware and software components according to organizational guidelines and technical requirements. This includes the implementation and configuration of multiple servers, network devices and network management tools as well as the management of user network access to ensure stable and reliable

network operations.

Network Management System - The use of network monitoring to determine, in real time, whether a network is running optimally, to optimize and improve the average percentage of time during which the network is performing its intended function.

Network Security Management - The process of providing complete visibility into the network and generating data for assets (asset groupings and classifications), firewalls, applications, ports, protocols, VPNs, NAT, and security policies and vendor devices.

Network Standards - Sets and establishes rules that determine how data is transmitted between different devices in the same network.

Requirements Management - The process of documenting, analyzing, tracing, prioritizing and agreeing on requirements and then controlling change while also communicating to relevant stakeholders.

Results Driven - Drives operational and process excellence and innovative behavior by empowering others, collaborating, taking appropriate risk, making timely decisions and holding people accountable for results.

Strategic Outlook - Examines issues, generates ideas, creates future scenarios and develops plans with a long-term perspective. Ensures short-term goals support long-term strategy and that organizational/functional strategy aligns with and supports MPC’s overall business strategy.

Troubleshooting - The act or process of discovering and resolving problems, disputes, or mechanical issues through a systematic, usually iterative, approach.

Network Engineer III

Savannah, GA

CBU: HMGMA

Purpose:

We seek a talented and motivated "Network Engineer III" to join our dynamic IT team. As a Network Engineer III, you will be pivotal in designing, implementing, and maintaining our organization's network infrastructure to ensure seamless connectivity, optimal performance, and security. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to identify and address network-related issues, contribute to network design discussions, and implement best practices to support our growing technology needs by helping to design and support network elements. Analyzes, resolves, and reports on network issues. Must be able to weigh business needs against the need for network changes and articulate issues to management.

Essential Functions:

  • Assist in designing, configuring, troubleshooting, and maintaining local area networks (LANs), wide area networks (WANs), and wireless networks.
  • Support the implementation and management of network hardware, including routers, switches, firewalls, and load balancers.
  • Monitor network performance and troubleshoot connectivity, latency, and other related issues to ensure optimal user experience.
  • Collaborate with system administrators and security teams to implement network security measures, including firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and access controls.
  • Participate in capacity planning and network expansion efforts to accommodate the organization's growth and evolving technology requirements.
  • Assist in the evaluation and integration of new networking technologies and solutions.
  • Respond to and resolve network incidents and service disruptions promptly.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of network configurations, procedures, and troubleshooting steps.
  • Provide technical support and guidance to junior team members as needed.
  • Stay updated with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in networking.
  • Ensure Change Management and other procedures are followed.
  • Document network procedures and system configurations.
  • Install, maintain, and configure Cisco routers/switches, firewall, VPN, and VLANs.
  • Monitor/Resolve LAN/WAN performance, health, and security issues.
  • Install, maintain, and configure all wireless networks.
  • Install, configure, and maintain all LAN/WAN hardware and cabling.
  • Participate in Network Operations planning.
  • Support all Administrators and developers as required.
  • Develop/test and analyze new technical solutions to problems.
  • Maintain a current inventory of all Network assets, purchase history, and warranty data.
  • Install, maintain, and configure all voice & data communication circuits.
  • Perform disaster recovery of all network systems.
  • Perform backup and restore of network systems.
  • Implements policies to ensure the security and integrity of the network.

Scope

  • Network Configuration and Maintenance: Responsible for configuring, installing, and maintaining network equipment, including routers, switches, firewalls, and load balancers. Ensure proper functioning of network devices and implement updates or patches as needed.
  • Network Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve network-related issues, including connectivity problems, latency, and downtime. Utilize troubleshooting tools and methodologies to identify root causes and implement effective solutions.
  • Network Monitoring and Performance: Monitor network performance, traffic patterns, and usage to identify potential bottlenecks or performance degradation proactively. Take necessary actions to optimize network resources and ensure optimal user experience.
  • Security Implementation: Collaborate with security teams to implement network security measures, such as firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and access controls. Participate in security audits and vulnerability assessments to safeguard network integrity.
  • Network Documentation: Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation of network configurations, topologies, procedures, and troubleshooting steps. Ensure documentation is easily accessible to team members for reference and knowledge sharing.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including system administrators, application developers, and IT support, to ensure seamless integration of network services and resolve interdepartmental network-related issues.
  • Project Support: Provide technical expertise and support for network-related projects, such as network upgrades, expansions, or migrations. Collaborate with project teams to ensure successful implementation of network changes.
  • Emerging Technologies: Stay informed about industry trends, emerging networking technologies, and best practices. Evaluate and recommend new technologies that enhance network performance, security, and efficiency.
  • Capacity Planning: Assist in capacity planning efforts to accommodate the organization's growth and evolving technology requirements. Evaluate network bandwidth needs and propose scaling solutions as needed.
  • Training and Knowledge Sharing: Continuously enhance your skills and knowledge in networking technologies and share insights with team members. Provide guidance and training to junior team members to facilitate their professional growth.
  • Incident Response: Respond to and resolve network incidents and service disruptions promptly. Collaborate with relevant teams to mitigate impacts and prevent recurrence.
  • Change Management: Adhere to established change management processes when implementing network changes or updates. Ensure changes are well-documented and communicated to stakeholders.

Education

A bachelor’s degree in MIS or computer science is preferred.

Related Work Experience (Yrs.)

At least 8 years of experience as a network engineer

Skills/Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of networking concepts, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, etc.), and technologies.
  • Proficiency in configuring and troubleshooting network equipment from vendors like Cisco, Juniper, or other significant providers.
  • Familiarity with network monitoring and management tools such as: Cisco IOS, Cisco ACS, Cisco WCS, Cisco WLC, Cisco MARS, Stealth Watch
  • Basic knowledge of network security principles and practices.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills for effective collaboration with cross-functional teams.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Relevant certifications such as CCNA, Network+, or equivalent are a plus.
  • Experience on Wifi-6 and 5G networks is a plus.

Certifications (Required/Preferred)

  • Required – CCNA routing and switching.
  • Preferred – CCNA wireless.
  • Preferred – CCNA voice.

Some travel, including international, may be required.

Make a difference at one of Florida’s premier institutions for education in science, technology, engineering, and math (STEM). Florida Polytechnic University, ranked the No. 1 public college in the region by U.S. News and World Report, offers a unique working environment that encourages faculty and staff to be part of a culture that prizes collaboration, innovation, and the willingness to go above and beyond to ensure our students and University succeed. Florida Poly offers a small campus academic environment where students form connections with their faculty and peers as they pursue high-value degrees in engineering and applied sciences.

The University is equipped with cutting-edge facilities and equipment and two award-winning, architecturally distinct academic buildings. Its evolving curriculum, designed to meet the needs of industry and provide a life-long educational foundation for students, has helped the institution grow in prominence since its opening in 2014. Florida Poly’s deliberately small classes, affordability, and outstanding graduate outcomes have helped it earn recognitions such as being named a top value school, in the top 25 nationally for affordability, and in the top five best universities in the South for tech students. Accredited by ABET and SACSCOC, Florida Poly is educating some of the brightest minds in Florida and attracting standout talent from across the nation.

JOB TITLE

Senior Network Engineer

Job Description Summary

ABOUT FLORIDA POLYTECHNIC INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY SERVICES:

The Information Technology Services (ITS) division at Florida Poly is dedicated to positioning the University as a leader among STEM institutions through the innovative use of information technology. Our mission is to transform teaching and learning, empower cutting-edge research, enhance the student experience and success, enable data-driven decision-making, and optimize University operations and services.

Staffed by a team of energetic professionals, we prioritize service excellence, foster innovation, and pursue continuous improvement in a highly collaborative environment. Currently, we are driving a major transformation of IT infrastructures, architectures, and service delivery models to align with Florida Poly’s new five-year strategic plan and support its ambitious goals.

Reporting to the Vice President and CIO, ITS is organized into six teams, including Technology Support, IT Security, IT Infrastructure Services, DevOps, Enterprise Solutions, and Business Services.

SUMMARY OF POSITION:

The Senior Network Engineer serves as a member of the IT Infrastructure team, reporting to the Director of IT Infrastructure Services and working with the Lead Network Engineer. This role performs advanced engineering, design, implementation, optimization, and complex troubleshooting of wired, wireless, and wide area network infrastructure. Responsibilities include designing and implementing complex solutions, leading assigned projects and technical workstreams, improving network performance and resiliency, and establishing standards and documentation. The Senior Network Engineer participates in an on-call rotation, plans and performs after-hours maintenance to minimize impact to users, and mentors Network Engineers, Technicians, and student workers. A significant portion of this role is dedicated to delivering network engineering services to external partner institutions, working on site and remotely alongside their IT staff, in addition to supporting ITS auxiliary services such as residence halls and dining.

This role is ideal for a highly technical, self-motivated, and experienced engineer with a strong passion for networking and a drive to build infrastructure that is stable, secure, and well documented. A positive attitude, sound judgment, and taking pride in the quality of your work are essential, along with the professionalism to represent the University with partner institutions. If you enjoy leading complex projects, mentoring others, and continuously expanding your skills in enterprise networking, security, and automation, this position offers significant opportunity to make a tangible impact across the University and beyond.

Job Description

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead the design, implementation, and optimization of complex network solutions, including campus core, data center, spine-leaf (EVPN/VXLAN) fabrics, WAN, and wireless. Plan, test, and implement changes and upgrades, scheduling user-impacting work after hours.
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex, multi-layer network incidents; lead root cause analysis and drive permanent corrective actions. Participate in a rotating on-call schedule to respond to after-hours incidents and outages.
  • Lead assigned network projects and technical workstreams from planning through deployment, including new construction and renovations. Develop standards, roadmaps, and capacity plans, and evaluate risk and tradeoffs in design decisions.
  • Engineer and improve network security, including segmentation, 802.1X/NAC, next-generation firewall policy, VPN, and vulnerability remediation, in partnership with IT Security and in alignment with frameworks such as CIS, NIST, and PCI.
  • Establish and maintain network documentation, configuration standards, and procedures, including diagrams, IP address management, and source of truth (e.g., NetBox). Develop automation using scripting, AI, and network automation tools.
  • Mentor Network Engineers, Network Technicians, and student workers, and review engineering work for quality and standards. Collaborate with systems, security, and application teams, vendors, and contractors; evaluate products and recommend improvements.
  • Deliver network engineering services through ITS auxiliary operations and external partnerships, including on-site and remote engineering, advisory, training, and knowledge transfer for partner institutions’ IT staff.
  • Proactively pursue opportunities to learn new systems and technologies, share knowledge, and partner with team members to continually enhance departmental expertise and effectiveness.
  • Perform all other duties assigned to support department and University objectives.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Advanced knowledge of enterprise, campus, and data center network design, including LAN/WAN, VLANs, Spanning Tree, wireless (802.11), high availability, and routing protocols such as OSPF and BGP.
  • Working knowledge of EVPN, VXLAN, and Clos (spine-leaf) fabric architectures, with hands-on design or implementation experience preferred.
  • Expert hands-on experience configuring, optimizing, and troubleshooting enterprise switching, routing, and wireless platforms (e.g., Cisco, Arista) using the command line interface (CLI).
  • Experience designing and administering next-generation firewalls (e.g., Palo Alto Networks and Fortinet), VPN, and 802.1X/network access control solutions.
  • Working knowledge of core network services (DNS, DHCP, NTP, RADIUS/TACACS+, QoS) and cloud networking in Microsoft Azure and/or AWS.
  • Experience with network monitoring, management, and documentation tools (e.g., Zabbix, SNMP, syslog, and NetBox).
  • Demonstrated ability to develop scripts and automation (e.g., Python, Ansible, or PowerShell) for configuration, compliance, and operational tasks.
  • Ability to effectively utilize artificial intelligence (AI).
  • Ability to lead projects and workstreams, mentor technical staff, and drive complex problems to resolution.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to present recommendations clearly to technical staff, partner institutions, and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to work outside normal business hours to implement changes and solutions to limit impact/exposure to users.
  • undefined

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Associate’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Four (4) or more years of experience as a network engineer or in a similar role supporting enterprise or campus networks.
    • A current Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) or equivalent vendor certification may be substituted for one (1) year of experience.
    • A current Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) or equivalent vendor certification may be substituted for two (2) years of experience; certification credit is not cumulative.
  • Up to two (2) years of extensive, documented home lab experience with enterprise-class networking equipment may be considered as work experience.
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Six (6) or more years of network engineering experience, preferably in higher education.
  • Hands-on experience designing or deploying EVPN/VXLAN spine-leaf fabrics and campus core replacements.
  • Experience leading projects or providing engineering services for external customers or partner institutions.
  • Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) or equivalent vendor certification.

PHYSICAL DEMAND AND WORKING CONDITIONS:

Physical requirements include occasional lifting and carrying of 5 to 70 pounds and occasional use of ladders and lifts. This role requires sitting, standing, reaching, walking, twisting, and kneeling, as well as the visual acuity, speech, hearing, hand-eye coordination, and manual dexterity needed to operate a computer and basic office equipment. Work is performed primarily in an office, with regular work in data centers and telecommunication rooms.

REQUIRED LICENSES, CERTIFICATIONS, AND/OR OTHER SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS OF LAW:

  • Must possess a valid driver’s license.
  • This position requires a criminal background check, which will include a Level II screening as required by Florida Statute
  • 435.04.
  • This position is subject to federal and state privacy regulations.

NORMAL WORK SCHEDULE: This position is salaried and exempt. The normal work schedule is Monday – Friday, 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m.; however, occasional after-hours work (evenings, weekends, and holidays) may be required. Local travel between university locations and local vendors may be required. Occasionally, travel to professional events and conferences may be required. This position may be eligible for a flexible work schedule.

TARGET HIRING SALARY & BENEFITS: $85,000-$93,600. Benefits include medical, personal, and parental leave, paid holidays, State of Florida health insurance and retirement plans.

LOCATION/WORK MODEL: Full-time/On-site

POSITION DURATION: This is a time-limited position for up to two (2) years, contingent upon the continued availability of funding, and may be eligible for extension.

Note: Employment-based visa sponsorship will NOT be considered for this position.

APPLICATION DEADLINE DATE: Review of applications will commence immediately. Please check to top right corner of the ad for information on post end dates.

APPLICATION PROCESS: In addition to completing the online application, all applicants are required to upload the following documents as PDF attachments to the application:

  • Resume
  • List of at least three (3) professional references (names and contact information)
  • Cover Letter answering the following items:
    • Why are you interested in the position?

    • Explain how your skills, experience, and personal qualities make you a strong fit for this role. You may include additional relevant experience not immediately apparent from your resume.

    • A description of a project you took on and completed, explaining challenges and how you overcame them, and the outcome. This can be technical or non-technical and may be something completed in a position or at home.

    • What motivates you professionally and personally to excel in a technical and collaborative environment?
If any of these three items are not included, your application will not be reviewed, and you will not be considered for the position.

References will not be contacted unless you are selected as a finalist for the position.

DIVERSITY STATEMENT:

Florida Polytechnic University is an equal opportunity/equal access institution. It is the policy of the Board of Trustees to provide equal opportunity for employment and educational opportunities to all (including applicants for employment, employees, applicants for admission, students, and others affiliated with the University) without regard to race, color, national origin, ethnicity, sex, religion, age, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status or genetic information.

Employment is contingent upon eligibility to work in the US. An appointment is not final until proof is provided.

Florida Poly Benefits Information

Florida Poly qualified employees have the opportunity to take advantage of a variety of health benefits (through the State of Florida) to help meet their specific needs, as well as the needs of their family. This comprehensive coverage includes flexible spending accounts, medical and life insurance, and worker's compensation.

Health benefits are administered through People First, on behalf of the State of Florida, as pre-tax insurance plans. People First handles all new hire enrollments, coverage changes, premium administration, and dependent eligibility. Their Service Center is staffed Monday through Friday, from 8 a.m.–6 p.m. EST, at 1-866-663-4735.

RETIREMENT

Florida Poly offers great options for retirement. From the required selection of a state plan to additional voluntary retirement plans, our employees have many opportunities to save and prepare for their future. Click Here for more information.

Other Benefits

  • Discounts & Perks
  • Annual Leave
    • To help promote work-life balance, Florida Poly provides a generous leave program, which includes paid time off and paid holidays. Qualified employees may accrue 22 days of annual leave. In addition, the University observes the holidays listed in our University Holidays policy FPU-1.008.
  • Sick Leave
    • Qualified employees may also accrue 12 days of annual sick leave and participate in our Sick Pool Program.
  • Employee Assistant Program (EAP)

EXPLORE LAKELAND FLORIDA

Conveniently located along I-4 between Tampa and Orlando, Lakeland is home to Florida Polytechnic University and many other businesses and attractions. Click here to explore Lakeland, Florida.

SPECIAL INSTRUCTIONS REGARDING ATTACHMENTS:

Required attachments are listed on each posting. Please be sure to attach all required documents in the Resume/CV field before continuing through the application. Once your application has been submitted, no changes may be made and additional attachments will not be considered.

An unofficial copy of the degree/transcript is acceptable during the application process. For positions requiring a degree, the official transcripts are required upon hire.

Foreign Transcript: Transcripts issued outside of the United States require a equivalency statement from a certified transcript evaluation service verifying the degree equivalency to that of an accredited institution within the USA. This report must be attached with the application and submitted by the application deadline.

All document(s) must be received on or before the closing date of the job announcements.

Virtual Service Operations is searching for Network Engineers to join our dynamic team in Lorton, Virginia. As a Network Engineer, you will be responsible for providing senior level support for our network infrastructure, with a focus on LAN/WAN designs, configurations, management, and Azure networking. You will handle tier 3 engineering escalations and troubleshooting, monitor network health, provide training, and create comprehensive documentation. If you have a deep understanding of network technologies, including Azure networking, and possess excellent problem solving skills, we want to hear from you!

Responsibilities

  • Design, configure, and manage LAN/WAN infrastructure, including Azure networking components, to ensure optimal network performance and reliability.
  • Resolve complex network issues escalated from lower tiers with a focus on timely resolution and minimal impact to operations.
  • Monitor network performance, proactively identify potential issues, and implement corrective measures to maintain network health and availability.
  • Collaborate with crossfunctional teams to develop and implement network security policies, procedures, and best practices, specifically in an Azure networking environment.
  • Conduct regular network performance analysis and capacity planning to anticipate future requirements and make recommendations for network enhancements, with a particular emphasis on Azure networking.
  • Provide training to junior network engineers and support staff on network technologies, best practices, and troubleshooting techniques, including Azure networking concepts.
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation related to network designs, configurations, processes, and procedures, focusing on Azure and networking components.

Qualifications

  • 7-10+ years of networking engineering experience.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Proven experience working as a Network Support Specialist or in a similar role, with a deep understanding of LAN/WAN designs, configurations, management, and Azure networking.
  • Indepth knowledge of network protocols, including TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, SNMP, VPN, and routing protocols (e.g., BGP, OSPF).
  • Experience with network security technologies, such as firewalls (Palo Alto), IDS/IPS, and access control systems, within an Azure networking environment.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills to identify and resolve complex network issues effectively.
  • Proficiency in network monitoring and management tools (e.g., Wireshark, SolarWinds, Nagios), with experience in monitoring Azure networking components.
  • Familiarity with network hardware and software, including routers, switches, load balancers, and network operating systems (e.g., Cisco, Juniper), as well as Azure networking components like virtual networks, subnets, VPN gateways, and Azure ExpressRoute.

Preferred Qualifications

  • CCNP Certified

Requirements

  • Must be within driving distance of Lorton, VA OR willing to relocate there (Relocation Assistance Package Available)
  • Must be willing to work onsite (This role may include the need to work outside of core hours on high priority investigations and may also include on-call responsibilities)
  • Must possess an active TS/ SCI clearance or above
  • DoD 8570 IAT II is required
  • Must be willing and able to travel frequently

What Is Important To Us

  • You are an excellent communicator in writing and speaking.
  • You have the ability to work independently but also value teamwork.
  • Your problem-solving skills are excellent.
  • You are looking for a job where performance appraisals occur regularly, and you look forward to advancing your career.
  • You seek a community of virtue-centered co-workers and clients.

What we offer you: As part of the VSO company, you will be part of a virtue-centered team who value their work and teammates. This is a no-jerk zone. We provide ongoing learning and development opportunities to foster continuous growth. We offer competitive salaries, health benefits, and flexible work arrangements.

More About VSO: VSO is a hybrid cloud and managed services consulting firm. Much of VSO's success can be attributed to our deep partnerships with IT services industry leaders such as AWS, IBM, Microsoft and others. VSO leverages numerous other partner relationships so as to provide our customers with optimal support. Additionally, we take pride in taking care of our employees. We offer a wide variety of benefits for eligible employees related to health, retirement, professional development, and more! For more information, please visit our website at https://vso-inc.com/careers

GovCIO is currently hiring for a Senior Network Engineer with an active Secret clearance, to provide Tier 3 support and engineering expertise for the design, testing, and implementation of the Next Generation Network for federal customer. This position is located in Merrifield, VA and is a fully onsite position.

Responsibilities:

This position requires administering network (Cisco ACI), compute (Cisco UCS), and virtualization (VMware, UCS Director) environments, performing network diagnostics and analysis, troubleshooting production outages with service providers, terminating fiber and network cables, and independently designing, writing, and updating system documentation and network diagrams.   • Acts as a technical escalation point for complex network incidents, outages, and performance issues
  • Participates in architecture reviews, design sessions, and implementation planning
  • Collaborates with Security, Cloud, Systems, and Application teams to ensure integrated solutions
  • Supports global operations, including after-hours support and maintenance windows as required
  • Develops and maintains engineering documentation, diagrams, and operational runbooks

Required Skills and Experience:

  • High School with 10+ years of network engineering (or commensurate experience)
  • 5+ years of experience with hands-on enterprise network experience
  • Active Secret Clearance with ability to obtain and hold DEA suitability
  • Professional certification (e.g., CCNP, CCDP)
  • Installing, configuring, and troubleshooting various network architectures
  • Knowledge of the inner workings of the major network routing protocols, including dynamic routing
  • Experience with a variety of firewalls
  • Solid background in network administration and architecture
  • Knowledge of building, developing, and maintaining SD-WAN environments
  • Familiarity with access control models and network security
  • Experience with network diagnostic, monitoring, and analysis tools
  • Solid understanding of network operating systems (Aruba, Juniper, Cisco)

  • Terminating fiber and network cables
  • Ability to work independently

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Network Engineer to support the design, deployment, and ongoing operation of our corporate network infrastructure across offices, warehouses, and data centers. This role is ideal for an engineer who has moved beyond foundational networking and is ready to take ownership of medium-to-large network projects while continuing to grow toward an intermediate or advanced-level role.

You'll work closely with IT Operations, Systems Engineering, Security, and Project Management teams to ensure reliable, secure, and scalable network solutions across all corporate locations, with a clear path toward Senior Network Engineer responsibilities as you grow in the role.

What You'll Be Working On:

  • Design, implement, and support network infrastructure across offices, warehouses, and datacenters: full site-build lifecycle (topology, IP/VLAN/subnet design, wireless planning, redundancy/failover), BOMs, expansions, migrations, and refreshes.
  • Administer, monitor, and troubleshoot the full network stack (firewalls, switches, wireless), serving as an escalation point for complex issues, driving root cause analysis, and participating in on-call/after-hours support.
  • Ensure configurations align with security policies, support audits and vulnerability remediation, and assist with security system integrations (cameras, access control).
  • Configure SaaS integrations (SSO, SCIM, OIDC, OAuth — primarily Okta) and build automations/workflows using low-code/API tools like Workato and Postman, in partnership with IT and Security.
  • Bring an automation-first mindset: proactively identifying ways to reduce manual work and staying current on AI-assisted tools for IT infrastructure and ops.
  • Maintain network documentation (diagrams, IP schemas, VLAN assignments, rack elevations, port maps) and contribute to standardizing designs and deployment patterns.
  • Collaborate with Senior Network Architect and Engineers on complex initiatives, liaise with vendors/ISPs/carriers on circuit turn-ups, and mentor Network Analysts.
  • Travel up to 20% may be required to support site deployments.


What You'll Bring to the Team:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience as a Network Engineer in office, warehouse, or datacenter environments.
  • Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, and routing.
  • Solid knowledge of Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking protocols.
  • Experience with wired and wireless enterprise networks.
  • Practical experience with circuit provisioning and carrier management.
  • Ability to analyze and troubleshoot network connectivity issues efficiently using Wireshark.
  • Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and technical documentation skills.
  • Comfortable owning network components or projects end-to-end.
  • Ability to work effectively across IT, Security, and Operations teams and explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • A growth mindset: eager to learn new platforms and progress toward senior-level responsibilities.
  • Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.


Bonus Points

  • Cisco Meraki experience (firewall, switching, wireless).
  • CCNA or equivalent certification.
  • Experience with WAN technologies (MPLS, DIA, SD-WAN), VPNs, and monitoring tools.
  • Familiarity with Lucid, Jira, IAM platforms (e.g., Okta, including SSO/SCIM/OIDC), low-code automation tools (e.g., Workato, Postman), and AI-assisted workflows.


Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages
  • Restricted Stock Units
  • Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs
  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance
  • Employer contributions to HSA account
  • Paid parental leave
  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability
  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement
  • Mental health & wellness support
  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)
  • Cell phone stipend
  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary
  • Volunteer time off
  • Global travel insurance & emergency assistance
  • Daily meals allowance
  • Additional perks & programs specific to location


Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $125,000 -$147,500 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.
