descriptionHtml:
About the Role



We are partnering with a leading organization in Bethpage, NY, seeking an experienced, highly hands-on Senior Network Engineer to support enterprise network infrastructure initiatives across campus, data center, and IT/OT environments. This position requires an engineer who can independently own network projects from start to finish, including requirements gathering, solution design, implementation, testing, troubleshooting, and documentation. The ideal candidate combines advanced Cisco routing and switching expertise with strong firewall administration, BGP traffic engineering, data center networking, and physical infrastructure experience. This is not a position focused solely on network monitoring, operational support, or high-level architecture. We need someone comfortable developing a technical approach, making decisions, coordinating resources, and personally executing the work. The engineer will work across multiple infrastructure projects and must be comfortable operating independently with minimal supervision.



Responsibilities



  • Key Responsibilities
  • End-to-End Network Project Delivery
  • Independently manage assigned network infrastructure projects from requirements gathering through implementation and completion.
  • Evaluate existing network designs, recommend improvements, and develop technical solutions based on business and operational requirements.
  • Perform hands-on configuration, deployment, testing, troubleshooting, and validation of network infrastructure.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, vendors, telecommunications providers, and project stakeholders.
  • Manage network migrations, upgrades, maintenance activities, and production changes.
  • Maintain accurate network diagrams, configuration documentation, and implementation procedures.
  • Cisco Routing, Switching & Advanced Networking
  • Configure, administer, and troubleshoot enterprise Cisco routing and switching infrastructure.
  • Support advanced routing protocols, including BGP, OSPF, and related Layer 2/Layer 3 technologies.
  • Perform BGP traffic engineering, including inbound and outbound traffic optimization across multiple ISP or partner connections.
  • Demonstrate practical knowledge of BGP attributes and routing policies, including AS-path prepending, MED, communities, and local preference.
  • Configure and troubleshoot spanning tree technologies, including BPDU Guard, Root Guard, and related network protection mechanisms.
  • Support network resiliency, redundancy, failover, and performance optimization.
  • Firewall Administration & Network Security
  • Perform hands-on firewall administration across enterprise security platforms such as Palo Alto, Cisco ASA/Firepower, or Check Point.
  • Create, modify, troubleshoot, and validate firewall security rules, access policies, and ACLs.
  • Configure and troubleshoot site-to-site IPsec VPN connections with external partners and remote locations.
  • Perform firewall upgrades, migrations, and security infrastructure changes.
  • Troubleshoot network connectivity and security issues across multiple layers of the network.
  • Data Center & Enterprise Infrastructure

Job Number: R0248277

Network Engineer

The Opportunity:

As a Network Engineer, you will be expected to configure and operate Cisco platforms such as ASA or Firepower, Nexus switches, and IOS‑based routers. You may also have responsibility in supporting routing protocols and tunneling technologies including OSPF, BGP or IBGP, GRE, and MPLS L3VPN. You will be expected to regularly troubleshoot complex network performance issues and implement corrective actions as well as support network architecture reviews, capacity planning, and performance optimization and integrate network security controls aligned to enterprise security and information assurance requirements.

What You'll Work On:

  • Support enterprise network modernization by designing, implementing, and maintaining secure and resilient network infrastructures across government environments.
  • Apply deep experience with Cisco technologies to configure, troubleshoot, and optimize routing, switching, and network security components.
  • Work closely with engineers, network operations staff, and technical leads to deliver reliable connectivity and ensure secure, scalable network performance for mission systems.


Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 5+ years of experience in network engineering, including designing, deploying, or providing advanced support of multi-protocol IP backbone and access networks
  • 2+ years of experience with Cisco network technologies
  • 2+ years of experience with security, routing, and switching protocols such as BGP, IS-IS, OSPF, MPLS, LDP, RSVP, VPLS, STP, or L3VPNs
  • Experience with network design, network performance management, or network planning
  • Experience with Juniper networks or MPLS L3VPN
  • Experience deploying, upgrading, and troubleshooting multivendor network equipment and solutions such as VMWare, Cisco, Palo Alto, Dell, HPE, or Juniper
  • Knowledge of network security principles
  • Secret clearance
  • Bachelor’s degree


Nice If You Have:

  • Experience with network operations support and enterprise network architecture
  • Experience with voice technologies such as Cisco TMS or Cisco Voice
  • Experience with network security auditing and information assurance
  • Knowledge of Cisco ASA Firepower, Cisco Nexus, Cisco routers, and Cisco IOS
  • Knowledge of LAN design, engineering principles, and hybrid delivery environments
  • Possession of excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills
  • TS/SCI clearance
  • Cisco Certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, or CCIE Certification

descriptionHtml:
About Us

AGE Solutions is a premier technology and professional services company, providing in-depth consulting, advanced technology solutions, and essential services throughout the U.S. government, defense, and intelligence sectors. Prioritizing innovation and client-focused solutions, we assist major agencies in addressing intricate issues and ensuring a more secure future.

The Corporate Enterprise Network (WAN): Network Engineer – Senior provides senior-level network engineering, implementation, modernization, and sustainment support for a DoD customer's global classified and unclassified WAN infrastructure. Responsible for ensuring secure, reliable connectivity between DoD facilities, networks, cloud environments, and mission-critical enterprise services.

Responsibilities Include

  • Design, configure, install, test, and maintain enterprise WAN routers, switches, firewalls, and associated infrastructure.
  • Support WAN connectivity across classified and unclassified networks as well as connectivity with DISN, NIPRNet, SIPRNet, and other DoD networks.
  • Configure and troubleshoot advanced routing and switching technologies, including BGP, OSPF, MPLS, multicast, QoS, and IPv4/IPv6.
  • Engineer and maintain Cisco networking platforms and Check Point firewall technologies.
  • Implement network technology refreshes, equipment replacements, and infrastructure modernization.
  • Perform Tier III/IV troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and restoration of network services.
  • Provide 24x7x365 on-call engineering support as required.
  • Conduct site surveys, infrastructure assessments, installation planning, and implementation activities.
  • Support DISA circuit provisioning, testing, activation, and troubleshooting.
  • Develop Engineering Change Requests, implementation plans, test plans, rollback procedures, and network diagrams.
  • Apply DISA STIGs, agency configuration standards, and cybersecurity requirements to network devices.
  • Evaluate network capacity, utilization, performance, and potential reliability improvements.
  • Support enterprise cloud connectivity, application delivery, and secure network integration.
  • Conduct laboratory testing, technology evaluations, and interoperability validation.
  • Provide technical support to Government and contractor WAN Management, NOC personnel, and other engineering teams.
  • Travel to CONUS or OCONUS locations for network installation or troubleshooting as required.

Required Skills, Qualifications And Experience

  • Experience:
    • Five years of progressive IT experience, including at least two projects involving Network and Telecommunications Services and Network Management. At least one qualifying project must have occurred within the previous three years.
  • Education:
    • High School Diploma.
  • Citizenship and Clearance:
    • US Citizenship is required.
    • DoD Top Secret clearance or Secret clearance with favorably adjudicated Tier 5/SSBI investigation.
  • Certification:
    • DoD 8570/8140: IAT Level III baseline certification.
    • Cisco Certified Network Professional – Enterprise (CCNP-E).
  • Location and Travel:
    • Candidates must be able to work daily from customer and/or contractor facilities as needed and be within commuting distance of one of the following locations:
      • Fort Belvoir, VA
      • Columbus, OH
      • Dayton, OH
      • New Cumberland, PA
      • Ogden, UT
      • Philadelphia, PA
      • Richmond, VA
      • Anniston, AL
      • San Diego, CA
      • Fort Bragg, NC
      • Robins AFB, GA
      • Tobyhanna, PA
    • Travel of up to approximately 40% may be required, both CONUS and OCONUS for network installation or troubleshooting as required.
Preferred Qualifications

  • Check Point Certified Security Administrator (CCSA) or higher certification.
    • If not attained prior to hire, must be attained after hire.
  • AWS Cloud Practitioner
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals
  • CompTIA Cloud+.
Work Environment And Physical Demand

  • Must be able to work from a computer for extended periods.
  • Must be able to work from office, comm closet, warehouse, and other environments associated with network deployment and sustainment.

The projected salary range for this position is $110,000+ annually. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including years of relevant experience, active security clearance level, certifications, technical skillset, contract requirements, and overall qualifications.

At AGE Solutions, we reward performance, invest in growth, and share success. Our benefits support the whole person, professionally, financially, and personally.

  • 26 Days Paid Leave: Includes vacation, sick, personal time, and holidays. You choose how to use it.
  • Performance Bonuses: Performance bonuses are awarded based on individual contributions and company-wide results, aligning recognition with impact.
  • 401(k) with Match: We match 3% of your contributions with immediate vesting.
  • Financial Protection: Company-paid life insurance up to $300K and options for additional coverage for you and your dependents.
  • Health Benefits: Multiple medical plans, dental, vision, FSA and HSA options to fit your needs.
  • Parental Leave: 15 days of fully paid leave for new parents, because family matters.
  • Military Differential Pay: We bridge the gap for employees on active duty, so they don’t take a financial hit while serving.
  • Professional Growth: Paid training and certifications, tuition reimbursement, and the tools and tech to get the job done right.
  • Shared Success: In the event of a company sale, our CEO has committed to returning 80% of net proceeds to employees. This ensures our team shares in the long term value they help create.

At AGE, you’ll do work that matters, supported by a company that delivers for its people.

Description

D.R. Horton, Inc., the largest homebuilder in the U.S., was founded in 1978 and is a publicly traded company on the New York Stock Exchange. It is engaged in the construction and sale of high quality homes designed principally for the entry-level and first time move-up markets. The Company also provides mortgage financing and title services for homebuyers through its mortgage and title subsidiaries. Please visit our website at www.drhorton.com for more information.

D.R. Horton, Inc. is currently looking for a Network Engineer II. The right candidate will be responsible for the installation and maintenance of network systems communications. Configures various network devices and services. Troubleshoots network issues within established guidelines.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  • Maintain computer networks including routers, switches, VPNs and other physical hardware/software
  • Monitor systems to improve network performance for all systems
  • Troubleshoot, resolve, and communicate networking issues to other employees and management
  • Research, install, configure and upgrade network hardware and software
  • Create firewall rules and update software and data security systems to keep data and communications protected
  • Implement disaster recovery procedures
  • Provide on-site support for projects that require on-site installation and support
  • Design and implement new network solutions and/or improving the efficiency of current networks
  • Arrange scheduled upgrades
  • Investigate faults in the network
  • Update network equipment to the latest firmware releases
  • Conducts all business in a professional and ethical manner to serve customers and increase the goodwill and profit of the company
  • Report network status to key stakeholders
  • Improve knowledge and understanding of network and security best practices to offer the best solutions and protection to company systems
  • Participate in on-call rotation
  • Ability to travel overnight


Qualifications

Education and/or Experience

  • High school diploma or general education degree (GED)
  • One to four years of related work experience
  • Must have a vehicle and a valid driver’s license
  • Strong understanding of network services and networks protocols (to include but not limited to): BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, HSRP, VRRP, VRF, VTP, DHCP, DNS
  • Strong understanding and practical knowledge of networking systems such as routers and switches and firewalls
  • Ability to analyze and evaluate networks, identify issues and provide solutions to ensure networks are operating efficiently
  • Ability to implement and troubleshoot network and security infrastructure
  • Manage projects/processes working independently
  • Knowledge of Windows operating systems
  • Strong interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to execute excellent customer service relationship skills
  • Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written oral form or via DRH applications
  • Proficiency with MS Office and email
  • Ability to lift 50 pounds.
  • In office: Monday through Friday


Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field from a four-year college or university preferred
  • Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) or Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) preferred
  • Working knowledge regarding Cisco Firewalls preferred
  • Experience working in the F5 Load Balancer preferred

  • Medical, Dental and Vision
  • 401(K)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Flex Spending Accounts
  • Life & Disability Insurance
  • Vacation, Sick, Personal Time and Company Holidays
  • Multiple Voluntary and Company provided Benefits

Business hours and after hours as needed

Candidates must be located in the Dallas-Fort Worth area or be willing to relocate upon hire

Job Description:

We are seeking a Senior Network Engineer to act as the lead technical authority for our enterprise network infrastructure. This role is deeply hands-on and responsible for driving network design standards, leading complex troubleshooting efforts, and executing high-impact engineering initiatives. The successful candidate will bring expert-level experience with Cisco enterprise networking, Palo Alto Networks firewalls, and advanced network services, along with proven proficiency in enterprise wireless networking. This role also plays a key part in developing standard operating procedures (SOPs) and mentoring other network engineering staff.

This position is well aligned with a CCIE-level engineering role, requiring strong theoretical knowledge, practical implementation skills, and disciplined operational rigor.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the lead network engineer, providing technical direction and hands-on leadership across all aspects of the enterprise network
  • Design, implement, and support complex Cisco-based campus, core, and wireless network architectures
  • Act as the primary escalation point for advanced network issues, performing deep-dive troubleshooting and root-cause analysis
  • Engineer, deploy, and maintain Palo Alto Networks firewalls, including policy design, advanced security features, and VPN services
  • Design, deploy, and support enterprise wireless networks, ensuring high availability, performance, security, and seamless client connectivity
  • Administer and enhance Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) for network access control, authentication, authorization, and profiling
  • Utilize Cisco Catalyst Center to support network automation, assurance, configuration management, and operational visibility across wired and wireless environments
  • Define and enforce network engineering standards, best practices, and design patterns
  • Lead network lifecycle activities including upgrades, migrations, expansions, and hardware refreshes
  • Create, maintain, and continuously improve standard operating procedures (SOPs), runbooks, and technical documentation
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior and mid-level network engineers
  • Collaborate with security, infrastructure, and application teams to ensure stable and secure network integration
  • Participate in on-call rotation and provide expert-level support during critical network incidents

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of hands-on enterprise network engineering experience
  • Expert-level knowledge of Cisco enterprise networking technologies
  • Extensive experience with Palo Alto Networks firewalls in production environments
  • Strong operational experience with Cisco ISE, including NAC policy design and troubleshooting
  • Proficiency with Cisco Catalyst Center for wired and wireless network operations
  • Proven proficiency with enterprise wireless networking, including design, deployment, and troubleshooting
  • Advanced understanding of:
    • Routing and switching protocols
    • Wireless RF fundamentals and client behavior
    • Network resiliency and high availability
    • Network security architecture and segmentation
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot complex, multi-domain network issues independently
  • Strong documentation skills, with experience authoring SOPs, standards, and operational guides
  • Ability to lead technical initiatives end-to-end with minimal oversight

Preferred Qualifications

  • CCIE (Enterprise, Security) or CCNP Enterprise, or equivalent demonstrated experience
  • Palo Alto Networks certifications (PCNSE preferred)
  • Experience with enterprise wireless platforms (Cisco Wireless, including controller-based or SDA environments)
  • Experience with network automation and scripting (Python, REST APIs, Ansible)
  • Experience supporting large-scale or mission-critical enterprise environments
  • Familiarity with SD-Access and advanced campus architectures

Description

About Millennial Software:

Millennial Software is revolutionizing the landscape of security and defense by leveraging our core competencies in software development, automation, DevSecOps, and machine learning.

  • 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision premiums for you and all dependents
  • 100% company-paid disability and life insurance benefits
  • 15% 401(k) company contribution
  • 30 days of PTO/holidays
  • Generous training budget
  • Paid Paternal and Maternal Leave
  • Business development / growth incentives
  • Top notch company swag

About The Position

Millennial Software is looking for a self-starting, team-oriented Mid-to-Senior Network Engineer to join our dynamic development and operations team in supporting a Government customer. The network engineer will own a medium-sized, multi-enclave network that spans several classification levels and rides across multiple commercial service providers, using VPNs and government-approved encryption to maintain end-to-end security. The environment is primarily Cisco and carries both development and operational data, so the successful candidate will be comfortable balancing fast iteration for development teams against the change discipline an operational mission requires.

Responsibilities include physical hardware installation and cabling, network installation and configuration, infrastructure maintenance, troubleshooting when issues arise, and evolving the architecture to support emerging needs. This role also works alongside the broader team managing data center hardware; racking, cabling, and replacing compute and storage equipment in addition to network devices. The successful candidate will have the ability to work both independently with little supervision as well as engage with a team to achieve overall project objectives.

This position is located in the Washington D.C. Metropolitan Area.

Job Functions

  • Install, configure, and maintain the client LAN/WAN across a primarily Cisco environment
  • Maintain network enclaves operating at multiple classification levels, preserving enclave separation, data labeling, and accreditation boundaries.
  • Deliver end-to-end encrypted transport between sites: configure, monitor, and troubleshoot site-to-site VPN. Potentially includes COMSEC responsibilities, based on site and team needs.
  • Respond to and resolve incidents within established service level agreements.
  • Draft and implement network change requests and enhancements performing OS upgrades and patching on network devices applying change control appropriate to whether a change affects development or operational data.
  • Support data center hardware installation and replacement alongside the broader team — racking, cabling, power, and swap-out of compute and storage devices as well as network equipment — including vendor RMA coordination.
  • Keep the environment documented and accounted for: topology drawings, configuration management records, asset management, and inventory.
  • Work directly with end-users and customers on site surveys, TEMS, and new equipment installs, ensuring their feedback is reflected in the delivered capability. Flexibility for occasional work beyond standard business hours and periodic travel as needed.

Requirements

Required Qualifications:

  • Active TS/SCI with a current full-scope polygraph (clearance must be active and transferable — this role cannot sponsor an initial investigation)
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or a related technical field; or equivalent hands-on experience in lieu of a degree
  • 10+ years of hands-on network engineering experience, including time supporting classified DoD or IC networks
  • Demonstrated depth with routing and switching configuration, OS upgrades, and troubleshooting on switches and routers
  • Demonstrated experience performing advanced troubleshooting of network, infrastructure, and security-related incidents
  • Hands-on experience configuring and troubleshooting IPsec VPN tunnels between sites, with an understanding of tunnel monitoring and failover (multi-carrier experience preferred)
  • Working command of TCP/IP, DNS/DHCP, subnetting, VLANs, routing (OSPF/BGP), firewalls, and LAN/WAN fundamentals
  • Experience operating in a multi-enclave, cross-domain, or air-gapped environment where networks are separated by classification or security boundary
  • Experience supporting operational customers

Nice To Have

  • Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP Enterprise) or equivalent demonstrated knowledge
  • DoD 8140/8570 IAT Level II certification (Security+ CE or equivalent)
  • Hands-on experience with Type 1 encryption devices or COMSEC custodian duties
  • Data center operations experience — structured cabling, power and cooling planning, hardware lifecycle and RMA management
  • Network automation exposure (Ansible, Python) or infrastructure-as-code in a DevSecOps environment
  • Experience troubleshooting cloud or hybrid infrastructure (AWS GovCloud, C2S, or similar)

descriptionHtml:
About Us

AGE Solutions is a premier technology and professional services company, providing in-depth consulting, advanced technology solutions, and essential services throughout the U.S. government, defense, and intelligence sectors. Prioritizing innovation and client-focused solutions, we assist major agencies in addressing intricate issues and ensuring a more secure future.

The Corporate Enterprise Network (WAN): Network Engineer – Senior provides senior-level network engineering, implementation, modernization, and sustainment support for a DoD customer's global classified and unclassified WAN infrastructure. Responsible for ensuring secure, reliable connectivity between DoD facilities, networks, cloud environments, and mission-critical enterprise services.

Responsibilities Include

  • Design, configure, install, test, and maintain enterprise WAN routers, switches, firewalls, and associated infrastructure.
  • Support WAN connectivity across classified and unclassified networks as well as connectivity with DISN, NIPRNet, SIPRNet, and other DoD networks.
  • Configure and troubleshoot advanced routing and switching technologies, including BGP, OSPF, MPLS, multicast, QoS, and IPv4/IPv6.
  • Engineer and maintain Cisco networking platforms and Check Point firewall technologies.
  • Implement network technology refreshes, equipment replacements, and infrastructure modernization.
  • Perform Tier III/IV troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and restoration of network services.
  • Provide 24x7x365 on-call engineering support as required.
  • Conduct site surveys, infrastructure assessments, installation planning, and implementation activities.
  • Support DISA circuit provisioning, testing, activation, and troubleshooting.
  • Develop Engineering Change Requests, implementation plans, test plans, rollback procedures, and network diagrams.
  • Apply DISA STIGs, agency configuration standards, and cybersecurity requirements to network devices.
  • Evaluate network capacity, utilization, performance, and potential reliability improvements.
  • Support enterprise cloud connectivity, application delivery, and secure network integration.
  • Conduct laboratory testing, technology evaluations, and interoperability validation.
  • Provide technical support to Government and contractor WAN Management, NOC personnel, and other engineering teams.
  • Travel to CONUS or OCONUS locations for network installation or troubleshooting as required.

Required Skills, Qualifications And Experience

  • Experience:
    • Five years of progressive IT experience, including at least two projects involving Network and Telecommunications Services and Network Management. At least one qualifying project must have occurred within the previous three years.
  • Education:
    • High School Diploma.
  • Citizenship and Clearance:
    • US Citizenship is required.
    • DoD Top Secret clearance or Secret clearance with favorably adjudicated Tier 5/SSBI investigation.
  • Certification:
    • DoD 8570/8140: IAT Level III baseline certification.
    • Cisco Certified Network Professional – Enterprise (CCNP-E).
  • Location and Travel:
    • Candidates must be able to work daily from customer and/or contractor facilities as needed and be within commuting distance of one of the following locations:
      • Fort Belvoir, VA
      • Columbus, OH
      • Dayton, OH
      • New Cumberland, PA
      • Ogden, UT
      • Philadelphia, PA
      • Richmond, VA
      • Anniston, AL
      • San Diego, CA
      • Fort Bragg, NC
      • Robins AFB, GA
      • Tobyhanna, PA
    • Travel of up to approximately 40% may be required, both CONUS and OCONUS for network installation or troubleshooting as required.
Preferred Qualifications

  • Check Point Certified Security Administrator (CCSA) or higher certification.
    • If not attained prior to hire, must be attained after hire.
  • AWS Cloud Practitioner
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals
  • CompTIA Cloud+.
Work Environment And Physical Demand

  • Must be able to work from a computer for extended periods.
  • Must be able to work from office, comm closet, warehouse, and other environments associated with network deployment and sustainment.

The projected salary range for this position is $110,000+ annually. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including years of relevant experience, active security clearance level, certifications, technical skillset, contract requirements, and overall qualifications.

At AGE Solutions, we reward performance, invest in growth, and share success. Our benefits support the whole person, professionally, financially, and personally.

  • 26 Days Paid Leave: Includes vacation, sick, personal time, and holidays. You choose how to use it.
  • Performance Bonuses: Performance bonuses are awarded based on individual contributions and company-wide results, aligning recognition with impact.
  • 401(k) with Match: We match 3% of your contributions with immediate vesting.
  • Financial Protection: Company-paid life insurance up to $300K and options for additional coverage for you and your dependents.
  • Health Benefits: Multiple medical plans, dental, vision, FSA and HSA options to fit your needs.
  • Parental Leave: 15 days of fully paid leave for new parents, because family matters.
  • Military Differential Pay: We bridge the gap for employees on active duty, so they don’t take a financial hit while serving.
  • Professional Growth: Paid training and certifications, tuition reimbursement, and the tools and tech to get the job done right.
  • Shared Success: In the event of a company sale, our CEO has committed to returning 80% of net proceeds to employees. This ensures our team shares in the long term value they help create.

At AGE, you’ll do work that matters, supported by a company that delivers for its people.

descriptionHtml:
About Us

AGE Solutions is a premier technology and professional services company, providing in-depth consulting, advanced technology solutions, and essential services throughout the U.S. government, defense, and intelligence sectors. Prioritizing innovation and client-focused solutions, we assist major agencies in addressing intricate issues and ensuring a more secure future.

The Corporate Enterprise Network (WAN): Network Engineer – Senior provides senior-level network engineering, implementation, modernization, and sustainment support for a DoD customer's global classified and unclassified WAN infrastructure. Responsible for ensuring secure, reliable connectivity between DoD facilities, networks, cloud environments, and mission-critical enterprise services.

Responsibilities Include

  • Design, configure, install, test, and maintain enterprise WAN routers, switches, firewalls, and associated infrastructure.
  • Support WAN connectivity across classified and unclassified networks as well as connectivity with DISN, NIPRNet, SIPRNet, and other DoD networks.
  • Configure and troubleshoot advanced routing and switching technologies, including BGP, OSPF, MPLS, multicast, QoS, and IPv4/IPv6.
  • Engineer and maintain Cisco networking platforms and Check Point firewall technologies.
  • Implement network technology refreshes, equipment replacements, and infrastructure modernization.
  • Perform Tier III/IV troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and restoration of network services.
  • Provide 24x7x365 on-call engineering support as required.
  • Conduct site surveys, infrastructure assessments, installation planning, and implementation activities.
  • Support DISA circuit provisioning, testing, activation, and troubleshooting.
  • Develop Engineering Change Requests, implementation plans, test plans, rollback procedures, and network diagrams.
  • Apply DISA STIGs, agency configuration standards, and cybersecurity requirements to network devices.
  • Evaluate network capacity, utilization, performance, and potential reliability improvements.
  • Support enterprise cloud connectivity, application delivery, and secure network integration.
  • Conduct laboratory testing, technology evaluations, and interoperability validation.
  • Provide technical support to Government and contractor WAN Management, NOC personnel, and other engineering teams.
  • Travel to CONUS or OCONUS locations for network installation or troubleshooting as required.

Required Skills, Qualifications And Experience

  • Experience:
    • Five years of progressive IT experience, including at least two projects involving Network and Telecommunications Services and Network Management. At least one qualifying project must have occurred within the previous three years.
  • Education:
    • High School Diploma.
  • Citizenship and Clearance:
    • US Citizenship is required.
    • DoD Top Secret clearance or Secret clearance with favorably adjudicated Tier 5/SSBI investigation.
  • Certification:
    • DoD 8570/8140: IAT Level III baseline certification.
    • Cisco Certified Network Professional – Enterprise (CCNP-E).
  • Location and Travel:
    • Candidates must be able to work daily from customer and/or contractor facilities as needed and be within commuting distance of one of the following locations:
      • Fort Belvoir, VA
      • Columbus, OH
      • Dayton, OH
      • New Cumberland, PA
      • Ogden, UT
      • Philadelphia, PA
      • Richmond, VA
      • Anniston, AL
      • San Diego, CA
      • Fort Bragg, NC
      • Robins AFB, GA
      • Tobyhanna, PA
    • Travel of up to approximately 40% may be required, both CONUS and OCONUS for network installation or troubleshooting as required.
Preferred Qualifications

  • Check Point Certified Security Administrator (CCSA) or higher certification.
    • If not attained prior to hire, must be attained after hire.
  • AWS Cloud Practitioner
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals
  • CompTIA Cloud+.
Work Environment And Physical Demand

  • Must be able to work from a computer for extended periods.
  • Must be able to work from office, comm closet, warehouse, and other environments associated with network deployment and sustainment.

The projected salary range for this position is $110,000+ annually. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including years of relevant experience, active security clearance level, certifications, technical skillset, contract requirements, and overall qualifications.

At AGE Solutions, we reward performance, invest in growth, and share success. Our benefits support the whole person, professionally, financially, and personally.

  • 26 Days Paid Leave: Includes vacation, sick, personal time, and holidays. You choose how to use it.
  • Performance Bonuses: Performance bonuses are awarded based on individual contributions and company-wide results, aligning recognition with impact.
  • 401(k) with Match: We match 3% of your contributions with immediate vesting.
  • Financial Protection: Company-paid life insurance up to $300K and options for additional coverage for you and your dependents.
  • Health Benefits: Multiple medical plans, dental, vision, FSA and HSA options to fit your needs.
  • Parental Leave: 15 days of fully paid leave for new parents, because family matters.
  • Military Differential Pay: We bridge the gap for employees on active duty, so they don’t take a financial hit while serving.

companySlogan: Experience that counts for more.
descriptionHtml:
About Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analysis that provide clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns.

Position Overview

The Information Technology (ITS) team at CRA is currently a Global team of 40 professionals dedicated to enhancing, maintaining, and developing the firm's technology infrastructure and security. The team is comprised of four functions: Service Delivery & Telecom, Enterprise Application Solutions, Infrastructure, Networking and Cloud Services and Security. Information Technology staff are based in the Boston, Chicago, London, Munich, New York, Oakland, and Washington, DC offices.

Responsibilities

We are seeking an experienced Network Engineer to join our small global networking team. The successful candidate will bring in-depth, hands-on expertise in planning, designing, implementing, documenting, securing, and troubleshooting enterprise network systems across campus, data center, wireless, WAN, and cloud environments. This position supports day-to-day operations and maintenance, advances security initiatives, and collaborates with IT colleagues and business stakeholders on a global scale. Typical responsibilities include:

  • Design, install, configure, test, document, and maintain secure network infrastructure across on-premises and cloud environments;
  • Identify, diagnose, and resolve complex network, wireless, firewall, DNS, and connectivity issues;
  • Produce and maintain Microsoft Visio network diagrams, implementation plans, configuration standards, and as-built documentation;
  • Administer and use Nexus Dashboard, Catalyst Center, Infoblox, and other management platforms for visibility, configuration, assurance, and lifecycle activities;
  • Maintain accurate configuration records, inventories, circuit information, support documentation, and vendor contacts;
  • Plan and execute upgrades while minimizing service disruption and maintaining tested rollback procedures;
  • Develop, implement, and maintain policies, procedures, and training plans for network resource administration, appropriate use, and disaster recovery;
  • Ensure network hardware, software, firmware, and configurations are current, supportable, and secure;
  • Monitor and test network performance and provide meaningful performance statistics, reports, and recommendations;
  • Coordinate with internal teams and external vendors to deliver projects and resolve incidents;
  • Coordinate across other teams within the IT department and across the firm; some travel to other CRA offices will be expected;
  • Some out-of-hours and weekend work will be required for scheduled upgrades and in response to unexpected outages.

Desired Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree (Master's desirable) in Computer Science, Information Systems or related discipline;
  • 4-6 years relevant work experience, preferably in a professional services environment;
  • Current Cisco certification at the CCNA level or a demonstrated track record of maintaining Cisco certifications at or above the CCNA level is required; CCNP preferred, relevant Microsoft Azure and AWS certifications highly desired;
  • Demonstrated knowledge of secure LAN/WAN, campus, data center, wireless, and cloud networking operations;
  • Hands-on experience designing, implementing, and supporting networking in both Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS);
  • Hands-on experience with Cisco Nexus data center switching, Cisco Catalyst switching, Cisco Catalyst wireless, and Cisco Firepower firewalls;
  • Experience with network management and automation platforms, including Cisco Nexus Dashboard, Cisco Catalyst Center, and Infoblox;
  • Demonstrated skill designing and documenting logical and physical networks using Microsoft Visio;
  • Strong practical knowledge of Cisco enterprise networking platforms across LAN/WAN, data center, wireless, firewall, and most importantly, cloud-connected environments;
  • Proficiency with network protocols and technologies, including Spanning Tree, DNS, DHCP, BGP, OSPF, HSRP, LACP, SNMP, NTP, IPsec VPN, and QoS;
  • Experience creating, reviewing, implementing, and troubleshooting firewall policies, preferably using Cisco Firepower;
  • Ability to create and maintain accurate network topology, rack, connectivity, and as-built documentation using Microsoft Visio;
  • Ability to propose and clearly communicate changes to existing network topology that improve availability, security, performance, and operational supportability;
  • Familiarity with ITIL change management practices, implementation planning, rollback planning, and pre-change risk assessment;
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across Layers 1 through 7, including packet capture and network performance analysis;
  • Must be comfortable in customer-facing scenarios and effectively collaborating in cross-functional technical teams;
  • Self-motivated, with a strong ability to prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment;
  • Ability to travel to other offices and execute project plans with minimal oversight.

Additional Preferred Skills

  • Demonstrated strong knowledge with Microsoft Azure networking, including virtual networks, routing, network security controls, and hybrid connectivity;
  • Demonstrated strong knowledge with Amazon Web Services networking, including VPCs, routing, security controls, and hybrid connectivity;
  • Cisco Nexus data center switches and Nexus Dashboard;
  • Cisco Catalyst switches, Catalyst wireless infrastructure, and Catalyst Center;
  • Cisco Firepower firewalls; Palo Alto firewall experience is also valued;
  • Infoblox DNS, DHCP, and IP address management (IPAM);
  • Cisco ISE and 802.1X network access control;
  • Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN;
  • Kemp LoadMaster load balancers;
  • Cisco Umbrella;
  • PKI, certificate lifecycle management, domain registration, DNS, and 802.1X fundamentals.

To Apply

To Be Considered For This Position, We Require

  • Resume – please include current address, personal email and telephone number;
  • Work Product (optional, submitted in cover letter field) – submit a sample set of diagrams generated with Visio.

Career Growth And Benefits

  • CRA’s robust skills development programs, encompassing both formal and informal programs, encourage you to thrive as an individual and team member. Training includes technical training, presentation skills, internal seminars, and career mentoring and performance coaching from an assigned senior colleague. Additional leadership and collaboration opportunities exist through internal firm development activities.
  • We offer a comprehensive total rewards program including a superior benefits package, wellness programming to support physical, mental, emotional and financial well-being, and in-house immigration support for foreign nationals and international business travelers.

Work Location Flexibility

CRA creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognize that individuals realize a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently expect that individuals spend at least 3 to 4 days a week working in the office (which may include traveling to another CRA office or to client meetings), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.

Responsible AI Use in Recruiting

We believe that recruiting is fundamentally a human process, and we are committed to a hiring process that is fair, transparent, and people-focused. While AI and other technology-enabled tools help our team operate more efficiently, we strive to provide every candidate with a personalized, thoughtful, and high-touch experience. As CRA invests significant human effort to find qualified members for our teams, we expect candidates to invest corresponding human effort to learn about CRA, prepare thoughtful application materials, and engage with our interviewers. Read more about appropriate hiring manager, recruiting team, and candidate AI at CRA on our website.

Our Commitment to Equal Employment Opportunity

Charles River Associates is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

Salary And Other Compensation

A good-faith estimate of the annual base salary range for this position is $130,000-$152,500. Starting pay within this range may vary based on factors such as education level, experience, skills, geographic location, market conditions, and other qualifications of the successful candidate. This position is eligible for additional bonus incentive compensation. CRA offers a comprehensive benefits package, subject to eligibility requirements, which includes: medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) retirement plan with employer match; life and disability insurance; paid time off (vacation, sick leave, holidays); paid parental leave; wellness programs and employee assistance resources; and commuter benefits.

Job Description:

Transform technology into opportunity as a Senior Network Engineer at GDIT. Shape what’s next for mission-critical government projects while shaping what’s next for your engineering career.

GDIT is seeking a Senior Network Engineer to help support the JSP ETM-NG program at the Pentagon in Arlington, VA.

Selected candidate will support Shift: Sunday - Thursday (6:00am - 2:30pm).

Due to the nature of work this role entails, telecommuting is not allowed and will require full-time onsite support

Meaningful Work And Personal Impact:

  • The Senior Network Engineer will play a crucial role in driving the success of multiple concurrent efforts.
  • Designs, plans, and builds communications networks.
  • Configure routers and switches, and firewalls for LAN and WAN systems and VPN concentrators with appropriate network engineering and communications protocols.
  • Coordinates LAN/WAN hardware/software improvements and/or enhancements.
  • Monitors the network utilizing industry leading technologies.
  • Provides innovative methods and technical solutions using the engineering design process.
  • Plans for implementation of enhancements.
  • Analyzes customer requirements and provides technical solutions to a wide range of difficult problems.
  • Performs maintenance and upgrade of networks including servers, routers, switches, firewalls, remote access systems, and networks.
  • Maintains network integrity and connectivity while ensuring compliance with policies and maintains system backup and recovery capability.
  • Coordinates the acquisition of hardware and software as well as subcontractor services as needed.
  • Creates plans and configure systems for data communication networks.
  • Evaluates new communications technologies to enhance capabilities of the network.
  • Maintains current knowledge of relevant technology as assigned.
  • Designs and builds the hardware and software components for computer or telecommunications networks.
  • Provides guidance and leadership to less-experienced network personnel.

What You’ll Need To Succeed (Required):

Bring your program management expertise along with a drive for innovation to GDIT. The Senior Network Engineer must have:

  • Education: Bachelor’s Degree. An additional 4 years of experience may be substituted in leu of degree.
  • Experience: 5+ years of related experience.
  • Security clearance level: Active Top Secret required with the ability to obtain SCI.
  • Certifications: Current IAT Level II certification required. In addition, candidate must possess a current Networking Certification to include Brocade, Cisco (CCNA/CCNP), Juniper (JNCIA/JNCIS/JNCIP), or Aruba.
  • Role requirements: Hands-on experience/knowledge with Aruba networking systems required.

GDIT is your place. At GDIT, the mission is our purpose, and our people are at the center of everything we do.

  • Growth: AI-powered career tool that identifies career steps and learning opportunities.
  • Support: An internal mobility team focused on helping you achieve your career goals.
  • Rewards: Comprehensive benefits and wellness packages, 401K with company match, and competitive pay and paid time off.
  • Community: Award-winning culture of innovation and a military-friendly workplace.

Own your opportunity. Explore a career in program management at GDIT and you’ll find endless opportunities to grow alongside colleagues who share your passion for the mission and delivering results.

Job Description:

GDIT seeks a Network Engineer SME to support U.S. Pacific Command (USPACOM) J6 engineering, modernization, and sustainment. The position contributes to Mission Partner Environment (MPE) engineering planning and development, strengthening secure, resilient, interoperable mission capabilities for U.S. forces and mission partners throughout the Pacific region. This role partners directly with government stakeholders and multidisciplinary engineers to translate operational priorities into executable technical outcomes.

How The Network Engineer SME Will Make An Impact

  • Serve as a senior technical authority for enterprise and MPE network architectures supporting theater-wide resilient connectivity and mission partner operations.
  • Develop detailed LAN/WAN routing, switching, segmentation, redundancy, quality-of-service, and secure enclave connectivity designs; maintain network diagrams and implementation packages.
  • Analyze current-state networks and develop phased modernization and legacy divestiture plans, including migration dependencies, rollback, acceptance criteria, and sustainment handoff.
  • Diagnose complex interoperability, routing, transport, and performance issues across geographically distributed sites and multiple engineering stakeholders.

descriptionHtml:
Responsibilities

About the Team

ByteDance Networking brings together innovative ideas and technologies from network architecture, software defined networking (SDN), network virtualization, switch software and hardware co-design, and high-speed networking, to create hyperscale data-center networking solutions that power several of the most popular apps of the world such as Douyin and TikTok which serve hundreds of millions of users around the globe.

ByteDance Networking is responsible for designing, building, and operating the global, intelligent network infrastructure to meet the requirements of high availability, scalability, and high-performance. By joining this team, you will gain marketable software development and/or network operation experiences in data center networking at massive scale.

We are looking for talented individuals to join our team. As a graduate, you will get opportunities to pursue bold ideas, tackle complex challenges, and unlock limitless growth.

Successful candidates must be able to commit to an onboarding date by the end of the year. Please state your availability and graduation date clearly in your resume.

Candidates can apply to a maximum of two positions and will be considered for jobs in the order you apply. The application limit is applicable to our Company and its affiliates' jobs globally. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis - we encourage you to apply early.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, operate and optimize ByteDance's global network, including backbone, data center, public cloud and Edge/CDN.
  • Work with cross-functional teams including but not limited to compute, storage, database, recommendation system, drive the innovation and evolution of ByteDance network.


Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • Individuals who are completing or have recently completed a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Software Development, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Good network knowledge, such as OSI and TCP/IP model
  • Basic understanding of routing protocols such as OSPF, ISIS and BGP
  • Understanding of basic network monitoring protocols and tools, such as SNMP, Sflow/netflow, Telemetry.
  • Hands-on experience of network devices, such as Cisco, Arista, Juniper etc
  • Self-motivated, good communication and written skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Good understanding of IPv6 and IPv4-IPv6 co-existence technologies.
  • Programming/scripting in Python or other languages.


Job Information

【For Pay Transparency】Compensation Description (Annually)

The base salary range for this position in the selected city is $128000 - $256000 annually.

Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience, and location. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units.

Benefits may vary depending on the nature of employment and the country work location. Employees have day one access to medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) savings plan with company match, paid parental leave, short-term and long-term disability coverage, life insurance, wellbeing benefits, among others. Employees also receive 10 paid holidays per year, 10 paid sick days per year and 17 days of Paid Personal Time (prorated upon hire with increasing accruals by tenure).

The Company reserves the right to modify or change these benefits programs at any time, with or without notice.

For Los Angeles County (unincorporated) Candidates:

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Our company believes that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship on the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment:

  • Interacting and occasionally having unsupervised contact with internal/external clients and/or colleagues;
  • Appropriately handling and managing confidential information including proprietary and trade secret information and access to information technology systems; and
  • Exercising sound judgment.


About Us

Founded in 2012, ByteDance's mission is to inspire creativity and enrich life. With a suite of more than a dozen products, including TikTok, Lemon8, CapCut and Pico as well as platforms specific to the China market, including Toutiao, Douyin, and Xigua, ByteDance has made it easier and more fun for people to connect with, consume, and create content.

Why Join ByteDance

Inspiring creativity is at the core of ByteDance's mission. Our innovative products are built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and enrich life - a mission we work towards every day.

As ByteDancers, we strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our Company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion

ByteDance is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At ByteDance, our mission is to inspire creativity and enrich life. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

descriptionHtml:
About Us

AGE Solutions is a premier technology and professional services company, providing in-depth consulting, advanced technology solutions, and essential services throughout the U.S. government, defense, and intelligence sectors. Prioritizing innovation and client-focused solutions, we assist major agencies in addressing intricate issues and ensuring a more secure future.

The Corporate Enterprise Network (WAN): Network Engineer – Senior provides senior-level network engineering, implementation, modernization, and sustainment support for a DoD customer's global classified and unclassified WAN infrastructure. Responsible for ensuring secure, reliable connectivity between DoD facilities, networks, cloud environments, and mission-critical enterprise services.

Responsibilities Include

  • Design, configure, install, test, and maintain enterprise WAN routers, switches, firewalls, and associated infrastructure.
  • Support WAN connectivity across classified and unclassified networks as well as connectivity with DISN, NIPRNet, SIPRNet, and other DoD networks.
  • Configure and troubleshoot advanced routing and switching technologies, including BGP, OSPF, MPLS, multicast, QoS, and IPv4/IPv6.
  • Engineer and maintain Cisco networking platforms and Check Point firewall technologies.
  • Implement network technology refreshes, equipment replacements, and infrastructure modernization.
  • Perform Tier III/IV troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and restoration of network services.
  • Provide 24x7x365 on-call engineering support as required.
  • Conduct site surveys, infrastructure assessments, installation planning, and implementation activities.
  • Support DISA circuit provisioning, testing, activation, and troubleshooting.
  • Develop Engineering Change Requests, implementation plans, test plans, rollback procedures, and network diagrams.
  • Apply DISA STIGs, agency configuration standards, and cybersecurity requirements to network devices.
  • Evaluate network capacity, utilization, performance, and potential reliability improvements.
  • Support enterprise cloud connectivity, application delivery, and secure network integration.
  • Conduct laboratory testing, technology evaluations, and interoperability validation.
  • Provide technical support to Government and contractor WAN Management, NOC personnel, and other engineering teams.
  • Travel to CONUS or OCONUS locations for network installation or troubleshooting as required.

Required Skills, Qualifications And Experience

  • Experience:
    • Five years of progressive IT experience, including at least two projects involving Network and Telecommunications Services and Network Management. At least one qualifying project must have occurred within the previous three years.
  • Education:
    • High School Diploma.
  • Citizenship and Clearance:
    • US Citizenship is required.
    • DoD Top Secret clearance or Secret clearance with favorably adjudicated Tier 5/SSBI investigation.
  • Certification:
    • DoD 8570/8140: IAT Level III baseline certification.
    • Cisco Certified Network Professional – Enterprise (CCNP-E).
  • Location and Travel:
    • Candidates must be able to work daily from customer and/or contractor facilities as needed and be within commuting distance of one of the following locations:
      • Fort Belvoir, VA
      • Columbus, OH
      • Dayton, OH
      • New Cumberland, PA
      • Ogden, UT
      • Philadelphia, PA
      • Richmond, VA
      • Anniston, AL
      • San Diego, CA
      • Fort Bragg, NC
      • Robins AFB, GA
      • Tobyhanna, PA
    • Travel of up to approximately 40% may be required, both CONUS and OCONUS for network installation or troubleshooting as required.
Preferred Qualifications

  • Check Point Certified Security Administrator (CCSA) or higher certification.
    • If not attained prior to hire, must be attained after hire.
  • AWS Cloud Practitioner
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals
  • CompTIA Cloud+.
Work Environment And Physical Demand

  • Must be able to work from a computer for extended periods.
  • Must be able to work from office, comm closet, warehouse, and other environments associated with network deployment and sustainment.

The projected salary range for this position is $110,000+ annually. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including years of relevant experience, active security clearance level, certifications, technical skillset, contract requirements, and overall qualifications.

At AGE Solutions, we reward performance, invest in growth, and share success. Our benefits support the whole person, professionally, financially, and personally.

  • 26 Days Paid Leave: Includes vacation, sick, personal time, and holidays. You choose how to use it.
  • Performance Bonuses: Performance bonuses are awarded based on individual contributions and company-wide results, aligning recognition with impact.
  • 401(k) with Match: We match 3% of your contributions with immediate vesting.
  • Financial Protection: Company-paid life insurance up to $300K and options for additional coverage for you and your dependents.
  • Health Benefits: Multiple medical plans, dental, vision, FSA and HSA options to fit your needs.
  • Parental Leave: 15 days of fully paid leave for new parents, because family matters.
  • Military Differential Pay: We bridge the gap for employees on active duty, so they don’t take a financial hit while serving.
  • Professional Growth: Paid training and certifications, tuition reimbursement, and the tools and tech to get the job done right.
  • Shared Success: In the event of a company sale, our CEO has committed to returning 80% of net proceeds to employees. This ensures our team shares in the long term value they help create.

At AGE, you’ll do work that matters, supported by a company that delivers for its people.

NETWORK ENGINEER PRINCIPAL

Transform technology into opportunity as a Network Engineer Principal at GDIT. Shape what’s next for mission-critical government projects while shaping what’s next for your engineering career.

As a Network Engineer Principal, the work you’ll do at GDIT will be impactful to the mission of client.

  • Analyzes customer requirements and provides technical solutions to a wide range of difficult problems.
  • Performs Radio Frequency site surveys, analyze network performance, configure access points/controllers, and troubleshoot connectivity issues. Key requirements include expertise in 802.11 standards, Cisco/Aruba or Bastille hardware.
  • Plans, designs, and deploys network infrastructure (routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, and wireless devices).
  • Has strong understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, OSPF, BGP), VLANs, DNS, and OSI models.
  • Understand Risk Management Frame process to support IA team with Authority To Operate activities.
  • Performs maintenance and upgrade of networks including servers, routers, switches, firewalls, remote access systems, and networks. Be well versed in a multi-vendor environment for layer 2/3 switching and routing protocols (e.g., OSPF, BGP, etc.), Network management solutions, as well as virtual and cloud-hosted networking technologies.
  • Installs, configures, and maintains entire physical networking Wireless Intrusion Detection System (WIDS) infrastructure. Oversee the WIDS implementation, System Development Life Cycle (SDLC), and system/ network administration activities.
  • Operations & Maintenance to include system administration, information assurance, and storage management to all WIDS architectures. Analyzing network performance, resolving, and providing Tier-2/Tier-3 support for network and WIDS incidents.
  • Maintains network integrity and connectivity while ensuring compliance with policies and maintains system backup and recovery capability.
  • Must utilize network monitoring applications for traffic, access, and performance of entire network. Ensuring network reliability through continuous monitoring, proactive maintenance, and system upgrades.
  • Creates and updates technical documentation for network configuration, topology, and mapping.
  • Provide recommendations related to understanding operating system dependencies, physical and virtual server environments, integration with infrastructure resources (e.g. storage and networking), and how to configure operating systems and applications in an efficient manner.
  • Coordinates the acquisition of hardware and software as well as subcontractor services as needed.
  • Evaluates new network solution, capabilities, and technologies to enhance capabilities of the network.
  • Subject matter expert to escalate all IT issues to leadership.
  • Participates in special projects as required.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED

Bring your engineering expertise along with a drive for innovation to GDIT. The Network Engineer Principal must have:

  • Education: Bachelor of Arts/Bachelor of Science
  • Experience: 8+ years of related experience
  • Technical skills: Westfields experience, Wireless Intrusion Detection System (WIDS) implementation, System Development Life Cycle, system/network administration activities, Windows and Linux systems experience a must.
  • Security clearance level: TS/SCI with polygraph
  • US citizenship required
  • Role requirements: Onsite client and travel required

GDIT IS YOUR PLACE

At GDIT, the mission is our purpose, and our people are at the center of everything we do.

  • Growth: AI-powered career tool that identifies career steps and learning opportunities
  • Support: An internal mobility team focused on helping you achieve your career goals
  • Rewards: Comprehensive benefits and wellness packages, 401K with company match, and competitive pay and paid time off
  • Community: Award-winning culture of innovation and a military-friendly workplace

OWN YOUR OPPORTUNITY

Explore an enterprise IT career at GDIT and you’ll find endless opportunities to grow alongside colleagues who share your desire to drive operations forward.

Onsite

descriptionHtml:
About Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analysis that provide clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns.

Position Overview

The Information Technology (ITS) team at CRA is currently a Global team of 40 professionals dedicated to enhancing, maintaining, and developing the firm's technology infrastructure and security. The team is comprised of four functions: Service Delivery & Telecom, Enterprise Application Solutions, Infrastructure, Networking and Cloud Services and Security. Information Technology staff are based in the Boston, Chicago, London, Munich, New York, Oakland, and Washington, DC offices.

Responsibilities

We are seeking an experienced Network Engineer to join our small global networking team. The successful candidate will bring in-depth, hands-on expertise in planning, designing, implementing, documenting, securing, and troubleshooting enterprise network systems across campus, data center, wireless, WAN, and cloud environments. This position supports day-to-day operations and maintenance, advances security initiatives, and collaborates with IT colleagues and business stakeholders on a global scale. Typical responsibilities include:

  • Design, install, configure, test, document, and maintain secure network infrastructure across on-premises and cloud environments;
  • Identify, diagnose, and resolve complex network, wireless, firewall, DNS, and connectivity issues;
  • Produce and maintain Microsoft Visio network diagrams, implementation plans, configuration standards, and as-built documentation;
  • Administer and use Nexus Dashboard, Catalyst Center, Infoblox, and other management platforms for visibility, configuration, assurance, and lifecycle activities;
  • Maintain accurate configuration records, inventories, circuit information, support documentation, and vendor contacts;
  • Plan and execute upgrades while minimizing service disruption and maintaining tested rollback procedures;
  • Develop, implement, and maintain policies, procedures, and training plans for network resource administration, appropriate use, and disaster recovery;
  • Ensure network hardware, software, firmware, and configurations are current, supportable, and secure;
  • Monitor and test network performance and provide meaningful performance statistics, reports, and recommendations;
  • Coordinate with internal teams and external vendors to deliver projects and resolve incidents;
  • Coordinate across other teams within the IT department and across the firm; some travel to other CRA offices will be expected;
  • Some out-of-hours and weekend work will be required for scheduled upgrades and in response to unexpected outages.

Desired Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree (Master's desirable) in Computer Science, Information Systems or related discipline;
  • 4-6 years relevant work experience, preferably in a professional services environment;
  • Current Cisco certification at the CCNA level or a demonstrated track record of maintaining Cisco certifications at or above the CCNA level is required; CCNP preferred, relevant Microsoft Azure and AWS certifications highly desired;
  • Demonstrated knowledge of secure LAN/WAN, campus, data center, wireless, and cloud networking operations;
  • Hands-on experience designing, implementing, and supporting networking in both Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS);
  • Hands-on experience with Cisco Nexus data center switching, Cisco Catalyst switching, Cisco Catalyst wireless, and Cisco Firepower firewalls;
  • Experience with network management and automation platforms, including Cisco Nexus Dashboard, Cisco Catalyst Center, and Infoblox;
  • Demonstrated skill designing and documenting logical and physical networks using Microsoft Visio;
  • Strong practical knowledge of Cisco enterprise networking platforms across LAN/WAN, data center, wireless, firewall, and most importantly, cloud-connected environments;
  • Proficiency with network protocols and technologies, including Spanning Tree, DNS, DHCP, BGP, OSPF, HSRP, LACP, SNMP, NTP, IPsec VPN, and QoS;
  • Experience creating, reviewing, implementing, and troubleshooting firewall policies, preferably using Cisco Firepower;
  • Ability to create and maintain accurate network topology, rack, connectivity, and as-built documentation using Microsoft Visio;
  • Ability to propose and clearly communicate changes to existing network topology that improve availability, security, performance, and operational supportability;
  • Familiarity with ITIL change management practices, implementation planning, rollback planning, and pre-change risk assessment;
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across Layers 1 through 7, including packet capture and network performance analysis;
  • Must be comfortable in customer-facing scenarios and effectively collaborating in cross-functional technical teams;
  • Self-motivated, with a strong ability to prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment;
  • Ability to travel to other offices and execute project plans with minimal oversight.

Additional Preferred Skills

  • Demonstrated strong knowledge with Microsoft Azure networking, including virtual networks, routing, network security controls, and hybrid connectivity;
  • Demonstrated strong knowledge with Amazon Web Services networking, including VPCs, routing, security controls, and hybrid connectivity;
  • Cisco Nexus data center switches and Nexus Dashboard;
  • Cisco Catalyst switches, Catalyst wireless infrastructure, and Catalyst Center;
  • Cisco Firepower firewalls; Palo Alto firewall experience is also valued;
  • Infoblox DNS, DHCP, and IP address management (IPAM);
  • Cisco ISE and 802.1X network access control;
  • Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN;
  • Kemp LoadMaster load balancers;
  • Cisco Umbrella;
  • PKI, certificate lifecycle management, domain registration, DNS, and 802.1X fundamentals.

To Apply

To Be Considered For This Position, We Require

  • Resume – please include current address, personal email and telephone number;
  • Work Product (optional, submitted in cover letter field) – submit a sample set of diagrams generated with Visio.

Career Growth And Benefits

  • CRA’s robust skills development programs, encompassing both formal and informal programs, encourage you to thrive as an individual and team member. Training includes technical training, presentation skills, internal seminars, and career mentoring and performance coaching from an assigned senior colleague. Additional leadership and collaboration opportunities exist through internal firm development activities.
  • We offer a comprehensive total rewards program including a superior benefits package, wellness programming to support physical, mental, emotional and financial well-being, and in-house immigration support for foreign nationals and international business travelers.

CRA creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognize that individuals realize a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently expect that individuals spend at least 3 to 4 days a week working in the office (which may include traveling to another CRA office or to client meetings), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.

We believe that recruiting is fundamentally a human process, and we are committed to a hiring process that is fair, transparent, and people-focused. While AI and other technology-enabled tools help our team operate more efficiently, we strive to provide every candidate with a personalized, thoughtful, and high-touch experience. As CRA invests significant human effort to find qualified members for our teams, we expect candidates to invest corresponding human effort to learn about CRA, prepare thoughtful application materials, and engage with our interviewers. Read more about appropriate hiring manager, recruiting team, and candidate AI at CRA on our website.

Charles River Associates is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

Salary And Other Compensation

A good-faith estimate of the annual base salary range for this position is $130,000-$152,500. Starting pay within this range may vary based on factors such as education level, experience, skills, geographic location, market conditions, and other qualifications of the successful candidate. This position is eligible for additional bonus incentive compensation. CRA offers a comprehensive benefits package, subject to eligibility requirements, which includes: medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) retirement plan with employer match; life and disability insurance; paid time off (vacation, sick leave, holidays); paid parental leave; wellness programs and employee assistance resources; and commuter benefits.
