Job Summary

The Senior Network Engineer is responsible for implementing, configuring, and maintaining network infrastructure across the enterprise. This role focuses on hands-on technical work including performance monitoring, issue resolution, and configuration management. The Senior Network Engineer works closely with architecture and security teams to ensure operational excellence and supports the stability, scalability, and security of all network services.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deploy, configure, and maintain enterprise-grade network infrastructure across global data centers and remote sites. (routers, switches, firewalls, wireless, etc.)
  • Monitor and optimize network performance using industry-standard tools to ensure high availability and reliability across diverse time zones.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of network topology, configurations, and operational procedures.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues involving routing, switching, firewalls, wireless systems, and connectivity between international locations.
  • Execute network changes and updates following change management processes.
  • Support the administration of Cisco network gear along with Palo Alto, Checkpoint, and F5 solutions.
  • Perform firmware upgrades, patches, and configuration changes in line with change management protocols.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams—including architecture, security, and cloud operations—to support integrated infrastructure projects.
  • Work with vendors and service providers to maintain uptime and support.
  • Document configuration standards and network diagrams to support scalability and incident response.
  • Provide input on network designs and participate in the evaluation of new technologies.
  • Ensure compliance with security standards and assist in audits or remediation tasks.
  • Serve as a technical escalation point for network-related incidents and problems.
  • Participate in on-call rotation and global incident escalations to ensure 24x7 uptime coverage.

Education Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in information systems, Engineering, Computer Science or a related field of study. Related experience may be considered in lieu of required formal education

Experience

5–7 years of experience in network engineering, including configuration, troubleshooting, and support of enterprise networks.

Licenses/Certifications Required

  • Professional Industry Certifications in the area of Network infrastructure, such as CCNP, CCIE

Licenses/Certifications Preferred

  • Industry Certifications in Networking, Cyber, wireless, telecom, or other infrastructure areas

Technical Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with Cisco routing and switching platforms (Catalyst, Nexus)
  • Configuration and support of Cisco and/or Juniper routers and switches
  • Network monitoring tools (e.g., SolarWinds, NetFlow, Wireshark)
  • Firewall administration (e.g., Palo Alto, Checkpoint, Cisco ASA)
  • Load balancer configuration and troubleshooting (F5 LTM/GTM)
  • Wireless networking (e.g., Cisco, HP/Aruba)
  • IP addressing and protocols: IPv4/IPv6, TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, DNS, DHCP
  • VLANs, STP, HSRP/VRRP, port-channeling
  • TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, BGP, EIGRP, OSPF
  • Network change and incident management processes
  • Familiarity with SD-WAN and basic cloud networking concepts (AWS/GCP/Azure)
  • Network monitoring and packet analysis tools (SolarWinds, Wireshark, NetFlow)
  • Solid understanding of global WAN technologies, VPN, and remote access infrastructure

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman’s Aeronautics Systems sector has an opening for a Network Engineer or Principal Network Engineer to join our team of qualified, diverse individuals in our Avionics organization. This position is located in Melbourne, FL.

In this role, you will design, plan, and implement secure IP‑based network communications systems for mission‑critical aircraft, delivering detailed architecture schematics, hardware/software specifications, and capacity forecasts. The role demands solid expertise in IP subnetting, routing protocols such as BDP, OSPF, and EIGRP, hands‑on Cisco IOS‑XE configuration, and advanced technologies like GRE/IPSEC tunnels, VRF, and VRRP, together with thorough testing and validation of network designs. You will maintain technical proficiency across routers, multiplexers, firewalls, hubs, bridges, and gateways, evaluate emerging communications technologies to enhance performance and cost‑effectiveness, and produce comprehensive documentation for short‑ and long‑range network planning.

Responsibilities And Expectations

  • Practical knowledge of functional and physical architecture definition, interface control, and creation of design drawings.
  • Hands-on involvement in test and verification processes, including creating verification matrices, overseeing hardware/software test, and managing test documentation.
  • Strong communication skills for cross-functional collaboration and supplier interaction.
  • Solid Understanding of IP4 network design, including IP subnetting and routing protocols including BGP, OSPF and EIGRP.
  • Ability to configure and troubleshoot common network devices; Required: Cisco IOS-XE.
  • Solid Understanding of advanced network topics, such as GRE/IPSEC tunnels, VRF, VRRP.
  • Solid understanding with network management protocols, like SNMP, SSH, syslog, RADIUS/TACACS.

This position may be filled by either at the Network Engineer OR Principal Network Engineer level based on the qualifications below.

Basic Qualifications

At a Network Engineer Level:

  • Must have a Bachelor's of Science degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) discipline AND 2 years of relevant military/professional experience; OR a Master's of Science Degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) discipline.

At a Principal Network Engineer Level

  • Must have a Bachelor's of Science degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) discipline AND 5 years of relevant military/professional experience; OR a Master's of Science Degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) discipline AND 3 years of relevant military/professional experience, OR a Ph.D. in a STEM discipline AND 1 year of related professional/military experience in Engineering.

And At Both Levels

  • Must have an US Government Secret clearance with the ability to obtain and maintain an interim Top Secret prior to starting, within a reasonable amount of time as determined by the business (with a background investigation completed within the last 6 years or currently enrolled into Continuous Evaluation).
  • Must have the ability to obtain and maintain Special Access Program (SAP) clearance within a reasonable amount of time as determined by business needs.
  • Must have experience performing requirements analysis and developing technical requirement documentation for hardware/software subsystems.
  • Must have experience supporting acquisition activities such as RFP development, supplier coordination, and reviewing supplier deliverables.
  • Must have experience with data acquisition from aerospace interfaces, specifically MIL-STD-1553 or equivalent bus protocols.

Preferred Qualifications

  • DODD 8570 certifications, such as CompTIA Security+, CISSP, or similar network/security certifications.
  • Familiarity with AGILE processes and SCRUM tools (JIRA, Confluence).
  • Familiar with Windows and Linux configuration and troubleshooting.
  • A professional certification specific to the networking industry like a CCNA/CCNP/CCIE or equivalent.
  • Experience with authentication and data encryption methods, to include securing communications at either the datalink or network layer.
  • Experience with embedded systems, Unix and Linux operating systems, single board computers, servers and Network Attached Storage (NAS) solutions.
  • Experience with non-Cisco networking environments such as Juniper or Palo Alto.
  • Experience with virtualization environments.
  • Working knowledge of cyber security and Risk Managed Framework (RMF), STIGs and associated elements.
  • Familiar with network management applications, like Splunk, Firepower Management Center (FMC), and/or Cisco ISE.
  • Experience with HAIPE/TACLANE and other military COMSEC/CRYPTO equipment and procedures.
  • Experience with tactical/military radio networks, like Common Data Link (CDL) and ANW2.
  • Experience performing troubleshooting with traffic capture tools, such as Wireshark and tcpdump, nmap and netcat.

Primary Level Salary Range: $79,300.00 - $118,900.00

Secondary Level Salary Range: $98,400.00 - $147,600.00

The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions.

Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business.

The application period for the job is estimated to be 20 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.

descriptionHtml:
ABOUT US:

LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a commitment to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, handle risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years.

Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.

LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 70 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG.

Our People:

People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our culture of connecting, creating opportunity and delivering excellence shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential.

We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and exciting experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.

We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise.

As a global organization spanning 70 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with relevant careers.

Role Summary

As the High-Skills Network Technical Lead, your main responsibility will be to ensure the ongoing support and reliability of all components within the LSEG ecosystem, including platforms, networks, applications, and services. In this role, you will provide 4th-line support to the Network Products and Services functions, ensuring the operational stability and adaptability of the LSEG global network. Your key focus will be on creating and maintaining software automation that improves the reliability and availability of digital platforms and their software delivery pipelines.

What You will be Doing:

  • You will play a significant role in designing, building, and maintaining systems, software, and applications across various domains. Your goal is to achieve the highest quality outcomes.
  • Independently, you’ll make technical design and amendment decisions, leading the workload effectively.
  • By analyzing data and understanding business requirements, you’ll translate them into technical requirements, ensuring alignment with infrastructure and network capacity needs.
  • You’ll complete relevant reporting documentation, ensuring it adheres to both internal and external standards.
  • Collaborating closely with other business areas, you’ll schedule and coordinate capacity and network upgrades, meeting service level objectives.
  • When vital, you’ll lead upgrades, coordinating efforts with internal teams and third parties.
  • Building accurate documentation and monitoring system performance are crucial to contribute optimally to business activities and continuous improvement.
  • You’ll support the deployment of emergent engineering patterns across development teams.
  • Contributing to creating solutions, you’ll coordinate design work within the infrastructure and network domain.

What You will Bring:

Preferred Skills and Experience:

  • A bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in an IT-related field is essential.
  • Previous roles in architecture or engineering are valuable.
  • Significant experience in technology-focused positions is crucial.
  • Extensive knowledge of routing and switching protocols, with a preference for CCIE certification, is highly desirable.
  • Proven years of experience in network products and services, ideally working with Cisco, Juniper, and Arista technologies while actively pursuing further accreditation, is important.
  • Expertise spanning LAN, WAN, HSRP, NAT, MPLS, VPN, GRE, BGP, and OSPF is vital.
  • Knowledge of multicast concepts, including IGMP, RP, and PIM, is beneficial.
  • Familiarity with low-latency technologies commonly deployed in the financial sector is advantageous.
  • Excellent knowledge of network Packet analysis and Packet Capture tools gives to operational efficiency.
  • Experience with Data Centre Networking, including Software-Defined Networking (SDN), Cisco ACI, VxLAN, and related technologies, is valuable.
  • Understanding cloud environments and possessing knowledge of network security, including standard processes, is beneficial.
  • Familiarity with load balancing technologies, TCP/IP, and multicast in internet environments is important.
  • Proficiency in required Service Management processes, ideally with ITIL knowledge, is advantageous.
  • Exposure to the financial sector and its associated technologies is valuable.
  • Proficiency in Python and Ansible allows for streamlined tasks.
  • Strong spoken and written English language skills, combined with client management abilities, supply to successful collaboration

Career Stage:

Manager

London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:

Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.

LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.

Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.

Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.

Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.

LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 70 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG.

Our People:

People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our culture of connecting, creating opportunity and delivering excellence shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential.

We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and exciting experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.

We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise.

As a global organization spanning 70 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with relevant careers.

Role Summary

As the High-Skills Network Technical Lead, your main responsibility will be to ensure the ongoing support and reliability of all components within the LSEG ecosystem, including platforms, networks, applications, and services. In this role, you will provide 4th-line support to the Network Products and Services functions, ensuring the operational stability and adaptability of the LSEG global network. Your key focus will be on creating and maintaining software automation that improves the reliability and availability of digital platforms and their software delivery pipelines.

What You will be Doing:



- You will play a significant role in designing, building, and maintaining systems, software, and applications across various domains. Your goal is to achieve the highest quality outcomes.
- Independently, you’ll make technical design and amendment decisions, leading the workload effectively.
- By analyzing data and understanding business requirements, you’ll translate them into technical requirements, ensuring alignment with infrastructure and network capacity needs.
- You’ll complete relevant reporting documentation, ensuring it adheres to both internal and external standards.
- Collaborating closely with other business areas, you’ll schedule and coordinate capacity and network upgrades, meeting service level objectives.
- When vital, you’ll lead upgrades, coordinating efforts with internal teams and third parties.
- Building accurate documentation and monitoring system performance are crucial to contribute optimally to business activities and continuous improvement.
- You’ll support the deployment of emergent engineering patterns across development teams.
- Contributing to creating solutions, you’ll coordinate design work within the infrastructure and network domain.

What You will Bring:

Preferred Skills and Experience:



- A bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in an IT-related field is essential.
- Previous roles in architecture or engineering are valuable.
- Significant experience in technology-focused positions is crucial.
- Extensive knowledge of routing and switching protocols, with a preference for CCIE certification, is highly desirable.
- Proven years of experience in network products and services, ideally working with Cisco, Juniper, and Arista technologies while actively pursuing further accreditation, is important.
- Expertise spanning LAN, WAN, HSRP, NAT, MPLS, VPN, GRE, BGP, and OSPF is vital.
- Knowledge of multicast concepts, including IGMP, RP, and PIM, is beneficial.
- Familiarity with low-latency technologies commonly deployed in the financial sector is advantageous.
- Excellent knowledge of network Packet analysis and Packet Capture tools gives to operational efficiency.
- Experience with Data Centre Networking, including Software-Defined Networking (SDN), Cisco ACI, VxLAN, and related technologies, is valuable.
- Understanding cloud environments and possessing knowledge of network security, including standard processes, is beneficial.
- Familiarity with load balancing technologies, TCP/IP, and multicast in internet environments is important.

descriptionHtml:
Job Number: R0251160

Network Engineer, Senior

The Opportunity:

A well-designed network is critical to move data and enable warfighters to achieve their missions, but how can an organization make sure their network will fit their current and evolving needs? Crafting the right network with the right equipment and software requires a combination of technical skill and careful planning. That’s why we need you, a network engineer who knows how to deliver satellite communications network needs.

As a Satellite Communications Network Engineer on our team, you will help develop, modernize, and sustain secure and resilient network capabilities that support critical defense operations. You’ll use your skills in network design, architecture, Layer 2 and 3 technologies, and system interoperability to improve reliability, availability, and performance across mission‑focused environments. You will also contribute to engineering efforts including implementation planning, technical reviews, test activities, and upgrades supporting enterprise‑wide modernization.

You’ll apply your knowledge in routing and switching, network design and architecture, IP engineering, network transport layers, updating network equipment, and performance monitoring as you join our team of problem-solvers to help the DoD evolve and deploy new capabilities and technologies. Your knowledge of network protocols, equipment, emerging technology, and configurations will come in handy as you help optimize client operations and modernization initiatives. Using your experience in Cisco, Juniper, and other COTS hardware and network performance management, and your technical curiosity and knowledge of industry standards, you’ll serve as a trusted advisor to clients on mission-critical projects and make an impact on national security missions.

Grow your career with us as we help the DoD field and sustain satellite communications capabilities to provide data and voice solutions to tactical and strategic users of worldwide network of SATCOM Teleports.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 4+ years of experience with network configuration, troubleshooting, or engineering support
  • Experience architecting and designing complex network systems and leading the testing and deployment of systems or solutions
  • Experience supporting engineering implementation planning, sustainment engineering, or technical reviews
  • Experience with routing and switching technologies and Layer 2 and 3 network protocols
  • Knowledge of network design and architecture, OSI model concepts, transport layers, and system interoperability
  • Knowledge of network security technologies and firewall implementations
  • Ability to perform Tier III troubleshooting of complex issues
  • Ability to interpret network diagrams, engineering documentation, and lab test outputs
  • Secret clearance
  • HS diploma or GED


Nice If You Have:

  • Experience leading large‑scale network modernization, migration, or redesign initiatives
  • Experience creating or approving engineering plans, topology diagrams, and risk assessments
  • Experience coordinating across engineering, cyber, operations, and mission stakeholders
  • Knowledge of enterprise engineering standards and long‑term architecture planning
  • Ability to mentor junior and mid‑level engineers, influence engineering decisions, and improve SOPs, baselines, and repeatable engineering processes independently
  • Ability to communicate complex network principles and designs to clients
  • Possession of excellent time management, analytical, and verbal and written communication skills
  • Top Secret clearance
  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Cisco Certified Network Professional Certification (CCNP), Security+, or Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) Certification


Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Secret clearance is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $77,600.00 to $176,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

  • Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
  • Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen or customer facility, in alignment with your leadership's expectations and the needs of the role.
  • Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed full-time at a customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.


Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

Position Title: Senior Network Engineer

Department: Network Engineering

About The Role

We are seeking a Senior Network Engineer who brings deep technical expertise, sound operational judgment, and the ability to deliver reliable, scalable network services across multi-region and global environments, including regulated and compliant FedRAMP-authorized platforms. This role is primarily operations‑focused, encompassing ownership of day‑to‑day network reliability, performance, and incident response, while also incorporating engineering and build responsibilities as required—such as evolving routing architectures, developing and maintaining automation pipelines, troubleshooting complex network behaviors, and executing major initiatives across data centers and cloud platforms.

Beyond technical capability, we are looking for the right cultural fit: someone who embodies our core expectation to "be kind"—a teammate who collaborates openly, communicates respectfully, supports others, and contributes to a positive, inclusive engineering culture.

You will work closely with Architecture, Product, Security, Compliance, and Operations teams to ensure our global backbone, data center networks, cloud connectivity, and FedRAMP environments remain secure, resilient, automated, compliant, and well-documented. You will be empowered to own meaningful problems end-to-end, influence design patterns, and mentor engineers across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Network Design & Implementation

  • Engineer, build, operate, and deliver network solutions for global data centers, cloud platforms, FedRAMP-authorized environments, build environments, and product connectivity needs.
  • Engineer and optimize routing for a global IP backbone, including multi-region anycast and unicast route propagation, redundancy, and traffic-engineering strategies.
  • Engineer, build, and operate scalable, highly available L3 topologies using BGP, OSPF, and robust routing policy (communities, AS-path manipulation, MED/local-pref tuning, ECMP, route-reflector hierarchy).
  • Design and implement secure network segmentation, boundary controls, and traffic isolation required for FedRAMP Moderate/High environments.
  • Implement hybrid and cloud-native routing across AWS/Azure/GCP using Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, VPN, Transit Gateway, Virtual WAN, and cloud router constructs - ensuring alignment with FedRAMP architectures and security control requirements.
  • Develop and maintain automated provisioning, configuration, compliance, and validation pipelines using Python, Ansible/AWX, and Git-driven CI/CD workflows, including FedRAMP configuration baselines.


Network Operations & Reliability

  • Ensure connectivity, availability, and performance across multi-region data centers, backbone sites, cloud platforms, and regulated FedRAMP environments using proactive monitoring, telemetry, and lifecycle management practices.
  • Operate networks in accordance with FedRAMP continuous monitoring requirements, including configuration drift detection, vulnerability mitigation, and audit readiness.
  • Troubleshoot complex routing, TCP, and connectivity issues using tools such as netcat, ping/ICMP, logs, and packet captures.
  • Lead or support major incident response when needed, including FedRAMP-relevant incident handling, escalation, and reporting procedures.
  • Execute changes, upgrades, and migrations safely using structured procedures (MOPs), documented approvals, automated workflows, and validated rollback mechanisms.
  • Remediate vulnerabilities and maintain compliance across network OS versions, configurations, firmware, and security posture in coordination with Security and Compliance teams.


Engineering, Build & Automation

  • Engineer enhancements, new capabilities, and service-driven connectivity features supporting product, platform evolution, and FedRAMP boundary services.
  • Design automation that enforces least privilege, segmentation, encryption-in-transit, logging, and configuration compliance for regulated environments.
  • Replace manual operational steps with automated workflows incorporating pre/post-checks, compliance gates, evidence collection, and safe-rollback logic.
  • Test new network OS versions, automation logic, routing changes, and security controls in controlled environments prior to production and FedRAMP deployment.
  • Partner with Build, Engineering, Architecture, Product, Security, and Compliance teams to ensure reliability, scalability, and alignment with FedRAMP control objectives.


Execution, Planning & Vendor Management

  • Translate product, regulatory, and platform requirements into network designs that meet FedRAMP architectural and security expectations with clear timelines and dependencies.
  • Conduct capacity planning across links, devices, cloud gateways, backbone segments, routing domains, and FedRAMP boundary components.
  • Manage procurement cycles, RMA workflows, vendor escalations, and equipment lifecycle, ensuring vendors and solutions support FedRAMP use cases.
  • Evaluate vendor technologies for performance, resiliency, automation compatibility, FedRAMP eligibility, and cost-effectiveness.


Documentation & Knowledge Management

  • Create and maintain high-quality runbooks, architectural diagrams, and troubleshooting guides, including FedRAMP boundary diagrams and network control documentation.
  • Maintain accurate documentation required for FedRAMP audits, assessments, and continuous monitoring activities.
  • Define lifecycle standards for network roles, routing constructs, appliances, and platform components.
  • Ensure monitoring, alerting, and operational procedures are documented, auditable, and continuously improved.
  • Mentor engineers through structured troubleshooting, technical deep dives, FedRAMP design considerations, and post-incident learning sessions.


Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (Master’s preferred).
  • 10+ years in network engineering with experience in large-scale, multi-region, and global routing environments.
  • Experience engineering, operating, or supporting FedRAMP Moderate and/or High environments is strongly preferred.


Technical Skills

  • Deep hands-on expertise with BGP and OSPF in global IP backbone environments, including traffic engineering and multi-vendor interoperability.
  • Strong operational and engineering experience with JunOS (MX, QFX preferred).
  • Proficiency with additional network & OS platforms (e.g., Fortinet, Opengear, BigIP, EOS, NX-OS, IOS-XE) is a plus.
  • Strong troubleshooting across routing, switching, TCP/IP, asymmetric paths, latency, packet loss, MTU/fragmentation, and QoS behaviors.
  • Experienced with hybrid cloud and cloud-native networking across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP.
  • Hands-on automation skills using Python, Ansible/AWX, configuration templating, Git workflows, and automated testing/validation pipelines.
  • Experience with AI based toolsets, API/MCP data sources, skills and agents to produce repeatable workflows, scripting, application tools, observability and automation to reduce toil and increase efficiency.
  • Strong understanding of network security controls, boundary protection, encryption, logging, and segmentation concepts required for FedRAMP.
  • Familiarity with firewalls, VPNs, DDoS mitigation, IDS/IPS, and NIST 800-53-based security frameworks.


Soft Skills

  • Strong incident leadership skills, able to coordinate cross-functional teams under pressure and produce meaningful RCA’s and CAPA’s
  • Excellent written and verbal communication across Architecture, Product, Security, Compliance, Operations, and Build teams.
  • Ability to mentor and elevate peers and junior engineers.
  • Effective in fast-paced environments with competing priorities and regulatory constraints.
  • Strong analytical thinking, structured problem-solving, and continuous-improvement mindset.
  • Reinforces a positive culture and demonstrates our expectation to "be kind."

Job summary

If you enjoy working with new technologies, enterprise-leading equipment, and seek to optimize systems to achieve maximum performance, we would like to speak to you. This position will play a key role in driving the performance, stability, and scalability of next-generation networks to support Information Technology (IT) workloads.

You will join a diverse team of software and platform engineers to design, deploy, and maintain network infrastructure. You will collaborate with people inside and outside the organization to deliver the highest standards for building, deploying, and scaling networks.

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Network Engineer to join our team. As a key member of the Networking team, you will play a critical role in implementing and supporting robust network infrastructure solutions.

Key Job Responsibilities

  • Deploy, configure, troubleshoot, and maintain Layer 2/3 data center architectures using BGP, VLANs, MLAG, LAG, Spine/Leaf topologies, Trunk/Access ports, and other related technologies.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into effective network solutions.
  • Stay updated on the latest networking trends and best practices; proactively seek out new learning opportunities to enhance technical expertise.
  • Contribute to the documentation of network infrastructure designs and configurations for future reference and knowledge sharing among team members.
  • Travel up to 25% of the time, as required, to perform on-site installations, maintenance, and troubleshooting activities at customer sites or data centers.

Required Qualifications

  • Proven experience in deploying, configuring, and managing Layer 2/3 Data Center architectures.
  • Expertise in VLAN, MLAG (Multi-Chassis Link Aggregation Group), LAG (Link Aggregation Group) configuration, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience with Spine and Leaf architecture design and implementation.
  • Strong understanding of Trunk/Access ports, their functions, and how to configure them for optimal performance in various network environments.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills; ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to travel up to 25% of the time, as required.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and commitment to quality work.
  • Ability to stay updated on industry trends and technology advancements; willingness to continue learning new things.
  • Active TS/SCI and the ability to maintain access as required by the program
  • Candidates must be able to lift to 25lbs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience deploying, managing, and monitoring a diverse ecosystem of networking technologies to guarantee maximum availability, performance, and security of the network.
  • Proficiency with network telemetry and analysis tools (Wireshark, SNMP, NetFlow, and Solarwinds) for deep packet inspection and network optimization.
  • Extensive hands-on experience configuring enterprise-grade core/edge routers, firewalls, and switches (Cisco, Juniper, and Arista).
  • Experience implementing secure WAN transport mechanisms such as IPSEC site-to-site VPNs, GRE/DMVPN tunnels, QoS traffic shaping, and ACL policies.
  • In depth experience deploying and troubleshooting core dynamic routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP), MPLS, and modern SD-WAN platforms (Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN\VIPTELA, Fortinet, or Silver Peak) to manage multisite enterprise traffic and WAN edge connectivity.

We offer

  • A dynamic and collaborative working environment that fosters professional growth and development.
  • Opportunities for personal and technical skill enhancement through ongoing training and professional development opportunities.
  • A supportive and inclusive team culture that values diversity and encourages individual contributions.

If you are passionate about networking, have a strong technical background, and thrive in a collaborative environment, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At ELEVI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits. Learn more here.

$185,000-240,000

Each member of the team enjoys the opportunity to expand their career to meet their individual goals and objectives. We celebrate the ideas that bring about positive change, and the diverse talents and backgrounds that come together to create those ideas.

We trust our employees and empower them to shape their work themselves so that we can achieve the best possible results.

descriptionHtml:
About Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analysis that provide clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns.

Position Overview

The Information Technology (ITS) team at CRA is currently a Global team of 40 professionals dedicated to enhancing, maintaining, and developing the firm's technology infrastructure and security. The team is comprised of four functions: Service Delivery & Telecom, Enterprise Application Solutions, Infrastructure, Networking and Cloud Services and Security. Information Technology staff are based in the Boston, Chicago, London, Munich, New York, Oakland, and Washington, DC offices.

Responsibilities

We are seeking an experienced Network Engineer to join our small global networking team. The successful candidate will bring in-depth, hands-on expertise in planning, designing, implementing, documenting, securing, and troubleshooting enterprise network systems across campus, data center, wireless, WAN, and cloud environments. This position supports day-to-day operations and maintenance, advances security initiatives, and collaborates with IT colleagues and business stakeholders on a global scale. Typical responsibilities include:

  • Design, install, configure, test, document, and maintain secure network infrastructure across on-premises and cloud environments;
  • Identify, diagnose, and resolve complex network, wireless, firewall, DNS, and connectivity issues;
  • Produce and maintain Microsoft Visio network diagrams, implementation plans, configuration standards, and as-built documentation;
  • Administer and use Nexus Dashboard, Catalyst Center, Infoblox, and other management platforms for visibility, configuration, assurance, and lifecycle activities;
  • Maintain accurate configuration records, inventories, circuit information, support documentation, and vendor contacts;
  • Plan and execute upgrades while minimizing service disruption and maintaining tested rollback procedures;
  • Develop, implement, and maintain policies, procedures, and training plans for network resource administration, appropriate use, and disaster recovery;
  • Ensure network hardware, software, firmware, and configurations are current, supportable, and secure;
  • Monitor and test network performance and provide meaningful performance statistics, reports, and recommendations;
  • Coordinate with internal teams and external vendors to deliver projects and resolve incidents;
  • Coordinate across other teams within the IT department and across the firm; some travel to other CRA offices will be expected;
  • Some out-of-hours and weekend work will be required for scheduled upgrades and in response to unexpected outages.

Desired Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree (Master's desirable) in Computer Science, Information Systems or related discipline;
  • 4-6 years relevant work experience, preferably in a professional services environment;
  • Current Cisco certification at the CCNA level or a demonstrated track record of maintaining Cisco certifications at or above the CCNA level is required; CCNP preferred, relevant Microsoft Azure and AWS certifications highly desired;
  • Demonstrated knowledge of secure LAN/WAN, campus, data center, wireless, and cloud networking operations;
  • Hands-on experience designing, implementing, and supporting networking in both Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS);
  • Hands-on experience with Cisco Nexus data center switching, Cisco Catalyst switching, Cisco Catalyst wireless, and Cisco Firepower firewalls;
  • Experience with network management and automation platforms, including Cisco Nexus Dashboard, Cisco Catalyst Center, and Infoblox;
  • Demonstrated skill designing and documenting logical and physical networks using Microsoft Visio;
  • Strong practical knowledge of Cisco enterprise networking platforms across LAN/WAN, data center, wireless, firewall, and most importantly, cloud-connected environments;
  • Proficiency with network protocols and technologies, including Spanning Tree, DNS, DHCP, BGP, OSPF, HSRP, LACP, SNMP, NTP, IPsec VPN, and QoS;
  • Experience creating, reviewing, implementing, and troubleshooting firewall policies, preferably using Cisco Firepower;
  • Ability to create and maintain accurate network topology, rack, connectivity, and as-built documentation using Microsoft Visio;
  • Ability to propose and clearly communicate changes to existing network topology that improve availability, security, performance, and operational supportability;
  • Familiarity with ITIL change management practices, implementation planning, rollback planning, and pre-change risk assessment;
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across Layers 1 through 7, including packet capture and network performance analysis;
  • Must be comfortable in customer-facing scenarios and effectively collaborating in cross-functional technical teams;
  • Self-motivated, with a strong ability to prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment;
  • Ability to travel to other offices and execute project plans with minimal oversight.

Additional Preferred Skills

  • Demonstrated strong knowledge with Microsoft Azure networking, including virtual networks, routing, network security controls, and hybrid connectivity;
  • Demonstrated strong knowledge with Amazon Web Services networking, including VPCs, routing, security controls, and hybrid connectivity;
  • Cisco Nexus data center switches and Nexus Dashboard;
  • Cisco Catalyst switches, Catalyst wireless infrastructure, and Catalyst Center;
  • Cisco Firepower firewalls; Palo Alto firewall experience is also valued;
  • Infoblox DNS, DHCP, and IP address management (IPAM);
  • Cisco ISE and 802.1X network access control;
  • Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN;
  • Kemp LoadMaster load balancers;
  • Cisco Umbrella;
  • PKI, certificate lifecycle management, domain registration, DNS, and 802.1X fundamentals.

To Apply

To Be Considered For This Position, We Require

  • Resume – please include current address, personal email and telephone number;
  • Work Product (optional, submitted in cover letter field) – submit a sample set of diagrams generated with Visio.

Career Growth And Benefits

  • CRA’s robust skills development programs, encompassing both formal and informal programs, encourage you to thrive as an individual and team member. Training includes technical training, presentation skills, internal seminars, and career mentoring and performance coaching from an assigned senior colleague. Additional leadership and collaboration opportunities exist through internal firm development activities.
  • We offer a comprehensive total rewards program including a superior benefits package, wellness programming to support physical, mental, emotional and financial well-being, and in-house immigration support for foreign nationals and international business travelers.

Work Location Flexibility

CRA creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognize that individuals realize a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently expect that individuals spend at least 3 to 4 days a week working in the office (which may include traveling to another CRA office or to client meetings), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.

Responsible AI Use in Recruiting

We believe that recruiting is fundamentally a human process, and we are committed to a hiring process that is fair, transparent, and people-focused. While AI and other technology-enabled tools help our team operate more efficiently, we strive to provide every candidate with a personalized, thoughtful, and high-touch experience. As CRA invests significant human effort to find qualified members for our teams, we expect candidates to invest corresponding human effort to learn about CRA, prepare thoughtful application materials, and engage with our interviewers. Read more about appropriate hiring manager, recruiting team, and candidate AI at CRA on our website.

Our Commitment to Equal Employment Opportunity

Charles River Associates is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

Salary And Other Compensation

A good-faith estimate of the annual base salary range for this position is $130,000-$152,500. Starting pay within this range may vary based on factors such as education level, experience, skills, geographic location, market conditions, and other qualifications of the successful candidate. This position is eligible for additional bonus incentive compensation. CRA offers a comprehensive benefits package, subject to eligibility requirements, which includes: medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) retirement plan with employer match; life and disability insurance; paid time off (vacation, sick leave, holidays); paid parental leave; wellness programs and employee assistance resources; and commuter benefits.

Job Description

Designs, implements, and operates resilient L3/L4 network services across data centers and cloud environments with broader influence beyond the immediate team. Leads moderately complex projects, drives automation and observability at scale, and contributes to standards and architectures. Mentors junior engineers, provides input on team decisions, and collaborates with SRE, platform, and security partners to deliver secure, compliant, and highly available network services with measurable impact on both team and group outcomes.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

L3/L4 Network Topologies and Overlays:

  • Lead designs for IP addressing, routing policies (BGP/OSPF/IS-IS), EVPN/VXLAN fabrics, and SDN overlays spanning on-prem and cloud.
  • Define HA, ECMP, and traffic-engineering patterns; validate through lab/sandbox testing, failure modeling, and staged rollouts.
  • Author design docs and drive reviews involving related teams; de-risk changes with method-of-procedure (MOP), rollback, and verification plans.


Cloud Networking Implementation and Operations:

  • Implement and operate VPC/VNet topologies, subnets, routing tables, NAT, Transit/Hub-and-Spoke (e.g., TGW/VCN), PrivateLink/service endpoints, and inter-cloud connectivity.
  • Design and tune L4/L7 load balancing and service insertion (proxies, firewalls) to meet defined SLOs and cost targets.
  • Ensure consistent network policy and connectivity across environments using standard blueprints and golden configs.


Network Security Controls and Compliance Guardrails:

  • Engineer segmentation (VRFs/security zones), ACLs/policies, encryption (IPsec/TLS), and DDoS/WAF integrations aligned to zero-trust.
  • Embed compliance guardrails (change control, access least privilege, evidence collection) and partner with security/GRC to pass audits.
  • Periodically review rulebases and routing policies; eliminate shadow/duplicate rules and reduce attack surface.


Automation, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code:

  • Develop reusable Terraform modules and Ansible playbooks; enforce code reviews, linting, policy-as-code, and test gates in pipelines.
  • Build validation and drift-detection tooling using APIs and scripting (e.g., Python); integrate automated rollbacks and canary changes.
  • Champion GitOps practices, configuration data modeling, and inventory source of truth.


Monitoring, Telemetry, and SLOs:

  • Implement SNMP/streaming telemetry, NetFlow/IPFIX, and flow logs for health, capacity, and security analytics.
  • Define SLIs/SLOs (availability, latency, loss, jitter) and build dashboards/alerts/runbooks; lead capacity/perf reviews and right-sizing actions.
  • Correlate telemetry with incidents; drive problem management and reduction of repeat issues.


Cross-Team Collaboration and Operations Excellence:

  • Partner with SRE, platform, and security teams on architecture reviews, incident response, post-incident remediation, and capacity planning.
  • Lead portions of on-call response and complex change events; coordinate with related teams to minimize risk and downtime.
  • Contribute to cross-LOB standards, reference architectures, and service onboarding patterns.


Documentation, Reviews, and Standards:

  • Produce and maintain high-quality design docs, network diagrams, runbooks, and inventories; ensure traceability to requirements and controls.
  • Facilitate and participate in design/change reviews; capture decisions and lessons learned; evolve patterns and modules accordingly.
  • Mentor junior engineers via code/document reviews, pairing, and knowledge shares.


Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution:

  • Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.


Collaboration & Partnership:

  • Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.


Problem Solving:

  • Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.


Continuous Learning:

  • Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.


Continuous Improvement:

  • Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.


Performance and Development:

  • Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.


Qualifications

Job Number: R0248277

Network Engineer

The Opportunity:

As a Network Engineer, you will be expected to configure and operate Cisco platforms such as ASA or Firepower, Nexus switches, and IOS‑based routers. You may also have responsibility in supporting routing protocols and tunneling technologies including OSPF, BGP or IBGP, GRE, and MPLS L3VPN. You will be expected to regularly troubleshoot complex network performance issues and implement corrective actions as well as support network architecture reviews, capacity planning, and performance optimization and integrate network security controls aligned to enterprise security and information assurance requirements.

What You'll Work On:

  • Support enterprise network modernization by designing, implementing, and maintaining secure and resilient network infrastructures across government environments.
  • Apply deep experience with Cisco technologies to configure, troubleshoot, and optimize routing, switching, and network security components.
  • Work closely with engineers, network operations staff, and technical leads to deliver reliable connectivity and ensure secure, scalable network performance for mission systems.


Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 5+ years of experience in network engineering, including designing, deploying, or providing advanced support of multi-protocol IP backbone and access networks
  • 2+ years of experience with Cisco network technologies
  • 2+ years of experience with security, routing, and switching protocols such as BGP, IS-IS, OSPF, MPLS, LDP, RSVP, VPLS, STP, or L3VPNs
  • Experience with network design, network performance management, or network planning
  • Experience with Juniper networks or MPLS L3VPN
  • Experience deploying, upgrading, and troubleshooting multivendor network equipment and solutions such as VMWare, Cisco, Palo Alto, Dell, HPE, or Juniper
  • Knowledge of network security principles
  • Secret clearance
  • Bachelor’s degree


Nice If You Have:

  • Experience with network operations support and enterprise network architecture
  • Experience with voice technologies such as Cisco TMS or Cisco Voice
  • Experience with network security auditing and information assurance
  • Knowledge of Cisco ASA Firepower, Cisco Nexus, Cisco routers, and Cisco IOS
  • Knowledge of LAN design, engineering principles, and hybrid delivery environments
  • Possession of excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills
  • TS/SCI clearance
  • Cisco Certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, or CCIE Certification


Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Secret clearance is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $77,600.00 to $176,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

  • Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.

  • Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed full-time at a customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.


Commitment to Non-Discrimination

descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

Galapagos Federal Systems LLC is seeking a highly qualified and motivated Network Engineer to support the Mission System Research and Development requirement at the Blossom Point Satellite Command and Tracking Facility (BPTF).

In this critical role, the Network Engineer will provide technical expertise in the administration, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of network infrastructure supporting multi-mission enclave operational environments. The successful candidate will ensure reliable Local Area Network (LAN) and Wide Area Network (WAN) connectivity between mission systems, Government satellite operations remote ground entry points, and commercial vendor ground entry points supporting antenna access networks.

The ideal candidate will possess hands-on experience with network hardware, software, protocols, and security within complex client/server environments. This individual will demonstrate strong technical troubleshooting capabilities, attention to detail, and the ability to maintain secure, reliable network operations supporting mission-critical satellite command-and-control activities.

Key Responsibilities

The Network Engineer will

  • Administer, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot LAN and WAN infrastructure supporting multi-mission enclave operational environments
  • Support reliable network connectivity between Government satellite operations remote ground entry points, commercial vendor ground entry points, and associated antenna access networks
  • Install, configure, maintain, and upgrade network hardware, software, and associated systems to support operational requirements
  • Monitor network performance, connectivity, and system availability to identify and resolve technical issues affecting mission operations
  • Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve mission-unique LAN/WAN service disruptions, network connectivity issues, and system performance problems
  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot network infrastructure components, including servers, modems, switches, firewalls, and routers
  • Apply Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol (TCP/IP) networking principles to support network configuration, troubleshooting, and operational performance
  • Support network security practices and procedures to maintain the integrity, availability, and reliability of mission-critical network environments
  • Perform network software updates, configuration changes, and system upgrades in accordance with operational requirements and established procedures
  • Collaborate with network administrators, systems engineers, satellite operations personnel, and other technical stakeholders to resolve network-related issues and maintain mission continuity
  • Assist in identifying network performance deficiencies, connectivity risks, and opportunities for infrastructure improvements
  • Maintain accurate technical documentation, network configurations, troubleshooting records, and operational procedures
  • Provide technical support and recommendations to address network infrastructure requirements and operational challenges
  • Communicate network status, technical findings, and recommended corrective actions to appropriate stakeholders
  • Demonstrate strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and responsiveness when supporting mission-critical network operations


Skills And Experience

The Network Engineer must have

  • Active Top Secret/Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) security clearance
  • 3+ years of professional experience performing Network Engineer responsibilities within a multi-platform environment
  • Thorough knowledge of network protocols, particularly Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol (TCP/IP), and their application within complex network environments
  • Demonstrated experience supporting multi-mission enclave operational environments
  • Working knowledge of LAN/WAN administration, including connectivity to Government satellite operations remote ground entry points and commercial vendor ground entry points supporting antenna access networks
  • Experience administering, maintaining, and troubleshooting network hardware, software, protocols, and network security within client/server environments
  • Working knowledge of network infrastructure components, including servers, modems, switches, firewalls, and routers
  • Demonstrated ability to diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve mission-unique LAN/WAN connectivity and service issues
  • Experience installing, configuring, maintaining, and upgrading software on network systems
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify technical issues and implement effective corrective actions
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple technical priorities in mission-critical environments
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams, Government personnel, and mission stakeholders
  • Demonstrated commitment to customer service, operational reliability, and mission success


Education and Certifications

Required Education

The Network Engineer must meet the following

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Management Information Systems (MIS), Computer Science, or a related technical discipline; OR
  • Equivalent military technical school training in a relevant Navy Enlisted Classification (NEC), Military Occupational Specialty (MOS), or Air Force Specialty Code (AFSC), plus a minimum of two (2) years of relevant systems experience
  • Possession of a current, qualifying computer or network-related certification satisfying the applicable DoD Manual 8140.03 qualification requirements, as specified for the position


Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • 401(k)
  • PTO
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Military Differential
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Paid federal holidays


Security Clearance

Must be a U.S. Citizen. A high-level Department of War active security clearance is/may be required. Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to government information.

Physical Requirements

Work may involve sitting or standing for extended periods of time and typing and reading from a computer screen. The candidate must have enough mobility, including bending, reaching, and kneeling, to complete daily duties in a prompt and efficient manner, and that may include lifting up to thirty pounds, as necessary.

Headquartered in Hawaii, Galapagos Federal Systems, LLC, is an SBA-Certified NHO-owned 8(a) Small Business specializing in global information technology solutions. We deliver professional services in IT Design & Installation, Cybersecurity Engineering & Support, Application Integration & Development, Software & Hardware Engineering, Network & Systems Management, Information Systems Security, and Business Management Services.

Leveraging over 30 years of providing IT services to the federal & commercial market with projects found around the world, our team has innovative expertise in the development of a wide range of technological solutions. Galapagos Federal Systems, LLC is an equal opportunity employer.

Our service commitment is simple - "Quality IT Solutions... On Time & On Budget."

Company Employment Statement

Galapagos Federal Systems, LLC reserves the right to change or modify job duties and assignments at any time. In this critical role, the Network Engineer will provide technical expertise in the administration, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of network infrastructure supporting multi-mission enclave operational environments. The successful candidate will ensure reliable Local Area Network (LAN) and Wide Area Network (WAN) connectivity between mission systems, Government satellite operations remote ground entry points, and commercial vendor ground entry points supporting antenna access networks.

The ideal candidate will possess hands-on experience with network hardware, software, protocols, and security within complex client/server environments. This individual will demonstrate strong technical troubleshooting capabilities, attention to detail, and the ability to maintain secure, reliable network operations supporting mission-critical satellite command-and-control activities.

We are looking for an experienced Senior IT Network Engineer to own and support Spire’s corporate and back-office network environment.

Reporting to the Global IT Director, this is a hands-on role with primary responsibility for the design, implementation, operation, reliability, and lifecycle management of the corporate network. You will own the networking that supports Spire’s offices, remote users, corporate services, and back-office systems, while working closely with Security, Infrastructure, Facilities, and other technical teams.

The role includes responsibility for corporate routing, firewalls, VPN and remote access, office-to-office connectivity, DNS, wireless networking, network authentication, and related network infrastructure. You will also help modernize legacy and bespoke network services, improve resiliency, and reduce operational dependency on individual subject-matter experts.

We are looking for someone who is proactive, self-directed, and comfortable owning complex technical problems from architecture through implementation and ongoing operation. The right person will combine strong network-engineering fundamentals with disciplined operational practices, including documentation, change management, monitoring, lifecycle management, and follow-through.

Role & Responsibilities

  • Own the architecture, implementation, operation, and reliability of Spire’s corporate and back-office network environment.
  • Design, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot corporate routing, switching, wired and wireless networking, firewalls, VPNs, and office-to-office connectivity.
  • Own the corporate remote-access environment, including VPN architecture, operation, authentication integration, user connectivity, and troubleshooting.
  • Manage corporate firewall platforms and policies in partnership with Security, including implementation, rule changes, lifecycle management, and troubleshooting.
  • Design and maintain network segmentation and routing between corporate offices, corporate cloud services, remote-access environments, and approved external connections.
  • Own corporate DNS operations and related network services supporting identity, email, SaaS, endpoints, and other business systems.
  • Manage office-to-office and corporate site-to-site VPN connectivity, including IPsec tunnels and related routing.
  • Support corporate cloud networking for IT-owned systems and services, including routing, connectivity, security controls, and integration with office and remote-access networks.
  • Maintain and improve corporate wireless networking and network-authentication services.
  • Serve as the senior technical escalation point for complex corporate network outages and connectivity issues.
  • Troubleshoot difficult problems involving routing, VPNs, firewalls, DNS, authentication, certificates, wireless networking, cloud connectivity, and interdependent network services.
  • Partner closely with Security on network-security architecture, firewall policy, segmentation, secure-access requirements, PKI, and other security controls.
  • Partner with Infrastructure and Engineering teams on connectivity between corporate and engineering environments, ensuring secure, reliable, and well-defined network boundaries.
  • Maintain accurate network diagrams, configurations, IP addressing, circuit information, operating procedures, and recovery documentation.
  • Develop and maintain scripts, infrastructure-as-code, and automation used to deploy, configure, monitor, or manage corporate network services.
  • Implement and maintain monitoring and alerting to identify network availability, reliability, capacity, and performance issues.
  • Plan and execute network hardware, software, certificate, circuit, and service lifecycle activities.
  • Support office openings, moves, expansions, consolidations, closures, and network infrastructure changes in partnership with End User Technology, Facilities, carriers, and vendors.
  • Manage or coordinate ISP, carrier, circuit, and network-vendor relationships where required.
  • Follow disciplined change-management practices, including planning, peer review, testing, documentation, rollback planning, and post-change validation.
  • Proactively identify architectural, reliability, lifecycle, capacity, and operational risks and drive them through resolution.
  • Participate in after-hours escalation or on-call support for critical corporate network incidents when required.
  • Contribute to broader IT initiatives involving infrastructure modernization, reliability, automation, cloud services, workplace technology, and security.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in network engineering, network operations, infrastructure engineering, or a similar hands-on technical role.
  • Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, NAT, VPNs, firewalls, VLANs, and network segmentation.
  • Hands-on experience designing, operating, and troubleshooting enterprise routing and switching environments.
  • Experience administering enterprise firewall platforms and implementing firewall policy and rule changes.
  • Experience designing, operating, and troubleshooting remote-access and site-to-site VPN technologies, including IPsec and SSL-based VPNs.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to diagnose complex connectivity and network-service issues across multiple layers and systems.
  • Experience supporting multi-site corporate networks, including office connectivity, WAN services, wireless networking, and Internet circuits.
  • Experience with cloud networking in AWS, Azure, or similar environments.
  • Working knowledge of identity, authentication, MFA, certificates, and PKI as they relate to network access and infrastructure services.
  • Experience with network monitoring, logging, alerting, and operational troubleshooting tools.
  • Experience with scripting, infrastructure-as-code, or automation using Terraform, Python, PowerShell, shell scripting, APIs, or similar tools.
  • Demonstrated ability to take ownership of technical systems and projects through completion with limited supervision.
  • Strong documentation, change-management, and operational practices.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and collaborate effectively across IT, Security, Infrastructure, Facilities, Engineering, vendors, and carriers.
  • Ability to participate in after-hours escalation or on-call support for critical network incidents.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Palo Alto Networks firewalls or similar enterprise firewall platforms.
  • Experience with BGP and other dynamic routing protocols.
  • Experience with OpenVPN or other enterprise remote-access platforms.
  • Experience with AWS networking, including VPCs, Transit Gateway, Route 53, security groups, routing, and related services.
  • Experience with enterprise wireless platforms and 802.1X or certificate-based network authentication.
  • Experience with DNS administration, domain-management platforms, and related infrastructure services.
  • Experience managing PKI, certificates, or certificate-based authentication for network services.
  • Experience modernizing legacy or bespoke network environments and migrating toward more standardized enterprise platforms.
  • Experience supporting geographically distributed offices and hybrid cloud environments.
  • Experience managing network hardware lifecycle, carrier circuits, Internet providers, and vendor relationships.
  • Experience designing resilient corporate networks and reducing single points of failure or operational dependency.
  • Experience supporting environments with security, regulatory, or compliance requirements.
  • Experience working closely with Security teams on segmentation, firewall policy, secure access, infrastructure hardening, and incident response.

Spire operates a hybrid work model, and this position will require you to work a minimum of three days per week in the office.
