Network Engineer

The Opportunity:

As a Network Engineer, you will be expected to configure and operate Cisco platforms such as ASA or Firepower, Nexus switches, and IOS‑based routers. Join us. The world can’t wait.

  • 2+ years of experience with Cisco network technologies

  • Experience with network design, network performance management, or network planning
  • Experience with Juniper networks or MPLS L3VPN

JOB SUMMARY:

The Network Engineering role supports all daily network operational activities delivering, managing, monitoring, and supporting all essential and company network infrastructure. This role will work to identify errors that are often difficult to detect and performs root cause analysis in finding a resolution to problems. This position supports REV’s internet product suite including voice, video, and data, along with day-to-day operation support across all GPON and DOCSIS platforms.

Location: Capital Region, LA

Area Served: Baton Rouge, Gonzales, Prairieville, Plaquemine, and surrounding communities.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES, FUNCTIONS & KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES: (include but are not limited to)

  • Responsible in supporting all network hardware components, network operating systems, performance network availability, patch management and security updates according to standards and current best practices
  • Performs installation, configuration and upgrades to network routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, VPN terminators and any other types of network and transports infrastructure in both LAN and WAN environments
  • Works in a high availability data center environment and in the areas of system backup, customer network installation, performance monitoring/tuning, security monitoring, network capacity management, user technical support, general network troubleshooting and infrastructure maintenance
  • Responsible for ensuring availability of both customer network connectivity and access to the production server environment in accordance with documented SLA’s for clients
  • Works with network systems such as: Calix (E7’s), Adtran (TA5000’s), Arris (E6000’s) Cisco (cBR-8 ‘s, ASR’s, Nexus, ASA’s), Fortinet, Juniper (EX’s and SRX’s)
  • Performs network problem troubleshooting, including a cooperative work effort with the server group and support desk
  • Participates in efforts in the identification of network security issues, as well as the design and implementation of effective solutions
  • Assists with configuration, maintenance, and upkeep of several enterprise class network environments
  • Performs required software maintenance, including installation and upgrades of products and NOS’s, at both the datacenter and customer level
  • Coordinates testing by users in preparation for installations and upgrades to live system
  • Manages production problems when they occur, escalate issues to the proper support personnel when situations arise

descriptionHtml:
Wright-Patterson AFB

 

At IPT Associates (IPTA), we enjoy solving real-world problems with technology. We work closely with our customers, teammates, experts, and partners to come up with practical solutions that make a difference. Whether it's a government or business organization, we focus on understanding the need and building something that works.

Our Team

At IPTA, everything starts with our people. We're big believers that when you invest in your team, great things happen. That's why we encourage learning, growth, and trying new things-even if you don't have all the answers yet.

Our culture is rooted in fierce determination, fearless integrity, and passionate service-but we also like to keep things collaborative, supportive, and down-to-earth.

We're Looking For People Who

  • Are curious and excited about technology
  • Like solving problems and figuring things out
  • Can take initiative but also enjoy working with a team
  • Want to keep learning, growing, and challenging themselves

If you're someone who's eager to jump in, learn something new, and make an impact-you'll fit right in here.

  • This position is contingent upon contract award and the actual job description may vary based on specific contract requirements and organizational needs.*

Responsibilities

  • Design, configure, maintain, monitor, and secure enterprise network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, intrusion detection and prevention systems, and VPNs.
  • Monitor availability, capacity, health, and performance; troubleshoot outages and connectivity issues, perform root-cause analysis, and coordinate resolution with technical teams.
  • Develop scalable network solutions and recommend upgrades, technology refreshes, and configuration changes based on mission, performance, and security needs.
  • Install, test, certify, and troubleshoot copper and fiber-optic cabling, coordinating work with external organizations when required.
  • Support connectivity for servers, data centers, storage, backup, voice, video, and conference-room technologies.
  • Apply approved security baselines, patches, firmware updates, and change-management practices.
  • Maintain network diagrams, configurations, procedures, implementation records, and hardware and software inventories.
  • Support disaster recovery, continuity of operations, and assigned after-hours outage response.

Requirements

  • Active Secret security clearance.
  • Current role-appropriate DoD Cyberspace Workforce qualification meeting DoDM 8140.03 requirements (minimum Security +) and any required operating-system or technology certification.
  • Hands-on experience designing, configuring, securing, monitoring, and troubleshooting enterprise LAN and WAN environments.
  • Knowledge of routing, switching, firewalls, load balancing, intrusion detection and prevention, VPNs, network monitoring, capacity planning, and copper and fiber-optic cabling.
  • Ability to maintain technical documentation and comply with privileged-user, cybersecurity, information-protection, and controlled-unclassified-information requirements.
  • Bachelor's degree in a related technical field or equivalent relevant education and experience.
  • Five or more years of network engineering or administration experience; DoD experience and a relevant certification such as CCNA, CCNP, or Network+ are preferred.
  • Ability to work primarily at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base and support occasional extended hours or on-call outage response.

IPTA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All employment decisions are based on individual merit, including qualifications, experience, performance, and business needs, consistent with applicable federal laws and federal contracting requirements. IPTA provides equal opportunity and utilizes merit-based principles to make employment-related decisions.

descriptionHtml:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

NETWORK ENGINEER (STARLINK)

  • Experience bringing up switches, routers, firewalls & servers
  • Operational experience in a Linux production environment
  • Experience with Python and/or bash scripting
  • Routing Protocol experience
  • Experience with physical troubleshooting of fiber & circuits

  • Experience with hands-on experience bringing up network infrastructure

  • Ability to run projects independently

descriptionHtml:
About Peraton

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

About The Role

Peraton is seeking a Mid-Level Network Engineer to support our Department of War (DoW) customer as part of a highly talented, highly motivated, and high-performing team. As part of the engineering team you will support an exciting program which involves design, development, test, and deployment of an exciting and complex system in an Agile construct to contribute to mission success for a variety of stakeholders. Join us and be part of the next generation of innovators as we blaze a trail forward for our profession and company.

What you'll do:

  • Participate in Agile meetings (sprint planning, daily standups, sprint retrospectives, sprint reviews, etc.) and work in an Agile process to plan your work for future sprints and increments
  • Work with teams across Group and customers to understand cloud networking requirements for upcoming projects; develop and document Wide Area Networks (WANs) / Local Area Networks (LANs)
  • Provide support and guidance to the Tier teams on the identification, isolation and troubleshoot network anomalies.
  • Track network system build-out status, specify and configure firewalls, switches, and routers, and support other systems and network engineering tasks, as required.
  • Design and implement automation through scripting and other techniques to implement cloud network infrastructure and improve operational efficiencies.
  • Create network architectures and designs that are highly available and scalable for new tenant systems and solutions to meet defined requirements
  • Coordinate with tenant to fully understand incident reported including documenting incident details in ticketing tool, assign as appropriate, and track through completion.
  • Use state-of-the-art monitoring tools to gather insight and act upon results
  • Create network designs, implementation plans, operational documentation, and continual improvement of cloud network services
  • Evaluate and recommend potential cloud networking solutions for inclusion into customer cloud service offerings and application migration solutions; participate in the procurement of network devices.

Qualifications

Required qualifications:

  • An active Top Secret clearance with eligibility to obtain SCI and the ability to maintain clearance.
  • Associates degree in Engineering or Computer Technology and 7+ years of experience; OR Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Computer Technology and 5+ years of network engineering experience; OR Master's Degree and 3+ years of network engineering experience. An additional four (4) years of relevant experience will be considered in lieu of a Bachelor's degree.
  • Candidate must meet DoD 8140 intermediate requirements for a Network Operations Specialist work role at an intermediate or above proficiency.
  • Experience supporting designing, building, and maintaining networks in a classified environment.
  • Experience configuring VLANS, VPNs, firewalls/switches/routers (Cisco, Arista, Brocade, Juniper, Palo Alto, etc.), networking and using network management functions and tools.
  • Secures network and maintains device software up to date in accordance with DOD policies.
  • Strong understanding of IP addressing and subnetting.
  • You have 3-5 years of experience operating/maintaining/troubleshooting DoD encryption/COMSEC equipment.
  • Background in supporting software and/or network operations with a clear understanding of networking fundamentals

Desired qualifications:

  • You are able to effectively communicate both with customers and technical staff.
  • You have experience working with UNIX and/or LINUX systems in a network environment.
  • Experience creating, modifying, and troubleshooting Ansible playbooks for system configuration and/or system sustainment activities (e.g. patching)
  • Strong problem solving and decision-making ability.
  • You are detail/process oriented, can multi-task, and the ability to work with minimal supervision
  • You have excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with management, the customer and user organizations across DoD.

Benefits:

Peraton offers enhanced benefits to employees working on this critical National Security program, which include heavily subsidized employee benefits coverage for you and your dependents, 25 days of PTO accrued annually up to a generous PTO cap and eligible to participate in an attractive bonus plan

#Metroplex

Details

Target Salary Range: $104,000 - $166,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement: Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

Application Statements: The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate's own.

EEO:Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

descriptionHtml:
WHY JOIN ALO?

Mindful movement. It’s at the core of why we do what we do at ALO—it’s our calling. Because mindful movement in the studio leads to better living. It changes who yogis are off the mat, making their lives and their communities better. That’s the real meaning of studio-to-street: taking the consciousness from practice on the mat and putting it into practice in life.

Overview

We seek a highly skilled and motivated Senior Network Engineer to join our dynamic IT team. As a Senior Network Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing our network infrastructure while ensuring the highest security, reliability, and performance levels. The ideal candidate should possess a strong background in layer 2 and 3 network design and protocols, with experience in NGFW management, SDWAN technologies, and cloud networking. Additionally, this role is essential for automation scripting expertise and the ability to work flexible hours, including rotational shifts and occasional change windows. 

Senior Network Engineer Skills and Experience Required

  • Layer 2 and 3 network design and protocols (OSPF, BGP, MPLS) 
  • Extensive Experience with Cisco and Meraki Networking Hardware. (Switches, Access Points, Firewalls, Gateways, IOSXe)  
  • Experience with change control and incident management processes
  • Experience with NGFW Design, Management, Configuration, Segmentation and Hardening. (Foritnet, PAN) 
  • Experience with SDWAN Technologies (Fortinet) 
  • Network infrastructure services (DNS, DHCP)  
  • User and site-to-site VPN (IPsec, SSL)
  • Networking of Azure Cloud and AWS Cloud Environments
  • Automation Scripting Experience (Teraform, Chef, Python)
  • Wireless networking design and protocols 
  • Experience with NAC Technologies (Clearpass, Cisco ISE) 
  • Work rotational shifts and occasional change windows during evenings and weekends

Day to Day Responsibilities

  • Hardware preventive maintenance (fixes).
  • Ensure all trouble tickets are detailed and completed accurately. 
  • Investigates and presents creative and cost-effective solutions for networking to Retail stores, corporate systems, and other global locations 
  • Provides support for Corporate and store networking projects. 
  • Consult with Retail Operation users concerning networking designs, connectivity, and support issues. 
  • Assist in or resolve (escalated) technical incidents. 
  • Establish and maintain effective communications and relationships with other IT teams and business units. 
  • Stay informed of current technologies in order to support the business. 
  • Develop, improve, and enforce disciplines, policies, procedures, and practices aimed at ensuring system availability, efficient & responsive service delivery, cost effectiveness, technology value and overall client satisfaction. 

Technology Responsibilities: 

  • Next-Generation Firewall (NGFW) Management: Configure, monitor, and maintain NGFW systems (Fortinet, PAN) to enhance network security and prevent potential threats. 
  • SDWAN Technologies: Implement and optimize SDWAN technologies to improve network performance and reduce operational costs. 
  • Network Infrastructure Services: Deploy and manage network infrastructure services, including DNS and DHCP, to ensure seamless connectivity for users and devices. 
  • VPN (Virtual Private Network) Solutions: Configure and manage user and site-to-site VPNs using IPsec and SSL for secure remote communication. 
  • Cloud Networking: Integrate and manage networking in a multi-cloud environment, facilitating efficient cloud-based services. 
  • Automation Scripting: Develop automation scripts using Terraform, Ansible, Chef, and Python to streamline network provisioning and enhance operational efficiency. 
  • Wireless Networking: Design and implement wireless networking solutions, ensuring reliable and high-speed connectivity for end-users. 
  • Network Design and Protocols: 
  • Design and implement robust layer 2 and layer 3 network configurations, including OSPF, BGP, and MPLS routing protocols. 
  • Optimize network performance and scalability to support the organization's evolving needs. 
  • Change Control and Incident Management: 
  • Lead change control processes to ensure smooth, seamless network operations with minimal service disruptions. 
  • Manage and resolve network-related incidents promptly and efficiently. 
  • Troubleshooting and Solutions Development: Investigate network-related issues and propose creative and cost-effective solutions for Retail stores, corporate systems, and other global locations. 
  • Project Support: Provide technical support for Corporate and store networking projects, ensuring successful project implementation. 
  • Effective Communication and Collaboration: Establish and maintain strong communications and relationships with other IT teams and business units. 
  • Continuous Learning: Stay informed about current technologies and industry trends to provide up-to-date support and solutions. 
  • Process Improvement: Develop, improve, and enforce disciplines, policies, procedures, and practices to ensure system availability, efficient & responsive service delivery, cost-effectiveness, technology value, and overall client satisfaction. 

Qualifications: 

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Network Engineering, or a related field. Equivalent experience is also acceptable.  
  • Experience in network engineering roles focusing on layer 2 and 3 network design and protocols. 
  • Strong knowledge of NGFW management and configuration and SDWAN technologies. 
  • Proficiency in network infrastructure services, user and site-to-site VPNs, and cloud networking, 
  • Experience with automation scripting using Terraform, Chef, and Python. 
  • Familiarity with wireless networking design and protocols. 
  • Demonstrated ability to work rotational shifts and occasionally change windows during evenings and weekends. 
  • Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
  • Effective communication and collaboration abilities.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., CCIE, CCNP, Fortinet NSE, AWS Certified Solutions Architect) will be advantageous. 

The base salary range for this position is $130,000-$140,000 per year which represents the current range for the base salary for this exempt position. Please note that actual salaries will vary based on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. As such, on occasion and when applicable, there is the possibility that the final, agreed-upon base salary may be outside of the upper end of the range. Please also note the range listed is just one component of the company’s total rewards package for exempt employees. Other rewards may include performance bonuses, long term incentives, a PTO policy, and many other progressive benefits

descriptionHtml:
About Peraton

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

About The Role

We are seeking Network / Hybrid Connectivity Engineers to design, implement, operate, and troubleshoot network services that connect cloud, on-premises, shared-service, mission, and security-domain environments.

This role will ensure that services and applications can communicate reliably across diverse deployment environments while maintaining appropriate network segmentation, access controls, security boundaries, and connectivity protections. Engineers will work across networking, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, cybersecurity, and platform teams to design and maintain reliable connectivity for enterprise and mission services.

The ideal candidate brings strong enterprise networking expertise and the ability to troubleshoot complex connectivity issues spanning cloud, on-premises infrastructure, applications, and security boundaries.

Responsibilities

Hybrid Network Engineering

  • Design, implement, and support routing, DNS, load balancing, ingress, egress, and network segmentation across cloud and on-premises environments.
  • Engineer and maintain connectivity between AWS classified cloud environments and on-premises infrastructure.
  • Support connectivity between shared services, tenant environments, mission systems, and external dependencies.
  • Design and troubleshoot network paths across diverse deployment locations and infrastructure environments.
  • Coordinate AWS Direct Connect or comparable enterprise connectivity solutions where applicable.
  • Evaluate network dependencies and connectivity requirements for new and evolving platform capabilities.

Security & Boundary Integration

  • Partner with cybersecurity teams to implement approved network segmentation and Zero Trust patterns.
  • Coordinate firewall, proxy, boundary, and controlled-interface requirements across technical teams.
  • Support connectivity to cross-domain services while maintaining clear ownership boundaries with Cross-Domain Solution (CDS) specialists.
  • Document network dependencies, approved traffic flows, ports, protocols, and connectivity requirements.
  • Ensure network designs appropriately account for security controls and boundary requirements.

Operations & Troubleshooting

  • Troubleshoot complex network and application-connectivity issues across hybrid environments.
  • Support Kubernetes networking, service mesh, load balancers, and platform ingress/egress where applicable.
  • Participate in Tier 3/4 support, incident troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and scheduled maintenance.
  • Monitor network capacity, latency, availability, and recurring connectivity issues and recommend corrective actions.
  • Collaborate with application, platform, cloud, security, and infrastructure teams to resolve issues that span multiple technical domains.
  • Support network lifecycle activities as environments, tenants, and platform capabilities evolve.

Location: This position is fully onsite in Chantilly, VA

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Active TS/SCI clearance with CI Polygraph.
  • Approximately 6-10 years of experience in enterprise, data-center, cloud, or hybrid networking.
  • 6+ years' of experience with a BS, an additional 4 years may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, DNS, firewalls, proxies, and load balancing.
  • Demonstrated experience with AWS networking.
  • Experience supporting hybrid cloud and on-premises environments.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex network, application, and infrastructure dependencies.
  • Strong technical documentation, analytical, and communication skills.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience with AWS Direct Connect.
  • Experience with Kubernetes networking.
  • Experience with Istio or comparable service mesh technologies.
  • Experience supporting classified network environments.
  • Experience with cross-domain interfaces or services.
  • Experience using Infrastructure-as-Code for network configuration and provisioning.
  • Experience with network automation and configuration management.

Details

Target Salary Range: $112,000 - $179,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement: Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

Application Statements: The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate's own.

EEO:Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

Job Description

Location:

New York, NY

Job Description

Condé Nast is a global media company, home to iconic brands including Vogue, GQ, Glamour, AD, Vanity Fair and Wired, among many others. Our award-winning content reaches 84 million consumers in print, 367 million in digital, and 379 million across social platforms, and generates more than 1 billion video views each month. We are headquartered in London and New York,

and operate in 31 markets worldwide, including China, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico & Latin America, Spain, Taiwan, the U.K. and the U.S., with local licence partners across the globe.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Network Engineer to join our infrastructure team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, maintaining, and securing our enterprise-wide wired and wireless network infrastructure. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in advanced Routing and Switching, a comprehensive understanding of Enterprise Wireless Technologies, and a strong background in Palo Alto Networks firewalls. Additionally, this role requires a candidate who is willing to be hands-on with physical infrastructure, including data center device installations and cabling.

This position demands a blend of high-level architectural thinking, rigorous security practices, wireless site optimization, and practical physical deployment skills.

What will you be doing?

  • Design and maintain enterprise routing and switching across offices and data centers.
  • Troubleshoot protocols like BGP, OSPF, and EIGRP, plus switching technologies (STP, VXLAN, VPC).
  • Deploy high-density Wi-Fi using WLCs, cloud dashboards, and access points.
  • Perform RF surveys and heat mapping to fix coverage and roaming issues.
  • Secure wireless via WPA3, 802.1X, and RADIUS/TACACS+ (e.g., Cisco ISE) integration.
  • Manage firewall policies, threat prevention, URL filtering, and S2S VPNs.
  • Ensure a strict security posture for the wired and wireless network edge.
  • Cloud based certifications are a plus e.g. (AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Cisco Certified Network Administrator Cloud
  • Knowledge in Terraform and Python
  • Experience with AppGate platform for SSL VPN connection
  • Engage in the enterprise-wide Change Management protocols and workflows.
  • Flexible/hybrid work schedule
  • Deliver on-site engineering support and physical infrastructure setup for live-streaming of high-visibility tentpole events (e.g. The Met Gala).

Who You Are:

  • Expertise in AWS cloud networking technologies, including Transit Gateways, Direct Connect, and VPNs.
  • Relevant industry certifications are highly preferred (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect or CCNA).
  • Technical proficiency in automation and scripting using Terraform and Python.
  • In-depth knowledge of advanced routing protocols like OSPF and BGP.
  • Hands-on experience with Zero Trust Networking and the AppGate SDP platform.
  • Competency in wireless deployments using Meraki, Cisco, and Aruba solutions.
  • Familiarity with multi-vendor interoperability and IEEE 802 standards.
  • Exceptional communication skills and collaborative mindset.
  • Skilled in Google Workspace and the creation of detailed network diagrams.
  • Disciplined approach to infrastructure schemas and standard naming conventions.
  • Commitment to continuous learning within switching and routing architectures.

Education And Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or a related field; equivalent professional experience and certifications will be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Relevant industry certifications strongly preferred, such as:
    • CCNP Enterprise (Routing & Switching / Wireless)
    • Palo Alto Networks PCNSA/PCNSE
    • Cisco Certified Wireless Professional (CWNP/CWNA/CWNP)
    • Cloud certifications: AWS Certified Solutions Architect
  • 5–8+ years of experience in enterprise network engineering, with demonstrated ownership of large-scale, multi-site environments.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience designing and troubleshooting advanced routing and switching protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, STP, VXLAN, VPC) in a production environment.
  • 2+ years of experience deploying and optimizing cloud-managed wireless networks (e.g., Meraki) architectures and RF site surveys.
  • Proven experience securing wireless networks using WPA3, 802.1X, and RADIUS/TACACS+, with hands-on exposure to Cisco ISE or similar NAC platforms.
  • Strong hands-on experience administering Palo Alto Networks firewalls, including policy management, threat prevention, URL filtering, and Site-to-Site VPN configuration.
  • Experience with SSL VPN platforms such as AppGate or similar Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) solutions is a plus.
  • Working knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and scripting/automation (Python) for network provisioning and management is a plus.
The expected base salary range for this position is from $127,000-$150,000. Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including but not limited to relevant skills, training, experience, and education.

What happens next?

If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply below, and we will review your application as soon as possible. You can update your resume or upload a cover letter at any time by accessing your candidate profile.

Condé Nast is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, familial status and other legally protected characteristics.

- Competency in wireless deployments using Meraki, Cisco, and Aruba solutions.

- Palo Alto Networks PCNSA/PCNSE

- Cloud certifications: AWS Certified Solutions Architect

descriptionHtml:
Position Description

About Harris County and Universal Services:

Harris County Universal Services is transforming the way the County does business and seeking a Director, Integrated Justice to join our team.

Universal Services is the enterprise IT solutions center for the departments and offices of Harris County, providing Information Technology, Public Safety and Justice Technologies, 311 Constituent Engagement Services, Fleet Services, and Records and Information Governance Services.

Harris County is the third largest and most diverse county in the nation, with a population of more than 4.7 million. Harris County Commissioners Court, the County’s governing body, directs a budget of more than $4 billion providing essential services including flood control, infrastructure, healthcare, housing, and justice administration.

This is a great time to join Universal Services as we enhance critical services to Harris County residents and internal customers.

Position Overview:

The Network Engineer is responsible for the design, implementation, support, and optimization of enterprise network infrastructure, with a primary focus on Aruba wireless technologies. This role serves as the wireless subject matter expert and collaborates with engineering, facilities, architects, and contractors on new construction and renovation projects to ensure network requirements are incorporated into building designs. The position requires participation in an on-call rotation and the ability to respond to network incidents and service outages outside of normal business hours.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Design, deploy, and support Aruba wireless infrastructure, including Aruba Central, Mobility Controllers, Access Points, and ClearPass.
  • Perform wireless site surveys, RF analysis, capacity planning, and coverage validation.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize wireless and network performance across enterprise environments.
  • Collaborate with engineering, facilities, architects, and construction teams on new building and renovation projects.
  • Review construction drawings and low-voltage designs to ensure compliance with network and wireless standards.
  • Develop wireless designs, access point placement plans, and network infrastructure requirements for new facilities.
  • Coordinate installation, testing, and commissioning of network and wireless systems.
  • Support LAN, WAN, routing, switching, and network security infrastructure.
  • Maintain network documentation, standards, and operational procedures.
  • Work in service manager to resolve customer trouble tickets with network related issues.


Harris County is an Equal Opportunity Employer

https://hrrm.harriscountytx.gov/Pages/EqualEmploymentOpportunityPlan.aspx

If you need special services or accommodations, please call (713) 274-5445 or email ADACoordinator@bmd.hctx.net .

This position is subject to a criminal history check. Only relevant convictions will be considered and, even when considered, may not automatically disqualify the candidate.

Requirements

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent


Experience:

  • Five (5) years of enterprise network engineering experience.
  • Three (3) years of experience designing and supporting Aruba wireless solutions.
  • Experience with wireless site surveys, RF design, and enterprise WLAN deployments.
  • Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, switching, VLANs, network security, and authentication technologies.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Must possess excellent interpersonal and written/oral communication skills.
  • The ability to interact with staff at all levels.
  • Strong knowledge of personal computers and various software, specifically Microsoft Office


Applicants for this position will be subject to a criminal background check that includes being fingerprinted. This applies to any position with network access to Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) or access to an area where CJIS is received, maintained or stored either manually or electronically (i.e. custodian, maintenance).

Automatic Disqualification:

  • Convictions, probation, or deferred adjudication for any Felony, and any Class A Misdemeanor
  • Convictions, probation, or deferred adjudication for a Class B Misdemeanor, if within the previous 10 years
  • Open arrest for any criminal offense (Felony or Misdemeanor)
  • Family Violence conviction


NOTE: Qualifying education, experience, knowledge and skills must be documented on your job application. You may attach a resume to the application as supporting documentation but ONLY information stated on the application will be used for consideration. "See Resume" will not be accepted for qualifications.

General Information

  • Harris County Universal Services does not provide sponsorship or authorization to work in the United States. Employees will be required to provide proof of legal authorization to work in the United States.**


Work Environment and Physical Demands:

  • Must be able to lift at least 50 lbs. and/or move boxes and equipment as needed.
  • Subject to kneeling, crouching, handling, climbing, walking, sitting, twisting and reaching are needed to perform the essential functions.


Hours:

  • All new hires are required to work onsite during their first 90 days of employment.
  • For positions eligible for a hybrid schedule, telework may be considered after this period and requires management approval based on performance and operational needs. Telework is a privilege and is not guaranteed
  • This position is hybrid and requires employees to be on-site Tuesday-Thursday.
  • Hybrid Scheduling can change at any time based on performance and/or business need.
  • May be required to work more than forty hours during the workweek or on weekends when special projects or deadlines need to be met.


Employment may be contingent on passing a drug screen and meeting other standards.

Due to a high volume of applications positions may close prior to the advertised closing date or at the discretion of the Hiring Department.

descriptionHtml:
Standard Job Description

WHAT WE'RE DOING

Join the EADGE-T team and help modernize the program’s technology while delivering new capabilities to the UAE customer. EADGE-T provides an integrated air and missile defense and air battle management capability that connects existing sensors, weapons, and emerging technologies.

The Technical Refresh effort will focus on hardware upgrades and foundational cybersecurity enhancements. This is an opportunity to help design and develop the updated baseline while working directly with an international customer.

THE WORK

The Network Communications Engineer will design, configure, secure, monitor, and troubleshoot complex, high-performance communication networks supporting mission-critical systems.

This role requires strong technical expertise across network architecture, integration, automation, cybersecurity, and performance optimization. You will help ensure the reliability, redundancy, security, and scalability of networks operating across multiple classification domains.

PLEASE NOTE

  • This position requires a government security clearance at the Secret level; you must be a U.S. Citizen for consideration.
  • This position may require travel to customer sites throughout the UAE.
  • This position may occasionally support off-hours test events, including overnight and weekend activities.

Key Responsibilities

Network Design & Architecture - Support the Lead Network Architect in decomposing system-level requirements and developing functional, logical, and physical architectures for data center network solutions.

Implementation & Integration - Install and configure routers, switches, firewalls, and specialized network infrastructure.

Performance Optimization - Support capacity planning, latency analysis, and bandwidth optimization for high-throughput, low-latency applications. Implement traffic engineering techniques, including MPLS, segment routing, policing, and traffic shaping, to meet performance requirements.

Troubleshooting & Incident Management - Perform root-cause analysis and resolve complex network faults, packet loss, routing loops, and authentication issues. Use tools such as Wireshark, NetFlow, and telemetry platforms to monitor performance and proactively address network issues.

Network Monitoring - Use commercial or open-source network monitoring tools such as OpenText NNMi, Nagios XI, SolarWinds, or OpenNMS.

Who We Are

EADGE-T has a geographically dispersed project team that operates in an Agile Scrum environment.

Team members have the opportunity to work directly with an international customer and gain exposure to the technologies and processes supporting this upgrade.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Network Communications, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, or Cyber Security 9+ years of hands on network engineering experience. Certifications: Cisco CCNA/CCNP/CCIE (Routing & Switching or Data Center) or Juniper JNCIA (preferred)/JNCIP/JNCIE, Arista EOS, etc.).
  • CompTIA Network+, Security+
  • Knowledge of TCP/IP, IPv4, VLAN tagging, RSTP, LAG, VTEP, BGP, OSPF, GRE, MPLS, TLS, IPsec, MACsec.
  • Proficiency with network hardware (Juniper (preferred), Cisco, Palo Alto, DELL, Arista)
  • Strong scripting/automation (Python, PowerShell, Ansible, Terraform).
  • Familiarity with network logging tools (ArcSight, Splunk, other Syslog tools)
  • Understanding of cybersecurity frameworks, IDS/IPS, VPNs, PKI, stateful/stateless firewall with ALG, and symmetric/asymmetric encryption methods, cryptographic hash functions and familiarity of NSA CSFC capabilities & algorithms
  • Excellent analytical and problem solving abilities; ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities.
  • Proficient in AI prompting as it applies to this position and practice.

Desired Skills

  • 7 years of experience in Network Communications as a network device SME
  • Experience with Juniper EX, QFX, SRX, and MX products
  • Network Management: Juniper Apstra, Mist, Ansible (configuration deployment), Syslog, NTPv4, NETConf, SNMPv2/v3
  • Virtual Hypervisor & Micro Services: VMWare VCF (understanding of vSwitch and vSAN, VM interfaces), K8 (understanding of Kubernetes and containers’ network interfaces and ports)
  • Experience with high capacity fiber optics MMF and SM i.e. 10/25/40/100 Gbps data rates Wireshark/PCAP and/or TCPDUMP/LIBPCAP packet analysis
  • Network Monitoring tools. Must have experience with SNMP v2c/v3
  • DISA network device STIGS including Network Policy

Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $129000.00 - $239600.00

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only. Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

Benefits offered: Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability.

  • Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.
  • For (Washington state applicants only) Non-represented full-time employees: accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. Represented full time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year.

Job Description

At Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), we build and operate cloud infrastructure at global scale. OCI Dedicated Region25 (DR25) delivers the capabilities of an OCI cloud region within a customer-selected data center through a compact, modular architecture that can expand as customer demand grows.

We are seeking a Senior Network Engineer to join the DR25 Network Engineering team. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role responsible for designing, implementing, and operating resilient physical and logical network infrastructure. You will independently own well-defined projects and significant portions of larger programs, working from requirements and design through modeling, testing, deployment, operational handoff, and production support.

The successful candidate will combine strong networking fundamentals with automation, disciplined change execution, and practical problem-solving. You will collaborate with network automation, virtual networking, compute, hardware, security, monitoring, region deployment, and operations teams to deliver reliable, secure, and repeatable DR25 deployments.

Work locations:

Seattle, WA

Reston, VA

Austin, TX

Santa Clara

Redwood City

Nashville, TN

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and operate resilient Layer 2, Layer 3, and Layer 4 network services for DR25 data-center environments.
  • Own defined network projects end to end, including requirements, technical design, implementation, validation, deployment, documentation, and operational handoff.
  • Develop IP-addressing plans and routing policies using technologies such as BGP, OSPF, IPv4, IPv6, ECMP, and high-availability routing.
  • Support modular region deployment and expansion by developing repeatable network designs, configuration models, validation procedures, and operational standards.
  • Integrate physical network infrastructure with cloud virtual networking, service connectivity, and overlay architectures.
  • Build and maintain network infrastructure-as-code, source-of-truth models, validation tools, and automation using Python, APIs, Git-based workflows, and CI/CD practices.
  • Execute complex production changes using approved methods of procedure, pre-change validation, post-change verification, and tested rollback plans.
  • Improve deployment safety and speed by creating reusable configuration patterns, automated tests, compliance checks, and drift-detection capabilities.
  • Establish production readiness through monitoring, telemetry, dashboards, alerts, capacity analysis, troubleshooting procedures, and operational runbooks.
  • Participate in on-call and operational rotations, serving as an escalation point for network incidents and leading root-cause analysis for issues within the engineer’s area of ownership.
  • Troubleshoot physical and logical network issues involving routing, switching, cabling, optics, device software, configuration, automation, and service connectivity.
  • Work with vendor and qualification teams to investigate defects and validate new hardware platforms, optics, firmware, and network operating-system releases.
  • Produce clear design documents, diagrams, deployment specifications, runbooks, decision records, and leadership-ready status updates.
  • Contribute to architecture and design reviews, identify opportunities to improve existing systems, and help evolve team standards and reference designs.
  • Mentor peers and junior engineers through technical guidance, code and document reviews, troubleshooting sessions, and knowledge sharing.
  • Use AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly to accelerate network modeling, automation, validation, troubleshooting, and documentation while independently verifying outputs.


Required Qualifications

  • Eight years of relevant network-engineering experience; or a bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical field and four years of experience; or a master’s degree and two years of experience; or a relevant doctorate.
  • Strong understanding of Layer 2 through Layer 4 networking, IP addressing and subnetting, BGP, OSPF, IPv4, IPv6, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, NAT, ECMP, and high-availability design.
  • Experience designing, deploying, or operating data-center, cloud, service-provider, or large-enterprise networks.
  • Hands-on experience automating network provisioning, configuration, validation, or operations using Python or another programming language.
  • Experience with Git, APIs, CI/CD workflows, automated testing, configuration modeling, or infrastructure-as-code practices.
  • Experience executing production network changes with appropriate risk assessment, validation, rollback, and change-management controls.
  • Demonstrated troubleshooting skills across network protocols, devices, automation systems, and physical infrastructure.
  • Experience participating in incident response, root-cause analysis, operational readiness, and continuous-improvement efforts.
  • Ability to work independently, manage project milestones and dependencies, and coordinate effectively with adjacent engineering and operations teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear technical designs, runbooks, and project updates.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building or operating hyperscale cloud, service-provider, ISP, or large-scale data-center networks.
  • Proven experience partnering with cloud networking and platform teams to integrate virtual network services with physical underlay infrastructure in large-scale overlay environments.
  • Experience with Clos or spine-leaf fabrics, EVPN/VXLAN, SDN overlays, traffic engineering, segmentation, and secure service connectivity.
  • Experience with Terraform, Ansible, YANG, OpenConfig, NETCONF, gNMI, or comparable model-driven networking technologies.
  • Experience implementing network telemetry and observability using SNMP, streaming telemetry, NetFlow/IPFIX, flow logs, dashboards, alerting, and service-level indicators.
  • Knowledge of network-security principles, including ACL and routing-policy management, least privilege, segmentation, MACsec, IPsec, and TLS.
  • Experience with commodity Ethernet platforms, optics, structured cabling, hardware qualification, and network operating-system validation.
  • Experience improving operational workflows through automated validation, reusable runbooks, deployment guardrails, or configuration-drift detection.
  • Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to improve automation, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, or operational efficiency.

Responsibilities

Network Engineer SME will be responsible for ensuring the stable operation and efficient performance of data networks; monitoring and managing all network hardware and equipment, including routers, switches, and encryptors; analyzing network performance across the organization’s LANs and WANs; and identifying and developing remedies for network performance bottlenecks. The network engineer SME shall have a solid working knowledge of network security measures, experience with network management and analysis tools such as Solar Winds.

  • Setup and configure Juniper network devices like MX series routers, SRX firewalls and QFX switches.
  • Design, implement, and maintain robust network infrastructures, including LAN, WAN, and VPNs.
  • Monitor network traffic and performance, troubleshoot connectivity issues, and optimize network resources to minimize downtime.
  • Implement and manage security measures, such as firewalls, access controls, and intrusion prevention systems.
  • Inspect, maintain, and, where necessary, replace network cabling and other network-related equipment.
  • Administer hardware and software upgrades for network equipment.
  • Create and maintain detailed network documentation, including network topology, IP schemas, and firewall rules.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain policies, procedures and associated training plans for network resource administration, appropriate use and disaster recovery.
  • Perform network asset management, including maintenance of network component inventory and related documentation and technical specifications information.
  • Administer and maintain user accounts, permissions, and access rights.
  • Recommend, schedule, and perform network improvements, upgrades, and repairs.
  • Interact with vendors, outsourcers, and contractors to secure network products and services.
  • Design, configure, troubleshoot, and expand IP address schemas for a WAN/LAN network
  • Develop functional, systems, and technical requirements documents based on operational and architectural requirements.
  • Perform technical analysis of IT alternatives in support of strategic modernization efforts.
  • Provide expert analysis and advice on the feasibility of system designs and capacity planning.
  • Perform detailed engineering to optimize enterprise network topologies and develop engineering design documentation to produce, install, test, integrate, and support a complete functional enterprise or processing system or subsystem.
  • Provide technical support and quality control checks to ensure information systems designs and specifications meet the necessary standards.
  • Troubleshoot and analyze network and communication issue and assist in their resolution.
  • Perform firmware upgrades, apply patches, and conduct routine maintenance to keep network systems up to date.
  • Work with other IT teams, such as security, system administrators, and applications, to ensure integrated network operations.
  • Other related duties as assigned.
  • Available for rotating on-call support.

  • A degree in the field of computer science or other IT related discipline is preferred.
  • Certifications: Juniper Networks Certified Specialist: Enterprise Routing and Switching (JNCIS-ENT), Juniper Network Certified Internet Expert (JNCIE) or the Cisco equivalent Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP), Cisco Certified Internet Expert (CCIE) is preferred.
  • Experience with Juniper network solutions is preferred.
  • Strong communication and written skills.

CLA is a top 10 national professional services firm where our purpose is to create opportunities every day, for our clients, our people, and our communities through industry-focused wealth advisory, digital, audit, tax, consulting, and outsourcing services. Even with more than 8,500 people, 130 U.S. locations, and a global reach, we promise to know you and help you.

CLA is seeking a Senior Network Engineer to join our Digital team and help clients modernize, secure, and optimize their network environments.

This role serves as a trusted technical advisor, delivering secure, scalable, and resilient networking solutions across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. You will partner with clients and project teams to lead network modernization initiatives, infrastructure transformations, cloud connectivity projects, M&A-related technology transitions, and security improvement efforts

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong consulting and communication skills and enjoys helping organizations solve complex networking and connectivity challenges.

About The Role

As a Senior Network Engineer, you will:

  • Lead the design, implementation, remediation, and support of client network infrastructure across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.
  • Design and support Cisco and Meraki solutions including routing, switching, wireless, firewalls, VPNs, SD-WAN, segmentation, and secure connectivity.
  • Conduct network assessments, discovery workshops, infrastructure reviews, and modernization planning engagements.
  • Lead network migration, integration, remediation, and infrastructure transformation projects.
  • Support Azure networking solutions including virtual networks, VPN gateways, network security groups, hybrid connectivity, and Microsoft 365 network dependencies.
  • Design and implement secure network architectures utilizing firewall technologies, Cisco Umbrella, network segmentation, 802.1X authentication, and secure remote access solutions.
  • Troubleshoot complex performance, availability, authentication, wireless, routing, and security issues.
  • Develop technical documentation including diagrams, standards, transition plans, inventories, and operational runbooks.
  • Collaborate directly with clients, vendors, carriers, managed service providers, and project teams to deliver successful outcomes.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to fellow engineers.
  • Contribute to automation and infrastructure modernization initiatives using scripting and Infrastructure as Code tools.

What You’ll Need

  • Bachelor's degree required. A combination of relevant experience, education, and training may be accepted in lieu of a degree. Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field preferred.

  • Experience supporting network assessments, remediation planning, target-state design, infrastructure modernization, and M&A-related transition initiatives within consulting, managed services, systems integrator, or enterprise network engineering environments preferred.

descriptionHtml:
MANTECH seeks an experienced and passionate, career and customer-oriented Network Engineer to join our team in Annapolis Junction, MD.

Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To

  • Integrate DoD IP encryption methodologies into intricate networks and systems, embodying a profound comprehension of security imperatives.
  • Troubleshoot spanning diverse technologies encompassing OSPF, EIGRP, BGP, DMVPN, LACP, VPLS, EVPN VxLAN, QoS IP multicasting technologies, LSP, Spanning-Tree, Port-Security, and multiple Layer 2 and 3 networking functions.
  • With no supervision and minimal guidance, assist with the evaluation, design, documentation, installation/implementation, testing, problem isolation and resolution of network errors
  • Provide Tier III engineering support to a globally distributed services team in geographically dispersed customer locations.
  • Conduct site surveys, prepare configuration capture (documents) computers, networking devices, and various peripheral equipment impacted by the cable plant.
  • Execute Tier 3 LAN and WAN support across multiple domains and locations both CONUS & OCONUS using standard enterprise tools.
  • Install data and voice cables for business cable television and router/switched systems, existing cable television and internet systems
  • Travel is required in support of service requirements ~20-30%. This position offers opportunities to support other bodies of work, at different locations, and to travel both CONUS and OCONUS (no hostile areas).

Minimum Qualifications

  • 4 years experience with a bachelor’s degree or 4 years of experience may be substituted for education.
  • Must hold a current 8570 compliance Level II certification such as Sec+ CE or CCNA
  • Proven hands-on experience with Cisco platforms (ASR, ISR, CSR, Catalyst) iand hands-on experience with network management and monitoring systems.
  • Possess the skills to track, analyze and monitor technology performance metrics.
  • Able to complete campus area network networking installations (configurations, port security, VLAN assignments, etc.).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with customer ticketing systems such as ServiceNow
  • Experience in a technical role with an understanding of IT equipment and service life as well as planning and implementation of equipment replacement
  • Experience with large scale enterprise IT contracts

Clearance Requirements

  • Must have a current/active TS/SCI w/ Poly

Physical Requirements

  • The person must be able to handle cables of varying lengths, widths and weights and the associated equipment. The person in this position must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time, occasionally moving about inside the office to collaborate with other leaders/teams, use standard office automation equipment, and virtual communication, which may involve delivering presentations.
  • Able to lift at least 30 pounds.
  • Work in both indoor and outdoor environments.

Location: Austin

Description

Are you ready to be the decision-maker for the global network backbone of a world-class cloud platform?

We are searching for a mid level engineer ready to take complete ownership of our rapidly expanding data center network across multiple continents. This is an empowering role where you will be instrumental in designing, architecting, and optimizing our complex global connectivity.

You will dive deep into cutting-edge technologies, including Juniper EVPN-VXLAN, and advanced routing protocols (BGP). Critically, while you will own the network domain, you will also be deeply embedded in the wider Infrastructure team. This provides a clear, defined path for you to grow into all areas of our Infra stack—from Linux compute and storage to Kubernetes and site reliability engineering (SRE).

If you are passionate about building resilient, secure, and scalable networks, and are eager for a role where your expertise acts as the core architectural decision-maker with clear opportunities to expand your career into overall infrastructure leadership, we can’t wait to connect with you.

This is a 5-day in-office position built for maximum impact. Direct, high-bandwidth collaboration is key to the level of Network Ownership and accelerated cross-functional growth we offer. Be in the room to influence architecture, partner with senior leadership, and make immediate, high-stakes decisions that drive the business forward. We believe that we are better together than apart.

Key Responsibilities

This role is for an engineer who will support network architecture while contributing across the broader infrastructure.
  • Implement, optimize, and scale the global data center backbone to ensure high availability and security.
  • Contribute to the implementation and refinement of Juniper EVPN-VXLAN fabric for scalable overlay networks in our cloud environment.
  • Configure and manage mission-critical routing protocols (BGP,IPSec,ICCP) to ensure resilient, high-performance global connectivity.
  • Configure and maintain security policies using enterprise-grade firewalls (Fortinet, or similar).
  • Collaborate with Infrastructure, SRE, and Development teams to integrate networking solutions with compute, storage and cloud systems (Kubernetes/Ceph).
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts (Python,Bash,Ansible) to streamline network provisioning and scaling.
  • Utilize and support network observability tools (Prometheus,Grafana) for infrastructure monitoring and insight.
  • Provide effective troubleshooting and resolution for network incidents of varying complexity to minimize downtime.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience as a Network Engineer proficient in Juniper EVPN-VXLAN, advanced routing, and enterprise firewalls.
  • Working knowledge of core routing protocols BGP/IPSec for scaling global data center networks.
  • Strong proficiency in Linux and proven ability to automate tasks using Python, Bash, or Ansible.
  • Practical experience with Prometheus and Grafana for proactive network monitoring and actionable insights.
  • Experience in configuring firewalls and implementing network security best practices.
  • Ability to independently troubleshoot and resolve complex network and infrastructure issues.
  • Proactive approach to learning and adopting new technologies across the infrastructure stack.
  • Willingness to occasionally travel to data centers for on-site deployments and maintenance.
Nice to Have:
  • Advanced troubleshooting utilities: grep, awk, sed, and tcpdump.
  • ​​​​​​​Implementing Anycast for scalable network resilience.
  • ​​​​​​​Integrating network solutions with Kubernetes and CNI.
  • Optimizing performance on Juniper QFX series switches.

Why work for us?

We are a Great Place to Work-Certified™ company and the global leader in cloud-based access control and video surveillance. Following our merger with Eagle Eye Networks, we are building the only platform powerful enough to support the future of AI-driven security.

Why Your Work Matters

Innovation drives our vibe, but purpose drives our mission. You will work on essential systems that protect the health, safety, and welfare of people and property worldwide. At Brivo, your voice is heard, your talent is respected, and your contributions have a global impact.

  • The Brivo Experience: We thrive on in-person collaboration and a "one-team" atmosphere. We embrace our international presence, leveraging diverse ideas and backgrounds to improve our culture and our products. To keep our global teams connected and inspired, we provide a premium onsite experience featuring communal meals, recurring social events, and fully stocked workspaces—ensuring you have everything you need to stay focused while building the future of security.
  • Total Rewards: We support our people with competitive medical, vision, and dental plans (including company-offset premiums), a 401k with company match, and an unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO) policy that empowers you to take the time you need to maintain a healthy work-life balance.
Individual compensation packages are based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, training, and market conditions. In addition, Brivonians enjoy a robust benefits and perks package tailored to their work location.

About Brivo

Brivo and Eagle Eye Networks have come together to create a category-defining, cloud-first platform at the intersection of AI and the physical world. Our mission is simple and ambitious: to make physical spaces safer, smarter, and more autonomous—from single-site businesses to global enterprises.

As the unified global leaders in cloud-based access control and video surveillance, we provide a comprehensive digital foundation for the built environment. By combining Brivo’s pioneering building access platform with Eagle Eye’s AI-powered video management system (VMS), we have created a system of intelligence that protects over 600 million square feet across 90+ countries. Every door, camera, and credential in our ecosystem acts as a real-time sensor, leveraging AI to prevent incidents, improve operations, and enable entirely new workflows across sectors, including commercial real estate, retail, healthcare, education, and critical infrastructure.

With a global footprint spanning headquarters in Bethesda, Maryland, and Austin, Texas, and international offices in Amsterdam, London, Bangalore, and Tokyo, we are leveraging our open APIs and cyber-secure cloud infrastructure to reshape the future of physical security. Join us as we build the world’s most robust platform for video intelligence and smart space automation. Learn more at www.brivo.com.

Brivo is an equal employment opportunity employer and values diversity. Qualified candidates are considered for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, military or veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodations during the application or interview process, please inform us.

  • Competitive Starting Pay between $100,000 - $120,000 annually

  • Annual Bonus

          Network Design and Engineering



  • Design and implement Azure virtual networks, subnets, IP address plans, peering, route tables, and hub-and-spoke or Virtual WAN topologies. 

  • Configure and support Azure load balancing and traffic management services, including application gateways, web application firewalls, and global traffic distribution. 

  • Design and implement name resolution for hybrid environments, including Azure DNS, private DNS zones, and conditional forwarding with on-premises DNS.

  • Support the technical design and implementation of moderately complex network solutions, including evaluating requirements, identifying appropriate solutions, developing configurations, coordinating implementation, and validating results.

  • Build and support hybrid connectivity between on-premises sites and Azure, including site-to-site VPN, point-to-site VPN, and dedicated private circuits, with routing and failover design.

  • Design and manage Azure networking components, including Virtual Networks (VNets), subnets, Network Security Groups (NSGs), route tables, Azure Firewall, VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute, private endpoints, DNS, and load-balancing technologies.

  • Design and support network connectivity between Azure environments, corporate locations, data centers, and third-party services.

  • Apply network segmentation, routing, resiliency, and security principles to ensure solutions meet business and technical requirements.

  • Participate in network architecture discussions and provide technical recommendations within the assigned area of responsibility.




    Network Deployment and Administration




  • Configure and maintain routers, switches, firewalls, wireless infrastructure, VPN technologies, and related network services.

  • Implement network changes, upgrades, expansions, and migrations with appropriate testing, documentation, and change controls.

  • Manage IP addressing, routing, DNS, DHCP, network segmentation, and connectivity configurations.

  • Maintain network configurations and technical documentation, including network diagrams, configuration standards, and operational procedures.

  • Support hybrid networking technologies connecting cloud and on-premises infrastructure.




    Monitoring, Troubleshooting, and Support




  • Monitor and troubleshoot network availability, performance, capacity, and connectivity using Azure Monitor, Network Watcher, Log Analytics, flow logs, and other network management and diagnostic tools.

  • Independently diagnose and resolve moderately complex network incidents involving routing, connectivity, latency, DNS, firewall policies, VPNs, and cloud infrastructure.

  • Perform root-cause analysis for recurring or significant network issues and implement corrective actions.

  • Provide escalation-level technical support for network-related incidents and service disruptions.

  • Participate in scheduled maintenance activities and an on-call rotation as required to support production systems.




    Security and Reliability




  • Implement network security controls in partnership with cybersecurity and infrastructure teams.

  • Implement and manage Azure network security controls, including network security groups, application security groups, Azure Firewall, DDoS protection, service endpoints, and Private Link/private endpoints, in accordance with established security standards.

  • Apply identity and access controls to Azure network resources, including role-based access control and integration with Microsoft Entra ID, in partnership with cybersecurity and infrastructure teams.

  • Support network resiliency, redundancy, disaster recovery, and business continuity requirements.

  • Identify network vulnerabilities, configuration risks, and opportunities to improve reliability, security, and performance.

  • Ensure network changes follow established change-management, documentation, and security practices.




    Continuous Improvement and Collaboration




  • Identify opportunities to improve network performance, reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.

  • Develop or improve automation for repeatable network configuration and deployment activities using tools such as PowerShell, Azure CLI, Bicep, or Terraform.

  • Work collaboratively with cloud, infrastructure, cybersecurity, application, ERP, and service desk teams to resolve technical issues and implement solutions.

  • Provide technical guidance to team members and contribute knowledge through documentation and knowledge sharing.

  • Maintain current knowledge of Azure networking capabilities, network security practices, and relevant technologies.






MINIMUM EDUCATION & WORK REQUIREMENTS:



  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Network Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant technical experience. 

  • Minimum of 4 years of professional experience supporting and engineering enterprise network environments. 

  • Hands-on experience designing, deploying, and supporting Microsoft Azure networking in a production environment. 

  • Experience supporting hybrid cloud and on-premises network environments. 

  • Experience implementing moderately complex to complex network solutions.

  • Preferred Qualifications 

  • Microsoft Azure networking or infrastructure certification, such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator, Azure Network Engineer, Azure Solutions Architect, or Azure Security Engineer.

  • Relevant networking certification, such as Cisco CCNA or equivalent experience.


KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:



  • Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6, subnetting, routing, switching, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, NAT, VPNs, and firewall technologies. 

  • Working knowledge of routing protocols and concepts, including BGP and dynamic routing. 

  • Strong understanding of Microsoft Azure networking, including VNets, VNet peering, NSGs, User Defined Routes, Azure Firewall, VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute, Private Link/private endpoints, DNS, and load balancing. 

  • Ability to translate technical and business requirements into network designs and implementation plans. 

  • Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose complex network connectivity, routing, security, and performance issues. 

  • Understanding of network security concepts, segmentation, least-privilege access, and cloud networking security practices. 

  • Experience with network monitoring, logging, and diagnostic tools. 

  • Working knowledge of infrastructure-as-code and automation technologies such as Terraform, Bicep, PowerShell, or Azure CLI. 

  • Ability to create and maintain network diagrams, configuration documentation, implementation plans, and operational procedures. 

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to explain technical issues to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders. 

  • Ability to manage multiple technical priorities and drive assigned network projects through implementation.
