Inspired by Hard Work

At Carhartt, the values of hard work—dependability, honesty, and trust—are rooted in the legacy of our founder, Hamilton Carhartt. His commitment to serving hardworking people continues to inspire everything we do. Guided by his legacy and our mission—We serve and protect all hardworking people by building durable products—we remain dedicated to upholding these principles in every decision we make and every product we create.

Position Details

Title: Sr. Network Engineer

Department: Information Technology

Reports to: Supervisor, Network Engineering

Location: Dearborn, MI

Job Classification: Hybrid

FLSA Status: Exempt

Job Band: Professional

Job Summary

The Senior Network Engineer has primary responsibility for the full network infrastructure lifecycle, including the design, implementation, security, optimization, and support of enterprise network services. This role is responsible for both new and existing network components, including local area networks (LANs), wide area networks (WANs), wireless networks (WiFi), internet and intranet connectivity, firewalls, network security platforms, intrusion prevention and detection systems (IPS/IDS), load balancers, VPN technologies, and other data communication systems. The Senior Network Engineer ensures the reliability, performance, scalability, and security of the organization's network infrastructure while supporting business and operational requirements.

Inspired by Hard Work

At Carhartt, the values of hard work—dependability, honesty, and trust—are rooted in the legacy of our founder, Hamilton Carhartt. His commitment to serving hardworking people continues to inspire everything we do. Guided by his legacy and our mission—We serve and protect all hardworking people by building durable products—we remain dedicated to upholding these principles in every decision we make and every product we create.

Associate Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, maintain, and continuously improve enterprise LAN, WAN, wireless, cloud, and network security infrastructure across corporate, retail, distribution, and remote locations.
  • Administer and optimize Cisco Meraki wireless networks, Arista switching environments, and related network technologies to ensure high availability, performance, scalability, and security.
  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot network infrastructure, including routers, switches, VPNs, circuits, wireless platforms, and security technologies while supporting day-to-day operations and strategic initiatives.
  • Monitor network performance, proactively identify bottlenecks, analyze trends, perform capacity planning, and implement improvements to enhance network reliability and efficiency.
  • Lead advanced Level 3 troubleshooting and service restoration for complex, multi-vendor network issues involving routing, switching, wireless, VPN, and connectivity services.
  • Implement and maintain network segmentation, VLANs, security best practices, and infrastructure standards to support secure and resilient operations.
  • Research and evaluate existing and emerging networking technologies, providing recommendations and roadmap guidance to ensure enterprise network solutions remain current, supportable, and aligned with business objectives.
  • Serve as a technical lead on cross-functional teams, driving the development and delivery of networking solutions that support business growth, application expansion, and operational excellence.
  • Develop conceptual, logical, and physical network architectures, including technical documentation, diagrams, testing plans, risk assessments, and implementation strategies.
  • Evaluate vendor solutions, perform cost-benefit analyses, and recommend scalable, cost-effective technologies and approaches for large-scale initiatives.
  • Lead the planning, design, and implementation of infrastructure projects, collaborating with business partners, vendors, and VARs to gather requirements, develop BRDs, create RFI/RFPs, manage project execution, and communicate project status throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive network and operational documentation, ensuring accurate system configurations, procedures, change records, and project and incident tracking.
  • Analyze recurring issues, identify trends, recommend corrective actions, and keep leadership informed of risks and problem areas.
  • Support new store openings, remodels, and infrastructure deployments, including network installation, cabling, and connectivity requirements.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and provide after-hours support for critical infrastructure incidents, maintenance activities, and business continuity events.

Required Education

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent years of experience required in Computer Science or Related Field
  • Professional level of industry certification or higher, such as Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) or Cisco Certified Design Professional (CCDP)

Required Skills & Experience

  • Minimum of 8 years of professional experience in a related field. Hands-on experience in enterprise network engineering, infrastructure operations, and network security.
  • Strong expertise in TCP/IP networking across Layers 2-7, including routing, switching, VLANs, DHCP, DNS, subnetting, MPLS, QoS, wireless networking, and network security technologies.
  • Proven experience designing, implementing, and supporting Cisco and Arista switching and wireless environments, including Arista EOS platforms and enterprise-grade access point deployments.
  • Hands-on experience with Palo Alto Networks firewalls and Panorama, including firewall policy management, VPN configuration, security zones, threat prevention, and IPS capabilities.
  • Strong knowledge of LAN/WAN architecture, SD-WAN, MPLS, cloud connectivity, and enterprise networking best practices.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to deal with stressful situations involving equipment and application failures in a composed and constructive manner.
  • Strong network troubleshooting and diagnostic skills, including root cause analysis and the use of packet captures, protocol analyzers, network monitoring platforms, and advanced diagnostic tools to resolve complex issues and support critical operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to perform switch and router configuration analysis, implement network segmentation, and maintain secure network infrastructures utilizing ACLs, QoS, and other security controls.
  • Working knowledge of cloud networking and routing, preferably within Microsoft Azure; experience with AWS or GCP is a plus.
  • Understanding of Zero Trust architecture, defense-in-depth strategies, compliance requirements, asset protection, and enterprise security principles.
  • Experience with reverse proxy technologies, remote access solutions, and network monitoring and management platforms.
  • Proven ability to evaluate emerging technologies, define implementation methodologies, and recommend innovative solutions that improve performance, scalability, and reliability.
  • Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills with the ability to communicate technical concepts and architectural strategies to technical and non-technical audiences alike.
  • Self-motivated professional with strong problem-solving abilities, capable of working independently and collaboratively in fast-paced, distributed environments

Physical Requirements And Working Conditions

  • Office Environment and Retail Stores
  • Position involves climbing ladders in compliance with safety protocols
  • Travel (30%)
  • Lifting of a maximum of 50 lbs.
  • On call availability
  • This position has a Hybrid location: Associate will work on-site regularly as needed for work activities.
  • Carhartt is a tobacco free workplace.

This position offers a comprehensive suite of medical, dental, and vision insurance for associates and their dependents. In addition to healthcare coverage, Carhartt provides short-term and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, an employee assistance program, and a 401(k) plan with employer matching contributions. Employees can also benefit from paid time off and designated paid holidays.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, disability, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, sexual orientation, age, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

All associates are required to understand and act in accordance with the Carhartt Core Values. Carhartt reserves the right to change, modify, suspend, interpret or cancel in whole or in any part, the job duties outlined above at any time and without advance notice to the employee.

descriptionHtml:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

PRINCIPAL NETWORK ENGINEER (STARLINK GROUND NETWORK)

At SpaceX we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to 7M+ users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for communities and businesses around the globe.

As a Principal Network Engineer, you will drive the operation, build, and deployment of our network around the world. You will be a key component in managing and expanding our global footprint, improving network performance and reliability, and optimizing our deployments.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and expand network interconnections, network co-location sites and points of presence (POPs)
  • Improve network performance and reliability based upon system performance metrics, including capacity planning, failure detection and remediation
  • Assist in capacity augmentation and network optimization deployments
  • Lead network integration and troubleshooting efforts for the largest and most strategic Starlink customers
  • Collaborate with hardware, software, and network engineers to create or improve Starlink products.
  • Support sales teams with technical pre-sales support during the sales cycle by acting as the Starlink technical subject matter expert.
  • Assist in updating system configuration and firmware
  • Automation for network devices, operational and deployment tools
  • Assist in architecting how Starlink satellite assets will integrate with more traditional ground networks
  • Mentor and train junior network engineers

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical or engineering discipline; OR 2+ years of professional networking experience deploying enterprise network solutions and/or cloud & web-scale networks in lieu of a degree
  • 7+ year of networking experience deploying enterprise network solutions and/or cloud & web-scale networks (Internship/Co-op experience recognized)
  • Layer-1 experience (Example: transport, DWDM, optical fiber, circuit troubleshooting, activations, etc.)
  • Experience with the deployment of networking hardware (Routers, Modems, Switch, Firewalls, etc..)

Preferred Skills And Experience

  • Master’s degree in a technical or engineering discipline
  • Experience bringing up switches, routers, firewalls & servers
  • Operational experience in a Linux production environment
  • Experience with Python and/or bash scripting
  • Routing Protocol experience
  • Experience with physical troubleshooting of fiber & circuits
  • Deep understanding of service provider networks including but not limited to:
    • Connectivity (Ethernet, IPv4, IPv6 and MPLS)
    • Routing (BGP, OSPF, IS-IS)
    • Switching and routing
    • Internet services (subscriber provisioning, BRAS, DNS, DHCP, NTP)
  • Strong familiarity with network health monitoring systems such as Observium, Solarwinds or Nagios
  • Experience with hands-on experience bringing up network infrastructure
  • Experience creating documentation and procedures
  • Ability to run projects independently
  • Experience working on wireless networks
  • Experience working on software defined networking (SDN) and/or network function virtualization (NFV)
  • Cisco, Juniper, Arista or other industry certification
Additional Requirements

  • Must be willing to do some travel domestically and globally when needed (primarily for POP deployments & build out)
  • Must be available for on-call rotations
  • Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed

Compensation And Benefits

Pay range:

Network Engineer/Principal: $200,000.00 - $285,000.00/per year

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock, stock options, or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. descriptionHtml:
Company Overview

Iridium is an award-winning satellite communications company operating the world's only truly global voice and data network, delivering reliable connectivity anywhere on Earth. For more than 20 years, Iridium has powered mission-critical communications for governments, businesses, aviation, maritime, and the rapidly expanding Internet of Things.

Now part of Iridium, Aireon is the world’s only space-based air traffic surveillance system, providing real-time visibility of aircraft over oceans, the poles, and remote regions. Together, Iridium and Aireon are helping build a safer, more connected, and more efficient future for global aviation.

Join our team and help shape how the world stays connected. We foster a collaborative, inclusive culture where employees are empowered to innovate, grow professionally, and make a meaningful impact.

What We’re Looking For:

We are looking for a Senior Network Administrator to partner with our Network Infrastructure team in support of a Space Development Agency (SDA) project. Responsibilities include autonomously implementing and maintaining functional network infrastructure and equipment as well as performing network and security testing, validation, and troubleshooting to ensure a fault-tolerant, reliable, scalable, and automated infrastructure across SDA networks. In this role, you will provide support to the overall SDA and remote Teleport networks by configuring and maintaining Local and Wide Area Network infrastructure equipment and devices. In addition, you’ll participate in, and at times lead, the implementation of solutions that follow Government best practice guiding principles.

This position requires an active/current Top Secret Security Clearance with the ability to obtain TS/SCI clearance (A U.S. Security Clearance that has been active in the past 24 months is considered active).

What You’ll Do:

  • Be responsible for day-to-day support and maintenance for SDA Network Infrastructure systems to support Local Area Networks (LAN) and Wide Area Networks (WAN) across multiple sites
  • Be responsible for day-to-day support and maintenance for a DevSecOps link to facilitate software deliveries to the Operational System
  • Work independently to perform installation, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of networking and security hardware including, but not limited to, Juniper EX4400, ACX, and Juniper SRX firewalls
  • Create and maintain documentation, audit logs, and adhere to Configuration Management rules required to meet compliance and to enable team members to assist in problems and apply consistent solutions across a different environments and teams
  • Conduct research on network products, services, protocols, and standards to remain abreast of developments in the DevOps and network industries, technologies, and best practices
  • Play a key role in real-time troubleshooting and problem resolution as required and provide 24x7 on call assistance as needed

What You’ll Need to Succeed:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related field; or equivalent, relevant, and progressively responsible experience in lieu of degree
  • 8+ years of experience with managing and maintaining mid-to-large scale LAN/WAN networks and security that include Juniper Routers, Switches, and other vendors networking technologies
  • 8+ years of experience working with various Firewall vendors including Juniper, Cisco ASA, Check Point, Palo Alto, and Fortinet platforms
  • 3+ years of experience working with Juniper Firewalls and associated management platforms
  • Strong knowledge and multi-year hands-on experience with IP communication protocols such as OSI Model, Spanning-Tree, VDC, VFR, VTP, VSS, and routing protocols such as OSPF, EIGRP, and BGP are required
  • Experience working with Netconf/Yang
  • Well versed in use of MS PowerPoint, Excel, and Visio
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly convey products, deliverables, analyses, and/or issues to groups outside of your team or those who are unfamiliar with the topic
  • Have confidence and be able to easily build relationships with leadership and colleagues outside of your team
  • Possess an analytical mindset, with the ability to understand a situation or problem and think critically to make decisions and come up with out-of-the-box solutions
  • Be proactive in providing feedback and be enthusiastic in sharing your knowledge with others
  • Capable of prioritizing your own tasks and potentially the tasks of others while making sure deadlines are met 

Things That Would be Great if You Brought to the Table:

  • Current/active TS/SCI clearance
  • Government Operations experience in a 24/7 Network Operations Center (NOC) environment
  • Familiarity with DISA (Defense Information Systems Agent) and Government provided WAN connections
  • Familiarity with the use of Type 1 encryption devices
  • Advanced skills with Nagios Monitoring performance tools
  • Any relevant technical certifications (i.e., CompTIA, CISSP, etc.)

We’ll also need you to:

  • Be able to support 24/7 on-call on an as-needed basis
  • Be able to travel occasionally, about 3 to 4 times per year
  • Be able to lift up to 30 lbs.
  • This position directly performs under, supports, or is exposed to a U.S. government contract. To comply with the requirements of that U.S. government contract, applicants for this position must be U.S. citizens

Work Environment:

This position exclusively works onsite in a classified operations center; remote work is not available. The position is largely sedentary with the majority of the position sitting in a chair and working with a computer. The role uses basic office equipment including a phone, video, computer, keyboard, mouse and printer. For meetings in person, this position will need to be able stand, walk within the office and climb stairs on occasion. 

Additional Information

This job description outlines the general nature and level of work for this role and is not a comprehensive list of duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. Employees may be assigned additional responsibilities as needed.

Base Pay Range: $116,000 - $150,000

Actual compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors and this range represents an estimate of compensation at the time of posting. Base salary is only one part of our compensation package for this role. You may also be eligible for company stock and annual bonus. Employee benefits also include medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage; 401(k) retirement plan options; paid time off and paid holidays; paid parental leave; and other discounts and perks.

We are seeking an experienced Network Engineer to join our network engineering team. In this role, you'll be designing, implementing, and maintaining Versa Networks SD-WAN solutions. Join us. The world can’t wait.

Description

SAIC is seeking an onsite network engineer at Kirtland AFB in Albuquerque, New Mexico, to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment with experienced engineers and customers supporting the Space Systems Command. Our network team makes sure satellites can communicate with their ground systems and are responsible for monitoring and support of network infrastructure (Cisco routers and switches, Palo Alto firewalls, SolarWinds, and Identity Services Engine (ISE) authentication) and virtual server environments (private cloud via VMWare Cloud Foundation, servers, storage area networks, and VMware). You should be able to troubleshoot, install, implement and administer network systems. You will also support the cybersecurity team to remediate deficiencies. We need experts who can determine what needs to be done and go off and do it but also work successfully as part of a team.

You will

  • Analyze network characteristics such as traffic, connect time, transmission speeds, packet sizes, and throughput.
  • Assist more senior network engineers with the installation, removal and modifications to network components.
  • Configure, deploy, upgrade, and troubleshoot multivendor switches, routers, firewalls, and peripheral equipment in operational and test lab environments.
  • Operate or administer Linux and Unix systems.
  • Provide occasional after-hours operational support for network issues.
  • Apply your knowledge of enterprise system monitoring and management tools (Solar Winds, WireShark, iPerf, etc.) to analyze network activity and problems.
  • Develop and maintain network topologies, diagrams and IP tracking.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in science and technology related discipline such as Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, Systems Engineering, or Computer Engineering from an accredited college or university and 5 years or more relevant experience; a Master’s degree and 3 years or more experience. Will accept 4 additional years of relevant experience in lieu of degree.
  • Active Top Secret or DoE Q clearance with SCI eligibility (must be eligible for SCI indoctrination within first 3 months of start date) and be able to obtain and maintain TS/SCI.
  • Must possess DoD 8570 baseline certification.
  • Strong background in Microsoft Office tools and Visio.
  • Record of success in contributing to the completion of programs and projects; ability to obtain results and make key recommendations.

Desired Experience

  • Good understanding of discipline process, information and data management, configuration control.
  • Seasoned communicator with demonstrated record of success in leadership, followership, and working with contract representatives and government sponsors.

At PEARCE, we've got a career for you!

Pearce is a leading technology-enabled provider of asset management solutions for mission-critical electromechanical infrastructure throughout North America. Pearce provides technical maintenance, repair, operations, and engineering services for uninterruptible power supply (UPS) systems, backup power generators, battery energy storage systems (BESS), critical cooling systems, and other electrical and mechanical infrastructure across end markets such as renewable energy, telecom, and data centers. Founded in 1998, Pearce has more than 4,000 employees and 28 locations across the U.S. Pearce is a wholly owned subsidiary of CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm. To learn more about Pearce visit http://www.pearce-services.com.

Pearce is seeking talented and motivated candidates for the Senior Network Engineer role, responsible for the design, implementation, administration, maintenance, and optimization of enterprise network infrastructure supporting global data center, cloud, campus, and branch environments. Provides advanced engineering expertise across routing, switching, cloud networking platforms, security, wireless, SDWAN, network segmentation, and load balancing. Serves as a technical lead for complex infrastructure initiatives, ensuring high availability, scalability, security, and operational excellence across all network services. This hybrid role requires two days per week in a Dallas-area office. Candidates currently based in the Dallas area are preferred; relocation assistance is not available.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, and support enterprise network infrastructure utilizing Cisco Nexus, Catalyst, ASR, ISR, Meraki, and Juniper/HPE networking platforms to include Mist.
  • Support cloud networking infrastructure across Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including network security, load balancing, connectivity, and hybrid-cloud integration.
  • Configure and maintain advanced routing and switching environments using BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, RPVST+, VPC, and other enterprise networking protocols.
  • Deploy and support Palo Alto firewalls, VPN technologies, IDS/IPS solutions, URL filtering, Layer 7 security policies, and Zero Trust security architectures.
  • Engineer and manage Network Access Control (NAC) solutions utilizing Cisco ISE, Forescout, and 802.1X authentication for enterprise segmentation and policy enforcement.
  • Manage enterprise wireless infrastructure including Cisco and Juniper Wireless LAN Controllers (WLCs), access points, RF optimization, roaming services, and wireless security.
  • Configure and maintain F5 load balancing platforms including LTM, GTM, APM, and application delivery services to ensure application availability and performance.
  • Administer IPAM, DNS, DHCP, certificate services, and related network management platforms.
  • Design, implement, and maintain WAN and SDWAN solutions including MPLS, DIA, VPLS/EVC, DWDM, and cloud connectivity services.
  • Administer and optimize Cisco ACI software-defined networking (SDN) environments to improve network scalability, segmentation, and automation.
  • Monitor network performance and capacity using NetFlow, SNMP, Syslog, IP SLA, packet capture tools, and other network monitoring solutions.
  • Perform advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis across network, cloud, security, and application delivery environments.
  • Develop automation and scripting solutions to streamline network provisioning, monitoring, configuration management, and operational processes.
  • Lead infrastructure projects from design through implementation, coordinating with project managers, vendors, security teams, and business stakeholders.
  • Create and maintain network diagrams, engineering standards, operational procedures, and technical documentation.
  • Provide mentorship and technical guidance to junior engineers and network operations personnel.
  • Participate in incident management, change management, capacity planning, and technology lifecycle management activities.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and provide recommendations to improve reliability, performance, security, and operational efficiency.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in enterprise network engineering and infrastructure operations.
  • Expert knowledge of Cisco and Juniper routing, switching, and data center technologies, including Cisco ACI, Nexus, Catalyst, ASR, and ISR platforms as well Juniper Mist.
  • Strong experience with Palo Alto firewalls, IPS/IDS technologies, VPN solutions, and network security architecture.
  • Experience designing and supporting SDWAN, WAN, cloud networking, and enterprise segmentation solutions.
  • Working knowledge of Azure, AWS, and GCP networking services and hybrid-cloud architectures.
  • Experience with Cisco ISE, NAC technologies, wireless networking, F5 load balancing, and network monitoring tools.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Industry certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, PCNSE, Azure Network Engineer, AWS Advanced Networking, or equivalent preferred.

Core Technologies

Cloud Networking Azure, AWS, GCP, Cisco ACI, Nexus 9000/7000/5000, Catalyst 9000, ASR, ISR, Catalyst 8000, Cisco Meraki, Juniper Mist, Palo Alto, Cisco ISE, Forescout, NAC, Zero Trust, SASE, VPN, IDS/IPS, BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, MPLS, VPLS, SDWAN, F5 LTM/GTM/APM, DNS, DHCP, IPAM, NetFlow, SNMP, Syslog, and Wireless LAN Controllers.

If you have questions about compensation, we encourage open discussions during the hiring process.

Pearce offers a family-friendly and innovative culture with opportunities for growth, competitive compensation, comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental and vision insurance, flexible spending accounts, HSA option. descriptionHtml:
Senior Network Engineer

Location: Washington, DC (On-Site)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Salary Range: $140,000 - $150,000 annually

MUST HAVE Active Top Secret Clearance with SCI Eligibility Required

  • PLEASE - DO NOT APPLY IF YOU DO NOT HOLD AN ACTIVE TOP-SECRET CLEARANCE**

Who We Are

RCG is a fast-growing federal contracting firm proudly Certified™ as a Great Place to Work® for four consecutive years. We are committed to fostering a culture of innovation, inclusion, and excellence. At RCG, we deliver technology and mission support services that help government agencies succeed.

The Opportunity

RCG is seeking a Senior Network Engineer to support enterprise network operations, architecture, modernization, and troubleshooting for a large federal agency in Washington, DC.

This is not a general IT support role, nor is it a paper-only architecture position. We are seeking a senior engineer who can independently own complex network issues, review and validate proposed changes, mentor junior engineers, and provide technical leadership across routing, switching, WAN, firewall, secure transport, and classified network operations.

The ideal candidate will be equally comfortable troubleshooting a production outage, reviewing a proposed network design, validating a firewall change, documenting an implementation plan, or leading a maintenance-window activity.

What You'll Do

  • Provide senior technical leadership for enterprise network operations, including routing, switching, firewalls, WAN transport, secure communications, and supporting infrastructure
  • Troubleshoot complex network issues across Layer 1 through Layer 7, including routing, switching, firewall policy, encrypted transport, and application/service connectivity
  • Design, review, implement, and validate network changes involving routing, switching, firewall policies, secure transport, and modernization initiatives
  • Support VOSIP, VTC, CUCM, and collaboration services, including network path validation, QoS considerations, multicast behavior, and secure communications requirements
  • Participate in network architecture reviews, modernization efforts, and major infrastructure upgrades
  • Lead maintenance-window activities, including implementation planning, rollback procedures, validation testing, and post-change reviews
  • Develop and maintain network diagrams, as-built documentation, implementation plans, validation procedures, and operational runbooks
  • Monitor network performance and troubleshoot issues using enterprise monitoring and diagnostic tools
  • Collaborate with government stakeholders, security teams, ISSOs, vendors, and technical SMEs to support operations, compliance, and modernization efforts
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers on troubleshooting, packet flow analysis, change management, and operational best practices

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical discipline
  • Minimum of 8+ years of hands-on network engineering experience in enterprise, federal, DoD, or similarly complex environments
  • Active CCNP Enterprise, CCNP Security, or equivalent advanced networking certification
  • Strong experience with Cisco routing and switching, enterprise LAN/WAN environments, routing protocols, high-availability technologies, and multi-site network troubleshooting
  • Experience troubleshooting routed, switched, firewalled, and encrypted transport environments
  • Experience supporting enterprise voice, video, and collaboration services
  • Experience with change control, maintenance planning, configuration review, rollback procedures, and post-change validation
  • Experience creating technical documentation, network diagrams, implementation plans, and operational procedures
  • Experience supporting Cisco, Dell, Palo Alto, Juniper, or other enterprise networking platforms
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and mentor less-experienced engineers

Preferred Qualifications

  • Cisco CCIE, Cisco Specialist certifications, or other advanced networking certifications
  • Experience supporting classified, Red/Black, TACLANE, HAIPE, or encrypted transport environments
  • Experience with GRE, IPsec, secure WAN transport, multicast, and collaboration services
  • Experience with Cisco ASA, Firepower, Cisco Nexus, and datacenter networking technologies
  • Experience with SolarWinds, Wireshark, packet analysis, and enterprise monitoring tools
  • Familiarity with cloud integration, network automation, and federal accreditation processes

What Success Looks Like

  • Independently manages complex network operations, troubleshooting, and engineering initiatives with minimal oversight
  • Balances technical expertise with sound judgment, ensuring production stability and minimizing operational risk
  • Produces accurate documentation, validates changes thoroughly, and follows established change management processes

You will come into a program that enjoys a close working relationship with the customer, bringing exquisite technical expertise to bear on real world problems, helping the customer execute real world missions that impact National Security on a daily basis. This close relationship, along with the program's longevity (20 years), ensures that as a new team member you will find a depth of support for growth and development that is unmatched, all while making a difference - daily.

Senior Network Engineer Lyntris is a defense technology company that connects sensing to action across the connected battlespace. Lyntris brings together the talents of Accelint and Vitesse teams under one mission, with each contributing deep expertise within their domain. Combining differentiated hardware, software and mission expertise, Lyntris helps customers sense threats, make sense of complex conditions and act with greater speed, precision and confidence in contested environments. Lyntris supports U.S. and allied defense organizations across every branch — including Navy, Army, Air Force, Space Force and allied partners — spanning strategic, operational and tactical missions and every domain: Space, Air, Land, Sea and Cyber. With more than 200 active defense programs, Lyntris works at every level of the mission, from national command authority to the tactical edge. Solutions are designed by operators who understand the mission, engineered for the conditions that degrade or defeat standard systems, and built on an open, modular architecture that integrates into existing programs without requiring them to start over. Lyntris moves faster than the traditional defense cycle — with integrated design, build and test capabilities in-house — and delivers systems that sustain and endure long after initial fielding. We are seeking a Senior Network Engineer to strengthen networking initiatives supporting Foreign Military Sales (FMS) programs. The ideal candidate will have substantial experience with military C4I systems and secure operational networks. descriptionHtml:
Greenberg Traurig (GT), a global law firm with locations across the world in 15 countries, has an exciting employment opportunity for you. We offer competitive compensation and an excellent benefits package, along with the opportunity to work within an innovative and collaborative environment.

Join our Technology Team as Network Engineer located in our Atlanta office.

We are seeking a professional who thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. The ideal candidate possesses strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities, ensuring efficiency and accuracy in every task. With a dedicated work ethic and a can-do attitude, you will take initiative and approach challenges with confidence and resilience. Excellent communication skills are essential for collaborating effectively across teams and delivering exceptional client service. If you are someone who demonstrates initiative, adaptability, and innovation, we invite you to join our team.

This role can be based in our Atlanta office on a hybrid basis. This role reports to the Director of Network Systems.

Position Summary

This position is responsible for the design, implementation, operation, and maintenance of enterprise level LAN, WAN, firewall, and Wi-Fi systems across a large, multi-national, multi-site organization. The Network Engineer will collaborate with infrastructure and application teams to ensure optimal network performance, security, and scalability, while also contributing to documentation, monitoring, and the ongoing migration of on-premises services to cloud and hybrid environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Implements and supports firewall/DMZ security infrastructure, including traffic flow troubleshooting, policy analysis and security postures
  • Implements and supports enterprise LAN, WAN and Wi-Fi systems in a large, multi-site environment
  • Implements and supports routing infrastructure using common routing protocols (OSPF, BGP, BGP-EVPN, VxLAN Encapsulation)
  • Administers LAN/WAN/VLAN/802.1x, Wi-Fi, VoIP, 802.1X authentication, RADIUS, Tacacs+ IPsec Tunnels and VPN technologies
  • Designs, implements, and supports hybrid cloud network connectivity to Microsoft Azure and/or AWS, including ExpressRoute, Azure Virtual WAN, AWS Direct Connect, and Transit Gateway architectures
  • Manages and troubleshoots cloud-based network security groups (NSGs), virtual network peering, and cloud firewall policies
  • Supports migration of on-premises network services to cloud and hybrid environments
  • Collaborates with infrastructure and application teams to ensure optimal cloud network architecture, performance, and security
  • Implements and supports network monitoring systems using technologies like SNMP, NetFlow, and syslog for monitoring and analysis
  • Develops and maintains network automation scripts using Powershell and Ansible to streamline network operations and improve efficiency

Qualifications

Skills & Competencies

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex network issues
  • Very strong knowledge of TCP/IP networking
  • Strong knowledge of network security and firewall administration. Palo Alto / Panorama experience a plus
  • Strong knowledge of routing and switching in a large enterprise environment. Arista and Cisco experience a plus
  • Strong knowledge and experience administering a large, multi-site LAN/WAN network, including data centers interconnections (DCI)
  • Strong Knowledge of dynamic LAN/WAN routing protocols
  • In-depth knowledge of BGP, VXLAN and BGP-EVPN
  • Strong knowledge of Wi-Fi networking technologies (Controller based deployments)
  • Strong knowledge of TCP/IP troubleshooting and network traffic analysis using packet capture tools like Wireshark
  • Working knowledge of cloud networking concepts in Microsoft Azure (VNets, ExpressRoute, Azure Firewall, NSGs, Azure Virtual WAN) and/or AWS (VPCs, Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, Security Groups)
  • Familiarity with cloud-native network monitoring and logging tools (e.g., Azure Network Watcher, AWS CloudWatch, VPC Flow Logs)
  • Understanding of Zero Trust Network Architecture (ZTNA) principles as applied to hybrid cloud environments
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates for provisioning cloud network resources
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices and tools
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell
  • Hands-on experience with network automation tools, particularly Ansible
  • Must have good written and verbal communication skills
  • Exposure to IaC (Infrastructure as Code) is a plus
  • Good ability to create documentation
  • Occasional travel required

Education & Prior Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field, or equivalent work experience
  • 7 + years of experience with routing and switching in a large enterprise environment
  • 7 + years of experience administering a large, multi-site LAN/WAN network
  • 7 + years of experience working with WAN dynamic routing protocols (BGP, OSPF)
  • 5 + years of experience administering WiFi networks, Aruba experience preferred
  • 5 + years of experience administering firewalls, Palo Alto experience preferred
  • 2+ years of experience with cloud networking in Azure and/or AWS environments, including hybrid connectivity solutions
  • Relevant cloud certifications a plus (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Azure Network Engineer Associate, AWS Certified Advanced Networking – Specialty, or equivalent)

Description

COMPANY OVERVIEW

Artisan Design Group (ADG), a Lowe's company, is a leading national provider of interior finishings solutions for homebuilders and property management clients. ADG delivers end to end design, procurement, and installation services for flooring, cabinets, countertops, and a growing portfolio of interior products.

Founded in 2016, ADG has grown by uniting respected regional operators across the country. Following its 2025 acquisition by Lowe's Companies, Inc., the company continues to operate as ADG while benefiting from the scale, resources, and brand strength of one of the most trusted names in home improvement. Together, they are expanding their capabilities in a highly fragmented market while remaining committed to craftsmanship, service, and local expertise that make their teams valued partners nationwide.

As a Senior Network Engineer at Artisan Design Group, you will be responsible for designing, configuring, implementing, and maintaining robust network infrastructures for our clients. . You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure the efficient and secure operation of networks. Your deep knowledge of Fortigate, Velo, Dell, Cisco technologies will be instrumental in delivering cutting-edge network solutions. This position offers a hybrid office work schedule.

Key Responsibilities

  • Network Design: Lead the design and deployment of complex network solutions, incorporating Fortigate, Velo, Dell, Cisco technologies, SD-WAN, and VOIP technologies.
  • Configuration and Optimization: Configure and optimize network devices and security solutions for maximum efficiency and performance.
  • Security: Implement and maintain advanced security measures to safeguard network assets and data.
  • VOIP Expertise: Manage and optimize VOIP systems, ensuring high-quality voice and video communications.
  • Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve network issues promptly, providing expert-level support to resolve complex problems.
  • Performance Monitoring: Continuously monitor network performance, proactively identifying and addressing potential bottlenecks and issues.
  • Documentation: Maintain comprehensive network documentation, including diagrams, configurations, and change logs.
  • Vendor Collaboration: Collaborate with technology vendors to evaluate and recommend hardware and software solutions.
  • Project Leadership: Lead network infrastructure projects, ensuring successful completion within established timelines and budgets.
  • Remote Work: Work in-office on a flexible 3-day schedule, with the option for 2 days of remote work.

If you are a seasoned Senior Network Engineer with a passion for cutting-edge technologies and a desire for a flexible work schedule, we encourage you to apply. Join us in delivering high-performance network solutions that enable businesses to thrive in today's dynamic digital landscape.

Requirements

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 7+ years of experience in network engineering roles, with a strong focus on Fortigate, Velo, Dell, Cisco technologies, SD-WAN, VOIP, and security.
  • Industry certifications such as Cisco CCNA/CCNP/CCIE, Fortinet NSE, or equivalent are highly desirable.
  • Extensive knowledge of network design, configuration, and troubleshooting.
  • Strong background in network security best practices and protocols.
  • Expertise in VOIP systems and protocols.
  • Proficiency with network monitoring and management tools.
  • Exceptional communication, teamwork, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proven ability to lead projects and work independently.

A Great Opportunity

  • Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.
  • Flexible work schedule with the option for remote work.
  • Ongoing professional development opportunities, including certifications and training.
  • A collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Opportunities for career advancement within a growing company.

Our Benefits

  • Health Insurance (Medical, Prescription, Dental, and Vision)
  • Life Insurance
  • Paid Holidays and Time Off
  • 401(k) Plan with company matching

descriptionHtml:
Wright-Patterson AFB

 

At IPT Associates (IPTA), we enjoy solving real-world problems with technology. We work closely with our customers, teammates, experts, and partners to come up with practical solutions that make a difference. Whether it's a government or business organization, we focus on understanding the need and building something that works.

Our Team

At IPTA, everything starts with our people. We're big believers that when you invest in your team, great things happen. That's why we encourage learning, growth, and trying new things-even if you don't have all the answers yet.

Our culture is rooted in fierce determination, fearless integrity, and passionate service-but we also like to keep things collaborative, supportive, and down-to-earth.

We're Looking For People Who

  • Are curious and excited about technology
  • Like solving problems and figuring things out
  • Can take initiative but also enjoy working with a team
  • Want to keep learning, growing, and challenging themselves

If you're someone who's eager to jump in, learn something new, and make an impact-you'll fit right in here.

  • This position is contingent upon contract award and the actual job description may vary based on specific contract requirements and organizational needs.*

Responsibilities

  • Design, configure, maintain, monitor, and secure enterprise network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, intrusion detection and prevention systems, and VPNs.
  • Monitor availability, capacity, health, and performance; troubleshoot outages and connectivity issues, perform root-cause analysis, and coordinate resolution with technical teams.
  • Develop scalable network solutions and recommend upgrades, technology refreshes, and configuration changes based on mission, performance, and security needs.
  • Install, test, certify, and troubleshoot copper and fiber-optic cabling, coordinating work with external organizations when required.
  • Support connectivity for servers, data centers, storage, backup, voice, video, and conference-room technologies.
  • Apply approved security baselines, patches, firmware updates, and change-management practices.
  • Maintain network diagrams, configurations, procedures, implementation records, and hardware and software inventories.
  • Support disaster recovery, continuity of operations, and assigned after-hours outage response.

Requirements

  • Active Secret security clearance.
  • Current role-appropriate DoD Cyberspace Workforce qualification meeting DoDM 8140.03 requirements (minimum Security +) and any required operating-system or technology certification.
  • Hands-on experience designing, configuring, securing, monitoring, and troubleshooting enterprise LAN and WAN environments.
  • Knowledge of routing, switching, firewalls, load balancing, intrusion detection and prevention, VPNs, network monitoring, capacity planning, and copper and fiber-optic cabling.
  • Ability to maintain technical documentation and comply with privileged-user, cybersecurity, information-protection, and controlled-unclassified-information requirements.
  • Bachelor's degree in a related technical field or equivalent relevant education and experience.
  • Five or more years of network engineering or administration experience; DoD experience and a relevant certification such as CCNA, CCNP, or Network+ are preferred.
  • Ability to work primarily at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base and support occasional extended hours or on-call outage response.

IPTA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All employment decisions are based on individual merit, including qualifications, experience, performance, and business needs, consistent with applicable federal laws and federal contracting requirements. IPTA provides equal opportunity and utilizes merit-based principles to make employment-related decisions.

descriptionHtml:
Nature and Scope

The IT Network Engineer is responsible for contributing to the design, implementation, maintenance, monitoring, and support of ARI’s enterprise network infrastructure and related communication technologies. This role helps ensure the availability, performance, reliability, scalability, and security of Local Area Networks (LAN), Wide Area Networks (WAN), wireless networks, cloud connectivity, and communication systems across all company locations.

The position supports and helps manage mission-critical network technologies, including data network infrastructure, enterprise network design and architecture, next-generation firewalls (Palo Alto and Cisco), Cisco Nexus backbone switches, Cisco ASR and ISR edge routers, VPN and MFA solutions, MPLS data circuits, voice and data communications, wireless infrastructure, virtualization platforms, and enterprise phone systems.

The IT Network Engineer works collaboratively with Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Applications, and business teams to deliver secure, resilient, and reliable network services that support business operations, regulatory and compliance requirements, and organizational growth.

This position is located in Shirley, NY

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

Network Infrastructure Management

  • Support Data Networks to all facilities (NY, OH, CA, and Altkirch).
  • Responsible for assisting with the design & architecture of the enterprise data network.
  • Assist in implementing, maintaining, and optimizing the enterprise network infrastructure.
  • Configure and administer Nexus/Catalyst switching core (Trunking/VPC/LACP).
  • Configure and administer WAN connectivity with ELINE/MPLS utilizing IPSEC mesh and dynamic routing.
  • Configure and administer Cisco Voice (CUCM/CUC/CUCX) add, moves, changes, upgrades, integrations.
  • Configure, administer, and monitor Corporate Firewalls (ASA, Palo Alto).
  • Configure and support routers, switches, firewalls, wireless controllers, VPN solutions, and load balancers.
  • Monitor network performance and capacity to ensure optimal operation and availability.
  • Support network expansion projects and infrastructure modernization initiatives.
  • Maintain inventory of network infrastructure equipment.
  • Maintain network diagrams, standards, procedures, and technical documentation.

Network Security

  • Assist in Implementing and maintaining secure network architectures and connectivity solutions.
  • Configure and manage network security controls, including firewalls, VLANs, NAC, IDS/IPS, and remote access technologies.
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to remediate vulnerabilities and support security initiatives.
  • Assist with incident response investigations and security event analysis.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable corporate security policies and industry regulations.

Operations and Support

  • Assist with the installation, configuration and maintenance of the organization’s LAN - Network Security Hardware/Software.
  • Configure and administer Enterprise Wireless (SSIDs, VLAN tagging, Security policies).
  • Apply fixes / patches to Network Hardware / Software on an as needed basis.
  • Support the management of all Enterprise Communications - VPN, MPLS Data Circuits and all voice & data Communications.
  • Support and administer the corporate telephony infrastructure including but not limited to the Cisco Phone Switch and telephony devices.
  • Support and administer VPN, Wireless, and Virtualization.
  • Provide technical support for network-related incidents and service requests.
  • Troubleshoot complex network performance, connectivity, and hardware issues.
  • Perform root cause analysis and implement preventive measures.
  • Participate in on-call support and escalation activities as required.
  • Manage network equipment lifecycle activities including upgrades, patching, and hardware replacements.

Cloud and Data Center Connectivity

  • Support network connectivity for cloud platforms including, but not limited to Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365 and Amazon Web Services.
  • Maintain site-to-site VPNs, SD-WAN, and hybrid cloud networking environments.
  • Support data center networking technologies and disaster recovery connectivity requirements.

Project Management and Continuous Improvement

  • Participate in infrastructure projects from planning through implementation.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements to enhance performance, reliability, and security.
  • Collaborate with vendors, consultants, and service providers to support project delivery.
  • Develop automation and standardization initiatives to improve operational efficiency.

Compliance and Documentation

  • Adhere to all IT policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
  • Support audit activities including JSOX, GxP, NIST, and cybersecurity assessments as applicable.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of network configurations, procedures, and recovery processes.
  • Collaborate with other I.T. Staff members with regard to security related projects.
  • Perform any other tasks/duties as assigned by management.

Education Requirements And Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required.

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field or 5 years of equivalent work experience.
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience in networking engineering, network administration, or a related IT infrastructure role required.
  • Demonstrates mastery level of Cisco and Palo Alto networking equipment. Cisco Certifications Required (Examples CCIE, CCNP, CCSP, CCVP). Other Certifications (such as CISSP and PCNSA) are recommended.
  • Hands-on experience configuring and troubleshooting LAN/WAN, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, VLANs, routing, and switching.
  • Experience with network equipment such as Cisco, Aruba, Fortinet, or equivalent.
  • Experience monitoring network performance, diagnosing connectivity issues, and resolving network outages.
  • Familiarity with firewalls, wireless networks, network security, and network monitoring tools.
  • Experience documenting network configurations, procedures, and troubleshooting activities.
  • Strong understanding of network security principles and IT infrastructure best practices.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills required to effectively interact with internal and external customers.
  • Excellent communication and technical skills are necessary to implement, manage and support all current and future network infrastructures.
  • While the position is for the Shirley, NY facility, some travel to other sites (New Albany, OH and Brea, CA) is required.

Expected Salary Range:

$105,000 - $120,000

The salary range, displayed is the minimum and maximum annual salary range of compensation for the role that the employer in good faith believes to be accurate at the time of the posting of an advertisement for the role. Actual compensation for the role will be based on a number of different factors including but not limited to the candidate’s qualifications, education, knowledge, skills and experience.

American Regent also offers a competitive total rewards package which includes healthcare, life insurance, profit sharing, paid time off, matching 401k as well as a wide range of other benefits.

American Regent celebrates diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, or protected veteran status.

Applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws.

  • FMLA poster: https://www.dol.gov/whd/regs/compliance/posters/fmlaen.pdf
  • Know Your Rights: Know Your Rights: Workplace discrimination is illegal (eeoc.gov)
  • Employee Polygraph Protection Act: https://www.dol.gov/whd/regs/compliance/posters/eppac.pdf

Alert: We’re aware of individuals impersonating our staff to target job seekers. Please note:

  • All legitimate communication will come directly from a verified ARI recruiter either by phone or via an americanregent.com email address.
  • Our recruiting process includes multiple in person and/or video interviews and assessments.
  • If you are unsure about the legitimacy of a message, contact John Rossini at jrossini@americanregent.com before responding.
  • We never request payment, bank information, or personal financial details during our offer process.

Your security is important to us, and we encourage you to stay vigilant when job searching.

American Regent Inc. endeavors to make https://careers.americanregent.com/ accessible to any and all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please email hrtalentacquisition@americanregent.com.

companyDescription: Since its founding in 1993, NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) has been a pioneer in accelerated computing. The company’s invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined computer graphics, ignited the era of modern AI and is fueling the creation of the metaverse. NVIDIA is now a full-stack computing company with data-center-scale offerings that are reshaping industry.
descriptionHtml:
NVIDIA is looking for a Senior Network Engineer to develop a cloud network infrastructure. The goal is to craft a reliable, scalable and efficient network to support NVIDIA software development workflows and tools, including CI/CD pipelines, compute resource management flow and developer productivity tools. The network is serving the needs across the whole software stack for NVIDIA from Graphics Drivers to Autonomous Vehicles to Deep Learning frameworks. To achieve this goal, we are looking for an engineer who has a deep understanding of L3 underlay networks, outstanding design skills and a track record in building and delivering large-scale networks.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Lead the overall architecture and design of our cloud network infrastructure including intra-DC, inter-DC, Corp IT, and Internet connectivity
  • Implement, manage and troubleshoot entire network stacks.
  • Automate network infrastructure end-to-end including provisioning, management and monitoring.

What We Need To See

  • Expert knowledge in large scale IP Networking Technologies and protocols such as: MP-BGP, OSPF, ISIS, VRF, VxLAN, EVPN, QoS, GRE, IPSEC, DNS, MACsec.
  • Hands-on experience around Peering and Datacenter interconnect technologies: PNI, Transit, Exchange, Passive DWDM, Wave circuits.
  • Ability to write and understand Python/Shell scripts and programs for automation, tools, frameworks, dashboards, alarms.
  • Understanding of network virtualization such as: VRFs, VXLAN. Familiarity with Arista, Cumulus OS, Fortinet OS etc. Expert in the field of network, especially in underlay network.
  • Strong track record of implementing network services in a variety of distributed computing environments.
  • You have architected, built, and deployed a network for a large scale (1000s of machines) in the past, used by 1000s of people. Familiar with designing and building POPs and large scale WANs.
  • Hands-on experience with high performance network and network optimization in highly-available, large-scale, multisite, international environments. Great communication and presentation skills.
  • 8+ years of experience in network, especially experience in Arista switches.
  • BS Degree or the equivalent experience.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

  • Hands-on background with building tooling and automation for provisioning, monitoring, and managing the network infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience in designing and implementing networks at scale, such as automated deployments (e.g., ZTP)
  • Passionate about innovating and investing in ground breaking technologies.

NVIDIA is leading the way in groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing and Visualization. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens up new universes to explore, enables amazing creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars. NVIDIA is looking for great people like you to help us accelerate the next wave of artificial intelligence.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are:

168,000 USD – 264,500 USD for Level 4; and 208,000 USD – 333,500 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 20, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

descriptionHtml:
About Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analysis that provide clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns.

Position Overview

The Information Technology (ITS) team at CRA is currently a Global team of 40 professionals dedicated to enhancing, maintaining, and developing the firm's technology infrastructure and security. The team is comprised of four functions: Service Delivery & Telecom, Enterprise Application Solutions, Infrastructure, Networking and Cloud Services and Security. Information Technology staff are based in the Boston, Chicago, London, Munich, New York, Oakland, and Washington, DC offices.

Responsibilities

We are seeking an experienced Network Engineer to join our small global networking team. The successful candidate will bring in-depth, hands-on expertise in planning, designing, implementing, documenting, securing, and troubleshooting enterprise network systems across campus, data center, wireless, WAN, and cloud environments. This position supports day-to-day operations and maintenance, advances security initiatives, and collaborates with IT colleagues and business stakeholders on a global scale. Typical responsibilities include:

  • Design, install, configure, test, document, and maintain secure network infrastructure across on-premises and cloud environments;
  • Identify, diagnose, and resolve complex network, wireless, firewall, DNS, and connectivity issues;
  • Produce and maintain Microsoft Visio network diagrams, implementation plans, configuration standards, and as-built documentation;
  • Administer and use Nexus Dashboard, Catalyst Center, Infoblox, and other management platforms for visibility, configuration, assurance, and lifecycle activities;
  • Maintain accurate configuration records, inventories, circuit information, support documentation, and vendor contacts;
  • Plan and execute upgrades while minimizing service disruption and maintaining tested rollback procedures;
  • Develop, implement, and maintain policies, procedures, and training plans for network resource administration, appropriate use, and disaster recovery;
  • Ensure network hardware, software, firmware, and configurations are current, supportable, and secure;
  • Monitor and test network performance and provide meaningful performance statistics, reports, and recommendations;
  • Coordinate with internal teams and external vendors to deliver projects and resolve incidents;
  • Coordinate across other teams within the IT department and across the firm; some travel to other CRA offices will be expected;
  • Some out-of-hours and weekend work will be required for scheduled upgrades and in response to unexpected outages.

Desired Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree (Master's desirable) in Computer Science, Information Systems or related discipline;
  • 4-6 years relevant work experience, preferably in a professional services environment;
  • Current Cisco certification at the CCNA level or a demonstrated track record of maintaining Cisco certifications at or above the CCNA level is required; CCNP preferred, relevant Microsoft Azure and AWS certifications highly desired;
  • Demonstrated knowledge of secure LAN/WAN, campus, data center, wireless, and cloud networking operations;
  • Hands-on experience designing, implementing, and supporting networking in both Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS);
  • Hands-on experience with Cisco Nexus data center switching, Cisco Catalyst switching, Cisco Catalyst wireless, and Cisco Firepower firewalls;
  • Experience with network management and automation platforms, including Cisco Nexus Dashboard, Cisco Catalyst Center, and Infoblox;
  • Demonstrated skill designing and documenting logical and physical networks using Microsoft Visio;
  • Strong practical knowledge of Cisco enterprise networking platforms across LAN/WAN, data center, wireless, firewall, and most importantly, cloud-connected environments;
  • Proficiency with network protocols and technologies, including Spanning Tree, DNS, DHCP, BGP, OSPF, HSRP, LACP, SNMP, NTP, IPsec VPN, and QoS;
  • Experience creating, reviewing, implementing, and troubleshooting firewall policies, preferably using Cisco Firepower;
  • Ability to create and maintain accurate network topology, rack, connectivity, and as-built documentation using Microsoft Visio;
  • Ability to propose and clearly communicate changes to existing network topology that improve availability, security, performance, and operational supportability;
  • Familiarity with ITIL change management practices, implementation planning, rollback planning, and pre-change risk assessment;
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across Layers 1 through 7, including packet capture and network performance analysis;
  • Must be comfortable in customer-facing scenarios and effectively collaborating in cross-functional technical teams;
  • Self-motivated, with a strong ability to prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment;
  • Ability to travel to other offices and execute project plans with minimal oversight.

Additional Preferred Skills

  • Demonstrated strong knowledge with Microsoft Azure networking, including virtual networks, routing, network security controls, and hybrid connectivity;
  • Demonstrated strong knowledge with Amazon Web Services networking, including VPCs, routing, security controls, and hybrid connectivity;
  • Cisco Nexus data center switches and Nexus Dashboard;
  • Cisco Catalyst switches, Catalyst wireless infrastructure, and Catalyst Center;
  • Cisco Firepower firewalls; Palo Alto firewall experience is also valued;
  • Infoblox DNS, DHCP, and IP address management (IPAM);
  • Cisco ISE and 802.1X network access control;
  • Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN;
  • Kemp LoadMaster load balancers;
  • Cisco Umbrella;
  • PKI, certificate lifecycle management, domain registration, DNS, and 802.1X fundamentals.

To Apply

To Be Considered For This Position, We Require

  • Resume – please include current address, personal email and telephone number;
  • Work Product (optional, submitted in cover letter field) – submit a sample set of diagrams generated with Visio.

Career Growth And Benefits

  • CRA’s robust skills development programs, encompassing both formal and informal programs, encourage you to thrive as an individual and team member. Training includes technical training, presentation skills, internal seminars, and career mentoring and performance coaching from an assigned senior colleague. Additional leadership and collaboration opportunities exist through internal firm development activities.
  • We offer a comprehensive total rewards program including a superior benefits package, wellness programming to support physical, mental, emotional and financial well-being, and in-house immigration support for foreign nationals and international business travelers.

Work Location Flexibility

CRA creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognize that individuals realize a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently expect that individuals spend at least 3 to 4 days a week working in the office (which may include traveling to another CRA office or to client meetings), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.

Responsible AI Use in Recruiting

We believe that recruiting is fundamentally a human process, and we are committed to a hiring process that is fair, transparent, and people-focused. While AI and other technology-enabled tools help our team operate more efficiently, we strive to provide every candidate with a personalized, thoughtful, and high-touch experience. As CRA invests significant human effort to find qualified members for our teams, we expect candidates to invest corresponding human effort to learn about CRA, prepare thoughtful application materials, and engage with our interviewers. Read more about appropriate hiring manager, recruiting team, and candidate AI at CRA on our website.

Our Commitment to Equal Employment Opportunity

Charles River Associates is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

Salary And Other Compensation

A good-faith estimate of the annual base salary range for this position is $130,000-$152,500. Starting pay within this range may vary based on factors such as education level, experience, skills, geographic location, market conditions, and other qualifications of the successful candidate. This position is eligible for additional bonus incentive compensation. CRA offers a comprehensive benefits package, subject to eligibility requirements, which includes: medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) retirement plan with employer match; life and disability insurance; paid time off (vacation, sick leave, holidays); paid parental leave; wellness programs and employee assistance resources; and commuter benefits.

SMS is hiring a WAN Engineer to support our AFCENT contract located at Shaw AFB, SC.

AFCENT’s mission is to deliver combat-ready air, space, communications, and cyberspace capability for USCENTCOM, helping maintain security and stability throughout Southwest Asia. We support the AFCENT Commander, USCENTCOM, coalition and joint partners, and warfighters who rely on NIPRNet, SIPRNet, partner networks, and other command-and-control systems. The AFCENT NOSC program is focused on running and protecting a 24/7 enterprise network and systems operations, including cybersecurity, engineering, maintenance, and technical support, keeping the AFCENT’s theater communications and IT infrastructure ready, secure, and available to effectively execute the AFCENT mission.

Since 1976, SMS has specialized in modernizing legacy IT and sustaining complex enterprise environments for federal agencies. With the goal of building long-term partnerships with our customers, we invest in our employees by providing the training, tools, and support they need to keep critical missions operational, improve performance, and reduce risk. SMS is headquartered in McLean, Virginia, with offices and on-site operations at customer locations throughout the United States. For additional information on SMS, visit www.sms.com.

Submit your resume today!

Job Responsibilities

  • Design and engineer enterprise WAN architecture.
  • Configure, monitor and trouble-shoot National IP/MPLS backbone network.
  • Configure and implement internal, external, and service provider routing protocols including but not limited to Border Gateway Protocol (BGP), Open Shortest Path First (OSPF), and Multi-Protocol Label Switching (MPLS).
  • Analyze a myriad of networking metrics and recognize sub-par network performance.
  • Configure and troubleshoot Quality of Service (QOS) involving policing, shaping, and queuing from partner owned routers.
  • Develop reports and trend analysis documentation on bandwidth and network security incidents.
  • Perform analysis for collaboration of network/system needs and participate in planning, designing, upgrading and deployment of enterprise datacenter hardware and software using a project-based timeline.
  • Provide General IT Management support.
  • Provide General Networking support.
  • Provide LAN support.
  • Provide WAN Enterprise support.
  • Provide technical and general O&M support as required.
  • Provide documentation/reports support as required.
  • Provide meetings/briefings support as required.
  • Provide functional training support as required.
  • Provide OCONUS deployment/TDY travel support as required.
  • Provide CONUS TDY support as required.

Required Qualifications

  • Associates in related field and 3 or more years’ relevant IT experience; or, 5 or more years’ relevant IT experience.
  • Knowledge of what constitutes a “threat” to a network.
  • Skill in providing feedback to enhance future collection and analysis.
  • Must possess experience and demonstrate an understanding of Microsoft server installation, roles, active directory, storage, performance management, and maintenance.
  • Must possess experience and demonstrate working knowledge in designing, engineering, implementing and troubleshooting enterprise WAN architectures utilizing External Gateway Protocols (EGPs) such as Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) and Open Shortest Path First (OSPF), and Interior Gateway Protocols (IGPs) such as Cisco’s Enhanced Interior Gateway Routing Protocol (EIGRP).

Certifications Required

  • Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP)
  • ITIL Foundation - Candidate has up to 60 days to acquire ITIL Foundation certification

Clearance Required

  • Department of Defense Secret security clearance or the ability to obtain an Interim Secret clearance.
