Job Description

Network Engineer

Atlanta, GA/Austin, TX/Alexandria, VA (Onsite 4 days per week)

About Acrisure

A global fintech leader, Acrisure empowers millions of ambitious businesses and individuals with the solutions to grow boldly forward. Bringing cutting-edge technology and top-tier human support together, it connects clients with personalized solutions across a range of insurance, reinsurance, payroll, benefits, cybersecurity, real estate services – and beyond. Since 2013, Acrisure has grown in revenue from $38 million to ~$5 billion and employs ~20,000 colleagues in 19 countries. And this is just the beginning. To learn more, visit Acrisure.com.

Job Summary:

Acrisure is seeking a Network Engineer on our growing team.

Overview

A Network Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, securing, and supporting enterprise network infrastructure services across cloud and on-premises environments. This role supports routing, switching, wireless networking, firewall administration, network security, DNS, DHCP, IP address management, cloud connectivity, remote access, monitoring, and operational readiness.

The Network Engineer partners with infrastructure, security, observability, telephony, service desk, architecture, business systems, and business teams to deliver secure, reliable, scalable, and well-governed network services that align with enterprise standards and business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, and support enterprise network infrastructure, including LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, wireless, cloud networking, and remote connectivity services.
  • Administer and support Palo Alto firewalls, Panorama, Meraki, Zscaler, Infoblox, VPN solutions, DNS, DHCP, NAC, IPAM, and network segmentation services.
  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot routing and switching platforms to ensure secure, reliable, and high-performance network connectivity.
  • Implement and maintain network security controls, including firewall policies, zero-trust access models, network segmentation, traffic filtering, and secure remote access capabilities.
  • Support cloud networking initiatives, including Azure Virtual Networks, ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway, DNS integration, and hybrid connectivity solutions.
  • Partner with security teams to implement enterprise network security standards, compliance requirements, access controls, and vulnerability remediation efforts.
  • Collaborate with observability and operations teams to configure actionable monitoring, alerting, dashboards, telemetry collection, escalation procedures, and operational reporting.
  • Support network lifecycle management activities, including hardware refreshes, software upgrades, firmware updates, capacity planning, backup validation, and disaster recovery readiness.
  • Participate in troubleshooting and tier-four escalation support for network outages, connectivity issues, DNS failures, application performance degradation, routing issues, and firewall-related incidents.
  • Perform packet capture analysis, traffic analysis, root cause investigations, and performance optimization using approved network diagnostic tools.
  • Support acquisition and integration projects by assessing network requirements, connectivity dependencies, security considerations, and migration planning activities.
  • Create and maintain operational documentation, SOPs, deployment guides, network diagrams, runbooks, standards, and knowledge transfer materials for enterprise network services.
  • Participate in change management, incident management, problem management, and operational review processes while ensuring adherence to governance and compliance standards.
  • Collaborate with infrastructure, telephony, EUC, security, and business technology teams to support enterprise initiatives and operational excellence.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Three or more years of experience designing, implementing, or supporting enterprise network infrastructure services.
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise routing and switching technologies in complex multi-site environments.
  • Experience administering Palo Alto firewalls and Panorama management platforms.
  • Experience supporting Meraki networking solutions, including switching, wireless, SD-WAN, and cloud-managed infrastructure.
  • Experience with Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), or similar secure access service edge technologies.
  • Strong understanding of DNS, DHCP, IPAM, network segmentation, routing protocols, wireless networking, VPN connectivity, and network security principles.
  • Experience supporting Azure networking services, including virtual networks, peering, VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute, network security groups, and hybrid connectivity architectures.
  • Knowledge of network security controls, encryption technologies, access control models, and secure infrastructure design principles.
  • Experience using network monitoring and troubleshooting tools such as Wireshark and enterprise observability platforms.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex network issues across cloud, infrastructure, security, application, and endpoint environments.
  • Strong documentation, communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills with the ability to work across technical and business teams.
  • Experience working within ITSM, change management, incident response, and operational governance processes.

Preferred Certifications

  • Cisco CCNA or CCNP
  • Palo Alto PCNSA or PCNSE
  • Microsoft Azure Network Engineer Associate (AZ-700)
  • Meraki Solutions certifications
  • Zscaler certifications
  • CompTIA Network+
  • CISSP, Security+, or other relevant security certifications

Preferred Attributes

  • Proactive, ownership-oriented, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced enterprise technology environment.
  • Strong commitment to secure, reliable, scalable, and well-documented network services.
  • Continuous improvement mindset with a focus on automation, standardization, operational maturity, and service excellence.
  • Ability to balance project delivery, operational support, stakeholder communication, and production reliability priorities.
  • Comfortable collaborating across network, infrastructure, observability, operations, telephony, security, and architecture functions.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify root causes, eliminate recurring issues, and improve operational resilience.

Career Opportunities

Network Engineers play a critical role in enabling secure and reliable enterprise connectivity across cloud and on-premises environments. This role offers growth opportunities into Senior Network Engineer, Network Architect, Security Engineer, Cloud Network Engineer, Infrastructure Architect, Platform Engineering, Network Operations Leadership, and Enterprise Engineering Leadership positions.

Note: This is a full-time role and we do not offer C2C or C2H employment and are not able to sponsor visas for this position.

Welcome, your new opportunity awaits you.

Candidates should be comfortable with an on-site presence to support collaboration, team leadership, and cross-functional partnership.

Why Join Us:

At Acrisure, we’re building more than a business, we’re building a community where people can grow, thrive, and make an impact. Our benefits are designed to support every dimension of your life, from your health and finances to your family and future.

Making a lasting impact on the communities it serves, Acrisure has pledged more than $22 million through its partnerships with Corewell Health Helen DeVos Children's Hospital in Grand Rapids, Michigan, UPMC Children's Hospital in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania and Blythedale Children's Hospital in Valhalla, New York.

Employee Benefits:

We also offer our employees a comprehensive suite of benefits and perks, including:

  • Physical Wellness: Comprehensive medical insurance, dental insurance, and vision insurance; life and disability insurance; fertility benefits; wellness resources; and paid sick time.
  • Mental Wellness: Generous paid time off and holidays; Employee Assistance Program (EAP); and a complimentary Calm app subscription.
  • Financial Wellness: Immediate vesting in a 401(k) plan; Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options; commuter benefits; and employee discount programs.

Network Engineer

Atlanta, GA/Austin, TX/Alexandria, VA (Onsite 4 days per week) 

About Acrisure

A global fintech leader, Acrisure empowers millions of ambitious businesses and individuals with the solutions to grow boldly forward. Bringing cutting-edge technology and top-tier human support together, it connects clients with personalized solutions across a range of insurance, reinsurance, payroll, benefits, cybersecurity, real estate services – and beyond. Since 2013, Acrisure has grown in revenue from $38 million to ~$5 billion and employs ~20,000 colleagues in 19 countries. And this is just the beginning. To learn more, visit Acrisure.com.

Job Summary: 

Acrisure is seeking a Network Engineer on our growing team.

Overview

A Network Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, securing, and supporting enterprise network infrastructure services across cloud and on-premises environments. This role supports routing, switching, wireless networking, firewall administration, network security, DNS, DHCP, IP address management, cloud connectivity, remote access, monitoring, and operational readiness.

The Network Engineer partners with infrastructure, security, observability, telephony, service desk, architecture, business systems, and business teams to deliver secure, reliable, scalable, and well-governed network services that align with enterprise standards and business objectives.

Key Responsibilities



-  Design, deploy, and support enterprise network infrastructure, including LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, wireless, cloud networking, and remote connectivity services.
-  Administer and support Palo Alto firewalls, Panorama, Meraki, Zscaler, Infoblox, VPN solutions, DNS, DHCP, NAC, IPAM, and network segmentation services.
-  Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot routing and switching platforms to ensure secure, reliable, and high-performance network connectivity.
-  Implement and maintain network security controls, including firewall policies, zero-trust access models, network segmentation, traffic filtering, and secure remote access capabilities.
-  Support cloud networking initiatives, including Azure Virtual Networks, ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway, DNS integration, and hybrid connectivity solutions.
-  Partner with security teams to implement enterprise network security standards, compliance requirements, access controls, and vulnerability remediation efforts.
-  Collaborate with observability and operations teams to configure actionable monitoring, alerting, dashboards, telemetry collection, escalation procedures, and operational reporting.
-  Support network lifecycle management activities, including hardware refreshes, software upgrades, firmware updates, capacity planning, backup validation, and disaster recovery readiness.
-  Participate in troubleshooting and tier-four escalation support for network outages, connectivity issues, DNS failures, application performance degradation, routing issues, and firewall-related incidents.
-  Perform packet capture analysis, traffic analysis, root cause investigations, and performance optimization using approved network diagnostic tools.
-  Support acquisition and integration projects by assessing network requirements, connectivity dependencies, security considerations, and migration planning activities.
-  Create and maintain operational documentation, SOPs, deployment guides, network diagrams, runbooks, standards, and knowledge transfer materials for enterprise network services.
-  Participate in change management, incident management, problem management, and operational review processes while ensuring adherence to governance and compliance standards.
-  Collaborate with infrastructure, telephony, EUC, security, and business technology teams to support enterprise initiatives and operational excellence.

Required Skills & Qualifications



-  Three or more years of experience designing, implementing, or supporting enterprise network infrastructure services.
-  Hands-on experience with enterprise routing and switching technologies in complex multi-site environments.
-  Experience administering Palo Alto firewalls and Panorama management platforms.
-  Experience supporting Meraki networking solutions, including switching, wireless, SD-WAN, and cloud-managed infrastructure.
-  Experience with Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), or similar secure access service edge technologies.
-  Strong understanding of DNS, DHCP, IPAM, network segmentation, routing protocols, wireless networking, VPN connectivity, and network security principles.
-  Experience supporting Azure networking services, including virtual networks, peering, VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute, network security groups, and hybrid connectivity architectures.
-  Knowledge of network security controls, encryption technologies, access control models, and secure infrastructure design principles.
-  Experience using network monitoring and troubleshooting tools such as Wireshark and enterprise observability platforms.
-  Ability to troubleshoot complex network issues across cloud, infrastructure, security, application, and endpoint environments.
-  Strong documentation, communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills with the ability to work across technical and business teams.
-  Experience working within ITSM, change management, incident response, and operational governance processes.

Preferred Certifications



-  Cisco CCNA or CCNP
-  Palo Alto PCNSA or PCNSE
-  Microsoft Azure Network Engineer Associate (AZ-700)
-  Meraki Solutions certifications
-  Zscaler certifications
-  CompTIA Network+
-  CISSP, Security+, or other relevant security certifications

Preferred Attributes



-  Proactive, ownership-oriented, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced enterprise technology environment.
-  Strong commitment to secure, reliable, scalable, and well-documented network services.
-  Continuous improvement mindset with a focus on automation, standardization, operational maturity, and service excellence.
-  Ability to balance project delivery, operational support, stakeholder communication, and production reliability priorities.
-  Comfortable collaborating across network, infrastructure, observability, operations, telephony, security, and architecture functions.
-  Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify root causes, eliminate recurring issues, and improve operational resilience.

Career Opportunities

Network Engineers play a critical role in enabling secure and reliable enterprise connectivity across cloud and on-premises environments. This role offers growth opportunities into Senior Network Engineer, Network Architect, Security Engineer, Cloud Network Engineer, Infrastructure Architect, Platform Engineering, Network Operations Leadership, and Enterprise Engineering Leadership positions.

Note: This is a full-time role and we do not offer C2C or C2H employment and are not able to sponsor visas for this position.

descriptionHtml:
Who We Are:

At Bandwidth, we shape how the world connects. We're the global communications software company and Tier 1 network operator with global reach.  The voice, messaging, and emergency services infrastructure behind the brands and apps you use every day.

Because we own the network we build on, the problems you'll solve here are bigger, more complex, and more impactful. And as communications shifts to AI, we're the infrastructure layer making it possible.

We call ourselves BANDmates because building something this big takes collaboration, different perspectives, and the freedom to bring your authentic self to the table.

We're experts who speak like humans. Ready to build what's next? #JoinTheBand

What We Are Looking For:

The Sr. IP Network Engineer designs, operates, and continuously improves Bandwidth's global IP network infrastructure. This role owns critical functions across datacenter fabric, WAN routing, and firewall security — and drives the automation initiatives that keep the network reliable at scale. The ideal candidate brings deep hands-on expertise in VxLAN/EVPN datacenter architectures and Palo Alto firewall platforms, combined with a strong foundation in service provider routing protocols.

What You'll Do:

  • Design and operate VxLAN/EVPN-based datacenter fabrics across multiple Points of Presence (PoPs), including leaf-spine topology, BGP EVPN control plane, and overlay/underlay integration.
  • Manage and maintain Palo Alto firewall infrastructure, including zone-based policy design, Panorama administration, threat prevention, and security rule lifecycle management.
  • Architect and maintain BGP-based WAN routing across Bandwidth's backbone network, including iBGP/eBGP policy, route manipulation, and prefix management.
  • Troubleshoot complex, multi-layer network issues spanning switching, routing, and security infrastructure.
  • Develop and maintain network automation tooling — including device provisioning, configuration management, and event-driven remediation — using Python, Ansible, or similar frameworks.
  • Evaluate emerging network technologies and lead proof-of-concept efforts to drive platform improvements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional Engineering and Operations teams to deliver network changes and infrastructure projects.
  • Mentor junior network engineers and provide technical leadership on complex projects.
  • Participate in on-call rotation and perform scheduled after-hours maintenance as required.
  • Contribute to network documentation, runbooks, and post-incident reviews (RFOs).
  • Support vendor relationships and assist with hardware procurement evaluation.

What You Need:

  • Education:   
    • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Network Engineering, or a related technical field; or equivalent work experience.
  • Experience:  
    • 10+ years of hands-on experience in service provider network infrastructure roles.
    • Demonstrated production experience with VxLAN/EVPN datacenter fabrics (leaf-spine architecture, BGP EVPN control plane).
    • Demonstrated production experience with Palo Alto Networks firewalls, including Panorama and zone-based security policy.
  • Knowledge:  
    • Expert-level understanding of BGP (iBGP/eBGP), OSPF, and MPLS in production environments.
    • Strong understanding of datacenter networking concepts: VxLAN, EVPN, VPCs, and Spanning Tree.
    • Familiarity with Linux operating systems and command-line tooling.
  • Skills: 
    • Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language (Python preferred) for network automation tasks.
    • Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to produce clear technical documentation.
    • Ability to work independently and lead project work with minimal supervision.
    • SI Proficiency: SI is a reliable part of your daily routine. You write clear, structured prompts, adjust your approach when the output doesn’t land, and always verify results before you act on them. You’re also mindful of using SI efficiently, including how many tokens you spend.

Bonus Points:

  • Education:
    • Industry certifications: CCIE (R&S or Data Center), JNCIE, PCNSE, or equivalent.
  • Experience: 
    • Experience with Cisco ASR/NCS (IOS-XR) and/or Juniper MX/SRX platforms.
    • Experience with ACI, NSX, or other SDN/overlay controller platforms.
    • Exposure to AI-assisted network operations tooling or observability platforms
  • Knowledge: 
    • Expert level datacenter fabric experience
  • Skills: 
    • Experience with infrastructure-as-code practices (Ansible, Terraform, or similar).
    • Familiarity with network source-of-truth platforms such as NetBox.

The Whole Person Promise:

At Bandwidth, we’re pretty proud of our corporate culture, which is rooted in our “Whole Person Promise.” We promise all employees that they can have meaningful work AND a full life, and we provide a work environment geared toward enriching your body, mind, and spirit. How do we do that? Well…

  • 100% company-paid Medical, Vision, & Dental coverage for you and your family with low deductibles and low out-of-pocket expenses.
  • All new hires receive four weeks of PTO.
  • PTO Embargo. When you take time off (of any kind!) you’re embargoed from working. Bandmates and managers are not allowed to interrupt your PTO – not even with email.
  • Additional PTO can be earned throughout the year through volunteer hours and Bandwidth challenges.
  • “Mahalo moments” program grants additional time off for life’s most important moments like graduations, buying a first home, getting married, wedding anniversaries (every five years), and the birth of a grandchild.
  • 90-Minute Workout Lunches and unlimited meetings with our very own nutritionist.

 

Are you excited about the position and its responsibilities, but not sure if you’re 100% qualified? Do you feel you can work to help us crush the mission? If you answered ‘yes’ to both of these questions, we encourage you to apply! You won’t want to miss the opportunity to be a part of the BAND.

Love Your Mondays again!

Join the Future of Connectivity with Metronet!

Are you ready to launch your career with one of the nation’s fastest-growing fiber-optic powerhouses? Welcome to Metronet, where we don’t just build networks; we build communities.

Enterprise Network Engineer

As an Enterprise Network Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, implementing, securing, optimizing, and supporting Metronet's enterprise network infrastructure and network security systems. You will help ensure the reliability, scalability, performance, and security of our wired, wireless, WAN, data center, cloud-connected, and remote-site environments while supporting critical business operations across the organization.

This role is ideal for an experienced network professional who has successfully designed, deployed, and supported enterprise-scale network and security solutions within medium to large business environments. You will lead network and security initiatives, manage infrastructure upgrades, troubleshoot complex technical challenges, and contribute to the continued modernization of our enterprise technology environment.

We're looking for a self-directed engineer who can take ownership of projects from planning through implementation, work independently with minimal supervision, and bring practical, real-world experience with enterprise networking technologies. The ideal candidate will have experience supporting large-scale firewall deployments, data center networking, routing and switching infrastructures, and multi-site enterprise environments. Success in this role comes from combining strong technical expertise with sound decision-making, problem-solving skills, and the ability to drive results in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  • Lead the design, deployment, maintenance, and ongoing optimization of enterprise network infrastructure and network security platforms, including routers, switches, firewalls, wireless access points, WAN circuits, VPNs, and related technologies.
  • Independently manage assigned network engineering projects from planning and design through implementation, documentation, testing, and operational support.
  • Design and maintain enterprise LAN, WAN, wireless, data center, and cloud-connected network architectures to support business requirements, remote site connectivity, resiliency, performance, security, and future growth.
  • Develop, maintain, and evolve network and network security standards, reference architectures, implementation practices, and engineering best practices that support scalability, security, and operational excellence across the enterprise.
  • Design, implement, review, and maintain network security controls including firewall policies, ACLs, segmentation, VPN access, NAT, secure management access, zero trust-aligned controls, and access control frameworks.
  • Serve as an escalation resource for complex network and network security incidents, including routing, switching, wireless, firewall, VPN, DNS, DHCP, WAN, cloud connectivity, performance, availability, and policy-related issues.
  • Perform firewall rule reviews, network access reviews, security policy cleanup, and assist with vulnerability remediation efforts related to network infrastructure.
  • Develop and maintain network and security documentation including diagrams, standards, configurations, procedures, support records, implementation plans, firewall rule documentation, and maintenance window documentation.
  • Respond to, document, update, and resolve assigned network and security operations tickets in accordance with established service levels, escalation procedures, and change management practices.
  • Drive network growth initiatives, capacity planning, infrastructure refresh projects, technology standardization efforts, and network security platform modernization across the enterprise.
  • Lead and collaborate with vendors, service providers, contractors, security teams, and internal stakeholders to successfully deliver network projects, site deployments, migrations, cutovers, and infrastructure upgrades.
  • Occasional travel to Evansville, IN for team meetings and collaboration events (approximately twice per year).
  • All other duties as assigned


JOB QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor’s degree or better in related field or 4+ years of related network engineering and network security experience minimum.
  • Strong experience with NGFW firewalls such as Cisco Firepower, Palo Alto, or FortiGate, including firewall policy management, NAT, VPN, logging, troubleshooting, rule review, and problem resolution.
  • Experience with enterprise networking technologies and management platforms such as Arista, Juniper, Cisco Nexus, Cisco ISE, Cisco ACI, NDFC, or similar enterprise networking and infrastructure management solutions preferred.
  • Experience designing, deploying, and supporting enterprise-scale network infrastructure within medium-to-large multi-site business environments.
  • Strong understanding of networking architectures, standards, and protocols, including routing, switching, VLANs, spanning tree, wireless, WAN, VPN, DNS, DHCP, NAT, QoS, and high availability concepts.
  • Experience with network security concepts including segmentation, ACLs, least privilege access, secure remote access, zero trust principles, logging, monitoring, and incident response support.
  • Experience with Cisco Catalyst 9000 switching platforms and enterprise wireless solutions such as Cisco Catalyst Wireless or Meraki preferred.
  • Experience with dynamic routing protocols such as BGP, OSPF, or EIGRP, including route filtering, redistribution, and troubleshooting preferred.
  • Experience with SD-WAN technologies, VPN technologies, WAN provider coordination, and remote-site connectivity preferred.
  • Experience configuring, deploying, and maintaining Cisco network devices in enterprise LAN, WAN, wireless, security, and data center environments.
  • Understanding of cloud networking and hybrid network connectivity concepts, including public cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure and related security controls.
  • Experience with network monitoring, firewall logging, NetFlow, SNMP, Syslog, packet analysis, and performance troubleshooting tools preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex network engineering projects, troubleshoot advanced technical issues, and drive solutions with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to communicate technical and security matters clearly to peers, leadership, vendors, contractors, and non-technical counterparts.
  • Good oral and written communication skills with the ability to document technical designs, changes, security decisions, and operational procedures.
  • Detail-oriented organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, projects, operational issues, and security-related requests.
  • Dependability, adaptability, flexibility, creativity, professional attitude, and the ability to understand complex issues, drive troubleshooting efforts, escalate appropriately when needed.
  • Willingness to work as a team and independently.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the U.S.


ADDITIONAL JOB REQUIREMENTS:

  • Participate in an on-call rotation to support network and security incidents outside normal business hours.
  • Industry-recognized certifications such as CCNP Enterprise, CCNA, Cisco Security, Palo Alto, Fortinet, AWS Networking, CompTIA Network+, Security+, or equivalent preferred.
  • Experience designing, implementing, securing, and supporting enterprise network infrastructure in a multi-site environment.


Join us and find out what it means to love your career!

At Metronet, we are committed to delivering cutting-edge technology combined with exceptional customer care. Our 100% fiber-optic technology ensures that we provide our customers with some of the fastest internet speeds in the world. As industry leaders in fiber-to-the-premise TV, voice, and internet services, we’re not just focused on expanding our networks—we’re focused on enriching the lives of those we serve.

We value our associates because they are the cornerstone of our success. By joining the Metronet family, you’re stepping into a rewarding career in technology with a company dedicated to your growth and success. We’re in it to win it, and a key part of our strategy is to strengthen our business-to-business technology sales team with talented and hard-working individuals who aspire to be the next generation of technology leaders.

Recognized as one of the Best Places to Work, we offer a competitive total compensation package, including 80% of medical premiums paid by the company, company-paid disability and life insurance, and a 401(k)-company match. Plus, enjoy discounted services within our coverage areas and thrive in a locally owned, friendly, and fun atmosphere.

Discover more with Metronet — a company where your success builds stronger communities, and your future is limitless.

Metronet is an equal opportunity employer. We will not discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity, race, gender, religion, age, national origin, color, disability, or veteran status. EOE/Minority/Female/Disabled/Veteran

  • Contribute to 24x7 NOC operations through on-call availability and documented escalation procedures
  • Assist in maintaining network stability, performance, and security across CLIENT's geographically distributed enterprise environment

  • Collaborate with infrastructure, platform, and cloud teams to ensure reliable connectivity and performance
  • Support network troubleshooting and resolution for cloud-connected services and hybrid environments

  • Follow and contribute to standard operating procedures for network tasks and escalation paths
  • Support cross-training efforts to ensure coverage continuity and team depth
  • Contribute to after-action reviews and Sprint Retrospectives with actionable improvement recommendations

  • Demonstrated experience in a Federal or private-sector enterprise environment of comparable scale and complexity
  • Proven ability to independently resolve complex network problems at the enterprise level
  • Experience supporting hybrid on-premises and cloud network environments
  • Experience executing enterprise network changes in accordance with formal change management processes

  • Enterprise LAN/WAN architecture and operations
  • Routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP)
  • Switching technologies (VLANs, STP, port aggregation)
  • Wireless enterprise networking
  • SD-WAN operations and support
  • Network security fabric and firewall management
  • Working knowledge of:
  • AWS and Azure cloud networking
  • Zero Trust Network Architecture
  • Network monitoring and event management tools
  • ITSM platforms (e.g., ServiceNow)
  • Network automation tools and scripting

Job Title

Senior Network Engineer - VXLAN

About The Role

Join a highly technical engineering team responsible for designing and evolving large-scale network infrastructure supporting critical technology environments. In this role, you’ll work across data center networking, security, cloud connectivity, SDN, and network automation while helping drive new technologies from proof of concept through production adoption.

You’ll have the opportunity to solve complex networking challenges, influence architecture decisions, automate infrastructure delivery, and serve as a technical mentor to other engineers.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and deliver highly available data center, network security, cloud connectivity, SDN, and automation solutions.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and vendor solutions through technical assessments and proofs of concept.
  • Design and support complex multi-data-center and multi-tenant network architectures.
  • Engineer underlay and overlay architectures using technologies such as BGP, EVPN, VXLAN, MPLS, and VRF.
  • Develop and manage advanced routing policies, including complex BGP route manipulation.
  • Support Internet connectivity, public IP management, peering, and DDoS protection.
  • Automate network provisioning and configuration using Python, Ansible, Jinja, APIs, YAML, JSON, and related tools.
  • Partner with infrastructure, cloud, security, and application teams to drive adoption of new network capabilities.
  • Troubleshoot complex network performance, routing, availability, and connectivity issues.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to other engineers.

Experience You’ll Need To Have

  • 6+ years of experience designing, deploying, and supporting complex enterprise or data center networks.
  • 5+ years of experience supporting multi-data-center and/or multi-tenant environments.
  • Strong expertise with BGP and dynamic routing, including complex routing policies and route manipulation.
  • Experience designing highly available underlay and overlay networks, including MPLS, EVPN, and VXLAN.

descriptionHtml:
Join Aristocrat, a global leader in regulated gaming entertainment, where innovation, reliability, and alignment to regulations are essential to our operations. As a Network Engineer III in the Aristocrat Service Center supporting Class II operations, you will develop and maintain the network framework. This framework supports mid-tier gaming operations. This position offers an outstanding opportunity to work in a highly regulated, 24x7 production environment. You will direct network builds and operational plans across our data centers and customer locations. Your knowledge will ensure the smooth performance and security of our vital systems, greatly influencing our worldwide gaming networks.

What You'll Do
  • Construct, align, and improve secure, scalable network builds for Class II gaming systems.
  • Take ownership for network build decisions from start to finish across primary and secondary data centers as well as customer environments.
  • Serve as a senior technical resource for complex network and infrastructure challenges, driving solutions that improve reliability, performance, and operational efficiency.
  • Define technical standards, reference architectures, and guidelines applicable to networking of Class II devices.
  • Maintain uptime, fault resistance, and efficiency of vital Class II network infrastructure.
  • Lead complex triage efforts across routing, VPNs, firewalls, and Multi Site networks.
  • Build and maintain resilient network infrastructures aligned with cybersecurity guidelines and gaming regulatory requirements.
  • Lead network change planning and risk assessment within formal change and configuration management processes.
  • Partner with gaming regulators and internal compliance teams to ensure compliant system operation.
  • Lead technical execution of new site deployments, infrastructure upgrades, and network modernization efforts.

What We're Looking For
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.
  • Over 5 years of increasingly responsible experience assisting enterprise, datacenter, or service provider network environments.
  • Strong knowledge of routing, switching, TCP/IP, VLANs, NAT, DNS, and DHCP.
  • Experience crafting, implementing, and supporting BGP and IPSec VPN connectivity in production environments.
  • Hands-on experience coordinating enterprise firewall platforms, with Palo Alto Networks and Panorama experience highly valued.
  • Experience using network monitoring, diagnostics, and analytics platforms to maintain performance, availability, and reliability.
  • Demonstrated success supporting highly available, regulated, or critical environments.
  • Solid understanding of network security principles and experience implementing secure network architectures and segmentation strategies.
  • Ability to work independently, lead technical initiatives, and collaborate effectively across engineering and operational teams.
  • Ability to acquire required Tribal Gaming licenses, including background investigations and other licensing requirements as applicable.

Preferred Qualifications
  • 7+ years of network engineering experience.
  • Cisco CCNA, CCNP, Palo Alto PCNSE, or equivalent industry certifications.
  • Familiarity with SD-WAN technologies and deployments.
  • Experience deploying or supporting VXLAN and EVPN networking technologies.
  • Experience assisting enterprise datacenter environments.
  • Experience with automation and scripting tools such as Python or PowerShell.

This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat.

Compensation Philosophy

We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits.

Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

Why choose the College of Lake County for your next opportunity?

The College of Lake County (CLC) offers a competitive salary, excellent benefits that includes Blue Cross Blue Shield of Illinois health, Delta Dental and Superior Vision insurance plans, tuition support for employees and qualified family members, three retirement plans, disability, group and supplemental life insurance, health and dependent care flexible spending account plans, a compressed work week in the summer (Closed Fridays!), generous vacation, sick and personal time off and 14 paid holidays each year.

Some benefits will not be available for Part-Time or Part Time Staff Under 20 Hours (ex: health insurance).

We value candidates who bring language skills that help us better serve and connect with our diverse community. Bilingual English/Spanish proficiency is preferred but not required.

Position Title

Lead Network Engineer

Job Summary

The Lead Network Engineer is accountable for the strategic direction and operation of the College’s network and its components. The Network Engineer understands network technology and trends at a strategic level; is versant in implementing new technologies and protocols; architects, creates, maintains, upgrades, and monitors network systems for optimal availability and performance; and troubleshoots network issues at their root cause. This role reports to the Director, Core Systems and Infrastructure.

Job Description

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

Independently performs all of the following tasks or supervises others in the performance of all of the following tasks:

Systems Administration and Maintenance (50%)

  • Administers network systems to ensure optimal design, usage, security, performance, and availability.
  • Maintains, upgrades, and patches network components with minimal interruption to students, faculty, and staff.
  • Creates and maintains network documentation, such as network diagrams and systems configurations, processes and procedures.
  • Ensures best practices, processes, and techniques are used when administering technology solutions.
  • Consistently monitor network for integrity, performance, and availability.

Support and Consulting (20%)

  • Addresses issues at their root level, using creative problem-solving techniques to achieve high-quality, highly efficient, highly effective resolutions.
  • Proactively identifies potential issues and resolves them before they become an issue.
  • Appropriately escalates issues to vendors and other College teams after an appropriate time or when issues require further expertise.
  • Able to interact positively with both internal and external partners to achieve high satisfaction in both consulting and problem resolution situations
  • Accurately documents and maintains all support requests and efforts in the ticket management system.
  • Ensures support tickets are appropriately transferred, escalated, and closed.
  • Keeps customers updated on the status of their open incidents.
  • Ensures that customers are satisfied upon ticket closure.
